## File: scripts/build-wasm.mjs
````javascript
 1: #!/usr/bin/env node
 2: 
 3: /**
 4:  * Build the browser WebAssembly package without exposing a half-written
 5:  * `static/pkg` directory to the dev server.
 6:  *
 7:  * wasm-pack reads an existing output package before replacing it, and older
 8:  * wasm-pack releases cannot parse the newer `files: [...]` manifest they just
 9:  * generated. A fresh staging directory avoids that version-skew trap. Only a
10:  * successful build is copied over the live browser assets.
11:  */
12: 
13: import { cp, mkdir, mkdtemp, readdir, rm } from 'node:fs/promises';
14: import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
15: import { dirname, join, resolve } from 'node:path';
16: import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
17: import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
18: 
19: const root = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
20: const output = join(root, 'static', 'pkg');
21: const staging = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'vackrooms-wasm-'));
22: 
23: function run(command, args) {
24:   return new Promise((resolveRun, rejectRun) => {
25:     const child = spawn(command, args, { cwd: root, stdio: 'inherit' });
26:     child.once('error', rejectRun);
27:     child.once('exit', (code, signal) => {
28:       if (code === 0) resolveRun();
29:       else rejectRun(new Error(`${command} failed (${signal ?? `exit ${code}`})`));
30:     });
31:   });
32: }
33: 
34: try {
35:   await run('wasm-pack', [
36:     'build',
37:     'wasm_frontend',
38:     '--target',
39:     'web',
40:     '--release',
41:     '--out-dir',
42:     staging,
43:   ]);
44: 
45:   await mkdir(output, { recursive: true });
46:   for (const entry of await readdir(staging, { withFileTypes: true })) {
47:     await cp(join(staging, entry.name), join(output, entry.name), {
48:       force: true,
49:       recursive: entry.isDirectory(),
50:     });
51:   }
52: } finally {
53:   await rm(staging, { force: true, recursive: true });
54: }
````

````rust
  1: //! Rectilinear world geometry shared by every anomaly family.
  2: //!
  3: //! Anomalies are authored on an orthogonal lattice. Keeping the transforms in
  4: //! one small module makes that invariant visible: planners choose a footprint,
  5: //! while samplers only translate between world and footprint-local space.
  6: 
  7: use crate::entities::models::Position;
  8: 
  9: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, PartialOrd, Ord)]
 10: #[repr(u8)]
 11: pub enum Axis2 {
 12:     X = 0,
 13:     Z = 1,
 14: }
 15: 
 16: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, PartialOrd, Ord)]
 17: #[repr(u8)]
 18: pub enum AxisDirection {
 19:     Negative = 0,
 20:     Positive = 1,
 21: }
 22: 
 23: impl AxisDirection {
 24:     pub fn sign(self) -> f32 {
 25:         match self {
 26:             Self::Negative => -1.0,
 27:             Self::Positive => 1.0,
 28:         }
 29:     }
 30: }
 31: 
 32: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
 33: #[repr(u8)]
 34: pub enum QuarterTurn {
 35:     Zero = 0,
 36:     Clockwise = 1,
 37: }
 38: 
 39: /// Axis-aligned bounds in world X/Z. All anomaly footprints are rectangles
 40: /// rotated in 90-degree increments so construction remains rectilinear.
 41: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
 42: pub struct WorldBounds {
 43:     pub min_x: f32,
 44:     pub min_z: f32,
 45:     pub max_x: f32,
 46:     pub max_z: f32,
 47: }
 48: 
 49: impl WorldBounds {
 50:     pub fn new(min_x: f32, min_z: f32, max_x: f32, max_z: f32) -> Self {
 51:         Self {
 52:             min_x: min_x.min(max_x),
 53:             min_z: min_z.min(max_z),
 54:             max_x: min_x.max(max_x),
 55:             max_z: min_z.max(max_z),
 56:         }
 57:     }
 58: 
 59:     pub fn contains(&self, x: f32, z: f32) -> bool {
 60:         x >= self.min_x && x <= self.max_x && z >= self.min_z && z <= self.max_z
 61:     }
 62: 
 63:     pub fn intersects(&self, other: Self) -> bool {
 64:         self.min_x <= other.max_x
 65:             && self.max_x >= other.min_x
 66:             && self.min_z <= other.max_z
 67:             && self.max_z >= other.min_z
 68:     }
 69: 
 70:     pub fn expanded(self, margin: f32) -> Self {
 71:         Self::new(
 72:             self.min_x - margin,
 73:             self.min_z - margin,
 74:             self.max_x + margin,
 75:             self.max_z + margin,
 76:         )
 77:     }
 78: }
 79: 
 80: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
 81: pub struct OrthoBasis {
 82:     pub turn: QuarterTurn,
 83: }
 84: 
 85: impl OrthoBasis {
 86:     pub fn to_local(self, dx: f32, dz: f32) -> (f32, f32) {
 87:         match self.turn {
 88:             QuarterTurn::Zero => (dx, dz),
 89:             QuarterTurn::Clockwise => (dz, -dx),
 90:         }
 91:     }
 92: 
 93:     pub fn to_world(self, lx: f32, lz: f32) -> (f32, f32) {
 94:         match self.turn {
 95:             QuarterTurn::Zero => (lx, lz),
 96:             QuarterTurn::Clockwise => (-lz, lx),
 97:         }
 98:     }
 99: 
100:     pub fn local_axis_in_world(self, axis: Axis2) -> Axis2 {
101:         match (self.turn, axis) {
102:             (QuarterTurn::Zero, a) => a,
103:             (QuarterTurn::Clockwise, Axis2::X) => Axis2::Z,
104:             (QuarterTurn::Clockwise, Axis2::Z) => Axis2::X,
105:         }
106:     }
107: }
108: 
109: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
110: pub struct OrientedFootprint {
111:     pub center: Position,
112:     /// Half extents in the instance's local coordinates.
113:     pub half_x: f32,
114:     pub half_z: f32,
115:     pub basis: OrthoBasis,
116: }
117: 
118: impl OrientedFootprint {
119:     pub fn local_coords(&self, wx: f32, wz: f32) -> (f32, f32) {
120:         self.basis.to_local(wx - self.center.x, wz - self.center.z)
121:     }
122: 
123:     pub fn world_coords(&self, lx: f32, lz: f32) -> Position {
124:         let (dx, dz) = self.basis.to_world(lx, lz);
125:         Position::new(self.center.x + dx, self.center.z + dz)
126:     }
127: 
128:     pub fn contains(&self, wx: f32, wz: f32) -> bool {
129:         let (x, z) = self.local_coords(wx, wz);
130:         x.abs() <= self.half_x && z.abs() <= self.half_z
131:     }
132: 
133:     pub fn boundary_distance(&self, wx: f32, wz: f32) -> f32 {
134:         let (x, z) = self.local_coords(wx, wz);
135:         (self.half_x - x.abs()).min(self.half_z - z.abs())
136:     }
137: 
138:     pub fn normalized_depth(&self, wx: f32, wz: f32) -> f32 {
139:         (self.boundary_distance(wx, wz) / self.half_x.min(self.half_z).max(0.001)).clamp(0.0, 1.0)
140:     }
141: 
142:     pub fn bounds(&self) -> WorldBounds {
143:         let (hx, hz) = match self.basis.turn {
144:             QuarterTurn::Zero => (self.half_x, self.half_z),
145:             QuarterTurn::Clockwise => (self.half_z, self.half_x),
146:         };
147:         WorldBounds::new(
148:             self.center.x - hx,
149:             self.center.z - hz,
150:             self.center.x + hx,
151:             self.center.z + hz,
152:         )
153:     }
154: }
155: 
156: pub(super) fn decode_axis(value: u32) -> Option<Axis2> {
157:     match value {
158:         0 => Some(Axis2::X),
159:         1 => Some(Axis2::Z),
160:         _ => None,
161:     }
162: }
163: 
164: pub(super) fn decode_direction(value: u32) -> Option<AxisDirection> {
165:     match value {
166:         0 => Some(AxisDirection::Negative),
167:         1 => Some(AxisDirection::Positive),
168:         _ => None,
169:     }
170: }
````

````rust
  1: //! Immutable anomaly instances and family-specific authored parameters.
  2: //!
  3: //! Placement belongs to the planner. Once an instance exists, this module
  4: //! provides only deterministic geometry queries derived from its stable data.
  5: 
  6: use crate::entities::models::Position;
  7: 
  8: use super::geometry::{OrientedFootprint, OrthoBasis, WorldBounds};
  9: use super::mix64;
 10: use super::reality::{AnomalyStateStamp, RealitySnapshot};
 11: use super::traversal::{PitHazard, TraversalGate};
 12: 
 13: pub type AnomalyId = u64;
 14: 
 15: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, PartialOrd, Ord)]
 16: #[repr(u8)]
 17: pub enum AnomalyKind {
 18:     PillarExpanse = 0,
 19:     BlackoutExpanse = 1,
 20:     PitLattice = 2,
 21:     RedRoom = 3,
 22:     /// Stable pale arch-room anchor. Never carries gates, epochs, or wake
 23:     /// mutation: the fixed landmark the mutable world is measured against.
 24:     ArchwayRoom = 4,
 25: }
 26: 
 27: pub(super) fn decode_kind(value: u32) -> Option<AnomalyKind> {
 28:     match value {
 29:         0 => Some(AnomalyKind::PillarExpanse),
 30:         1 => Some(AnomalyKind::BlackoutExpanse),
 31:         2 => Some(AnomalyKind::PitLattice),
 32:         3 => Some(AnomalyKind::RedRoom),
 33:         4 => Some(AnomalyKind::ArchwayRoom),
 34:         _ => None,
 35:     }
 36: }
 37: 
 38: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
 39: pub struct PillarLattice {
 40:     pub bay_x: f32,
 41:     pub bay_z: f32,
 42:     pub phase_x: f32,
 43:     pub phase_z: f32,
 44:     pub min_side: f32,
 45:     pub max_side: f32,
 46:     pub variation_seed: u64,
 47: }
 48: 
 49: impl PillarLattice {
 50:     /// Variable wallpapered piers, always snapped to the shared 0.4u plan
 51:     /// lattice. Entry regularity comes from placement, not a fixed size.
 52:     pub fn pillar_size(&self, cell_x: i64, cell_z: i64) -> f32 {
 53:         let hash = mix64(
 54:             self.variation_seed
 55:                 ^ (cell_x as u64).wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15)
 56:                 ^ (cell_z as u64).rotate_left(29),
 57:         );
 58:         let steps = (((self.max_side - self.min_side) / 0.4).round() as u64).max(1);
 59:         let step = (hash % (steps + 1)) as f32;
 60:         (self.min_side + 0.4 * step).clamp(self.min_side, self.max_side)
 61:     }
 62: }
 63: 
 64: /// The two authored arch-room layouts.
 65: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
 66: #[repr(u8)]
 67: pub enum ArchLayout {
 68:     /// Circulation-to-anomaly airlock: arch rhythm on both long walls.
 69:     Transition = 0,
 70:     /// Dead-end composition: one entrance arch, an alcove band at the far
 71:     /// end, blind arcade rhythm along the long walls.
 72:     DeadEnd = 1,
 73: }
 74: 
 75: /// Arch-room composition parameters, all snapped to the 0.4u plan lattice.
 76: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
 77: pub struct ArchProfile {
 78:     pub layout: ArchLayout,
 79:     /// Center-to-center rhythm of arch openings along the long (local X) walls.
 80:     pub bay: f32,
 81:     /// Clear width of one arch opening.
 82:     pub opening: f32,
 83:     /// Every `blind_every`-th arch is blind (a shelter niche reads as a
 84:     /// skipped opening in the same rhythm).
 85:     pub blind_every: u8,
 86: }
 87: 
 88: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
 89: pub struct PitLattice {

 91:     pub spacing_z: f32,
 92:     pub phase_x: f32,
 93:     pub phase_z: f32,
 94:     pub side: f32,
 95:     pub depth: f32,
 96: }
 97: 
 98: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
 99: pub struct AnomalyInstance {
100:     pub id: AnomalyId,
101:     pub kind: AnomalyKind,
102:     pub footprint: OrientedFootprint,
103:     pub basis: OrthoBasis,
104:     pub macro_anchor: (i64, i64),
105:     pub pillar_lattice: Option<PillarLattice>,
106:     pub pit_lattice: Option<PitLattice>,
107:     pub arch: Option<ArchProfile>,
108:     pub gates: Vec<TraversalGate>,
109:     /// Epoch-invariant internal route half-width.
110:     pub skeleton_half_width: f32,
111:     /// Boundary depth kept regular before corruption/remapping begins.
112:     pub entry_band: f32,
113: }
114: 
115: impl AnomalyInstance {
116:     pub fn contains(&self, x: f32, z: f32) -> bool {
117:         self.footprint.contains(x, z)
118:     }
119: 
120:     pub fn local_coords(&self, x: f32, z: f32) -> (f32, f32) {

122:     }
123: 
124:     pub fn world_coords(&self, x: f32, z: f32) -> Position {
125:         self.footprint.world_coords(x, z)
126:     }
127: 
128:     pub fn boundary_distance(&self, x: f32, z: f32) -> f32 {
129:         self.footprint.boundary_distance(x, z)
130:     }
131: 
132:     pub fn normalized_depth(&self, x: f32, z: f32) -> f32 {
133:         self.footprint.normalized_depth(x, z)
134:     }
135: 
136:     pub fn state<'a>(&self, reality: &'a RealitySnapshot) -> Option<&'a AnomalyStateStamp> {
137:         reality.lookup(self.id)
138:     }
139: 
140:     pub fn traversal_gates(&self) -> &[TraversalGate] {
141:         &self.gates
142:     }
143: 
144:     pub fn pillar_size(&self, cell_x: i64, cell_z: i64) -> Option<f32> {
145:         self.pillar_lattice
146:             .map(|lattice| lattice.pillar_size(cell_x, cell_z))
147:     }
148: 
149:     pub fn pit_hazards_for_bounds(&self, bounds: WorldBounds) -> Vec<PitHazard> {
150:         let Some(lattice) = self.pit_lattice else {
151:             return Vec::new();
152:         };
153:         let corners = [
154:             self.local_coords(bounds.min_x, bounds.min_z),
155:             self.local_coords(bounds.min_x, bounds.max_z),
156:             self.local_coords(bounds.max_x, bounds.min_z),
157:             self.local_coords(bounds.max_x, bounds.max_z),
158:         ];
159:         let min_lx = corners
160:             .iter()
161:             .map(|point| point.0)
162:             .fold(f32::INFINITY, f32::min);
163:         let max_lx = corners
164:             .iter()
165:             .map(|point| point.0)
166:             .fold(f32::NEG_INFINITY, f32::max);
167:         let min_lz = corners
168:             .iter()
169:             .map(|point| point.1)
170:             .fold(f32::INFINITY, f32::min);
171:         let max_lz = corners
172:             .iter()
173:             .map(|point| point.1)
174:             .fold(f32::NEG_INFINITY, f32::max);
175:         let ix0 = ((min_lx - lattice.phase_x) / lattice.spacing_x).floor() as i64 - 1;
176:         let ix1 = ((max_lx - lattice.phase_x) / lattice.spacing_x).ceil() as i64 + 1;
177:         let iz0 = ((min_lz - lattice.phase_z) / lattice.spacing_z).floor() as i64 - 1;
178:         let iz1 = ((max_lz - lattice.phase_z) / lattice.spacing_z).ceil() as i64 + 1;
179: 
180:         let mut hazards = Vec::new();
181:         for iz in iz0..=iz1 {
182:             for ix in ix0..=ix1 {
183:                 let lx = lattice.phase_x + ix as f32 * lattice.spacing_x;
184:                 let lz = lattice.phase_z + iz as f32 * lattice.spacing_z;
185:                 let center = self.world_coords(lx, lz);
186:                 if !self.contains(center.x, center.z)
187:                     || self.boundary_distance(center.x, center.z) < lattice.side
188:                     || !bounds.expanded(lattice.side).contains(center.x, center.z)
189:                 {
190:                     continue;
191:                 }
192:                 // The immutable center lane remains solid and navigable.
193:                 if lz.abs() < self.skeleton_half_width + lattice.side {
194:                     continue;
195:                 }
196:                 // The center between four pits is deterministically clear even
197:                 // when pit side and spacing vary between instances.
198:                 let recovery =
199:                     self.world_coords(lx + lattice.spacing_x * 0.5, lz + lattice.spacing_z * 0.5);
200:                 let id = mix64(self.id ^ (ix as u64).rotate_left(17) ^ (iz as u64).rotate_left(43));
201:                 hazards.push(PitHazard {
202:                     id,
203:                     instance_id: self.id,
204:                     center,
205:                     half_side: lattice.side * 0.5,
206:                     depth: lattice.depth,
207:                     recovery,
208:                 });
209:             }
210:         }
211:         hazards.sort_by_key(|hazard| hazard.id);
212:         hazards.dedup_by_key(|hazard| hazard.id);
213:         hazards
214:     }
215: }
````

````rust
  1: //! Immutable encounter state and its deterministic transition reducer.
  2: //!
  3: //! A snapshot is request identity: workers receive it by value and generate a
  4: //! complete chunk from that exact reality. Gate interpretation is concentrated
  5: //! here so geometry sampling never mutates ambient state.
  6: 
  7: use std::collections::BTreeMap;
  8: 
  9: use super::geometry::{Axis2, AxisDirection, decode_axis, decode_direction};
 10: use super::mix64;

 12: use super::traversal::{TraversalGate, TraversalGateKind};

 14: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, PartialOrd, Ord)]
 15: #[repr(u8)]
 16: pub enum RedRoomPhase {
 17:     Outside = 0,
 18:     Sealed = 1,
 19:     EscapeOpen = 2,
 20: }
 21: 
 22: impl Default for RedRoomPhase {
 23:     fn default() -> Self {
 24:         Self::Outside
 25:     }

 28: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, PartialOrd, Ord)]
 29: pub struct AnomalyStateStamp {
 30:     pub instance_id: AnomalyId,
 31:     pub epoch: u32,
 32:     pub gate_plane_milli: i32,
 33:     pub gate_axis: Axis2,
 34:     pub travel_direction: AxisDirection,

 36:     pub loop_count: u8,

 38: }
 39: 
 40: impl AnomalyStateStamp {
 41:     #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
 42:     pub fn new(
 43:         instance_id: AnomalyId,
 44:         epoch: u32,
 45:         gate_plane: f32,
 46:         gate_axis: Axis2,
 47:         travel_direction: AxisDirection,
 48:         phase: RedRoomPhase,
 49:         loop_count: u8,
 50:         last_gate_id: u64,
 51:     ) -> Self {
 52:         Self {
 53:             instance_id,
 54:             epoch,
 55:             gate_plane_milli: (gate_plane * 1000.0).round() as i32,
 56:             gate_axis,
 57:             travel_direction,
 58:             phase,
 59:             loop_count,
 60:             last_gate_id,
 61:         }
 62:     }
 63:

 66:     }
 67: 
 68:     pub fn point_is_in_wake(&self, x: f32, z: f32, min_distance: f32) -> bool {
 69:         let coordinate = match self.gate_axis {
 70:             Axis2::X => x,
 71:             Axis2::Z => z,
 72:         };
 73:         match self.travel_direction {
 74:             AxisDirection::Positive => coordinate < self.gate_plane() - min_distance,
 75:             AxisDirection::Negative => coordinate > self.gate_plane() + min_distance,
 76:         }
 77:     }

 80: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
 81: pub struct RealitySnapshot {
 82:     stamps: Vec<AnomalyStateStamp>,
 83: }

 85: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
 86: pub enum RealitySnapshotDecodeError {
 87:     Header,
 88:     Length,
 89:     Value,
 90:     Fingerprint,
 91: }
 92: 
 93: /// The mutable values of one stamp while a single gate event is reduced.
 94: /// Location/direction metadata comes from the event and is written afterwards.
 95: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
 96: struct TransitionState {
 97:     epoch: u32,
 98:     phase: RedRoomPhase,
 99:     loop_count: u8,
100: }
101: 
102: impl TransitionState {
103:     fn before(existing: Option<&AnomalyStateStamp>, first_epoch: u32) -> Self {
104:         existing.map_or(
105:             Self {
106:                 epoch: first_epoch,
107:                 phase: RedRoomPhase::Outside,
108:                 loop_count: 0,
109:             },
110:             |stamp| Self {
111:                 epoch: stamp.epoch,
112:                 phase: stamp.phase,
113:                 loop_count: stamp.loop_count,
114:             },
115:         )
116:     }
117: }
118: 
119: /// Remap gates always commit a new geometry epoch while retaining any
120: /// red-room phase information already associated with the instance.
121: fn advance_remap(mut state: TransitionState, next_epoch: u32) -> TransitionState {
122:     state.epoch = next_epoch;
123:     state
124: }
125: 
126: /// The inner red threshold seals only in its authored forward direction.
127: fn advance_red_threshold(
128:     mut state: TransitionState,
129:     next_epoch: u32,
130:     direction: AxisDirection,
131:     forward: AxisDirection,
132: ) -> TransitionState {
133:     if direction == forward {
134:         state.phase = RedRoomPhase::Sealed;
135:         state.epoch = next_epoch;
136:     }
137:     state
138: }
139: 
140: /// A loop crossing matters only after commitment. Three accepted crossings
141: /// expose the escape while each accepted crossing advances the geometry epoch.
142: fn advance_red_loop(mut state: TransitionState, next_epoch: u32) -> TransitionState {
143:     if state.phase == RedRoomPhase::Sealed {
144:         state.loop_count = state.loop_count.saturating_add(1);
145:         if state.loop_count >= 3 {
146:             state.phase = RedRoomPhase::EscapeOpen;
147:         }
148:         state.epoch = next_epoch;
149:     }
150:     state
151: }
152: 
153: /// RedEscape is currently observational: crossing it records event metadata
154: /// without changing phase or epoch. Keeping the no-op named makes that part of
155: /// the v2 behavior explicit until the encounter design assigns an exit effect.
156: fn advance_red_escape(state: TransitionState) -> TransitionState {
157:     state
158: }
159: 
160: fn transition_for(
161:     gate: &TraversalGate,
162:     direction: AxisDirection,
163:     existing: Option<&AnomalyStateStamp>,
164:     next_epoch: u32,
165: ) -> TransitionState {
166:     let state = TransitionState::before(existing, next_epoch);
167:     match gate.kind {
168:         TraversalGateKind::Remap => advance_remap(state, next_epoch),
169:         TraversalGateKind::RedThreshold => {
170:             advance_red_threshold(state, next_epoch, direction, gate.forward)
171:         }
172:         TraversalGateKind::RedLoop => advance_red_loop(state, next_epoch),
173:         TraversalGateKind::RedEscape => advance_red_escape(state),
174:     }
175: }
176: 
177: impl RealitySnapshot {
178:     const MAGIC: u32 = 0x5254_5902; // "RTY" v2
179:     const STAMP_WORDS: usize = 7;
180: 
181:     pub fn empty() -> Self {
182:         Self::default()
183:     }
184: 
185:     pub fn new(stamps: Vec<AnomalyStateStamp>) -> Self {
186:         let mut by_id: BTreeMap<AnomalyId, AnomalyStateStamp> = BTreeMap::new();
187:         for stamp in stamps {
188:             by_id
189:                 .entry(stamp.instance_id)
190:                 .and_modify(|old| {
191:                     if stamp > *old {
192:                         *old = stamp;
193:                     }
194:                 })
195:                 .or_insert(stamp);
196:         }
197:         Self {
198:             stamps: by_id.into_values().collect(),
199:         }
200:     }
201: 
202:     pub fn stamps(&self) -> &[AnomalyStateStamp] {
203:         &self.stamps
204:     }
205: 
206:     pub fn lookup(&self, id: AnomalyId) -> Option<&AnomalyStateStamp> {
207:         self.stamps
208:             .binary_search_by_key(&id, |stamp| stamp.instance_id)
209:             .ok()
210:             .map(|index| &self.stamps[index])
211:     }
212: 
213:     pub fn with_advanced_gate(&self, gate: &TraversalGate, direction: AxisDirection) -> Self {
214:         let existing = self.lookup(gate.instance_id);
215:         // Streaming can report the same crossing more than once, so an
216:         // identical gate+direction event is idempotent.  The opposite
217:         // direction is a real traversal, however: a Red Room loop advances
218:         // by walking back and forth through its one authored checkpoint.
219:         if existing.is_some_and(|stamp| {
220:             gate.id == stamp.last_gate_id && direction == stamp.travel_direction
221:         }) {
222:             return self.clone();
223:         }
224: 
225:         // Epoch is the snapshot-wide encounter revision, not a per-instance
226:         // counter. That makes the most recently entered recursive Red Room
227:         // unambiguous even when a child encounter has a different stable id.
228:         let next_epoch = self
229:             .stamps
230:             .iter()
231:             .map(|stamp| stamp.epoch)
232:             .max()
233:             .unwrap_or(0)
234:             .saturating_add(1);
235:         let next = transition_for(gate, direction, existing, next_epoch);
236:         let mut stamps = self.stamps.clone();
237:         stamps.retain(|stamp| stamp.instance_id != gate.instance_id);
238:         stamps.push(AnomalyStateStamp::new(
239:             gate.instance_id,
240:             next.epoch,
241:             gate.plane,
242:             gate.axis,
243:             direction,
244:             next.phase,
245:             next.loop_count,
246:             gate.id,
247:         ));
248:         Self::new(stamps)
249:     }
250: 
251:     fn hash_words(words: &[u32]) -> u64 {
252:         let mut hash = 0xCBF2_9CE4_8422_2325u64;
253:         for &word in words {
254:             hash ^= word as u64;
255:             hash = hash.wrapping_mul(0x100_0000_01B3);
256:         }
257:         mix64(hash)
258:     }
259: 
260:     pub fn fingerprint(&self) -> u64 {
261:         let words = self.words_without_fingerprint();
262:         Self::hash_words(&words)
263:     }
264: 
265:     fn words_without_fingerprint(&self) -> Vec<u32> {
266:         let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(2 + self.stamps.len() * Self::STAMP_WORDS);
267:         out.push(Self::MAGIC);
268:         out.push(self.stamps.len() as u32);
269:         for stamp in &self.stamps {
270:             out.extend_from_slice(&[
271:                 stamp.instance_id as u32,
272:                 (stamp.instance_id >> 32) as u32,
273:                 stamp.epoch,
274:                 stamp.gate_plane_milli as u32,
275:                 (stamp.gate_axis as u32)
276:                     | ((stamp.travel_direction as u32) << 8)
277:                     | ((stamp.phase as u32) << 16)
278:                     | ((stamp.loop_count as u32) << 24),
279:                 stamp.last_gate_id as u32,
280:                 (stamp.last_gate_id >> 32) as u32,
281:             ]);
282:         }
283:         out
284:     }
285: 
286:     pub fn to_words(&self) -> Vec<u32> {
287:         let mut out = self.words_without_fingerprint();
288:         let fingerprint = Self::hash_words(&out);
289:         out.push(fingerprint as u32);
290:         out.push((fingerprint >> 32) as u32);
291:         out
292:     }
293: 
294:     pub fn from_words(words: &[u32]) -> Result<Self, RealitySnapshotDecodeError> {
295:         if words.len() < 4 || words[0] != Self::MAGIC {
296:             return Err(RealitySnapshotDecodeError::Header);
297:         }
298:         let count = words[1] as usize;
299:         let body_len = 2 + count.saturating_mul(Self::STAMP_WORDS);
300:         if words.len() != body_len + 2 {
301:             return Err(RealitySnapshotDecodeError::Length);
302:         }
303:         let expected = words[body_len] as u64 | ((words[body_len + 1] as u64) << 32);
304:         if Self::hash_words(&words[..body_len]) != expected {
305:             return Err(RealitySnapshotDecodeError::Fingerprint);
306:         }
307: 
308:         let mut stamps = Vec::with_capacity(count);
309:         for chunk in words[2..body_len].chunks_exact(Self::STAMP_WORDS) {
310:             stamps.push(AnomalyStateStamp {
311:                 instance_id: chunk[0] as u64 | ((chunk[1] as u64) << 32),
312:                 epoch: chunk[2],
313:                 gate_plane_milli: chunk[3] as i32,
314:                 gate_axis: decode_axis(chunk[4] & 0xff).ok_or(RealitySnapshotDecodeError::Value)?,
315:                 travel_direction: decode_direction((chunk[4] >> 8) & 0xff)
316:                     .ok_or(RealitySnapshotDecodeError::Value)?,
317:                 phase: decode_phase((chunk[4] >> 16) & 0xff)
318:                     .ok_or(RealitySnapshotDecodeError::Value)?,
319:                 loop_count: ((chunk[4] >> 24) & 0xff) as u8,
320:                 last_gate_id: chunk[5] as u64 | ((chunk[6] as u64) << 32),
321:             });
322:         }
323:         let decoded = Self::new(stamps);
324:         if decoded.to_words() != words {
325:             return Err(RealitySnapshotDecodeError::Value);
326:         }
327:         Ok(decoded)
328:     }
329: }
330: 
331: fn decode_phase(value: u32) -> Option<RedRoomPhase> {
332:     match value {
333:         0 => Some(RedRoomPhase::Outside),
334:         1 => Some(RedRoomPhase::Sealed),
335:         2 => Some(RedRoomPhase::EscapeOpen),
336:         _ => None,
337:     }
338: }
````

## File: src/domain/entities/anomaly/traversal.rs
````rust
  1: //! Semantic crossings and hazards exported beside generated voxel geometry.
  2: //!
  3: //! These records describe interaction surfaces; they do not decide how a
  4: //! reality changes. The application detects a crossing, then the reality
  5: //! reducer interprets it as a deterministic state transition.
  6: 
  7: use crate::entities::models::Position;
  8: 
  9: use super::geometry::{Axis2, AxisDirection, WorldBounds, decode_axis, decode_direction};
 10: use super::phenomena::{AnomalyId, AnomalyKind, decode_kind};
 11: 
 12: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
 13: #[repr(u8)]
 14: pub enum TraversalGateKind {
 15:     Remap = 0,
 16:     RedThreshold = 1,
 17:     RedLoop = 2,
 18:     RedEscape = 3,
 19: }
 20: 
 21: /// A semantic plane crossing. `span_*` lies on the perpendicular world axis.
 22: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
 23: pub struct TraversalGate {
 24:     pub id: u64,
 25:     pub instance_id: AnomalyId,
 26:     pub anomaly_kind: AnomalyKind,
 27:     pub kind: TraversalGateKind,
 28:     pub axis: Axis2,
 29:     pub plane: f32,
 30:     pub span_min: f32,
 31:     pub span_max: f32,
 32:     /// For directional thresholds (red rooms), the authored inward direction.
 33:     pub forward: AxisDirection,
 34:     pub affected_bounds: WorldBounds,
 35: }
 36: 
 37: impl TraversalGate {
 38:     /// Returns traversal direction when a movement segment crosses the plane
 39:     /// inside its span. Merely touching or moving parallel does not fire.
 40:     pub fn crossing(&self, old: [f32; 2], new: [f32; 2]) -> Option<AxisDirection> {
 41:         let (a0, a1, b0, b1) = match self.axis {
 42:             Axis2::X => (old[0], new[0], old[1], new[1]),
 43:             Axis2::Z => (old[1], new[1], old[0], new[0]),
 44:         };
 45:         let delta = a1 - a0;
 46:         if delta.abs() < 1e-6 {
 47:             return None;
 48:         }
 49:         let t = (self.plane - a0) / delta;
 50:         if !(0.0 < t && t <= 1.0) {
 51:             return None;
 52:         }
 53:         let across = b0 + (b1 - b0) * t;
 54:         if across < self.span_min || across > self.span_max {
 55:             return None;
 56:         }
 57:         Some(if delta > 0.0 {
 58:             AxisDirection::Positive
 59:         } else {
 60:             AxisDirection::Negative
 61:         })
 62:     }
 63: 
 64:     pub const WORDS: usize = 15;
 65: 
 66:     pub fn to_words(self) -> [u32; Self::WORDS] {
 67:         [
 68:             self.id as u32,
 69:             (self.id >> 32) as u32,
 70:             self.instance_id as u32,
 71:             (self.instance_id >> 32) as u32,
 72:             self.anomaly_kind as u32,
 73:             self.kind as u32,
 74:             self.axis as u32,
 75:             self.plane.to_bits(),
 76:             self.span_min.to_bits(),
 77:             self.span_max.to_bits(),
 78:             self.forward as u32,
 79:             self.affected_bounds.min_x.to_bits(),
 80:             self.affected_bounds.min_z.to_bits(),
 81:             self.affected_bounds.max_x.to_bits(),
 82:             self.affected_bounds.max_z.to_bits(),
 83:         ]
 84:     }
 85: 
 86:     pub fn from_words(words: &[u32]) -> Option<Self> {
 87:         if words.len() != Self::WORDS {
 88:             return None;
 89:         }
 90:         Some(Self {
 91:             id: words[0] as u64 | ((words[1] as u64) << 32),
 92:             instance_id: words[2] as u64 | ((words[3] as u64) << 32),
 93:             anomaly_kind: decode_kind(words[4])?,
 94:             kind: match words[5] {
 95:                 0 => TraversalGateKind::Remap,
 96:                 1 => TraversalGateKind::RedThreshold,
 97:                 2 => TraversalGateKind::RedLoop,
 98:                 3 => TraversalGateKind::RedEscape,
 99:                 _ => return None,
100:             },
101:             axis: decode_axis(words[6])?,
102:             plane: f32::from_bits(words[7]),
103:             span_min: f32::from_bits(words[8]),
104:             span_max: f32::from_bits(words[9]),
105:             forward: decode_direction(words[10])?,
106:             affected_bounds: WorldBounds::new(
107:                 f32::from_bits(words[11]),
108:                 f32::from_bits(words[12]),
109:                 f32::from_bits(words[13]),
110:                 f32::from_bits(words[14]),
111:             ),
112:         })
113:     }
114: }

117: pub struct PitHazard {
118:     pub id: u64,
119:     pub instance_id: AnomalyId,
120:     pub center: Position,
121:     pub half_side: f32,
122:     pub depth: f32,
123:     pub recovery: Position,

125: 
126: impl PitHazard {
127:     pub fn contains(&self, x: f32, z: f32) -> bool {
128:         (x - self.center.x).abs() < self.half_side && (z - self.center.z).abs() < self.half_side
129:     }
130: 
131:     pub const TRANSPORT_WORDS: usize = 10;
132: 
133:     pub fn write_words(self, out: &mut Vec<u32>) {
134:         out.extend_from_slice(&[
135:             self.id as u32,
136:             (self.id >> 32) as u32,
137:             self.instance_id as u32,
138:             (self.instance_id >> 32) as u32,
139:             self.center.x.to_bits(),
140:             self.center.z.to_bits(),
141:             self.half_side.to_bits(),
142:             self.depth.to_bits(),
143:             self.recovery.x.to_bits(),
144:             self.recovery.z.to_bits(),
145:         ]);
146:     }
147: 
148:     pub fn from_transport_words(words: &[u32]) -> Option<Self> {
149:         if words.len() != Self::TRANSPORT_WORDS {
150:             return None;
151:         }
152:         Some(Self {
153:             id: words[0] as u64 | ((words[1] as u64) << 32),
154:             instance_id: words[2] as u64 | ((words[3] as u64) << 32),
155:             center: Position::new(f32::from_bits(words[4]), f32::from_bits(words[5])),
156:             half_side: f32::from_bits(words[6]),
157:             depth: f32::from_bits(words[7]),
158:             recovery: Position::new(f32::from_bits(words[8]), f32::from_bits(words[9])),
159:         })
160:     }
161: }
````

````rust
 5: /// Anomaly controls are separate from ordinary office-fabric tuning: changing
 6: /// wall or light density must never silently change encounter frequency.
 7: /// Multipliers are centered on `1.0`; distances are world units.

 9: pub struct AnomalyTuning {
10:     /// Overall organic candidate frequency. Debug forcing remains independent.
````

## File: src/use_cases/anomalies/determinism.rs
````rust
 1: //! Shared deterministic primitives for anomaly planners.
 2: //!
 3: //! These helpers are intentionally integer-first. A candidate's identity must
 4: //! depend on the world seed and its stable lattice anchor, never on which
 5: //! region or voxel chunk happened to request it.
 6: 
 7: use crate::domain::entities::anomaly::AnomalyKind;
 8: 
 9: pub(crate) const SNAP: f32 = 0.4;
10: 
11: pub(crate) fn snap(value: f32) -> f32 {
12:     (value / SNAP).round() * SNAP
13: }
14: 
15: pub(crate) fn mix64(mut value: u64) -> u64 {
16:     value ^= value >> 30;
17:     value = value.wrapping_mul(0xBF58_476D_1CE4_E5B9);
18:     value ^= value >> 27;
19:     value = value.wrapping_mul(0x94D0_49BB_1331_11EB);
20:     value ^ (value >> 31)
21: }
22: 
23: pub(crate) fn hash(seed: u32, salt: u64, x: i64, z: i64) -> u64 {
24:     mix64(
25:         seed as u64
26:             ^ salt
27:             ^ (x as u64).wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15)
28:             ^ (z as u64).rotate_left(31),
29:     )
30: }
31: 
32: pub(crate) fn unit(hash: u64) -> f32 {
33:     (hash >> 40) as f32 / (1u64 << 24) as f32
34: }
35: 
36: pub(crate) fn stable_id(seed: u32, kind: AnomalyKind, anchor_x: i64, anchor_z: i64) -> u64 {
37:     hash(
38:         seed,
39:         0xA110_4A1E_0000_0000 | kind as u64,
40:         anchor_x,
41:         anchor_z,
42:     )
43: }
````

## File: src/use_cases/anomalies/geometry.rs
````rust
  1: //! Column geometry for immutable, non-Red-Room anomaly families.
  2: //!
  3: //! The region planner decides *where* an anomaly exists. This module decides
  4: //! what one world-space column inside that immutable plan looks like. Red Rooms
  5: //! remain a separate encounter feature because their geometry is coupled to a
  6: //! dedicated phase machine and recursive Level 0 destination.
  7: 
  8: use crate::domain::entities::anomaly::{AnomalyInstance, AnomalyKind, ArchLayout, RealitySnapshot};
  9: use crate::domain::entities::environment::{EnvironmentProfile, FloorState};
 10: use crate::domain::entities::voxel_grid::{VOXEL_FLUID, VOXEL_GLIMMER, VOXEL_LIGHT};
 11: use crate::use_cases::backrooms_level::{BackroomsLevel, ColumnPlan};
 12: use crate::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig;
 13: use crate::use_cases::ports::NoiseProvider;
 14: use crate::use_cases::region_plan::PLAN_WALL_T;
 15: 
 16: const LIGHT_PERIOD: f32 = 2.8;
 17: 
 18: /// Mutable anomaly infill uses a stable content tile for its seam guard. The
 19: /// tile is a world-generation constant, never the size of an output request.
 20: const GENERATION_TILE_UNITS: f32 = 10.0;
 21: 
 22: struct SampleContext<'a> {
 23:     instance: &'a AnomalyInstance,
 24:     noise: &'a dyn NoiseProvider,
 25:     seed: u32,
 26:     config: &'a GeneratorConfig,
 27:     reality: &'a RealitySnapshot,
 28:     world_x: f32,
 29:     world_z: f32,
 30:     local_x: f32,
 31:     local_z: f32,
 32:     boundary: f32,
 33:     perimeter: bool,
 34:     skeleton: bool,
 35:     away_from_seam: bool,
 36: }
 37: 
 38: /// Sample one immutable macro anomaly or stable archway anchor.
 39: ///
 40: /// Corridors have already won composition priority before this function is
 41: /// called, so every family may assume its protected bearing route is the only
 42: /// remaining cross-cutting circulation concern. Blackout expanses delegate
 43: /// their substrate to the ordinary Level 0 fabric sampler before applying the
 44: /// anomaly profile.
 45: pub(crate) fn sample_anomaly(
 46:     instance: &AnomalyInstance,
 47:     noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
 48:     seed: u32,
 49:     config: &GeneratorConfig,
 50:     reality: &RealitySnapshot,
 51:     world_x: f32,
 52:     world_z: f32,
 53: ) -> ColumnPlan {
 54:     let (local_x, local_z) = instance.local_coords(world_x, world_z);
 55:     let boundary = instance.boundary_distance(world_x, world_z);
 56:     let seam_x = world_x.rem_euclid(GENERATION_TILE_UNITS);
 57:     let seam_z = world_z.rem_euclid(GENERATION_TILE_UNITS);
 58:     let context = SampleContext {
 59:         instance,
 60:         noise,
 61:         seed,
 62:         config,
 63:         reality,
 64:         world_x,
 65:         world_z,
 66:         local_x,
 67:         local_z,
 68:         boundary,
 69:         perimeter: boundary <= PLAN_WALL_T,
 70:         skeleton: local_z.abs() <= instance.skeleton_half_width,
 71:         away_from_seam: seam_x > PLAN_WALL_T * 2.0
 72:             && seam_x < GENERATION_TILE_UNITS - PLAN_WALL_T * 2.0
 73:             && seam_z > PLAN_WALL_T * 2.0
 74:             && seam_z < GENERATION_TILE_UNITS - PLAN_WALL_T * 2.0,
 75:     };
 76: 
 77:     match instance.kind {
 78:         AnomalyKind::PillarExpanse => sample_pillar_expanse(&context),
 79:         AnomalyKind::BlackoutExpanse => sample_blackout_expanse(&context),
 80:         AnomalyKind::PitLattice => sample_pit_lattice(&context),
 81:         AnomalyKind::ArchwayRoom => sample_archway_anchor(&context),
 82:         AnomalyKind::RedRoom => unreachable!("red rooms have a dedicated geometry sampler"),
 83:     }
 84: }
 85: 
 86: fn anomaly_hash(instance: &AnomalyInstance, epoch: u32, salt: u64, x: i64, z: i64) -> f32 {
 87:     let mut hash = instance.id
 88:         ^ salt
 89:         ^ (epoch as u64).rotate_left(19)
 90:         ^ (x as u64).wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15)
 91:         ^ (z as u64).rotate_left(37);
 92:     hash ^= hash >> 30;
 93:     hash = hash.wrapping_mul(0xBF58_476D_1CE4_E5B9);
 94:     hash ^= hash >> 27;
 95:     hash = hash.wrapping_mul(0x94D0_49BB_1331_11EB);
 96:     hash ^= hash >> 31;
 97:     (hash >> 40) as f32 / (1u64 << 24) as f32
 98: }
 99: 
100: fn remap_epoch(context: &SampleContext<'_>) -> Option<u32> {
101:     let state = context.instance.state(context.reality)?;
102:     (state.epoch > 0
103:         && context.boundary > context.instance.entry_band
104:         && state.point_is_in_wake(
105:             context.world_x,
106:             context.world_z,
107:             context.config.anomalies.remap_distance,
108:         ))
109:     .then_some(state.epoch)
110: }
111: 
112: fn sample_pillar_expanse(context: &SampleContext<'_>) -> ColumnPlan {
113:     let instance = context.instance;
114:     let tuning = &context.config.tuning;
115:     let (local_x, local_z) = (context.local_x, context.local_z);
116:     let lattice = instance.pillar_lattice.expect("pillar instance lattice");
117:     let cell_x = ((local_x - lattice.phase_x) / lattice.bay_x).floor() as i64;
118:     let cell_z = ((local_z - lattice.phase_z) / lattice.bay_z).floor() as i64;
119:     let mut within_x = (local_x - lattice.phase_x).rem_euclid(lattice.bay_x);
120:     let within_z = (local_z - lattice.phase_z).rem_euclid(lattice.bay_z);
121:     let mut side = instance.pillar_size(cell_x, cell_z).unwrap_or(1.2);
122: 
123:     // Distortion grows only after the entry has taught the player a regular
124:     // grid. The route and entry band therefore remain a reliable baseline.
125:     let budget = ((context.boundary - instance.entry_band) / (instance.entry_band.max(8.0) * 2.5))
126:         .clamp(0.0, 1.0);
127:     let immutable_zone = context.skeleton || budget <= 0.0;
128:     let mut dropped = false;
129:     if !immutable_zone {
130:         dropped = anomaly_hash(instance, 0, 0x11D0, cell_x, cell_z) < 0.10 * budget;
131:         if anomaly_hash(instance, 0, 0x11D1, cell_z, 0) < 0.30 * budget {
132:             within_x = (within_x + lattice.bay_x * 0.5).rem_euclid(lattice.bay_x);
133:         }
134:         if anomaly_hash(instance, 0, 0x11D2, cell_x, cell_z) < 0.08 * budget {
135:             side += 0.4;
136:         }
137:     }
138: 
139:     // A committed wake may change relationships between bays, but never at a
140:     // stable content-tile seam where resident reality cohorts meet.
141:     let wake_epoch = (!immutable_zone && context.away_from_seam)
142:         .then(|| remap_epoch(context))
143:         .flatten();
144:     if let Some(epoch) = wake_epoch {
145:         if anomaly_hash(instance, epoch, 0x11F4, cell_x, cell_z) < 0.25 {
146:             side += 0.4;
147:         }
148:         if anomaly_hash(instance, epoch, 0x11F5, cell_z, cell_x) < 0.35 {
149:             within_x = (within_x + 0.4).rem_euclid(lattice.bay_x);
150:         }
151:     }
152: 
153:     let dx = within_x.min(lattice.bay_x - within_x);
154:     let dz = within_z.min(lattice.bay_z - within_z);
155:     let mut solid = context.perimeter || (!dropped && dx < side * 0.5 && dz < side * 0.5);
156:     if !solid && let Some(epoch) = wake_epoch {
157:         let edge_x = within_x < PLAN_WALL_T || lattice.bay_x - within_x < PLAN_WALL_T;
158:         let edge_z = within_z < PLAN_WALL_T || lattice.bay_z - within_z < PLAN_WALL_T;
159:         let threshold = (0.12 * context.config.anomalies.remap_intensity).clamp(0.0, 0.48);
160:         solid = (edge_x && anomaly_hash(instance, epoch, 0x11F1, cell_x, cell_z) < threshold)
161:             || (edge_z && anomaly_hash(instance, epoch, 0x11F2, cell_x, cell_z) < threshold);
162:     }
163:     if context.skeleton {
164:         solid = false;
165:     }
166: 
167:     let lane_light =
168:         local_z.abs() < 0.45 && (local_x - 2.4 + 0.45).rem_euclid(4.8) < 0.9 && tuning.lights > 0.0;
169:     let field_light = (local_x - 2.4 + 0.45).rem_euclid(4.8) < 0.9
170:         && (local_z + 0.45).rem_euclid(4.8) < 0.9
171:         && anomaly_hash(instance, 0, 0x11A7, cell_x, cell_z) < 0.62 * tuning.lights;
172:     let ceiling_units = if !immutable_zone
173:         && anomaly_hash(instance, 0, 0x11D3, cell_x / 2, cell_z / 2) < 0.35 * budget
174:     {
175:         4.0
176:     } else {
177:         4.2
178:     };
179:     ColumnPlan {
180:         light: !solid && (lane_light || field_light),
181:         solid,
182:         ceiling_units,
183:         floor_material: EnvironmentProfile::pillar_expanse().floor_voxel(),
184:         ..ColumnPlan::open(ceiling_units)
185:     }
186: }
187: 
188: fn sample_blackout_expanse(context: &SampleContext<'_>) -> ColumnPlan {
189:     let instance = context.instance;
190:     let tuning = &context.config.tuning;
191:     let (local_x, local_z) = (context.local_x, context.local_z);
192:     let mut plan = BackroomsLevel::column_plan(
193:         context.noise,
194:         context.seed ^ instance.id as u32,
195:         tuning,
196:         context.world_x,
197:         context.world_z,
198:     );
199:     let depth = instance.normalized_depth(context.world_x, context.world_z);
200:     let profile = EnvironmentProfile::blackout(depth);
201:     plan.wall_material = profile.wall_voxel();
202:     plan.light_material = profile.light_voxel();
203: 
204:     // Ordinary fixtures thin through the approach instead of cutting directly
205:     // to black, so the darkness is spatially earned.
206:     if depth <= 0.22 {
207:         let cell_x = (context.world_x / LIGHT_PERIOD).floor() as i64;
208:         let cell_z = (context.world_z / LIGHT_PERIOD).floor() as i64;
209:         let keep = 1.0 - depth / 0.22;
210:         plan.light = plan.light && anomaly_hash(instance, 0, 0xFADE, cell_x, cell_z) < keep;
211:         plan.light_material = VOXEL_LIGHT;
212:     } else {
213:         plan.light = false;
214:     }
215:     plan.red_light = false;
216:     plan.ceiling_units = if depth > 0.68 {
217:         2.6
218:     } else if depth > 0.35 {
219:         3.0
220:     } else {
221:         3.4
222:     };
223: 
224:     if profile.floor == FloorState::RecessedFluid && !plan.solid && !context.skeleton {
225:         let cell = 7.2;
226:         let basin_x = (local_x / cell).floor() as i64;
227:         let basin_z = (local_z / cell).floor() as i64;
228:         if anomaly_hash(instance, 0, 0xF10D, basin_x, basin_z) < 0.22
229:             && local_x.rem_euclid(cell) > 1.2
230:             && local_z.rem_euclid(cell) > 1.2
231:         {
232:             plan.floor_material = VOXEL_FLUID;
233:         }
234:     }
235: 
236:     plan.solid |= context.perimeter;
237:     if context.skeleton {
238:         plan.solid = false;
239:         plan.light = local_x.rem_euclid(28.0) < 0.45 && tuning.lights > 0.0;
240:         plan.light_material = VOXEL_GLIMMER;
241:         return plan;
242:     }
243: 
244:     let decoys = context.config.anomalies.blackout_decoys.clamp(0.0, 0.5);
245:     let off_lane = (local_z.abs() - (instance.skeleton_half_width + 7.2)).abs() < 0.45;
246:     if off_lane
247:         && depth > 0.3
248:         && local_x.rem_euclid(28.0) < 0.45
249:         && tuning.lights > 0.0
250:         && anomaly_hash(
251:             instance,
252:             0,
253:             0xDEC0,
254:             (local_x / 28.0).floor() as i64,
255:             local_z.is_sign_negative() as i64,
256:         ) < decoys
257:     {
258:         plan.light = true;
259:         plan.light_material = VOXEL_GLIMMER;
260:     }
261: 
262:     if context.away_from_seam
263:         && let Some(epoch) = remap_epoch(context)
264:     {
265:         let cell = 7.2;
266:         let cell_x = (local_x / cell).floor() as i64;
267:         let cell_z = (local_z / cell).floor() as i64;
268:         let within_x = local_x.rem_euclid(cell);
269:         let within_z = local_z.rem_euclid(cell);
270:         let edge = within_x < PLAN_WALL_T || within_z < PLAN_WALL_T;
271:         let threshold = (0.20 * context.config.anomalies.remap_intensity).clamp(0.0, 0.65);
272:         if edge && anomaly_hash(instance, epoch, 0xB1AC, cell_x, cell_z) < threshold {
273:             plan.solid = true;
274:             plan.light = false;
275:         }
276:     }
277:     plan
278: }
279: 
280: fn sample_pit_lattice(context: &SampleContext<'_>) -> ColumnPlan {
281:     let lattice = context.instance.pit_lattice.expect("pit instance lattice");
282:     let within_x = (context.local_x - lattice.phase_x).rem_euclid(lattice.spacing_x);
283:     let within_z = (context.local_z - lattice.phase_z).rem_euclid(lattice.spacing_z);
284:     let dx = within_x.min(lattice.spacing_x - within_x);
285:     let dz = within_z.min(lattice.spacing_z - within_z);
286:     let pit = !context.skeleton
287:         && context.boundary > lattice.side
288:         && dx < lattice.side * 0.5
289:         && dz < lattice.side * 0.5;
290:     ColumnPlan {
291:         floor: !pit,
292:         solid: context.perimeter,
293:         light: !context.perimeter
294:             && context.local_x.rem_euclid(3.2) < 0.45
295:             && context.local_z.rem_euclid(3.2) < 0.45
296:             && context.config.tuning.lights > 0.0,
297:         ..ColumnPlan::open(3.8)
298:     }
299: }
300: 
301: /// Stable pale arch rooms never inspect `RealitySnapshot`, which keeps them a
302: /// fixed landmark against every mutable anomaly family.
303: fn sample_archway_anchor(context: &SampleContext<'_>) -> ColumnPlan {
304:     let instance = context.instance;
305:     let tuning = &context.config.tuning;
306:     let (local_x, local_z) = (context.local_x, context.local_z);
307:     let arch = instance.arch.expect("arch instance profile");
308:     let profile = EnvironmentProfile::archway_room();
309:     let half_x = instance.footprint.half_x;
310:     let half_z = instance.footprint.half_z;
311:     let mut plan = ColumnPlan {
312:         wall_material: profile.wall_voxel(),
313:         floor_material: profile.floor_voxel(),
314:         ..ColumnPlan::open(3.6)
315:     };
316: 
317:     let bay_index = ((local_x + half_x) / arch.bay).floor() as i64;
318:     let along = (local_x + half_x).rem_euclid(arch.bay);
319:     let across_opening = (along - arch.bay * 0.5).abs() < arch.opening * 0.5;
320:     let blind = bay_index.rem_euclid(arch.blind_every as i64) == arch.blind_every as i64 - 1;
321:     let arch_head = {
322:         let t = ((along - arch.bay * 0.5).abs() / (arch.opening * 0.5)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
323:         ((2.0 + 0.6 * (1.0 - t)) / 0.2).round() * 0.2
324:     };
325: 
326:     if context.perimeter {
327:         plan.solid = tuning.walls > 0.0;
328:         let on_long_wall = half_z - local_z.abs() <= PLAN_WALL_T;
329:         match arch.layout {
330:             ArchLayout::Transition => {
331:                 if on_long_wall && across_opening && !blind {
332:                     plan.solid = false;
333:                     plan.lintel_from_units = (tuning.walls > 0.0).then_some(arch_head);
334:                 }
335:             }
336:             ArchLayout::DeadEnd => {
337:                 let on_entrance_wall = half_x - local_x.abs() <= PLAN_WALL_T && local_x < 0.0;
338:                 if on_entrance_wall && local_z.abs() < 1.0 {
339:                     plan.solid = false;
340:                     plan.lintel_from_units = (tuning.walls > 0.0)
341:                         .then_some(((2.0 + 0.6 * (1.0 - local_z.abs())) / 0.2).round() * 0.2);
342:                 }
343:             }
344:         }
345:         return plan;
346:     }
347: 
348:     if arch.layout == ArchLayout::DeadEnd {
349:         let arcade_plane = half_z - 1.2 - PLAN_WALL_T;
350:         let in_arcade = (local_z.abs() - arcade_plane).abs() < PLAN_WALL_T * 0.5;
351:         let in_alcove = local_z.abs() > arcade_plane;
352:         if in_arcade && tuning.walls > 0.0 {
353:             if across_opening && !blind {
354:                 plan.lintel_from_units = Some(arch_head);
355:             } else {
356:                 plan.solid = true;
357:             }
358:         } else if in_alcove {
359:             plan.ceiling_units = 3.0;
360:             if ((local_x * 2.5).sin() * (local_z * 1.7).cos()).abs() < 0.3 {
361:                 plan.floor_material = VOXEL_FLUID;
362:             }
363:         }
364:     }
365: 
366:     plan.light = local_z.abs() < 0.45
367:         && (local_x + half_x - arch.bay * 0.5).rem_euclid(arch.bay * 2.0) < 0.45
368:         && tuning.lights > 0.0;
369:     let _ = context.boundary;
370:     plan
371: }
````

## File: src/use_cases/anomalies/macro_planner.rs
````rust
  1: //! World-lattice planner for region-spanning Level 0 anomalies.
  2: //!
  3: //! Macro candidates live on a 160-unit lattice. Regions merely query that
  4: //! lattice, so overlapping region and chunk requests recover identical
  5: //! instance IDs, footprints, internal phases, and traversal gates.
  6: 
  7: use crate::domain::entities::anomaly::{
  8:     AnomalyInstance, AnomalyKind, ArchLayout, ArchProfile, Axis2, AxisDirection, OrientedFootprint,
  9:     OrthoBasis, PillarLattice, PitLattice, QuarterTurn, TraversalGate, TraversalGateKind,
 10:     WorldBounds,
 11: };
 12: use crate::entities::models::Position;
 13: use crate::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig;
 14: 
 15: use super::determinism::{hash, mix64, snap, stable_id, unit};
 16: 
 17: const MACRO_CELL: f32 = 160.0;
 18: const MAX_QUERY_MARGIN: f32 = 400.0;
 19: 
 20: fn weighted_family(config: &GeneratorConfig, sample: f32) -> Option<AnomalyKind> {
 21:     let tuning = config.anomalies;
 22:     let weights = [
 23:         (AnomalyKind::PillarExpanse, tuning.pillar_expanses.max(0.0)),
 24:         (AnomalyKind::BlackoutExpanse, tuning.blackouts.max(0.0)),
 25:         (AnomalyKind::PitLattice, tuning.pit_lattices.max(0.0)),
 26:         (AnomalyKind::ArchwayRoom, tuning.archways.max(0.0)),
 27:     ];
 28:     let total: f32 = weights.iter().map(|(_, weight)| weight).sum();
 29:     if total <= 0.0 {
 30:         return None;
 31:     }
 32: 
 33:     let mut cursor = sample * total;
 34:     for (kind, weight) in weights {
 35:         if cursor < weight {
 36:             return Some(kind);
 37:         }
 38:         cursor -= weight;
 39:     }
 40:     Some(AnomalyKind::PillarExpanse)
 41: }
 42: 
 43: fn remap_gates(instance: &AnomalyInstance) -> Vec<TraversalGate> {
 44:     let (step, first, last) = match instance.kind {
 45:         AnomalyKind::PillarExpanse => {
 46:             let bay = instance.pillar_lattice.map_or(4.0, |lattice| lattice.bay_x);
 47:             (
 48:                 bay * 4.0,
 49:                 -instance.footprint.half_x + instance.entry_band,
 50:                 instance.footprint.half_x - instance.entry_band,
 51:             )
 52:         }
 53:         AnomalyKind::BlackoutExpanse => (
 54:             22.0,
 55:             -instance.footprint.half_x + instance.entry_band,
 56:             instance.footprint.half_x - instance.entry_band,
 57:         ),
 58:         _ => return Vec::new(),
 59:     };
 60: 
 61:     let mut gates = Vec::new();
 62:     let mut local_x = snap((first / step).ceil() * step);
 63:     let world_bounds = instance.footprint.bounds();
 64:     let axis = instance.basis.local_axis_in_world(Axis2::X);
 65:     while local_x <= last {
 66:         let at = instance.world_coords(local_x, 0.0);
 67:         let (plane, span_min, span_max) = match axis {
 68:             Axis2::X => (at.x, world_bounds.min_z, world_bounds.max_z),
 69:             Axis2::Z => (at.z, world_bounds.min_x, world_bounds.max_x),
 70:         };
 71:         let gate_index = (local_x / step).round() as i64;
 72:         gates.push(TraversalGate {
 73:             id: mix64(instance.id ^ (gate_index as u64).rotate_left(23) ^ 0x6A7E),
 74:             instance_id: instance.id,
 75:             anomaly_kind: instance.kind,
 76:             kind: TraversalGateKind::Remap,
 77:             axis,
 78:             plane,
 79:             span_min,
 80:             span_max,
 81:             forward: AxisDirection::Positive,
 82:             affected_bounds: world_bounds,
 83:         });
 84:         local_x += step;
 85:     }
 86:     gates
 87: }
 88: 
 89: fn macro_instance(
 90:     seed: u32,
 91:     anchor_x: i64,
 92:     anchor_z: i64,
 93:     kind: AnomalyKind,
 94:     config: &GeneratorConfig,
 95: ) -> AnomalyInstance {
 96:     let id = stable_id(seed, kind, anchor_x, anchor_z);
 97:     let h = |salt| hash(seed, salt, anchor_x, anchor_z);
 98:     let size_scale = config.anomalies.size.clamp(0.5, 2.0);
 99:     let center_x = snap((anchor_x as f32 + 0.5) * MACRO_CELL + (unit(h(0xC1)) - 0.5) * 48.0);
100:     let center_z = snap((anchor_z as f32 + 0.5) * MACRO_CELL + (unit(h(0xC2)) - 0.5) * 48.0);
101:     let basis = OrthoBasis {
102:         turn: if h(0xC3) & 1 == 0 {
103:             QuarterTurn::Zero
104:         } else {
105:             QuarterTurn::Clockwise
106:         },
107:     };
108:     let (half_x, half_z, entry_band, skeleton_half_width) = match kind {
109:         AnomalyKind::PillarExpanse => (
110:             snap((75.0 + 85.0 * unit(h(0xD1))) * size_scale),
111:             snap((55.0 + 65.0 * unit(h(0xD2))) * size_scale),
112:             16.0,
113:             2.0,
114:         ),
115:         AnomalyKind::BlackoutExpanse => (
116:             snap((65.0 + 70.0 * unit(h(0xD3))) * size_scale),
117:             snap((50.0 + 55.0 * unit(h(0xD4))) * size_scale),
118:             12.0,
119:             2.0,
120:         ),
121:         AnomalyKind::PitLattice => (
122:             snap((32.0 + 30.0 * unit(h(0xD5))) * size_scale),
123:             snap((28.0 + 25.0 * unit(h(0xD6))) * size_scale),
124:             6.0,
125:             1.8,
126:         ),
127:         AnomalyKind::ArchwayRoom => (
128:             snap(4.0 + 3.0 * unit(h(0xD7))),
129:             snap(5.0 + 3.0 * unit(h(0xD8))),
130:             0.0,
131:             0.0,
132:         ),
133:         AnomalyKind::RedRoom => unreachable!("red rooms are planned from assemblies"),
134:     };
135:     let footprint = OrientedFootprint {
136:         center: Position::new(center_x, center_z),
137:         half_x,
138:         half_z,
139:         basis,
140:     };
141:     let pillar_lattice = (kind == AnomalyKind::PillarExpanse).then(|| PillarLattice {
142:         bay_x: snap(3.6 + 1.2 * unit(h(0xE1))),
143:         bay_z: snap(3.6 + 1.2 * unit(h(0xE2))),
144:         phase_x: snap((unit(h(0xE3)) - 0.5) * 3.2),
145:         phase_z: snap((unit(h(0xE4)) - 0.5) * 3.2),
146:         min_side: 1.2,
147:         max_side: 1.6,
148:         variation_seed: id ^ 0xA111_AA55_u64,
149:     });
150:     let pit_lattice = (kind == AnomalyKind::PitLattice).then(|| PitLattice {
151:         spacing_x: snap(2.0 + 0.4 * unit(h(0xF1))),
152:         spacing_z: snap(2.0 + 0.4 * unit(h(0xF2))),
153:         phase_x: snap(unit(h(0xF3)) * 1.2),
154:         phase_z: snap(unit(h(0xF4)) * 1.2),
155:         side: snap(0.8 + 0.2 * unit(h(0xF5))),
156:         depth: 2.4,
157:     });
158:     let arch = (kind == AnomalyKind::ArchwayRoom).then(|| ArchProfile {
159:         layout: if h(0xA0) & 1 == 0 {
160:             ArchLayout::Transition
161:         } else {
162:             ArchLayout::DeadEnd
163:         },
164:         bay: snap(2.4 + 0.8 * unit(h(0xA1))),
165:         opening: snap(1.6 + 0.4 * unit(h(0xA2))),
166:         blind_every: 3 + (h(0xA3) % 2) as u8,
167:     });
168:     let mut instance = AnomalyInstance {
169:         id,
170:         kind,
171:         footprint,
172:         basis,
173:         macro_anchor: (anchor_x, anchor_z),
174:         pillar_lattice,
175:         pit_lattice,
176:         arch,
177:         gates: Vec::new(),
178:         skeleton_half_width,
179:         entry_band,
180:     };
181:     instance.gates = remap_gates(&instance);
182:     instance
183: }
184: 
185: fn forced_instance(
186:     seed: u32,
187:     query: WorldBounds,
188:     protected_point: Position,
189:     config: &GeneratorConfig,
190: ) -> Option<AnomalyInstance> {
191:     let kind = config.anomalies.forced_kind?;
192:     if kind == AnomalyKind::RedRoom {
193:         return None;
194:     }
195: 
196:     if kind == AnomalyKind::ArchwayRoom {
197:         // A forced anchor is moved next to the protected point so it is both
198:         // resident and visible; organic anchors keep their macro-cell center.
199:         let center = Position::new(snap(protected_point.x + 10.0), snap(protected_point.z));
200:         let anchor_x = (center.x / MACRO_CELL).floor() as i64;
201:         let anchor_z = (center.z / MACRO_CELL).floor() as i64;
202:         let mut instance = macro_instance(seed, anchor_x, anchor_z, kind, config);
203:         instance.footprint.center = center;
204:         return instance
205:             .footprint
206:             .bounds()
207:             .intersects(query)
208:             .then_some(instance);
209:     }
210: 
211:     let anchor_x = (protected_point.x / MACRO_CELL).floor() as i64;
212:     let anchor_z = (protected_point.z / MACRO_CELL).floor() as i64;
213:     let instance = macro_instance(seed, anchor_x, anchor_z, kind, config);
214:     instance
215:         .footprint
216:         .bounds()
217:         .intersects(query)
218:         .then_some(instance)
219: }
220: 
221: pub(crate) fn plan_macro_anomalies(
222:     seed: u32,
223:     query: WorldBounds,
224:     protected_point: Position,
225:     config: &GeneratorConfig,
226: ) -> Vec<AnomalyInstance> {
227:     let mut instances: Vec<_> = forced_instance(seed, query, protected_point, config)
228:         .into_iter()
229:         .collect();
230:     if config.anomalies.frequency <= 0.0 {
231:         return instances;
232:     }
233: 
234:     let expanded = query.expanded(MAX_QUERY_MARGIN);
235:     let anchor_x_min = (expanded.min_x / MACRO_CELL).floor() as i64;
236:     let anchor_x_max = (expanded.max_x / MACRO_CELL).floor() as i64;
237:     let anchor_z_min = (expanded.min_z / MACRO_CELL).floor() as i64;
238:     let anchor_z_max = (expanded.max_z / MACRO_CELL).floor() as i64;
239:     let chance = (0.20 * config.anomalies.frequency.clamp(0.0, 4.0)).min(0.75);
240: 
241:     for anchor_z in anchor_z_min..=anchor_z_max {
242:         for anchor_x in anchor_x_min..=anchor_x_max {
243:             let candidate = hash(seed, 0xCAAD_1DA7, anchor_x, anchor_z);
244:             if unit(candidate) >= chance {
245:                 continue;
246:             }
247:             let Some(kind) = weighted_family(config, unit(candidate.rotate_left(21))) else {
248:                 continue;
249:             };
250:             let instance = macro_instance(seed, anchor_x, anchor_z, kind, config);
251:             if !instance.footprint.bounds().intersects(query) {
252:                 continue;
253:             }
254:             // Organic candidates honor the opening-region keep-out. Forced
255:             // candidates intentionally bypass it for developer inspection.
256:             if instance
257:                 .footprint
258:                 .bounds()
259:                 .expanded(48.0)
260:                 .contains(protected_point.x, protected_point.z)
261:             {
262:                 continue;
263:             }
264:             instances.push(instance);
265:         }
266:     }
267:     instances
268: }
````

````rust
  1: //! Level 0 anomaly planning use case.
  2: //!
  3: //! This module composes two independent sources of immutable plans:
  4: //! world-lattice macro anomalies and Red Rooms promoted from architectural
  5: //! assemblies. Voxelization and encounter-state transitions live elsewhere.
  6: 
  7: pub mod config;
  8: pub(crate) mod determinism;
  9: pub(crate) mod geometry;

 12: use crate::domain::entities::anomaly::{AnomalyInstance, WorldBounds};

 15: use crate::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig;
 16: use crate::use_cases::red_rooms::planning::plan_red_rooms;
 17: 
 18: /// Returns every immutable anomaly instance whose footprint overlaps a region.
 19: ///
 20: /// Identity is independent of the query partition: callers may ask through
 21: /// adjacent regions or different voxel sizes and receive the same instance.
 22: pub fn plan_anomalies_for_region(
 23:     seed: u32,
 24:     region_origin: Position,
 25:     region_size: f32,
 26:     assemblies: &[AssemblyInstance],
 27:     protected_point: Position,
 28:     config: &GeneratorConfig,
 29: ) -> Vec<AnomalyInstance> {
 30:     let query = WorldBounds::new(
 31:         region_origin.x,
 32:         region_origin.z,
 33:         region_origin.x + region_size,
 34:         region_origin.z + region_size,
 35:     );
 36:     let mut instances = macro_planner::plan_macro_anomalies(seed, query, protected_point, config);
 37:     instances.extend(plan_red_rooms(seed, region_origin, assemblies, config));
 38:     instances.sort_by_key(|instance| instance.id);
 39:     instances.dedup_by_key(|instance| instance.id);
 40:     instances
 41: }
````

## File: src/use_cases/level_zero/column_field.rs
````rust
 1: //! A sampled Level 0 area plus the one-column halo needed for clean caps.
 2: 
 3: use crate::use_cases::backrooms_level::ColumnPlan;
 4: 
 5: /// Resolution-dependent samples of a resolution-independent world plan.
 6: ///
 7: /// The halo is part of this type's invariant.  Callers cannot accidentally
 8: /// voxelize a chunk without knowing its neighbours' ceiling heights, which is
 9: /// what keeps separately generated requests sealed at their shared edge.
10: pub(crate) struct ColumnField {
11:     width: usize,
12:     depth: usize,
13:     columns: Vec<ColumnPlan>,
14: }
15: 
16: impl ColumnField {
17:     pub(crate) fn sample(
18:         width: usize,
19:         depth: usize,
20:         mut plan_at: impl FnMut(i64, i64) -> ColumnPlan,
21:     ) -> Self {
22:         let mut columns = Vec::with_capacity((width + 2) * (depth + 2));
23:         for z in -1..=depth as i64 {
24:             for x in -1..=width as i64 {
25:                 columns.push(plan_at(x, z));
26:             }
27:         }
28:         Self {
29:             width,
30:             depth,
31:             columns,
32:         }
33:     }
34: 
35:     pub(crate) fn width(&self) -> usize {
36:         self.width
37:     }
38: 
39:     pub(crate) fn depth(&self) -> usize {
40:         self.depth
41:     }
42: 
43:     /// Local coordinates include the halo, so `x` and `z` may be `-1` or
44:     /// exactly the corresponding output dimension.
45:     pub(crate) fn get(&self, x: i64, z: i64) -> &ColumnPlan {
46:         debug_assert!((-1..=self.width as i64).contains(&x));
47:         debug_assert!((-1..=self.depth as i64).contains(&z));
48:         &self.columns[((z + 1) as usize) * (self.width + 2) + (x + 1) as usize]
49:     }
50: }
51: 
52: #[cfg(test)]
53: mod tests {
54:     use super::*;
55: 
56:     #[test]
57:     fn sampler_owns_a_one_column_halo() {
58:         let field = ColumnField::sample(2, 3, |x, z| ColumnPlan::open((x + z + 10) as f32));
59:         assert_eq!(field.get(-1, -1).ceiling_units, 8.0);
60:         assert_eq!(field.get(2, 3).ceiling_units, 15.0);
61:     }
62: }
````

## File: src/use_cases/level_zero/voxelize.rs
````rust
 1: //! Materialize sampled Level 0 columns at the requested voxel size.
 2: 
 3: use crate::domain::entities::voxel_grid::{VOXEL_CEILING, VOXEL_LIGHT, VOXEL_RED_LIGHT, VoxelGrid};
 4: use crate::use_cases::level_zero::ColumnField;
 5: 
 6: const SCONCE_HEIGHT_UNITS: f32 = 2.4;
 7: 
 8: /// Writes geometry and fixture voxels without knowing seeds, regions,
 9: /// anomalies, chunks, or recursive branches.  Those are planning concerns;
10: /// this stage only quantizes an already sampled physical area.
11: pub(crate) fn voxelize_columns(grid: &mut VoxelGrid, field: &ColumnField, voxel_size: f32) {
12:     let max_y = grid.height().saturating_sub(1);
13:     let to_voxel = |units: f32| ((units / voxel_size) as usize).clamp(2, max_y);
14: 
15:     for z in 0..field.depth() {
16:         for x in 0..field.width() {
17:             let plan = *field.get(x as i64, z as i64);
18:             let ceiling_y = to_voxel(plan.ceiling_units);
19: 
20:             if plan.floor {
21:                 grid.set(x, 0, z, plan.floor_material);
22:             }
23: 
24:             if plan.solid {
25:                 for y in 1..ceiling_y {
26:                     grid.set(x, y, z, plan.wall_material);
27:                 }
28:                 if plan.sconce {
29:                     let y = to_voxel(SCONCE_HEIGHT_UNITS).min(ceiling_y - 1);
30:                     grid.set(x, y, z, VOXEL_LIGHT);
31:                 }
32:             } else if let Some(lintel_height) = plan.lintel_from_units {
33:                 for y in to_voxel(lintel_height)..ceiling_y {
34:                     grid.set(x, y, z, plan.wall_material);
35:                 }
36:             }
37: 
38:             // A lower ceiling grows a skirt up to its tallest neighbour.  A
39:             // request therefore cannot see through a height step that lives
40:             // just across its output boundary.
41:             let neighbour_ceiling = [
42:                 field.get(x as i64 - 1, z as i64),
43:                 field.get(x as i64 + 1, z as i64),
44:                 field.get(x as i64, z as i64 - 1),
45:                 field.get(x as i64, z as i64 + 1),
46:             ]
47:             .iter()
48:             .map(|neighbour| to_voxel(neighbour.ceiling_units))
49:             .max()
50:             .unwrap_or(ceiling_y);
51: 
52:             let cap_material = if plan.solid {
53:                 plan.wall_material
54:             } else {
55:                 VOXEL_CEILING
56:             };
57:             for y in ceiling_y..=neighbour_ceiling.max(ceiling_y) {
58:                 grid.set(x, y, z, cap_material);
59:             }
60: 
61:             if plan.light && !plan.solid {
62:                 let material = if plan.red_light {
63:                     VOXEL_RED_LIGHT
64:                 } else {
65:                     plan.light_material
66:                 };
67:                 grid.set(x, ceiling_y, z, material);
68:             }
69:         }
70:     }
71: }
````

## File: src/use_cases/red_rooms/geometry.rs
````rust
  1: //! Red Room presentation layered over an authored Level 0 assembly.
  2: //!
  3: //! This sampler knows nothing about chunks or voxel indices.  It receives one
  4: //! world column and returns one architectural decision, leaving recursive
  5: //! world addressing and voxelization to their own stages.
  6: 
  7: use crate::domain::entities::anomaly::{AnomalyInstance, Axis2, RealitySnapshot, RedRoomPhase};
  8: use crate::domain::entities::environment::EnvironmentProfile;
  9: use crate::domain::entities::voxel_grid::VOXEL_STICKY_CARPET;
 10: use crate::use_cases::backrooms_level::ColumnPlan;
 11: use crate::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig;
 12: use crate::use_cases::region_plan::PLAN_WALL_T;
 13: 
 14: /// Applies avoidable warning cues and the committed encounter topology.
 15: pub(crate) fn sample_red_room(
 16:     instance: &AnomalyInstance,
 17:     mut column: ColumnPlan,
 18:     config: &GeneratorConfig,
 19:     reality: &RealitySnapshot,
 20:     world_x: f32,
 21:     world_z: f32,
 22: ) -> ColumnPlan {
 23:     let (local_x, local_z) = instance.local_coords(world_x, world_z);
 24:     let half_x = instance.footprint.half_x;
 25:     let half_z = instance.footprint.half_z;
 26:     let loop_width = 2.0f32.min(half_x * 0.35).min(half_z * 0.35).max(1.2);
 27:     let boundary = instance.boundary_distance(world_x, world_z);
 28: 
 29:     // Warning cues intensify toward the shell but never replace masonry with
 30:     // a special red wall.  The anomaly is read through carpet, compression,
 31:     // and light; collision remains ordinary Level 0 architecture.
 32:     let contamination = (1.0 - boundary / (loop_width * 2.0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
 33:     let profile = EnvironmentProfile::red_room(contamination);
 34:     if boundary > PLAN_WALL_T + 0.05 {
 35:         if contamination > 0.15 {
 36:             column.floor_material = profile.floor_voxel();
 37:         }
 38:         if contamination > 0.33 {
 39:             column.ceiling_units = (column.ceiling_units - 0.2).max(2.6);
 40:         }
 41:         if contamination > 0.66 {
 42:             column.ceiling_units = (column.ceiling_units - 0.4).max(2.4);
 43:         }
 44:     }
 45:     column.red_light = true;
 46: 
 47:     let Some(state) = instance.state(reality) else {
 48:         return column;
 49:     };
 50:     if state.phase == RedRoomPhase::Outside {
 51:         return column;
 52:     }
 53: 
 54:     // Commitment closes the remembered entrance and reduces the authored
 55:     // room to one walkable perimeter loop around an opaque core.
 56:     let in_core = local_x.abs() < half_x - loop_width && local_z.abs() < half_z - loop_width;
 57:     column.solid = boundary <= PLAN_WALL_T || in_core;
 58:     column.lintel_from_units = None;
 59:     column.floor_material = VOXEL_STICKY_CARPET;
 60:     column.ceiling_units = column.ceiling_units.min(2.8);
 61:     if column.solid {
 62:         column.light = false;
 63:     }
 64: 
 65:     if state.phase == RedRoomPhase::EscapeOpen {
 66:         open_single_escape(
 67:             instance,
 68:             state.epoch,
 69:             config.anomalies.red_escape_bias,
 70:             local_x,
 71:             local_z,
 72:             &mut column,
 73:         );
 74:     }
 75:     column
 76: }
 77: 
 78: /// Opens one deterministic side of the loop.  The bias is an authored width
 79: /// control: zero keeps the encounter sealed; positive values widen a single
 80: /// breach without turning both symmetric walls into exits.
 81: fn open_single_escape(
 82:     instance: &AnomalyInstance,
 83:     epoch: u32,
 84:     bias: f32,
 85:     local_x: f32,
 86:     local_z: f32,
 87:     column: &mut ColumnPlan,
 88: ) {
 89:     let width = bias.clamp(0.0, 1.0) * 2.4;
 90:     if width <= 0.0 {
 91:         return;
 92:     }
 93:     let Some(threshold) = instance.gates.first() else {
 94:         return;
 95:     };
 96:     let side_sign = if stable_bit(instance.id, epoch) {
 97:         1.0
 98:     } else {
 99:         -1.0
100:     };
101:     let (side_coordinate, side_extent, along) = match threshold.axis {
102:         Axis2::Z => (local_x, instance.footprint.half_x, local_z),
103:         Axis2::X => (local_z, instance.footprint.half_z, local_x),
104:     };
105:     let on_selected_wall = (side_coordinate - side_sign * side_extent).abs() <= PLAN_WALL_T + 0.1;
106:     if on_selected_wall && along.abs() < width {
107:         column.solid = false;
108:     }
109: }
110: 
111: fn stable_bit(instance_id: u64, epoch: u32) -> bool {
112:     let mut value = instance_id ^ (epoch as u64).rotate_left(29) ^ 0xE5CA_9E5C_A9E5_CA9E;
113:     value ^= value >> 30;
114:     value = value.wrapping_mul(0xBF58_476D_1CE4_E5B9);
115:     value ^= value >> 27;
116:     value & 1 == 1
117: }
````
