## File: wasm_frontend/src/drivers/gl/program.rs
````rust
 1: //! WebGL2 context creation and shader program linking — the one copy of
 2: //! this plumbing for all drivers.
 3: 
 4: use js_sys::Reflect;
 5: use wasm_bindgen::{JsCast, JsValue};
 6: use web_sys::{HtmlCanvasElement, WebGl2RenderingContext as Gl, WebGlProgram, WebGlShader};
 7: 
 8: /// Options for [`create_context`]. Raster paths want a depth buffer; the
 9: /// fullscreen raymarcher resolves visibility itself, so depth and MSAA
10: /// would be wasted bandwidth on low-spec GPUs.
11: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
12: pub struct ContextOptions {
13:     pub depth: bool,
14: }
15: 
16: /// Creates a WebGL2 context with the engine's standard attributes
17: /// (no antialiasing, opaque, high-performance GPU preference).
18: pub fn create_context(
19:     canvas: &HtmlCanvasElement,
20:     options: ContextOptions,
21: ) -> Result<Gl, JsValue> {
22:     let attrs = js_sys::Object::new();
23:     Reflect::set(&attrs, &"antialias".into(), &false.into())?;
24:     Reflect::set(&attrs, &"depth".into(), &options.depth.into())?;
25:     Reflect::set(&attrs, &"stencil".into(), &false.into())?;
26:     Reflect::set(&attrs, &"alpha".into(), &false.into())?;
27:     Reflect::set(&attrs, &"powerPreference".into(), &"high-performance".into())?;
28:     canvas
29:         .get_context_with_context_options("webgl2", &attrs)?
30:         .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("WebGL2 is not supported on this browser"))?
31:         .dyn_into::<Gl>()
32:         .map_err(|_| JsValue::from_str("webgl2 context has an unexpected type"))
33: }
34: 
35: pub fn compile_shader(gl: &Gl, kind: u32, source: &str) -> Result<WebGlShader, JsValue> {
36:     let shader = gl
37:         .create_shader(kind)
38:         .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("failed to create shader object"))?;
39:     gl.shader_source(&shader, source);
40:     gl.compile_shader(&shader);
41:     if gl
42:         .get_shader_parameter(&shader, Gl::COMPILE_STATUS)
43:         .as_bool()
44:         .unwrap_or(false)
45:     {
46:         Ok(shader)
47:     } else {
48:         let log = gl.get_shader_info_log(&shader).unwrap_or_default();
49:         gl.delete_shader(Some(&shader));
50:         Err(JsValue::from_str(&format!("shader compile error: {log}")))
51:     }
52: }
53: 
54: pub fn link_program(gl: &Gl, vertex: &str, fragment: &str) -> Result<WebGlProgram, JsValue> {
55:     let vs = compile_shader(gl, Gl::VERTEX_SHADER, vertex)?;
56:     let fs = compile_shader(gl, Gl::FRAGMENT_SHADER, fragment)?;
57:     let program = gl
58:         .create_program()
59:         .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("failed to create shader program"))?;
60:     gl.attach_shader(&program, &vs);
61:     gl.attach_shader(&program, &fs);
62:     gl.link_program(&program);
63:     if gl
64:         .get_program_parameter(&program, Gl::LINK_STATUS)
65:         .as_bool()
66:         .unwrap_or(false)
67:     {
68:         Ok(program)
69:     } else {
70:         let log = gl.get_program_info_log(&program).unwrap_or_default();
71:         gl.delete_program(Some(&program));
72:         Err(JsValue::from_str(&format!("shader link error: {log}")))
73:     }
74: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/drivers/gl/shadow_target.rs
````rust
 1: //! Depth-only render target for the hero-light shadow map.
 2: 
 3: use wasm_bindgen::JsValue;
 4: use web_sys::{WebGl2RenderingContext as Gl, WebGlFramebuffer, WebGlTexture};
 5: 
 6: pub struct ShadowTarget {
 7:     pub fbo: WebGlFramebuffer,
 8:     pub texture: WebGlTexture,
 9:     pub size: i32,
10: }
11: 
12: /// Creates a `size`² DEPTH_COMPONENT16 texture bound to a framebuffer's
13: /// depth attachment. NEAREST filtering: the shaders do their own PCF.
14: pub fn create_shadow_target(gl: &Gl, size: i32) -> Result<ShadowTarget, JsValue> {
15:     let texture = gl
16:         .create_texture()
17:         .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("create shadow texture"))?;
18:     gl.bind_texture(Gl::TEXTURE_2D, Some(&texture));
19:     gl.tex_image_2d_with_i32_and_i32_and_i32_and_format_and_type_and_opt_u8_array(
20:         Gl::TEXTURE_2D,
21:         0,
22:         Gl::DEPTH_COMPONENT16 as i32,
23:         size,
24:         size,
25:         0,
26:         Gl::DEPTH_COMPONENT,
27:         Gl::UNSIGNED_SHORT,
28:         None,
29:     )?;
30:     gl.tex_parameteri(Gl::TEXTURE_2D, Gl::TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, Gl::NEAREST as i32);
31:     gl.tex_parameteri(Gl::TEXTURE_2D, Gl::TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, Gl::NEAREST as i32);
32:     gl.tex_parameteri(Gl::TEXTURE_2D, Gl::TEXTURE_WRAP_S, Gl::CLAMP_TO_EDGE as i32);
33:     gl.tex_parameteri(Gl::TEXTURE_2D, Gl::TEXTURE_WRAP_T, Gl::CLAMP_TO_EDGE as i32);
34: 
35:     let fbo = gl
36:         .create_framebuffer()
37:         .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("create shadow FBO"))?;
38:     gl.bind_framebuffer(Gl::FRAMEBUFFER, Some(&fbo));
39:     gl.framebuffer_texture_2d(
40:         Gl::FRAMEBUFFER,
41:         Gl::DEPTH_ATTACHMENT,
42:         Gl::TEXTURE_2D,
43:         Some(&texture),
44:         0,
45:     );
46: 
47:     // A depth-only WebGL2 target has no color attachment. Explicitly route
48:     // both drawing and reading to NONE; leaving the defaults at
49:     // COLOR_ATTACHMENT0 makes strict mobile drivers report an incomplete
50:     // framebuffer and silently discard the shadow pass.
51:     let draw_buffers = js_sys::Array::new();
52:     draw_buffers.push(&wasm_bindgen::JsValue::from_f64(Gl::NONE as f64));
53:     gl.draw_buffers(draw_buffers.as_ref());
54:     gl.read_buffer(Gl::NONE);
55: 
56:     let status = gl.check_framebuffer_status(Gl::FRAMEBUFFER);
57:     if status != Gl::FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE {
58:         gl.bind_framebuffer(Gl::FRAMEBUFFER, None);
59:         gl.delete_framebuffer(Some(&fbo));
60:         gl.delete_texture(Some(&texture));
61:         return Err(JsValue::from_str(&format!(
62:             "shadow framebuffer is incomplete (status 0x{status:04x})"
63:         )));
64:     }
65:     gl.bind_framebuffer(Gl::FRAMEBUFFER, None);
66: 
67:     Ok(ShadowTarget { fbo, texture, size })
68: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/drivers/gl/timer.rs
````rust
 1: //! Asynchronous GPU frame timing via `EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2`.
 2: //!
 3: //! One query is in flight at a time; results are polled (never blocked on)
 4: //! at the top of the next frames, so the HUD's GPU number lags a frame or
 5: //! two but the pipeline never stalls. Toggleable (`RenderToggles::gpu_timer`)
 6: //! because some drivers serialize on timer queries.
 7: 
 8: use js_sys::Object;
 9: use web_sys::{WebGl2RenderingContext as Gl, WebGlQuery};
10: 
11: /// Extension constants absent from WebGL2 core.
12: const TIME_ELAPSED_EXT: u32 = 0x88BF;
13: const GPU_DISJOINT_EXT: u32 = 0x8FBB;
14: 
15: pub struct GpuFrameTimer {
16:     extension: Option<Object>,
17:     pending: Option<WebGlQuery>,
18:     last_ms: Option<f32>,
19: }
20: 
21: impl GpuFrameTimer {
22:     /// Probes for the extension; a `None` extension makes every method a
23:     /// no-op so callers never branch on support.
24:     pub fn new(gl: &Gl) -> Self {
25:         Self {
26:             extension: gl
27:                 .get_extension("EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2")
28:                 .ok()
29:                 .flatten(),
30:             pending: None,
31:             last_ms: None,
32:         }
33:     }
34: 
35:     pub fn last_ms(&self) -> Option<f32> {
36:         self.last_ms
37:     }
38: 
39:     /// Collects a finished query, if any. Disjoint intervals (GPU clock
40:     /// disturbance) discard the sample.
41:     pub fn poll(&mut self, gl: &Gl) {
42:         let Some(query) = self.pending.as_ref() else {
43:             return;
44:         };
45:         let available = gl
46:             .get_query_parameter(query, Gl::QUERY_RESULT_AVAILABLE)
47:             .as_bool()
48:             .unwrap_or(false);
49:         let disjoint = self.extension.is_some()
50:             && gl
51:                 .get_parameter(GPU_DISJOINT_EXT)
52:                 .ok()
53:                 .and_then(|value| value.as_bool())
54:                 .unwrap_or(false);
55:         if !available && !disjoint {
56:             return;
57:         }
58:         let query = self.pending.take().expect("pending timer exists");
59:         if available && !disjoint {
60:             self.last_ms = gl
61:                 .get_query_parameter(&query, Gl::QUERY_RESULT)
62:                 .as_f64()
63:                 .map(|nanos| (nanos as f32) * 1.0e-6);
64:         }
65:         gl.delete_query(Some(&query));
66:     }
67: 
68:     /// Starts timing this frame. Returns whether a query was issued (pass
69:     /// it to [`Self::end`]). `enabled` comes from the toggle switchboard.
70:     pub fn begin(&mut self, gl: &Gl, enabled: bool) -> bool {
71:         if !enabled {
72:             // The HUD must not present an old sample as current after timing
73:             // has been switched off. An in-flight query is still collected
74:             // by `poll` and then discarded from view on this frame.
75:             self.last_ms = None;
76:             return false;
77:         }
78:         if self.extension.is_none() || self.pending.is_some() {
79:             return false;
80:         }
81:         let Some(query) = gl.create_query() else {
82:             return false;
83:         };
84:         gl.begin_query(TIME_ELAPSED_EXT, &query);
85:         self.pending = Some(query);
86:         true
87:     }
88: 
89:     pub fn end(&self, gl: &Gl, started: bool) {
90:         if started {
91:             gl.end_query(TIME_ELAPSED_EXT);
92:         }
93:     }
94: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/drivers/gl/visibility.rs
````rust
 1: //! Conservative visibility tests shared by the raster drivers.
 2: 
 3: use crate::application::ports::FrameParams;
 4: 
 5: /// Draw-distance cap for the raster paths (world units). Their fog reaches
 6: /// full opacity before this, so the cull is invisible.
 7: pub const MAX_DRAW_DISTANCE: f32 = 100.0;
 8: 
 9: /// Sphere visibility: inside the draw distance and not entirely behind the
10: /// camera plane. Returns the squared distance for near-to-far sorting, or
11: /// `None` when culled. Deliberately conservative (no side-plane frustum
12: /// test): a false "visible" costs a few draws, a false cull costs a hole
13: /// in the world.
14: pub fn sphere_visible(
15:     center: [f32; 3],
16:     radius: f32,
17:     frame: &FrameParams,
18:     max_draw_distance: f32,
19: ) -> Option<f32> {
20:     let to = [
21:         center[0] - frame.camera_pos[0],
22:         center[1] - frame.camera_pos[1],
23:         center[2] - frame.camera_pos[2],
24:     ];
25:     let distance2 = to[0] * to[0] + to[1] * to[1] + to[2] * to[2];
26:     // Cull only when the *whole sphere* lies beyond the distance boundary.
27:     // Testing the center against `max_draw_distance` cuts chunks/cells that
28:     // still intersect the visible volume and creates a hard pop at the fog
29:     // edge.
30:     let farthest_visible_center = max_draw_distance + radius;
31:     if distance2 > farthest_visible_center * farthest_visible_center {
32:         return None;
33:     }
34:     let (sp, cp) = frame.pitch.sin_cos();
35:     let (sy, cy) = frame.yaw.sin_cos();
36:     let forward = [-cp * sy, sp, -cp * cy];
37:     let dot = to[0] * forward[0] + to[1] * forward[1] + to[2] * forward[2];
38:     if dot >= -radius { Some(distance2) } else { None }
39: }
40: 
41: /// Center + bounding-sphere radius of a chunk from its origin and local
42: /// bounds-max — the shape both mesh and splat chunk records share.
43: pub fn chunk_bounding_sphere(origin: [f32; 3], bounds_max: [f32; 3]) -> ([f32; 3], f32) {
44:     let center = [
45:         origin[0] + bounds_max[0] * 0.5,
46:         origin[1] + bounds_max[1] * 0.5,
47:         origin[2] + bounds_max[2] * 0.5,
48:     ];
49:     let radius = (bounds_max[0] * bounds_max[0]
50:         + bounds_max[1] * bounds_max[1]
51:         + bounds_max[2] * bounds_max[2])
52:         .sqrt()
53:         * 0.5;
54:     (center, radius)
55: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/drivers/shaders/chunks.rs
````rust
  1: //! Shared GLSL chunks — snippets spliced into more than one shader so the
  2: //! engine has exactly one definition of each cross-cutting effect.
  3: //!
  4: //! Shader sources are assembled at startup by `format!` concatenation (a
  5: //! few string copies once per program link — nothing per frame). Each chunk
  6: //! is a self-contained set of GLSL functions/consts with no `uniform`
  7: //! declarations, so any stage can include it.
  8: 
  9: /// The flashlight spotlight cone — **GLSL mirror of the single spec in
 10: /// `adapters::cpu_splatter::flashlight`** (inner/outer angle, range, facing
 11: /// floor, lamp offset, tint). A tuning change there must be mirrored here.
 12: ///
 13: /// Shape: smoothstep between an inner cone (full strength, 11°) and an
 14: /// outer cone (zero, 24°) around the camera forward axis, times a range
 15: /// fade (full to 3 u, gone at 14 u), times a floored Lambert facing term.
 16: pub const SPOT_CONE_GLSL: &str = r#"
 17: // --- flashlight cone (spec: adapters/cpu_splatter/flashlight.rs) ---
 18: const float SPOT_INNER_COS = 0.9816272; // cos(11 deg)
 19: const float SPOT_OUTER_COS = 0.9135455; // cos(24 deg)
 20: const float SPOT_RANGE_FULL = 3.0;
 21: const float SPOT_RANGE_END = 14.0;
 22: const float SPOT_FACING_FLOOR = 0.08;
 23: const vec3  SPOT_TINT = vec3(1.0, 0.96, 0.85);
 24: 
 25: // The hand-held lamp sits slightly forward of and below the eye.
 26: vec3 spotLampPos(vec3 camPos, vec3 camForward) {
 27:     return camPos + camForward * 0.18 - vec3(0.0, 0.10, 0.0);
 28: }
 29: 
 30: // Angular falloff: 1 inside the inner cone, 0 outside the outer.
 31: float spotCone(vec3 beam, vec3 camForward) {
 32:     return smoothstep(SPOT_OUTER_COS, SPOT_INNER_COS, dot(beam, camForward));
 33: }
 34: 
 35: // Distance falloff: full out to RANGE_FULL, zero at RANGE_END.
 36: float spotRange(float dist) {
 37:     return 1.0 - smoothstep(SPOT_RANGE_FULL, SPOT_RANGE_END, dist);
 38: }
 39: 
 40: // Full beam response at a surface point with normal N. Multiply by albedo.
 41: vec3 spotBeam(vec3 camPos, vec3 camForward, vec3 surfacePos, vec3 N) {
 42:     vec3 lamp = spotLampPos(camPos, camForward);
 43:     vec3 toSurf = surfacePos - lamp;
 44:     float dist = length(toSurf);
 45:     vec3 beam = toSurf / max(dist, 1e-4);
 46:     float cone = spotCone(beam, camForward);
 47:     float range = spotRange(dist);
 48:     float facing = max(-dot(beam, N), SPOT_FACING_FLOOR);
 49:     return SPOT_TINT * (cone * range * facing);
 50: }
 51: "#;
 52: 
 53: /// Material palette lookup, shared by the surface and splat paths so both
 54: /// rasterizers color a wall identically.
 55: pub const MATERIAL_COLOR_GLSL: &str = r#"
 56: vec3 materialColor(float material) {
 57:     if (material < 1.5) return vec3(0.87, 0.80, 0.40); // wall
 58:     if (material < 2.5) return vec3(0.60, 0.53, 0.07); // floor
 59:     if (material < 3.5) return vec3(0.80, 0.78, 0.67); // ceiling
 60:     if (material < 4.5) return vec3(1.00, 0.97, 0.78); // fluorescent
 61:     if (material < 5.5) return vec3(0.53, 0.00, 0.00); // red wall
 62:     if (material < 6.5) return vec3(0.31, 0.60, 0.24); // grass
 63:     if (material < 7.5) return vec3(0.18, 0.42, 0.72); // water
 64:     if (material < 8.5) return vec3(0.42, 0.29, 0.18); // tree
 65:     if (material < 9.5) return vec3(1.00, 0.27, 0.20);  // red light
 66:     if (material < 10.5) return vec3(0.85, 0.82, 0.75); // pale arch wall
 67:     if (material < 11.5) return vec3(0.54, 0.50, 0.36); // rough damaged wall
 68:     if (material < 12.5) return vec3(0.76, 0.72, 0.42); // dry shallow carpet
 69:     if (material < 13.5) return vec3(0.42, 0.37, 0.13); // deep wet carpet
 70:     if (material < 14.5) return vec3(0.48, 0.29, 0.15); // sticky red carpet
 71:     if (material < 15.5) return vec3(0.18, 0.16, 0.13); // dark pooled fluid
 72:     return vec3(0.62, 0.77, 0.91);                      // cool glimmer
 73: }
 74: "#;
 75: 
 76: /// World-hash and interleaved-gradient-noise helpers.
 77: ///
 78: /// OPTIMIZATION: IGN is two `fract`s and a `dot` — far cheaper than a
 79: /// sin-hash — and is used to break up 8-bit banding in fog gradients,
 80: /// which is especially visible at reduced internal resolutions.
 81: pub const NOISE_GLSL: &str = r#"
 82: float hash3D(vec3 p) {
 83:     return fract(sin(dot(p, vec3(12.9898, 78.233, 45.164))) * 43758.5453);
 84: }
 85: 
 86: float ign(vec2 p) {
 87:     vec3 magic = vec3(0.06711056, 0.00583715, 52.9829189);
 88:     return fract(magic.z * fract(dot(p, magic.xy)));
 89: }
 90: "#;
 91: 
 92: /// Reinhard tone map + gamma, shared by the surface and splat fragments.
 93: pub const TONE_MAP_GLSL: &str = r#"
 94: vec3 toneMap(vec3 color) {
 95:     color = color / (color + vec3(1.0));
 96:     return pow(color, vec3(1.0 / 2.2));
 97: }
 98: "#;
 99: 
100: /// Flare-core glow sprites: additive embers occluded by any surface nearer
101: /// than the flare along the fragment's view ray — no x-ray dots. Shared by
102: /// the surface and splat fragments; requires the `uCoreCount` / `uCores` /
103: /// `uCoreColors` uniforms to be declared before this chunk is spliced in
104: /// (both programs declare them identically).
105: pub const FLARE_CORES_GLSL: &str = r#"
106: vec3 flareCores(vec3 worldPos, vec3 camPos) {
107:     vec3 toFrag = worldPos - camPos;
108:     float fragDist = length(toFrag);
109:     vec3 rd = toFrag / max(fragDist, 1e-4);
110:     vec3 sum = vec3(0.0);
111:     for (int i = 0; i < uCoreCount; i++) {
112:         vec3 toLight = uCores[i].xyz - camPos;
113:         float along = dot(toLight, rd);
114:         if (along <= 0.05 || along >= fragDist) continue;
115:         float perp = length(toLight - rd * along);
116:         float coreSize = 0.06 + along * 0.004;
117:         float core = 1.0 - smoothstep(coreSize * 0.4, coreSize, perp);
118:         sum += uCoreColors[i] * uCores[i].w * core * 1.4;
119:     }
120:     return sum;
121: }
122: "#;
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/drivers/shaders/mod.rs
````rust
 1: //! GLSL ES 3.00 programs for every GPU render path, one module per program:
 2: //!
 3: //! | module      | program                                                |
 4: //! |-------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
 5: //! | [`raymarch`]| fullscreen SVO raymarcher (`?renderer=raymarch`)       |
 6: //! | [`surface`] | indexed greedy meshes (default renderer)               |
 7: //! | [`splat`]   | instanced face splats (`?renderer=splat`)              |
 8: //! | [`shadow`]  | depth-only hero-light shadow pass (surface + splat)    |
 9: //! | [`chunks`]  | shared GLSL snippets spliced into the programs above   |
10: //!
11: //! Cross-cutting effects (the flashlight cone, the material palette, noise
12: //! helpers, tone mapping, flare cores) exist exactly once, in [`chunks`],
13: //! and are concatenated into each program's source at link time. The
14: //! flashlight cone's constants are the GLSL mirror of the CPU spec in
15: //! `adapters::cpu_splatter::flashlight` — change both together.
16: //!
17: //! The SVO node atlas texel encoding is documented in the core's
18: //! `OctreeGpuSerializer`; the compact vertex/instance formats in
19: //! `application::ports`.
20: 
21: pub mod chunks;
22: pub mod raymarch;
23: pub mod shadow;
24: pub mod splat;
25: pub mod surface;
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/drivers/shaders/raymarch.rs
````rust
  1: //! Fullscreen SVO raymarcher program (`?renderer=raymarch`, debug path).
  2: //!
  3: //! Pipeline per fragment:
  4: //!   1. Reconstruct the camera ray from NDC + the precomputed camera basis.
  5: //!   2. Slab-test every resident chunk AABB, insertion-sorting hits by entry
  6: //!      distance so the nearest chunk is marched first (early out on hit).
  7: //!   3. March the chunk's SVO with stack-based descent + empty-space
  8: //!      skipping: an empty leaf/octant is exited in a single step via its
  9: //!      AABB exit plane instead of voxel-by-voxel DDA.
 10: //!   4. Shade from the leaf's packed RGB color, BFS light word, face normal,
 11: //!      the flashlight cone, dynamic lights, and exponential distance fog.
 12: //!
 13: //! The SVO node atlas lives in a 1024-texel-wide RGBA32UI texture; the texel
 14: //! encoding is documented in the core's `OctreeGpuSerializer`.
 15: 
 16: use super::chunks;
 17: 
 18: /// Fullscreen-triangle-pair vertex shader.
 19: pub const VERTEX_SHADER: &str = r#"#version 300 es
 20: in vec2 position;
 21: out vec2 vUv;
 22: void main() {
 23:     vUv = position * 0.5 + 0.5;
 24:     gl_Position = vec4(position, 0.0, 1.0);
 25: }
 26: "#;
 27: 
 28: /// Preamble: version, precision, varyings, uniforms.
 29: const FRAGMENT_HEADER: &str = r#"#version 300 es
 30: precision highp float;
 31: precision highp int;
 32: precision highp usampler2D;
 33: 
 34: in vec2 vUv;
 35: out vec4 fragColor;
 36: 
 37: uniform vec3 uCameraPosition;
 38: // Camera basis vectors, precomputed once per frame on the CPU so no
 39: // per-pixel trigonometry is needed to build the ray.
 40: uniform vec3 uCamRight;
 41: uniform vec3 uCamUp;
 42: uniform vec3 uCamForward;
 43: uniform float uAspect;
 44: // tan(FOV/2); 0.767 = 75 degree default.
 45: uniform float uFovTan;
 46: 
 47: uniform float uFaceWeightTop;
 48: uniform float uFaceWeightBottom;
 49: uniform float uFaceWeightX;
 50: uniform float uFaceWeightZ;
 51: 
 52: uniform int uFlashlightEnabled;
 53: // OPTIMIZATION (rt_f2b): sort chunk intersections nearest-first and stop at
 54: // the first solid hit. Off = visit input order and compare every hit.
 55: uniform int uFrontToBackEnabled;
 56: // Optimization/effect toggle: banding-noise dither (see RenderToggles).
 57: uniform int uDitherEnabled;
 58: 
 59: // Level atmosphere: outdoors (grassland) the miss/fog colors switch to a
 60: // bright sky and the ambient response scales up. Indoors these are unused.
 61: uniform int uOutdoor;
 62: uniform vec3 uSkyColor;
 63: uniform vec3 uFogColor;
 64: uniform float uAmbientScale;
 65: 
 66: // Per-frame dynamic lights (dropped flares): xyz = position, w = radius /
 67: // intensity. Same contract as the surface/splat/CPU paths.
 68: uniform int uDynamicLightCount;
 69: uniform vec4 uDynamicPosRadius[4];
 70: uniform vec4 uDynamicColorIntensity[4];
 71: 
 72: uniform usampler2D uNodeTexture;
 73: uniform int uNumChunks;
 74: uniform vec3 uChunkOrigins[25];
 75: uniform int uChunkRootIndices[25];
 76: uniform float uChunkWorldSizes[25];
 77: "#;
 78: 
 79: /// SVO traversal + shading body (everything after the shared chunks).
 80: const FRAGMENT_BODY: &str = r#"
 81: struct StackFrame {
 82:     int node_idx;
 83:     vec3 b_min;
 84:     vec3 b_max;
 85: };
 86: 
 87: struct ChunkHit {
 88:     int idx;
 89:     float t_min;
 90:     float t_max;
 91: };
 92: 
 93: struct DecodedNode {
 94:     bool isLeaf;
 95:     uint voxelType;
 96:     uint color;
 97:     uint lightLevel;
 98:     uint childBaseIndex;
 99:     uint childMask;
100: };
101: 
102: ivec2 nodeIndexToTexel(int nodeIndex, int textureWidth) {
103:     return ivec2(nodeIndex % textureWidth, nodeIndex / textureWidth);
104: }
105: 
106: DecodedNode decodeNode(usampler2D octreeTex, int nodeIndex, int textureWidth) {
107:     ivec2 texCoord = nodeIndexToTexel(nodeIndex, textureWidth);
108:     uvec4 node = texelFetch(octreeTex, texCoord, 0);
109: 
110:     DecodedNode decoded;
111:     decoded.isLeaf = (node.x == 1u);
112: 
113:     if (decoded.isLeaf) {
114:         decoded.voxelType = node.y;
115:         decoded.color = node.z;
116:         decoded.lightLevel = node.w;
117:         decoded.childBaseIndex = 0u;
118:         decoded.childMask = 0u;
119:     } else {
120:         decoded.voxelType = 0u;
121:         decoded.color = 0u;
122:         decoded.lightLevel = 0u;
123:         decoded.childBaseIndex = node.y;
124:         decoded.childMask = node.z;
125:     }
126:     return decoded;
127: }
128: 
129: bool raymarchSVO(
130:     vec3 ro, vec3 rd,
131:     int chunk_root_idx,
132:     float t_entry, float t_exit,
133:     float world_size,
134:     out vec4 hitColor, out vec3 hitNormal, out bool isLight, out uint hitVoxelType, out float hit_t, out uint hitLightWord
135: ) {
136:     float t = t_entry;
137:     vec3 p = ro + t * rd;
138: 
139:     StackFrame stack[9];
140:     int stack_ptr = 0;
141: 
142:     int current_node = chunk_root_idx;
143:     vec3 current_min = vec3(0.0);
144:     vec3 current_max = vec3(world_size);
145: 
146:     int steps = 0;
147:     const int MAX_STEPS = 160;
148: 
149:     while (steps < MAX_STEPS) {
150:         steps++;
151: 
152:         DecodedNode node = decodeNode(uNodeTexture, current_node, 1024);
153: 
154:         if (node.isLeaf) {
155:             if (node.voxelType != 0u) {
156:                 float r = float((node.color >> 16) & 0xFFu) / 255.0;
157:                 float g = float((node.color >> 8) & 0xFFu) / 255.0;
158:                 float b = float(node.color & 0xFFu) / 255.0;
159:                 float light = float(node.lightLevel & 0xFFu) / 15.0;
160: 
161:                 hitColor = vec4(r, g, b, light);
162:                 // Keep the emissive material set in parity with the domain
163:                 // palette: fluorescent (4), red light (9), glimmer (16).
164:                 isLight = (node.voxelType == 4u || node.voxelType == 9u || node.voxelType == 16u);
165:                 hitVoxelType = node.voxelType;
166:                 // Full packed light word: scalar (0-7), occlusion mask
167:                 // (8-15), RGB flood-fill channels (16-27).
168:                 hitLightWord = node.lightLevel;
169: 
170:                 vec3 hit_p = ro + t * rd;
171:                 vec3 center = (current_min + current_max) * 0.5;
172:                 vec3 size = (current_max - current_min) * 0.5;
173:                 vec3 local_p = (hit_p - center) / size;
174:                 vec3 abs_p = abs(local_p);
175: 
176:                 if (abs_p.x > abs_p.y && abs_p.x > abs_p.z) {
177:                     hitNormal = vec3(sign(local_p.x), 0.0, 0.0);
178:                 } else if (abs_p.y > abs_p.x && abs_p.y > abs_p.z) {
179:                     hitNormal = vec3(0.0, sign(local_p.y), 0.0);
180:                 } else {
181:                     hitNormal = vec3(0.0, 0.0, sign(local_p.z));
182:                 }
183:                 hit_t = t;
184:                 return true;
185:             } else {
186:                 // TRAVERSAL: empty-space skip — jump straight to this
187:                 // leaf's exit plane instead of stepping voxel by voxel.
188:                 vec3 t_max_planes = (vec3(
189:                     rd.x > 0.0 ? current_max.x : current_min.x,
190:                     rd.y > 0.0 ? current_max.y : current_min.y,
191:                     rd.z > 0.0 ? current_max.z : current_min.z
192:                 ) - ro) / rd;
193: 
194:                 float t_exit_box = min(t_max_planes.x, min(t_max_planes.y, t_max_planes.z));
195:                 t = t_exit_box;
196:                 p = ro + t * rd;
197:                 // Snap every tied axis past its exit plane: leaving an axis
198:                 // exactly ON its plane stalls the march (t stops advancing).
199:                 if (abs(t_exit_box - t_max_planes.x) < 0.0001) p.x = (rd.x > 0.0 ? current_max.x : current_min.x) + (rd.x > 0.0 ? 0.001 : -0.001);
200:                 if (abs(t_exit_box - t_max_planes.y) < 0.0001) p.y = (rd.y > 0.0 ? current_max.y : current_min.y) + (rd.y > 0.0 ? 0.001 : -0.001);
201:                 if (abs(t_exit_box - t_max_planes.z) < 0.0001) p.z = (rd.z > 0.0 ? current_max.z : current_min.z) + (rd.z > 0.0 ? 0.001 : -0.001);
202: 
203:                 // Pop EVERY level the ray exited: a skip through a plane
204:                 // shared by several ancestor boxes leaves p outside more
205:                 // than one of them, and descending from a box that no
206:                 // longer contains p corrupts the traversal (wall cracks).
207:                 while (p.x < current_min.x || p.x > current_max.x ||
208:                        p.y < current_min.y || p.y > current_max.y ||
209:                        p.z < current_min.z || p.z > current_max.z) {
210: 
211:                     if (stack_ptr == 0) return false;
212:                     stack_ptr--;
213:                     current_node = stack[stack_ptr].node_idx;
214:                     current_min = stack[stack_ptr].b_min;
215:                     current_max = stack[stack_ptr].b_max;
216:                 }
217:             }
218:         } else {
219:             vec3 center = (current_min + current_max) * 0.5;
220:             int ox = p.x >= center.x ? 1 : 0;
221:             int oy = p.y >= center.y ? 1 : 0;
222:             int oz = p.z >= center.z ? 1 : 0;
223:             int child_idx = (oz << 2) | (oy << 1) | ox;
224: 
225:             if ((node.childMask & (1u << uint(child_idx))) != 0u) {
226:                 // Descend into the occupied octant.
227:                 if (stack_ptr < 8) {
228:                     stack[stack_ptr] = StackFrame(current_node, current_min, current_max);
229:                     stack_ptr++;
230:                 }
231:                 current_min.x = ox == 1 ? center.x : current_min.x;
232:                 current_max.x = ox == 1 ? current_max.x : center.x;
233:                 current_min.y = oy == 1 ? center.y : current_min.y;
234:                 current_max.y = oy == 1 ? current_max.y : center.y;
235:                 current_min.z = oz == 1 ? center.z : current_min.z;
236:                 current_max.z = oz == 1 ? current_max.z : center.z;
237:                 current_node = int(node.childBaseIndex) + child_idx;
238:             } else {
239:                 // TRAVERSAL: masked-out (air) octant skipped in one step.
240:                 vec3 oct_max = vec3(
241:                     ox == 1 ? current_max.x : center.x,
242:                     oy == 1 ? current_max.y : center.y,
243:                     oz == 1 ? current_max.z : center.z
244:                 );
245:                 vec3 oct_min = vec3(
246:                     ox == 1 ? center.x : current_min.x,
247:                     oy == 1 ? center.y : current_min.y,
248:                     oz == 1 ? center.z : current_min.z
249:                 );
250:                  vec3 t_max_planes = (vec3(
251:                     rd.x > 0.0 ? oct_max.x : oct_min.x,
252:                     rd.y > 0.0 ? oct_max.y : oct_min.y,
253:                     rd.z > 0.0 ? oct_max.z : oct_min.z
254:                 ) - ro) / rd;
255: 
256:                 float t_exit_oct = min(t_max_planes.x, min(t_max_planes.y, t_max_planes.z));
257:                 t = t_exit_oct;
258:                 p = ro + t * rd;
259:                 if (abs(t_exit_oct - t_max_planes.x) < 0.0001) p.x = (rd.x > 0.0 ? oct_max.x : oct_min.x) + (rd.x > 0.0 ? 0.001 : -0.001);
260:                 if (abs(t_exit_oct - t_max_planes.y) < 0.0001) p.y = (rd.y > 0.0 ? oct_max.y : oct_min.y) + (rd.y > 0.0 ? 0.001 : -0.001);
261:                 if (abs(t_exit_oct - t_max_planes.z) < 0.0001) p.z = (rd.z > 0.0 ? oct_max.z : oct_min.z) + (rd.z > 0.0 ? 0.001 : -0.001);
262: 
263:                 // Same multi-level pop as the empty-leaf skip above.
264:                 while (p.x < current_min.x || p.x > current_max.x ||
265:                        p.y < current_min.y || p.y > current_max.y ||
266:                        p.z < current_min.z || p.z > current_max.z) {
267: 
268:                     if (stack_ptr == 0) return false;
269:                     stack_ptr--;
270:                     current_node = stack[stack_ptr].node_idx;
271:                     current_min = stack[stack_ptr].b_min;
272:                     current_max = stack[stack_ptr].b_max;
273:                 }
274:             }
275:         }
276:     }
277:     return false;
278: }
279: 
280: void main() {
281:     vec2 ndc = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
282:     vec3 rd = normalize(
283:         uCamRight * (ndc.x * uAspect * uFovTan) +
284:         uCamUp * (ndc.y * uFovTan) +
285:         uCamForward
286:     );
287: 
288:     vec3 ro = uCameraPosition;
289: 
290:     ChunkHit hits[25];
291:     int numHits = 0;
292: 
293:     // Clamp near-zero direction components: the slab test divides by them,
294:     // and a NaN here corrupts the whole traversal.
295:     vec3 safe_rd = vec3(
296:         abs(rd.x) < 1e-4 ? (rd.x < 0.0 ? -1e-4 : 1e-4) : rd.x,
297:         abs(rd.y) < 1e-4 ? (rd.y < 0.0 ? -1e-4 : 1e-4) : rd.y,
298:         abs(rd.z) < 1e-4 ? (rd.z < 0.0 ? -1e-4 : 1e-4) : rd.z
299:     );
300:     vec3 invRd = 1.0 / safe_rd;
301: 
302:     // TRAVERSAL: chunk-level coarse pass — slab-test each chunk AABB before
303:     // entering its SVO.
304:     for (int i = 0; i < uNumChunks; i++) {
305:         vec3 local_ro = ro - uChunkOrigins[i];
306: 
307:         vec3 box_min = vec3(0.0);
308:         vec3 box_max = vec3(uChunkWorldSizes[i]);
309: 
310:         vec3 t1 = (box_min - local_ro) * invRd;
311:         vec3 t2 = (box_max - local_ro) * invRd;
312:         vec3 t_min_p = min(t1, t2);
313:         vec3 t_max_p = max(t1, t2);
314: 
315:         float t_entry = max(t_min_p.x, max(t_min_p.y, t_min_p.z));
316:         float t_exit = min(t_max_p.x, min(t_max_p.y, t_max_p.z));
317: 
318:         if (t_entry < t_exit && t_exit > 0.0) {
319:             float real_entry = max(t_entry, 0.0);
320:             // OPTIMIZATION (rt_f2b): insertion-sort the small fixed hit list.
321:             // The disabled reference path retains input order.
322:             int insert_pos = numHits;
323:             if (uFrontToBackEnabled == 1) {
324:                 while (insert_pos > 0 && hits[insert_pos - 1].t_min > real_entry) {
325:                     hits[insert_pos] = hits[insert_pos - 1];
326:                     insert_pos--;
327:                 }
328:             }
329:             hits[insert_pos] = ChunkHit(i, real_entry, t_exit);
330:             numHits++;
331:         }
332:     }
333: 
334:     vec4 finalColor = vec4(0.0);
335:     vec3 finalNormal = vec3(0.0);
336:     bool hitSolid = false;
337:     bool hitIsLight = false;
338:     uint finalVoxelType = 0u;
339:     uint finalLightWord = 0u;
340:     float closest_t = 1e6;
341:     int hit_chunk_idx = -1;
342: 
343:     for (int k = 0; k < numHits; k++) {
344:         int i = hits[k].idx;
345:         vec3 local_ro = ro - uChunkOrigins[i];
346: 
347:         vec4 col;
348:         vec3 norm;
349:         bool isL;
350:         uint h_voxel_type;
351:         float h_t;
352:         uint h_light_word;
353:         if (raymarchSVO(local_ro, safe_rd, uChunkRootIndices[i], hits[k].t_min, hits[k].t_max,
354:                         uChunkWorldSizes[i], col, norm, isL, h_voxel_type, h_t, h_light_word)) {
355:             if (uFrontToBackEnabled == 1 || h_t < closest_t) {
356:                 finalColor = col;
357:                 finalNormal = norm;
358:                 hitSolid = true;
359:                 hitIsLight = isL;
360:                 finalVoxelType = h_voxel_type;
361:                 finalLightWord = h_light_word;
362:                 closest_t = h_t;
363:                 hit_chunk_idx = i;
364:             }
365:             if (uFrontToBackEnabled == 1) break;
366:         }
367:     }
368: 
369:     if (hitSolid) {
370:         vec3 albedo = hitIsLight ? vec3(1.0) : finalColor.rgb;
371:         float staticLight = finalColor.a;
372: 
373:         vec3 N = finalNormal;
374:         vec3 V = -rd; // View direction pointing back to camera
375: 
376:         vec3 litColor;
377:         if (hitIsLight) {
378:             // Emissive materials skip diffuse lighting, but still pass
379:             // through the common fog/vignette/dither stage below so distant
380:             // fixtures cannot pierce the level atmosphere.
381:             litColor = finalColor.rgb * 1.5;
382:         } else {
383:         // 1. Natural ambient and contact shadows.
384:         float voxel_scale = uChunkWorldSizes[hit_chunk_idx] > 20.0 ? 0.1 : 0.2;
385:         vec3 local_hit_p = (ro - uChunkOrigins[hit_chunk_idx]) + closest_t * rd;
386: 
387:         float distToFloor = local_hit_p.y - voxel_scale;
388:         float distToCeiling = (3.0 - voxel_scale) - local_hit_p.y;
389: 
390:         // Soft contact-shadow AO in corners where walls meet floor/ceiling.
391:         float edgeAO = 1.0;
392:         if (abs(N.y) < 0.5) { // Only apply to vertical walls
393:             edgeAO = smoothstep(0.0, 0.4, distToFloor) * smoothstep(0.0, 0.4, distToCeiling);
394:             edgeAO = mix(0.55, 1.0, edgeAO);
395:         }
396: 
397:         // Brighter, warmer ambient for a natural Backrooms look.
398:         float bfs_term = 0.4 + 0.8 * staticLight;
399:         vec3 vSq = V * V;
400:         float y_val = V.y > 0.0 ? uFaceWeightTop : uFaceWeightBottom;
401:         float face_shading_scalar = vSq.x * uFaceWeightX + vSq.y * y_val + vSq.z * uFaceWeightZ;
402: 
403:         // Decode per-face occlusion from the 6-bit mask.
404:         uint finalOcclusion = (finalLightWord >> 8u) & 0x3Fu;
405:         bool isOccluded = false;
406:         if (N.x > 0.5) { isOccluded = ((finalOcclusion & 1u) != 0u); }
407:         else if (N.x < -0.5) { isOccluded = ((finalOcclusion & 2u) != 0u); }
408:         else if (N.y > 0.5) { isOccluded = ((finalOcclusion & 4u) != 0u); }
409:         else if (N.y < -0.5) { isOccluded = ((finalOcclusion & 8u) != 0u); }
410:         else if (N.z > 0.5) { isOccluded = ((finalOcclusion & 16u) != 0u); }
411:         else if (N.z < -0.5) { isOccluded = ((finalOcclusion & 32u) != 0u); }
412: 
413:         // Colored flood-fill light: the BFS propagates three channels, so
414:         // the local light *chroma* comes straight from the atlas instead of
415:         // a binary red/white flag. Falls back to a warm white where unlit.
416:         vec3 lightRgb = vec3(
417:             float((finalLightWord >> 16u) & 0xFu),
418:             float((finalLightWord >> 20u) & 0xFu),
419:             float((finalLightWord >> 24u) & 0xFu)
420:         ) * (1.0 / 15.0);
421:         float maxChannel = max(lightRgb.r, max(lightRgb.g, lightRgb.b));
422:         vec3 lightTint = maxChannel > 0.001 ? lightRgb / maxChannel : vec3(1.0, 0.98, 0.90);
423: 
424:         float face_occlusion_factor = isOccluded ? 0.35 : 1.0;
425: 
426:         vec3 groundColor = vec3(0.24, 0.21, 0.16);
427:         vec3 skyColor = vec3(0.52, 0.48, 0.40);
428:         if (uOutdoor == 1) {
429:             // Daylight: cool bright hemisphere instead of sickly interior.
430:             groundColor = vec3(0.38, 0.40, 0.36);
431:             skyColor = vec3(0.72, 0.78, 0.86);
432:         }
433:         vec3 ambient = mix(groundColor, skyColor, N.y * 0.5 + 0.5) * (bfs_term * face_shading_scalar * face_occlusion_factor) * edgeAO * uAmbientScale;
434:         // Let strong colored light bleed subtly into the ambient term.
435:         ambient *= mix(vec3(1.0), lightTint, 0.5 * staticLight);
436: 
437:         // 2. Faux-directional room lights: assume a fixture at the center
438:         // of the nearest 3-unit ceiling cell.
439:         vec2 cell_center = floor(local_hit_p.xz / 3.0) * 3.0 + 1.5;
440:         vec3 light_pos = vec3(cell_center.x, 3.6, cell_center.y);
441:         vec3 auto_L = normalize(light_pos - local_hit_p);
442: 
443:         // Wrapped diffuse lets vertical walls catch overhead light.
444:         float wrappedNdotL = dot(N, auto_L) * 0.5 + 0.5;
445:         float staticDiffuse = wrappedNdotL * staticLight * 0.9;
446:         vec3 staticDiffuseContrib = staticDiffuse * albedo * lightTint;
447: 
448:         // Per-voxel material response (fixed mappings).
449:         float roughness = 0.9;
450:         float specularStrength = 0.0;
451:         if (finalVoxelType == 1u) { // VOXEL_WALL
452:             roughness = 0.85;
453:             specularStrength = 0.02;
454:         } else if (finalVoxelType == 2u) { // VOXEL_FLOOR (carpet)
455:             roughness = 1.0;
456:             specularStrength = 0.0; // Completely diffuse
457:         } else if (finalVoxelType == 3u) { // VOXEL_CEILING
458:             roughness = 0.5;
459:             specularStrength = 0.15;
460:         } else if (finalVoxelType == 5u) { // VOXEL_RED_WALL
461:             roughness = 0.7;
462:             specularStrength = 0.08;
463:         } else if (finalVoxelType == 8u) { // VOXEL_TREE / PILLAR
464:             roughness = 0.4;
465:             specularStrength = 0.25;
466:         }
467: 
468:         // Blinn-Phong specular modulated by per-voxel roughness.
469:         float shininess = mix(256.0, 4.0, roughness);
470:         vec3 staticH = normalize(auto_L + V);
471:         float staticSpecular = pow(max(dot(N, staticH), 0.0), shininess) * staticLight * specularStrength;
472:         vec3 staticSpecularContrib = staticSpecular * lightTint;
473: 
474:         vec3 staticContrib = (staticDiffuseContrib + staticSpecularContrib) * edgeAO;
475: 
476:         litColor = albedo * ambient + staticContrib;
477: 
478:         // 3. Flashlight: a true spotlight cone around the camera forward
479:         // axis (shared spec with the CPU splatter — see SPOT_* above).
480:         // This replaces the old N-dot-V "headlamp" approximation that lit
481:         // everything facing the camera regardless of screen position.
482:         if (uFlashlightEnabled == 1) {
483:             vec3 world_hit = ro + closest_t * rd;
484:             litColor += albedo * spotBeam(uCameraPosition, uCamForward, world_hit, N);
485:         }
486: 
487:         // Dynamic lights (dropped flares): local point lights with quadratic
488:         // falloff, matching the other render paths.
489:         {
490:             vec3 world_hit = ro + closest_t * rd;
491:             for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
492:                 if (i >= uDynamicLightCount) break;
493:                 vec3 toL = uDynamicPosRadius[i].xyz - world_hit;
494:                 float d2 = dot(toL, toL);
495:                 float r = uDynamicPosRadius[i].w;
496:                 float r2 = r * r;
497:                 if (d2 >= r2) continue;
498:                 float d = sqrt(d2);
499:                 vec3 L = toL / max(d, 1e-4);
500:                 float ndotl = max(dot(N, L), 0.0);
501:                 float atten = pow(max(1.0 - d2 / r2, 0.0), 2.0);
502:                 litColor += albedo * uDynamicColorIntensity[i].rgb
503:                     * (uDynamicColorIntensity[i].a * atten * ndotl);
504:             }
505:         }
506:         }
507: 
508:         // 4. Fog and vignette.
509:         float dist = closest_t;
510:         float fogFactor = exp(-0.02 * dist);
511: 
512:         float vignette = vUv.x * vUv.y * (1.0 - vUv.x) * (1.0 - vUv.y);
513:         vignette = clamp(pow(16.0 * vignette, 0.25), 0.0, 1.0);
514: 
515:         vec3 fogTarget = uOutdoor == 1 ? uFogColor : vec3(0.0);
516:         vec3 outColor = mix(fogTarget, litColor, fogFactor * vignette);
517:         // Interleaved-gradient-noise dither breaks up the 8-bit banding of
518:         // fog/vignette gradients (toggle: rt_dither).
519:         outColor += (ign(gl_FragCoord.xy) - 0.5) * (1.0 / 128.0) * float(uDitherEnabled);
520:         fragColor = vec4(outColor, 1.0);
521:     } else {
522:         fragColor = vec4(uOutdoor == 1 ? uSkyColor : vec3(0.0), 1.0);
523:     }
524: }
525: "#;
526: 
527: /// Assembles the fragment shader from the preamble, shared chunks, and the
528: /// traversal/shading body. Runs once at program link time.
529: pub fn fragment_source() -> String {
530:     let mut source = String::with_capacity(
531:         FRAGMENT_HEADER.len()
532:             + chunks::NOISE_GLSL.len()
533:             + chunks::SPOT_CONE_GLSL.len()
534:             + FRAGMENT_BODY.len(),
535:     );
536:     source.push_str(FRAGMENT_HEADER);
537:     source.push_str(chunks::NOISE_GLSL);
538:     source.push_str(chunks::SPOT_CONE_GLSL);
539:     source.push_str(FRAGMENT_BODY);
540:     source
541: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/drivers/shaders/shadow.rs
````rust
 1: //! Hero-light shadow-map program: depth-only render of chunk meshes from
 2: //! the light's view. Both the surface and splat renderers use it — the
 3: //! splat path casts from the retained greedy mesh so caster and visible
 4: //! splats always agree (same grids, same LOD).
 5: 
 6: pub const VERTEX_SHADER: &str = r#"#version 300 es
 7: layout(location = 0) in vec3 aPosition;
 8: uniform mat4 uLightViewProjection;
 9: uniform vec3 uChunkOrigin;
10: 
11: void main() {
12:     vec3 worldPosition = uChunkOrigin + aPosition * (1.0 / 1024.0);
13:     gl_Position = uLightViewProjection * vec4(worldPosition, 1.0);
14: }
15: "#;
16: 
17: pub const FRAGMENT_SHADER: &str = r#"#version 300 es
18: precision highp float;
19: void main() {
20:     // Depth is automatically written to the depth buffer.
21: }
22: "#;
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/drivers/shaders/splat.rs
````rust
  1: //! Instanced face-splat program — the GPU microvoxel path.
  2: //!
  3: //! One instance is one axis-aligned surface rectangle (`PackedFaceInstance`);
  4: //! the vertex shader rebuilds the quad from center + extents + axis via
  5: //! `gl_VertexID` (4-vertex TRIANGLE_STRIP) and evaluates ALL lighting once
  6: //! per face, flat — the voxel look, and the reason the fragment shader
  7: //! shrinks to fog + grain + dither (the Pi win).
  8: 
  9: use super::chunks;
 10: 
 11: /// Preamble: version, attributes, uniforms, varyings.
 12: const VERTEX_HEADER: &str = r#"#version 300 es
 13: precision highp float;
 14: precision highp sampler3D;
 15: 
 16: in vec3 aFacePos;      // face center, chunk-local fixed point (1/1024 u)
 17: in vec2 aFaceExtents;  // cells along the face's U/V axes
 18: in vec4 aFaceMeta;     // normal_axis, material, baked_light (0-15), ao
 19: in float aFaceFlags;   // bit 0: emissive
 20: 
 21: uniform mat4 uProjection;
 22: uniform mat4 uView;
 23: uniform vec3 uChunkOrigin;
 24: uniform vec3 uChunkSize;
 25: uniform float uVoxelScale;
 26: uniform vec3 uCameraPosition;
 27: // Camera forward axis for the flashlight cone.
 28: uniform vec3 uCamForward;
 29: uniform int uFlashlightEnabled;
 30: uniform sampler3D uLightVolume;
 31: 
 32: uniform int uLightCount;
 33: uniform vec3 uLightPositions[4];
 34: uniform vec3 uLightColors[4];
 35: uniform vec4 uLightParams[4];
 36: 
 37: uniform sampler2D uShadowMap;
 38: uniform mat4 uLightViewProjection;
 39: uniform int uShadowedLightIndex;
 40: uniform int uShadowTaps;
 41: 
 42: // Level atmosphere (see the surface shader).
 43: uniform int uOutdoor;
 44: uniform float uAmbientScale;
 45: 
 46: out vec3 vWorldPos;
 47: flat out vec3 vColor;
 48: flat out vec3 vNormal;
 49: flat out float vEmissive;
 50: flat out float vGrainAmp;
 51: flat out float vBeamPattern;
 52: "#;
 53: 
 54: /// Quad reconstruction + per-face lighting body.
 55: const VERTEX_BODY: &str = r#"
 56: vec3 normalForAxis(float axis) {
 57:     if (axis < 0.5) return vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
 58:     if (axis < 1.5) return vec3(0.0, -1.0, 0.0);
 59:     if (axis < 2.5) return vec3(0.0, 0.0, -1.0);
 60:     if (axis < 3.5) return vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
 61:     if (axis < 4.5) return vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
 62:     return vec3(-1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
 63: }
 64: 
 65: // In-plane basis with U x V = outward normal, so the TRIANGLE_STRIP corner
 66: // order (-1,-1)(1,-1)(-1,1)(1,1) is counter-clockwise from the front.
 67: void faceBasis(float axis, out vec3 u, out vec3 v) {
 68:     if (axis < 0.5)      { u = vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0); v = vec3(0.0, 0.0, -1.0); }
 69:     else if (axis < 1.5) { u = vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0); v = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0); }
 70:     else if (axis < 2.5) { u = vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0); v = vec3(0.0, -1.0, 0.0); }
 71:     else if (axis < 3.5) { u = vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0); v = vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0); }
 72:     else if (axis < 4.5) { u = vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0); v = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0); }
 73:     else                 { u = vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0); v = vec3(0.0, 0.0, -1.0); }
 74: }
 75: 
 76: // Face-center shadow visibility. Vertex shaders have no derivatives or
 77: // gl_FragCoord, so this uses a fixed symmetric tap pattern; tap count is a
 78: // spec-profile knob (1 on Pi-class, 4 on high).
 79: float shadowVisibility(vec3 worldPos, vec3 normal, vec3 lightDir) {
 80:     vec4 lightClip = uLightViewProjection * vec4(worldPos + normal * 0.025, 1.0);
 81:     vec3 p = lightClip.xyz / lightClip.w;
 82:     vec2 uv = p.xy * 0.5 + 0.5;
 83:     float receiverDepth = p.z * 0.5 + 0.5;
 84:     if (any(lessThan(uv, vec2(0.0))) || any(greaterThan(uv, vec2(1.0))) || receiverDepth >= 1.0) {
 85:         return 1.0;
 86:     }
 87:     float bias = max(0.003 * (1.0 - dot(normal, lightDir)), 0.0008);
 88:     float compare = receiverDepth - bias;
 89:     if (uShadowTaps <= 1) {
 90:         float d = textureLod(uShadowMap, uv, 0.0).r;
 91:         return (compare > d) ? 0.0 : 1.0;
 92:     }
 93:     vec2 texelSize = 1.0 / vec2(textureSize(uShadowMap, 0));
 94:     vec2 offsets[4] = vec2[](
 95:         vec2(-0.5, -0.5), vec2(0.5, -0.5),
 96:         vec2(-0.5,  0.5), vec2(0.5,  0.5)
 97:     );
 98:     float shadow = 0.0;
 99:     for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
100:         float d = textureLod(uShadowMap, uv + offsets[i] * texelSize, 0.0).r;
101:         shadow += (compare > d) ? 0.0 : 1.0;
102:     }
103:     return shadow * 0.25;
104: }
105: 
106: // Quantize the light magnitude while preserving its RGB ratio. Quantizing
107: // channels independently makes warm yellow light jump toward neutral grey.
108: vec3 quantizeLighting(vec3 lightColor) {
109:     float peak = max(max(lightColor.r, lightColor.g), lightColor.b);
110:     if (peak < 0.0001) {
111:         return vec3(0.08, 0.07, 0.035);
112:     }
113:     float band = max(floor(peak * 6.0 + 0.5) / 6.0, 0.08);
114:     return lightColor * (band / peak);
115: }
116: 
117: void main() {
118:     vec2 corner = vec2(
119:         (gl_VertexID == 1 || gl_VertexID == 3) ? 1.0 : -1.0,
120:         (gl_VertexID >= 2) ? 1.0 : -1.0
121:     );
122:     vec3 N = normalForAxis(aFaceMeta.x);
123:     vec3 U, V;
124:     faceBasis(aFaceMeta.x, U, V);
125: 
126:     vec3 center = uChunkOrigin + aFacePos * (1.0 / 1024.0);
127:     float halfU = aFaceExtents.x * uVoxelScale * 0.5;
128:     float halfV = aFaceExtents.y * uVoxelScale * 0.5;
129:     vec3 world = center + corner.x * halfU * U + corner.y * halfV * V;
130:     vWorldPos = world;
131:     vNormal = N;
132:     gl_Position = uProjection * uView * vec4(world, 1.0);
133: 
134:     vec3 albedo = materialColor(aFaceMeta.y);
135:     bool emissive = aFaceFlags > 0.5;
136:     vEmissive = emissive ? 1.0 : 0.0;
137:     // Per-voxel grain amplitude: subtle on walls/floors, none on ceilings
138:     // (a bright ceiling plane turns grain into salt-and-pepper noise) or
139:     // emissive fixtures.
140:     bool isCeiling = aFaceMeta.y > 2.5 && aFaceMeta.y < 3.5;
141:     vGrainAmp = (emissive || isCeiling) ? 0.0 : 0.02;
142:     // Coffer beams live in shading, not geometry: downward ceiling faces
143:     // get a world-locked beam-grid darkening in the fragment shader.
144:     vBeamPattern = (isCeiling && aFaceMeta.x > 0.5 && aFaceMeta.x < 1.5) ? 1.0 : 0.0;
145:     if (emissive) {
146:         vColor = albedo * 1.5;
147:         return;
148:     }
149: 
150:     vec3 toCamera = uCameraPosition - center;
151:     float distanceToCamera = length(toCamera);
152: 
153:     // Sample the baked light volume half a voxel into the air so a face
154:     // never reads the dark interior of its own wall.
155:     vec3 samplePos = center + N * (0.5 * uVoxelScale);
156:     vec3 uvw = (samplePos - uChunkOrigin) / uChunkSize;
157:     vec3 irradiance = textureLod(uLightVolume, clamp(uvw, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0).rgb;
158:     // The compact face record carries the scalar bake too. It is a robust
159:     // floor at chunk borders and preserves the CPU splatter's light bands,
160:     // while the 3D volume supplies the actual warm/red chroma.
161:     float baked = aFaceMeta.z * (1.0 / 15.0);
162:     vec3 bakedWarm = vec3(baked, baked * 0.94, baked * 0.72);
163:     irradiance = max(irradiance, bakedWarm);
164:     irradiance = max(irradiance, vec3(0.035, 0.03, 0.015));
165:     if (uOutdoor == 1) {
166:         irradiance = max(irradiance, vec3(0.30, 0.32, 0.36));
167:     }
168: 
169:     float faceResponse = 0.8;
170:     if (N.y > 0.5) {
171:         faceResponse = 1.0;
172:     } else if (N.y < -0.5) {
173:         faceResponse = 0.35;
174:     } else {
175:         faceResponse = 0.65 + 0.1 * N.x + 0.05 * N.z;
176:     }
177: 
178:     float ao = mix(1.0, 0.22, clamp(aFaceMeta.w * 1.3, 0.0, 1.0));
179: 
180:     vec3 ambientUp = vec3(1.05, 1.0, 0.72) * irradiance;
181:     vec3 ambientDown = vec3(0.58, 0.52, 0.30) * irradiance;
182:     if (uOutdoor == 1) {
183:         ambientUp = vec3(0.98, 1.02, 1.08) * irradiance;
184:         ambientDown = vec3(0.56, 0.58, 0.55) * irradiance;
185:     }
186:     vec3 ambient = mix(ambientDown, ambientUp, N.y * 0.5 + 0.5) * ao * faceResponse * uAmbientScale;
187: 
188:     vec3 directDiffuse = vec3(0.0);
189:     for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
190:         if (i >= uLightCount) break;
191:         vec3 toLight = uLightPositions[i] - center;
192:         float d2 = dot(toLight, toLight);
193:         float range = uLightParams[i].x;
194:         float range2 = range * range;
195:         if (d2 >= range2) continue;
196: 
197:         float d = sqrt(d2);
198:         vec3 L = toLight / max(d, 0.001);
199:         float ndotl = max(dot(N, L), 0.0);
200:         float falloff = pow(max(1.0 - d2 / range2, 0.0), 2.0) / (1.0 + 0.05 * d2);
201: 
202:         float visible = 1.0;
203:         if (i == uShadowedLightIndex) {
204:             visible = shadowVisibility(center, N, L);
205:         }
206: 
207:         float lightHash = hash3D(uLightPositions[i] * 10.0);
208:         float directMod = 1.0 + 0.05 * (lightHash - 0.5);
209:         vec3 lightColor = mix(uLightColors[i], vec3(1.0, 0.96, 0.85), 0.3);
210:         directDiffuse += lightColor * uLightParams[i].y * falloff * visible * ndotl * directMod;
211:     }
212: 
213:     // Flashlight: the shared spotlight cone (spec in the CPU splatter),
214:     // evaluated once per face at its center — flat like all splat lighting.
215:     // Kept INSIDE the light sum: the material color is the immutable base
216:     // and every light multiplies it, so the flashlight brightens yellow
217:     // walls toward brighter yellow, never neutral grey.
218:     vec3 flashlight = vec3(0.0);
219:     if (uFlashlightEnabled == 1) {
220:         flashlight = spotBeam(uCameraPosition, uCamForward, center, N);
221:     }
222: 
223:     vec3 lighting = quantizeLighting(ambient + directDiffuse + flashlight);
224:     vColor = albedo * lighting;
225: }
226: "#;
227: 
228: /// Fragment preamble.
229: const FRAGMENT_HEADER: &str = r#"#version 300 es
230: precision highp float;
231: // Fragment ints default to mediump; the vertex stage declares uOutdoor at
232: // its (highp) default, and linking demands the precisions match.
233: precision highp int;
234: 
235: in vec3 vWorldPos;
236: flat in vec3 vColor;
237: flat in vec3 vNormal;
238: flat in float vEmissive;
239: flat in float vGrainAmp;
240: flat in float vBeamPattern;
241: 
242: uniform vec3 uCameraPosition;
243: uniform float uVoxelScale;
244: // Optimization/effect toggle: grain + banding dither (RenderToggles).
245: uniform int uDitherEnabled;
246: 
247: // Dropped-flare cores: xyz = world position, w = intensity (pre-flickered).
248: uniform int uCoreCount;
249: uniform vec4 uCores[4];
250: uniform vec3 uCoreColors[4];
251: 
252: // Level atmosphere: outdoors the fog fades to a bright sky haze instead of
253: // black (the framebuffer is cleared to the matching sky color).
254: uniform int uOutdoor;
255: uniform vec3 uFogColor;
256: 
257: out vec4 fragColor;
258: "#;
259: 
260: /// The splat fragment body is deliberately tiny (the Pi win): fog,
261: /// voxel-lattice albedo grain, ordered dither, tone map. All lighting
262: /// arrived flat from the vertex shader.
263: const FRAGMENT_BODY: &str = r#"
264: void main() {
265:     vec3 color = vColor;
266:     float distanceToCamera = length(uCameraPosition - vWorldPos);
267: 
268:     if (vEmissive < 0.5) {
269:         // World-locked per-voxel albedo grain: sample half a voxel inside
270:         // the surface so faces lying exactly on lattice planes hash stably.
271:         // Amplitude is per-face (zero on ceilings) so large bright planes
272:         // read as solid construction, not noise.
273:         vec3 lattice = floor((vWorldPos - vNormal * (0.5 * uVoxelScale)) / uVoxelScale);
274:         float grain = 1.0 + (hash3D(lattice) - 0.5) * 2.0 * vGrainAmp * float(uDitherEnabled);
275:         color *= grain;
276: 
277:         // Coffer beam grid on ceilings (matches the generator's
278:         // COFFER_PERIOD): intentional construction lines, zero geometry.
279:         if (vBeamPattern > 0.5) {
280:             bool onBeam = mod(vWorldPos.x, 2.8) < 0.22 || mod(vWorldPos.z, 2.8) < 0.22;
281:             if (onBeam) {
282:                 color *= 0.86;
283:             }
284:         }
285: 
286:     }
287: 
288:     // Warm haze nearby, fading all the way to black before the draw limit.
289:     // The framebuffer is cleared to the same black, so a not-yet-generated
290:     // chunk reads as void instead of a brown rectangle.
291:     float fogOnset = 14.0;
292:     float fogDist = max(0.0, distanceToCamera - fogOnset);
293:     float fogDensity = 0.032;
294:     float heightFactor = 1.0 + 0.35 * smoothstep(0.0, 3.4, vWorldPos.y);
295:     float fogAmount = 1.0 - exp(-fogDist * fogDensity * heightFactor);
296:     fogAmount = max(fogAmount, smoothstep(34.0, 48.0, distanceToCamera));
297: 
298:     float hNorm = clamp(vWorldPos.y / 5.0, 0.0, 1.0);
299:     vec3 heightFogColor = mix(
300:         vec3(0.055, 0.040, 0.014),
301:         vec3(0.055, 0.060, 0.020),
302:         hNorm
303:     );
304:     float farFade = smoothstep(28.0, 48.0, distanceToCamera);
305:     vec3 currentFogColor = mix(heightFogColor, vec3(0.0), farFade);
306:     if (uOutdoor == 1) {
307:         currentFogColor = uFogColor;
308:     }
309:     color = mix(color, currentFogColor, clamp(fogAmount, 0.0, 1.0));
310: 
311:     // Flare cores (shared chunk; occluded by nearer surfaces).
312:     color += flareCores(vWorldPos, uCameraPosition);
313: 
314:     color = toneMap(color);
315:     color += (ign(gl_FragCoord.xy) - 0.5) * (1.0 / 128.0) * (1.0 - fogAmount) * float(uDitherEnabled);
316: 
317:     fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
318: }
319: "#;
320: 
321: /// Assembles the vertex shader (quad rebuild + all lighting, flat).
322: pub fn vertex_source() -> String {
323:     let mut source = String::with_capacity(
324:         VERTEX_HEADER.len()
325:             + chunks::MATERIAL_COLOR_GLSL.len()
326:             + chunks::NOISE_GLSL.len()
327:             + chunks::SPOT_CONE_GLSL.len()
328:             + VERTEX_BODY.len(),
329:     );
330:     source.push_str(VERTEX_HEADER);
331:     source.push_str(chunks::MATERIAL_COLOR_GLSL);
332:     source.push_str(chunks::NOISE_GLSL);
333:     source.push_str(chunks::SPOT_CONE_GLSL);
334:     source.push_str(VERTEX_BODY);
335:     source
336: }
337: 
338: /// Assembles the (deliberately tiny) fragment shader.
339: pub fn fragment_source() -> String {
340:     let mut source = String::with_capacity(
341:         FRAGMENT_HEADER.len()
342:             + chunks::NOISE_GLSL.len()
343:             + chunks::TONE_MAP_GLSL.len()
344:             + chunks::FLARE_CORES_GLSL.len()
345:             + FRAGMENT_BODY.len(),
346:     );
347:     source.push_str(FRAGMENT_HEADER);
348:     source.push_str(chunks::NOISE_GLSL);
349:     source.push_str(chunks::TONE_MAP_GLSL);
350:     source.push_str(chunks::FLARE_CORES_GLSL);
351:     source.push_str(FRAGMENT_BODY);
352:     source
353: }
````

````rust
  1: //! Indexed-surface program — the default renderer's shaders.
  2: //!
  3: //! They intentionally use only ordinary WebGL2 vertex/index buffers: raster
  4: //! depth testing replaces the fullscreen SVO traversal while the SVO remains
  5: //! available for collision and debug/reference queries. Lighting runs per
  6: //! fragment: baked 3D light volume + up to four selected point lights (one
  7: //! shadow-mapped hero light) + the flashlight cone + flare cores + fog.
  8: 
  9: use super::chunks;
 10: 
 11: pub const VERTEX_SHADER: &str = r#"#version 300 es
 12: precision highp float;
 13: 
 14: layout(location = 0) in vec3 aPosition;
 15: in float aNormalAxis;
 16: in float aMaterial;
 17: in float aStaticIndirect;
 18: in float aAo;
 19: 
 20: uniform mat4 uProjection;
 21: uniform mat4 uView;
 22: uniform vec3 uChunkOrigin;
 23: 
 24: out vec3 vWorldPosition;
 25: out vec3 vNormal;
 26: flat out float vMaterial;
 27: flat out float vStaticIndirect;
 28: flat out float vAo;
 29: 
 30: vec3 normalForAxis(float axis) {
 31:     if (axis < 0.5) return vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
 32:     if (axis < 1.5) return vec3(0.0, -1.0, 0.0);
 33:     if (axis < 2.5) return vec3(0.0, 0.0, -1.0);
 34:     if (axis < 3.5) return vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
 35:     if (axis < 4.5) return vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
 36:     return vec3(-1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
 37: }
 38: 
 39: void main() {
 40:     vec3 world = uChunkOrigin + aPosition * (1.0 / 1024.0);
 41:     vWorldPosition = world;
 42:     vNormal = normalForAxis(aNormalAxis);
 43:     vMaterial = aMaterial;
 44:     vStaticIndirect = aStaticIndirect;
 45:     vAo = aAo;
 46:     gl_Position = uProjection * uView * vec4(world, 1.0);
 47: }
 48: "#;
 49: 
 50: /// Preamble: version, precision, varyings, uniforms.
 51: const FRAGMENT_HEADER: &str = r#"#version 300 es
 52: precision highp float;
 53: precision highp sampler3D;
 54: 
 55: in vec3 vWorldPosition;
 56: in vec3 vNormal;
 57: flat in float vMaterial;
 58: flat in float vStaticIndirect;
 59: flat in float vAo;
 60: 
 61: uniform vec3 uCameraPosition;
 62: // Camera forward axis for the flashlight cone.
 63: uniform vec3 uCamForward;
 64: uniform int uFlashlightEnabled;
 65: // Optimization/effect toggle: ordered-dither light banding (RenderToggles).
 66: uniform int uDitherEnabled;
 67: uniform sampler3D uLightVolume;
 68: uniform vec3 uChunkOrigin;
 69: uniform vec3 uChunkSize;
 70: 
 71: uniform int uLightCount;
 72: uniform vec3 uLightPositions[4];
 73: uniform vec3 uLightColors[4];
 74: uniform vec4 uLightParams[4];
 75: 
 76: uniform sampler2D uShadowMap;
 77: uniform mat4 uLightViewProjection;
 78: uniform int uShadowedLightIndex;
 79: 
 80: // Dropped-flare cores: xyz = world position, w = intensity (pre-flickered).
 81: uniform int uCoreCount;
 82: uniform vec4 uCores[4];
 83: uniform vec3 uCoreColors[4];
 84: 
 85: // Level atmosphere: outdoors (grassland) fog turns into bright sky haze and
 86: // the ambient response scales up. Indoors these are unused.
 87: uniform int uOutdoor;
 88: uniform vec3 uFogColor;
 89: uniform float uAmbientScale;
 90: 
 91: out vec4 fragColor;
 92: "#;
 93: 
 94: /// Lighting/fog body (everything after the shared chunks).
 95: const FRAGMENT_BODY: &str = r#"
 96: float pcf4(sampler2D shadowMap, vec2 uv, float compareDepth) {
 97:     vec2 texelSize = 1.0 / vec2(textureSize(shadowMap, 0));
 98:     float shadow = 0.0;
 99: 
100:     vec2 offsets[4] = vec2[](
101:         vec2(-0.5, -0.5), vec2(0.5, -0.5),
102:         vec2(-0.5,  0.5), vec2(0.5,  0.5)
103:     );
104: 
105:     for(int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
106:         float pcfDepth = texture(shadowMap, uv + offsets[i] * texelSize).r;
107:         shadow += (compareDepth > pcfDepth) ? 0.0 : 1.0;
108:     }
109:     return shadow / 4.0;
110: }
111: 
112: float shadowVisibility(vec3 worldPos, vec3 normal, vec3 lightDir, vec2 halfSize) {
113:     // Interleaved gradient noise for area sampling
114:     float noise = ign(gl_FragCoord.xy) * 6.283185;
115:     vec2 offset = vec2(cos(noise), sin(noise)) * halfSize;
116: 
117:     // Simulate moving the light by moving the receiver in the opposite direction
118:     vec3 jitteredPos = worldPos + vec3(-offset.x, 0.0, -offset.y);
119: 
120:     vec4 lightClip = uLightViewProjection * vec4(jitteredPos + normal * 0.025, 1.0);
121:     vec3 p = lightClip.xyz / lightClip.w;
122:     vec2 uv = p.xy * 0.5 + 0.5;
123:     float receiverDepth = p.z * 0.5 + 0.5;
124: 
125:     if (any(lessThan(uv, vec2(0.0))) || any(greaterThan(uv, vec2(1.0))) || receiverDepth >= 1.0) {
126:         return 1.0;
127:     }
128: 
129:     float bias = max(0.003 * (1.0 - dot(normal, lightDir)), 0.0008);
130:     return pcf4(uShadowMap, uv, receiverDepth - bias);
131: }
132: 
133: bool emissive(float material) {
134:     return abs(material - 4.0) < 0.1 || abs(material - 9.0) < 0.1
135:         || abs(material - 16.0) < 0.1;
136: }
137: 
138: float getOrderedDither() {
139:     int x = int(gl_FragCoord.x) % 4;
140:     int y = int(gl_FragCoord.y) % 4;
141:     int index = x + y * 4;
142:     float threshold = 0.0;
143:     if (index == 0) threshold = 0.0625;
144:     else if (index == 1) threshold = 0.5625;
145:     else if (index == 2) threshold = 0.1875;
146:     else if (index == 3) threshold = 0.6875;
147:     else if (index == 4) threshold = 0.8125;
148:     else if (index == 5) threshold = 0.3125;
149:     else if (index == 6) threshold = 0.9375;
150:     else if (index == 7) threshold = 0.4375;
151:     else if (index == 8) threshold = 0.25;
152:     else if (index == 9) threshold = 0.75;
153:     else if (index == 10) threshold = 0.125;
154:     else if (index == 11) threshold = 0.625;
155:     else if (index == 12) threshold = 0.875;
156:     else if (index == 13) threshold = 0.375;
157:     else if (index == 14) threshold = 0.95;
158:     else if (index == 15) threshold = 0.45;
159:     return threshold - 0.5;
160: }
161: 
162: vec3 quantize5(vec3 lightColor, float dither) {
163:     vec3 bands = lightColor * 4.0;
164:     bands.r = floor(bands.r + dither * 0.4 + 0.5) / 4.0;
165:     bands.g = floor(bands.g + dither * 0.4 + 0.5) / 4.0;
166:     bands.b = floor(bands.b + dither * 0.4 + 0.5) / 4.0;
167:     return max(bands, 0.0);
168: }
169: 
170: float getGrime(vec3 pos) {
171:     float n = sin(pos.x * 0.15) * cos(pos.z * 0.15) * sin(pos.y * 0.3);
172:     n += 0.35 * sin(pos.x * 0.8 + pos.y * 0.5) * cos(pos.z * 0.8);
173:     return mix(0.85, 1.0, clamp(n * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.0, 1.0));
174: }
175: 
176: void main() {
177:     vec3 albedo = materialColor(vMaterial);
178:     vec3 N = normalize(vNormal);
179:     vec3 toCamera = uCameraPosition - vWorldPosition;
180:     float distanceToCamera = length(toCamera);
181:     vec3 V = toCamera / max(distanceToCamera, 0.001);
182: 
183:     vec3 uvw = (vWorldPosition - uChunkOrigin) / uChunkSize;
184:     vec3 irradiance = texture(uLightVolume, clamp(uvw, 0.0, 1.0)).rgb;
185:     // The packed face record carries the scalar BFS bake as a seam-safe
186:     // fallback when a linearly filtered 3D sample straddles a chunk edge.
187:     // Consuming it here also makes `aStaticIndirect` part of the linked
188:     // program instead of letting the GLSL linker optimize the attribute out.
189:     float baked = vStaticIndirect * (1.0 / 15.0);
190:     vec3 bakedWarm = vec3(baked, baked * 0.94, baked * 0.72);
191:     irradiance = max(irradiance, bakedWarm);
192:     if (uOutdoor == 1) {
193:         // Daylight floor: the sky layer's BFS light dominates outdoors; do
194:         // not crush it toward the dim interior baseline.
195:         irradiance = max(irradiance, vec3(0.30, 0.32, 0.36));
196:     } else {
197:         irradiance = max(irradiance, vec3(0.16, 0.13, 0.07));
198:         irradiance = mix(vec3(0.18, 0.15, 0.08), irradiance, 0.25);
199:     }
200: 
201:     // Upward-facing surfaces brightest, downward surfaces notably darker,
202:     // side walls vary subtly by cardinal direction.
203:     float faceResponse = 0.8;
204:     if (N.y > 0.5) {
205:         faceResponse = 1.0;
206:     } else if (N.y < -0.5) {
207:         faceResponse = 0.35;
208:     } else {
209:         faceResponse = 0.65 + 0.1 * N.x + 0.05 * N.z;
210:     }
211: 
212:     // Strengthen voxel AO, but clamp so it is never pure black
213:     float ao = mix(1.0, 0.22, clamp(vAo * 1.3, 0.0, 1.0));
214: 
215:     float roughness = 0.8;
216:     if (vMaterial > 1.5 && vMaterial < 2.5) {
217:         roughness = 0.4; // Pillars
218:     } else if (vMaterial > 0.5 && vMaterial < 1.5) {
219:         roughness = 0.6; // Floor
220:     }
221: 
222:     // Yellow-green ambient and olive shadows (cool neutral hemisphere
223:     // outdoors so the grassland reads as daylight, not office fluorescence).
224:     vec3 ambientUp = vec3(0.35, 0.38, 0.22) * irradiance;
225:     vec3 ambientDown = vec3(0.14, 0.15, 0.08) * irradiance;
226:     if (uOutdoor == 1) {
227:         ambientUp = vec3(0.62, 0.66, 0.72) * irradiance;
228:         ambientDown = vec3(0.34, 0.36, 0.33) * irradiance;
229:     }
230:     vec3 ambient = mix(ambientDown, ambientUp, N.y * 0.5 + 0.5) * ao * faceResponse * uAmbientScale;
231: 
232:     // Flashlight: a true spotlight cone around the camera forward axis
233:     // (shared spec with the CPU splatter). Replaces the old N-dot-V
234:     // "headlamp" that lit every camera-facing surface regardless of where
235:     // the player pointed.
236:     vec3 flashlight = vec3(0.0);
237:     if (uFlashlightEnabled == 1) {
238:         flashlight = spotBeam(uCameraPosition, uCamForward, vWorldPosition, N);
239:     }
240: 
241:     vec3 color;
242:     if (emissive(vMaterial)) {
243:         // Restrained emissive fixtures
244:         color = albedo * 1.5;
245:     } else {
246:         vec3 directDiffuse = vec3(0.0);
247:         vec3 directSpecular = vec3(0.0);
248: 
249:         for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
250:             if (i >= uLightCount) break;
251: 
252:             vec3 toLight = uLightPositions[i] - vWorldPosition;
253:             float d2 = dot(toLight, toLight);
254:             float range = uLightParams[i].x;
255:             float range2 = range * range;
256: 
257:             if (d2 >= range2) continue;
258: 
259:             float d = sqrt(d2);
260:             vec3 L = toLight / max(d, 0.001);
261: 
262:             float ndotl = max(dot(N, L), 0.0);
263: 
264:             // Specular (Blinn-Phong)
265:             vec3 H = normalize(L + V);
266:             float ndoth = max(dot(N, H), 0.0);
267:             float specPower = exp2(10.0 * (1.0 - roughness) + 1.0);
268:             float specular = pow(ndoth, specPower) * (1.0 - roughness) * 0.5;
269: 
270:             // Inverse square falloff
271:             float falloff = pow(max(1.0 - d2 / range2, 0.0), 2.0) / (1.0 + 0.05 * d2);
272: 
273:             float visible = 1.0;
274:             if (i == uShadowedLightIndex) {
275:                 visible = shadowVisibility(vWorldPosition, N, L, uLightParams[i].zw);
276:             }
277: 
278:             // Subtle deterministic world-space fluorescent flicker/noise to direct light only
279:             float lightHash = hash3D(uLightPositions[i] * 10.0);
280:             float eyeHum = hash3D(vWorldPosition + uCameraPosition * 0.01);
281:             float directMod = (1.0 + 0.05 * (lightHash - 0.5)) * (1.0 + 0.02 * (eyeHum - 0.5));
282: 
283:             // Cream highlights under fixtures
284:             vec3 lightColor = mix(uLightColors[i], vec3(1.0, 0.96, 0.85), 0.3);
285: 
286:             directDiffuse += lightColor * uLightParams[i].y * falloff * visible * ndotl * directMod;
287:             directSpecular += lightColor * uLightParams[i].y * falloff * visible * specular * directMod;
288:         }
289: 
290:         // Quantize indirect (ambient) + direct diffuse into 5 bands with
291:         // ordered dithering (rt_dither disables the dither offset only, so
292:         // the banded art style survives the toggle).
293:         float ditherVal = uDitherEnabled == 1 ? getOrderedDither() : 0.0;
294:         vec3 totalDiffuseLight = quantize5(ambient + directDiffuse, ditherVal);
295: 
296:         // Low-frequency grime/stain modulation on albedo
297:         float grime = getGrime(vWorldPosition);
298:         vec3 modulatedAlbedo = albedo * grime;
299: 
300:         color = totalDiffuseLight * modulatedAlbedo + directSpecular + modulatedAlbedo * flashlight;
301:     }
302: 
303:     // Fog with onset distance - pushed further back for large open spaces like the Atrium
304:     float fogOnset = 15.0;
305:     float fogDist = max(0.0, distanceToCamera - fogOnset);
306:     float fogDensity = 0.028;
307:     float heightFactor = 1.0 + 0.35 * smoothstep(0.0, 3.4, vWorldPosition.y);
308: 
309:     // Ensure fog reaches exactly 1.0 before the chunk ungenerated boundary
310:     float fogAmount = 1.0 - exp(-fogDist * fogDensity * heightFactor);
311:     fogAmount = max(fogAmount, smoothstep(38.0, 50.0, distanceToCamera));
312: 
313:     // Volumetric scattering (glow)
314:     vec3 glow = vec3(0.0);
315:     for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
316:         if (i >= uLightCount) break;
317:         vec3 toLight = uLightPositions[i] - uCameraPosition;
318:         float dl = length(toLight);
319:         vec3 L = toLight / max(dl, 0.001);
320: 
321:         float cosTheta = max(dot(L, V), 0.0);
322:         float phase = pow(cosTheta, 12.0) * 0.6 + pow(cosTheta, 4.0) * 0.15;
323: 
324:         float depthMask = smoothstep(dl - 2.0, dl + 2.0, distanceToCamera);
325:         float attenuation = smoothstep(45.0, 0.0, dl);
326: 
327:         glow += uLightColors[i] * uLightParams[i].y * phase * attenuation * depthMask * 2.5;
328:     }
329: 
330:     // Slight distance desaturation and contrast compression before fog,
331:     // retaining bright emissive ceiling fixtures.
332:     if (!emissive(vMaterial) && uOutdoor == 0) {
333:         float desatFactor = clamp(distanceToCamera * 0.015, 0.0, 0.55);
334:         float gray = dot(color, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114));
335:         color = mix(color, vec3(gray), desatFactor);
336:         color = mix(color, vec3(0.22, 0.18, 0.12), desatFactor * 0.35); // pull toward a warm middle gray
337:     }
338: 
339:     // Baseline fog color
340:     vec3 baselineFogColor = vec3(0.15, 0.125, 0.055);
341: 
342:     // Height-based fog color: warmer/darker near the floor, sickly-green/dimmer near the ceiling
343:     float hNorm = clamp(vWorldPosition.y / 5.0, 0.0, 1.0);
344:     vec3 heightFogColor = mix(
345:         vec3(0.12, 0.09, 0.035), // warmer/darker near the floor
346:         vec3(0.14, 0.15, 0.06), // sickly-green/dimmer near the ceiling
347:         hNorm
348:     );
349:     if (uOutdoor == 1) {
350:         // Outdoors distance haze fades toward the bright sky.
351:         baselineFogColor = uFogColor;
352:         heightFogColor = uFogColor;
353:     }
354: 
355:     // Seamless transition back to baseline fog color at far boundary
356:     float farFade = smoothstep(35.0, 50.0, distanceToCamera);
357:     vec3 currentFogColor = mix(heightFogColor, baselineFogColor, farFade);
358: 
359:     // Also fade the volumetric glow to 0 at the far clip so it doesn't cause a gap
360:     currentFogColor += glow * (1.0 - farFade);
361: 
362:     // Blend geometry color toward currentFogColor
363:     color = mix(color, currentFogColor, clamp(fogAmount, 0.0, 1.0));
364: 
365:     // Add a subtle ambient glow to the near-field (so it isn't completely dry and flat up close)
366:     color += glow * 0.12 * exp(-distanceToCamera * 0.05);
367: 
368:     // Flare cores (shared chunk; occluded by nearer surfaces, no x-ray dots).
369:     color += flareCores(vWorldPosition, uCameraPosition);
370: 
371:     color = toneMap(color);
372: 
373:     fragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
374: }
````

## File: wasm_frontend/src/drivers/splat_webgl/draw.rs
````rust
  1: //! Per-frame face-splat pipeline.
  2: //!
  3: //! The sequence is intentionally explicit and made of small stages:
  4: //!
  5: //! 1. clear and establish fixed-function state;
  6: //! 2. select visible chunks near-to-far;
  7: //! 3. select the four most important lights;
  8: //! 4. optionally render the hero-light shadow map;
  9: //! 5. bind frame uniforms once;
 10: //! 6. draw whole instance pages or coalesced visible cell ranges.
 11: //!
 12: //! Every optional shortcut is labeled at its branch and controlled by the
 13: //! shared `RenderToggles` switchboard.
 14: 
 15: use std::collections::HashMap;
 16: 
 17: use web_sys::WebGl2RenderingContext as Gl;
 18: 
 19: use crate::application::ports::{
 20:     ChunkDraw, FrameParams, RendererPort, SurfaceChunk, SurfaceChunkKey,
 21: };
 22: use crate::application::render_settings::RenderToggles;
 23: use crate::drivers::gl::lights::{
 24:     SelectedLights, dynamic_light_sources, flare_cores, select_lights,
 25: };

 34: struct ShadowState {
 35:     light_index: i32,
 36:     light_view_projection: [f32; 16],
 37: }
 38: 
 39: impl Default for ShadowState {
````
