## File: src/adapters/blueprint_renderer.rs
````rust
  1: use crate::domain::entities::architecture::{
  2:     RegionPlan, SpaceProgram, StructuralSystem,
  3: };
  4: 
  5: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
  6: pub struct BlueprintOptions {
  7:     pub pixels_per_unit: f32,
  8:     pub show_chunk_grid: bool,
  9:     pub show_fixtures: bool,
 10:     pub show_structure: bool,
 11:     pub seed: u32,
 12:     pub level: u32,
 13:     pub voxel_scale: f32,
 14: }
 15: 
 16: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
 17: pub struct ChunkBounds {
 18:     pub min_x: f32,
 19:     pub min_z: f32,
 20:     pub max_x: f32,
 21:     pub max_z: f32,
 22:     pub label: String,
 23: }
 24: 
 25: pub fn render_region_blueprint_svg(
 26:     plan: &RegionPlan,
 27:     chunk_bounds: &[ChunkBounds],
 28:     options: BlueprintOptions,
 29: ) -> String {
 30:     let scale = options.pixels_per_unit;
 31:     let size_px = plan.size_world * scale;
 32: 
 33:     let mut svg = String::new();
 34:     svg.push_str(&format!(
 35:         r##"<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 {} {}" width="{}" height="{}">
 36:   <style>
 37:     .bg {{ fill: #0b0f19; }}
 38:     .grid {{ stroke: #1e293b; stroke-width: 0.5; }}
 39:     .chunk-grid {{ stroke: #f43f5e; stroke-width: 1.0; stroke-dasharray: 4,4; fill: none; }}
 40:     .chunk-label {{ fill: #f43f5e; font-family: monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; }}
 41:     .assembly {{ fill: #1e293b; fill-opacity: 0.2; stroke: #475569; stroke-width: 1.0; }}
 42:     .assembly-corrupt {{ fill: #a21caf; fill-opacity: 0.15; stroke: #d946ef; stroke-width: 1.0; }}
 43:     .assembly-label {{ fill: #94a3b8; font-family: monospace; font-size: 9px; font-weight: bold; }}
 44:     .corridor-main {{ stroke: #38bdf8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; fill: none; }}
 45:     .corridor-secondary {{ stroke: #818cf8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; fill: none; }}
 46:     .entrance {{ stroke: #10b981; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: square; }}
 47:     .entrance-node {{ fill: #10b981; }}
 48:     .fixture-lit {{ fill: #fbbf24; stroke: #d97706; stroke-width: 0.5; }}
 49:     .fixture-unlit {{ fill: #475569; stroke: #334155; stroke-width: 0.5; }}
 50:     .column {{ fill: #64748b; stroke: #475569; stroke-width: 0.5; }}
 51:     .title-bg {{ fill: #0f172a; fill-opacity: 0.9; stroke: #475569; stroke-width: 1.5; }}
 52:     .title-text {{ fill: #f8fafc; font-family: monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: bold; }}
 53:     .title-sub {{ fill: #94a3b8; font-family: monospace; font-size: 9px; }}
 54:   </style>
 55:   <rect class="bg" width="{}" height="{}" />
 56: "##,
 57:         size_px, size_px, size_px, size_px, size_px, size_px
 58:     ));
 59: 
 60:     // Grid lines every 5 world units
 61:     let grid_step = 5.0 * scale;
 62:     let mut grid_y = grid_step;
 63:     while grid_y < size_px {
 64:         svg.push_str(&format!(
 65:             r##"  <line class="grid" x1="0" y1="{}" x2="{}" y2="{}" />
 66:   <line class="grid" x1="{}" y1="0" x2="{}" y2="{}" />
 67: "##,
 68:             grid_y, size_px, grid_y, grid_y, grid_y, size_px
 69:         ));
 70:         grid_y += grid_step;
 71:     }
 72: 
 73:     let to_svg_x = |wx: f32| -> f32 {
 74:         (wx - plan.origin_world.x) * scale
 75:     };
 76:     let to_svg_y = |wz: f32| -> f32 {
 77:         (plan.size_world - (wz - plan.origin_world.z)) * scale
 78:     };
 79: 
 80:     // Layer 1: Corridors
 81:     for s in &plan.corridors {
 82:         if s.path.len() < 2 {
 83:             continue;
 84:         }
 85:         let class_name = if s.spine_kind == SpaceProgram::MainCorridor {
 86:             "corridor-main"
 87:         } else {
 88:             "corridor-secondary"
 89:         };
 90:         let mut points_str = String::new();
 91:         for pos in &s.path {
 92:             points_str.push_str(&format!("{},{} ", to_svg_x(pos.x), to_svg_y(pos.z)));
 93:         }
 94:         let stroke_w = s.width * scale;
 95:         svg.push_str(&format!(
 96:             r##"  <polyline class="{}" points="{}" stroke-width="{}" />
 97: "##,
 98:             class_name, points_str, stroke_w
 99:         ));
100:     }
101: 
102:     // Layer 2: Assembly Footprints
103:     for a in &plan.assemblies {
104:         let mut points_str = String::new();
105:         for &(vx, vz) in &a.footprint.vertices {
106:             points_str.push_str(&format!("{},{} ", to_svg_x(vx), to_svg_y(vz)));
107:         }
108:         let class_name = if a.corruption.misalignment.0 != 0.0 || a.corruption.misalignment.1 != 0.0 || a.corruption.abandoned {
109:             "assembly-corrupt"
110:         } else {
111:             "assembly"
112:         };
113:         svg.push_str(&format!(
114:             r##"  <polygon class="{}" points="{}" />
115: "##,
116:             class_name, points_str
117:         ));
118:     }
119: 
120:     // Layer 3: Entrances / Portals
121:     for a in &plan.assemblies {
122:         for e in &a.entrances {
123:             let door_half_w = e.width * 0.5;
124:             let (x1, z1, x2, z2) = if e.through_x_wall {
125:                 (e.center.x - door_half_w, e.center.z, e.center.x + door_half_w, e.center.z)
126:             } else {
127:                 (e.center.x, e.center.z - door_half_w, e.center.x, e.center.z + door_half_w)
128:             };
129: 
130:             let svg_x1 = to_svg_x(x1);
131:             let svg_y1 = to_svg_y(z1);
132:             let svg_x2 = to_svg_x(x2);
133:             let svg_y2 = to_svg_y(z2);
134: 
135:             svg.push_str(&format!(
136:                 r##"  <line class="entrance" x1="{}" y1="{}" x2="{}" y2="{}" />
137:   <circle class="entrance-node" cx="{}" cy="{}" r="3.5" />
138: "##,
139:                 svg_x1, svg_y1, svg_x2, svg_y2,
140:                 to_svg_x(e.center.x), to_svg_y(e.center.z)
141:             ));
142: 
143:             let txt_x = to_svg_x(e.center.x);
144:             let txt_y = to_svg_y(e.center.z) - 6.0;
145:             svg.push_str(&format!(
146:                 r##"  <text x="{}" y="{}" fill="#10b981" font-family="monospace" font-size="8px" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">{:.1}m</text>
147: "##,
148:                 txt_x, txt_y, e.width
149:             ));
150:         }
151:     }
152: 
153:     // Layer 4: Fixtures
154:     if options.show_fixtures {
155:         for a in &plan.assemblies {
156:             for f in &a.fixtures {
157:                 let w_px = f.half_x * 2.0 * scale;
158:                 let h_px = f.half_z * 2.0 * scale;
159:                 let svg_f_x = to_svg_x(f.at.x) - w_px * 0.5;
160:                 let svg_f_y = to_svg_y(f.at.z) - h_px * 0.5;
161: 
162:                 let class_name = if f.lit { "fixture-lit" } else { "fixture-unlit" };
163:                 svg.push_str(&format!(
164:                     r##"  <rect class="{}" x="{}" y="{}" width="{}" height="{}" rx="1" />
165: "##,
166:                     class_name, svg_f_x, svg_f_y, w_px, h_px
167:                 ));
168:             }
169:         }
170:     }
171: 
172:     // Layer 5: Columns
173:     if options.show_structure {
174:         for a in &plan.assemblies {
175:             let st = &a.structure;
176:             if st.system == StructuralSystem::CoreAndShell {
177:                 continue;
178:             }
179:             let (min_x, min_z, max_x, max_z) = a.footprint.bounds();
180: 
181:             let start_x = ((min_x - st.phase.0) / st.bay_x).floor() as i32 - 1;
182:             let end_x = ((max_x - st.phase.0) / st.bay_x).ceil() as i32 + 1;
183:             let start_z = ((min_z - st.phase.1) / st.bay_z).floor() as i32 - 1;
184:             let end_z = ((max_z - st.phase.1) / st.bay_z).ceil() as i32 + 1;
185: 
186:             for iz in start_z..=end_z {
187:                 for ix in start_x..=end_x {
188:                     let mut wx = st.phase.0 + ix as f32 * st.bay_x;
189:                     let wz = st.phase.1 + iz as f32 * st.bay_z;
190:                     if st.system == StructuralSystem::OffsetGrid {
191:                         if iz.rem_euclid(2) == 1 {
192:                             wx += st.bay_x * 0.5;
193:                         }
194:                     }
195: 
196:                     let col_center_x = wx + st.column_side * 0.5;
197:                     let col_center_z = wz + st.column_side * 0.5;
198:                     if a.footprint.contains(col_center_x, col_center_z) {
199:                         let svg_col_x = to_svg_x(wx);
200:                         let svg_col_y = to_svg_y(wz + st.column_side);
201:                         let w_px = st.column_side * scale;
202:                         svg.push_str(&format!(
203:                             r##"  <rect class="column" x="{}" y="{}" width="{}" height="{}" />
204: "##,
205:                             svg_col_x, svg_col_y, w_px, w_px
206:                         ));
207:                     }
208:                 }
209:             }
210:         }
211:     }
212: 
213:     // Layer 6: Labels
214:     for a in &plan.assemblies {
215:         let mut sum_x = 0.0;
216:         let mut sum_z = 0.0;
217:         for &(vx, vz) in &a.footprint.vertices {
218:             sum_x += vx;
219:             sum_z += vz;
220:         }
221:         let cx = sum_x / a.footprint.vertices.len() as f32;
222:         let cz = sum_z / a.footprint.vertices.len() as f32;
223: 
224:         let label = format!("#{} · {:?}", a.id, a.program);
225:         let svg_cx = to_svg_x(cx);
226:         let svg_cz = to_svg_y(cz);
227: 
228:         svg.push_str(&format!(
229:             r##"  <text class="assembly-label" x="{}" y="{}" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle">{}</text>
230: "##,
231:             svg_cx, svg_cz, label
232:         ));
233:     }
234: 
235:     // Layer 7: Chunk Grid Overlays
236:     if options.show_chunk_grid {
237:         for cb in chunk_bounds {
238:             let svg_min_x = to_svg_x(cb.min_x);
239:             let svg_max_x = to_svg_x(cb.max_x);
240:             let svg_min_y = to_svg_y(cb.max_z);
241:             let svg_max_y = to_svg_y(cb.min_z);
242: 
243:             let w_px = svg_max_x - svg_min_x;
244:             let h_px = svg_max_y - svg_min_y;
245: 
246:             svg.push_str(&format!(
247:                 r##"  <rect class="chunk-grid" x="{}" y="{}" width="{}" height="{}" />
248:   <text class="chunk-label" x="{}" y="{}" text-anchor="start" dominant-baseline="hanging">{}</text>
249: "##,
250:                 svg_min_x, svg_min_y, w_px, h_px,
251:                 svg_min_x + 6.0, svg_min_y + 6.0, cb.label
252:             ));
253:         }
254:     }
255: 
256:     // Layer 8: Title Block
257:     let title_x = size_px - 230.0;
258:     let title_y = size_px - 140.0;
259:     let rx = (plan.origin_world.x / plan.size_world).round() as i32;
260:     let rz = (plan.origin_world.z / plan.size_world).round() as i32;
261:     svg.push_str(&format!(
262:         r##"  <g transform="translate({}, {})">
263:     <rect class="title-bg" width="215" height="125" rx="6" />
264:     <text class="title-text" x="15" y="25">VACKROOMS ARCHITECTURE</text>
265:     <text class="title-sub" x="15" y="45">Seed: {} | Level: {}</text>
266:     <text class="title-sub" x="15" y="60">Region: ({}, {})</text>
267:     <text class="title-sub" x="15" y="75">Region Size: {:.1}m x {:.1}m</text>
268:     <text class="title-sub" x="15" y="90">Voxel Scale: {}m</text>
269:     <text class="title-sub" x="15" y="105">Scale: 1 unit = {}px</text>
270:   </g>
271: "##,
272:         title_x, title_y,
273:         options.seed, options.level,
274:         rx, rz,
275:         plan.size_world, plan.size_world,
276:         options.voxel_scale, scale
277:     ));
278: 
279:     svg.push_str("</svg>\n");
280:     svg
281: }

283: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
284: pub enum BlueprintSlice {
285:     FloorPlan,       // y = 0: floor, walls projected upward
286:     WallPlan,        // any WALL / REDWALL in y = 1..ceiling
287:     CeilingPlan,     // ceiling and LIGHT voxels
288:     Composite,       // wall + floor + light + semantic overlay
289: }
290: 
291: pub fn render_voxel_chunk_svg(
292:     grid: &crate::domain::entities::voxel_grid::VoxelGrid,
293:     origin: crate::entities::models::Position,
294:     config: &crate::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig,
295:     slice: BlueprintSlice,
296:     semantics: Option<&RegionPlan>,
297: ) -> String {
298:     use crate::domain::entities::voxel_grid::{
299:         VOXEL_AIR, VOXEL_CEILING, VOXEL_FLOOR, VOXEL_GRASS, VOXEL_LIGHT,
300:         VOXEL_RED_LIGHT, VOXEL_RED_WALL, VOXEL_TREE, VOXEL_WALL, VOXEL_WATER,
301:     };
302: 
303:     let w_voxels = grid.width().saturating_sub(2);
304:     let d_voxels = grid.depth().saturating_sub(2);
305: 
306:     let cell_size = 12.0;
307:     let width_px = w_voxels as f32 * cell_size;
308:     let height_px = d_voxels as f32 * cell_size;
309: 
310:     let mut svg = String::new();
311:     svg.push_str(&format!(
312:         r##"<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 {} {}" width="{}" height="{}">
313:   <style>
314:     .bg {{ fill: #070a13; }}
315:     .cell-air {{ fill: #0b0f19; }}
316:     .cell-main-corridor {{ fill: #083344; fill-opacity: 0.8; }}
317:     .cell-secondary-corridor {{ fill: #1e1b4b; fill-opacity: 0.8; }}
318:     .cell-assembly {{ fill: #111827; fill-opacity: 0.8; }}
319:     
320:     .voxel-wall {{ fill: #1e293b; stroke: #475569; stroke-width: 0.5; }}
321:     .voxel-red-wall {{ fill: #7f1d1d; stroke: #b91c1c; stroke-width: 0.5; }}
322:     .voxel-floor {{ fill: #78350f; stroke: #92400e; stroke-dasharray: 1,1; stroke-width: 0.5; }}
323:     .voxel-grass {{ fill: #14532d; stroke: #166534; stroke-width: 0.5; }}
324:     .voxel-water {{ fill: #1e3a8a; stroke: #1d4ed8; stroke-width: 0.5; }}
325:     .voxel-tree {{ fill: #064e3b; stroke: #047857; stroke-width: 0.5; }}
326:     .voxel-ceiling {{ fill: #334155; stroke: #475569; stroke-width: 0.5; }}
327:     .voxel-light {{ fill: #fef08a; stroke: #ca8a04; stroke-width: 0.5; filter: drop-shadow(0px 0px 2px #fef08a); }}
328:     .voxel-red-light {{ fill: #fecaca; stroke: #dc2626; stroke-width: 0.5; filter: drop-shadow(0px 0px 2px #fecaca); }}
329: 
330:     .grid-line {{ stroke: #1e293b; stroke-width: 0.25; }}
331:     .label-text {{ fill: #94a3b8; font-family: monospace; font-size: 10px; }}
332:   </style>
333:   <rect class="bg" width="{}" height="{}" />
334: "##,
335:         width_px, height_px, width_px, height_px, width_px, height_px
336:     ));
337: 
338:     // Render cells
339:     for z in 0..d_voxels {
340:         for x in 0..w_voxels {
341:             // Voxel coordinates are 1-indexed due to padding
342:             let vx = x + 1;
343:             let vz = z + 1;
344: 
345:             // World coordinates
346:             let wx = origin.x + x as f32 * config.voxel_scale;
347:             let wz = origin.z + z as f32 * config.voxel_scale;
348: 
349:             // 1. Semantic background classification
350:             let mut semantic_class = "cell-air";
351:             if let Some(plan) = semantics {
352:                 let mut inside_main = false;
353:                 let mut inside_secondary = false;
354:                 for c in &plan.corridors {
355:                     if c.path.len() >= 2 {
356:                         let dist = point_to_polyline_distance(
357:                             wx + config.voxel_scale * 0.5,
358:                             wz + config.voxel_scale * 0.5,
359:                             &c.path,
360:                         );
361:                         if dist <= c.width * 0.5 {
362:                             if c.spine_kind == SpaceProgram::MainCorridor {
363:                                 inside_main = true;
364:                             } else {
365:                                 inside_secondary = true;
366:                             }
367:                         }
368:                     }
369:                 }
370:                 if inside_main {
371:                     semantic_class = "cell-main-corridor";
372:                 } else if inside_secondary {
373:                     semantic_class = "cell-secondary-corridor";
374:                 } else {
375:                     for a in &plan.assemblies {
376:                         if a.footprint.contains(
377:                             wx + config.voxel_scale * 0.5,
378:                             wz + config.voxel_scale * 0.5,
379:                         ) {
380:                             semantic_class = "cell-assembly";
381:                             break;
382:                         }
383:                     }
384:                 }
385:             }
386: 
387:             // 2. Voxel classification based on BlueprintSlice
388:             let mut has_wall = false;
389:             let mut has_red_wall = false;
390:             let mut has_light = false;
391:             let mut has_red_light = false;
392:             let mut has_floor = false;
393:             let mut has_ceiling = false;
394:             let mut has_tree = false;
395:             let mut has_grass = false;
396:             let mut has_water = false;
397: 
398:             for y in 0..grid.height() {
399:                 match grid.get(vx, y, vz) {
400:                     VOXEL_WALL => has_wall = true,
401:                     VOXEL_RED_WALL => has_red_wall = true,
402:                     VOXEL_LIGHT => has_light = true,
403:                     VOXEL_RED_LIGHT => has_red_light = true,
404:                     VOXEL_FLOOR => has_floor = true,
405:                     VOXEL_CEILING => has_ceiling = true,
406:                     VOXEL_TREE => has_tree = true,
407:                     VOXEL_GRASS => has_grass = true,
408:                     VOXEL_WATER => has_water = true,
409:                     _ => {}
410:                 }
411:             }
412: 
413:             let voxel_class = match slice {
414:                 BlueprintSlice::FloorPlan => {
415:                     if has_wall || has_red_wall || has_tree {
416:                         Some(if has_red_wall { "voxel-red-wall" } else { "voxel-wall" })
417:                     } else if has_floor || has_grass || has_water {
418:                         Some(if has_water { "voxel-water" } else if has_grass { "voxel-grass" } else { "voxel-floor" })
419:                     } else {
420:                         None
421:                     }
422:                 }
423:                 BlueprintSlice::WallPlan => {
424:                     if has_wall || has_red_wall || has_tree {
425:                         Some(if has_red_wall { "voxel-red-wall" } else { "voxel-wall" })
426:                     } else {
427:                         None
428:                     }
429:                 }
430:                 BlueprintSlice::CeilingPlan => {
431:                     if has_light || has_red_light {
432:                         Some(if has_red_light { "voxel-red-light" } else { "voxel-light" })
433:                     } else if has_ceiling {
434:                         Some("voxel-ceiling")
435:                     } else {
436:                         None
437:                     }
438:                 }
439:                 BlueprintSlice::Composite => {
440:                     if has_wall || has_red_wall || has_tree {
441:                         Some(if has_red_wall { "voxel-red-wall" } else { "voxel-wall" })
442:                     } else if has_light || has_red_light {
443:                         Some(if has_red_light { "voxel-red-light" } else { "voxel-light" })
444:                     } else if has_floor || has_grass || has_water {
445:                         Some(if has_water { "voxel-water" } else if has_grass { "voxel-grass" } else { "voxel-floor" })
446:                     } else {
447:                         None
448:                     }
449:                 }
450:             };
451: 
452:             // Render rect in SVG coordinates (origin top-left)
453:             let svg_x = x as f32 * cell_size;
454:             let svg_y = (d_voxels - 1 - z) as f32 * cell_size;
455: 
456:             if let Some(vc) = voxel_class {
457:                 svg.push_str(&format!(
458:                     r##"  <rect class="{}" x="{}" y="{}" width="{}" height="{}" />
459: "##,
460:                     vc, svg_x, svg_y, cell_size, cell_size
461:                 ));
462:             } else {
463:                 svg.push_str(&format!(
464:                     r##"  <rect class="{}" x="{}" y="{}" width="{}" height="{}" />
465: "##,
466:                     semantic_class, svg_x, svg_y, cell_size, cell_size
467:                 ));
468:             }
469:         }
470:     }
471: 
472:     // Draw coordinate label on top
473:     svg.push_str(&format!(
474:         r##"  <text class="label-text" x="10" y="20">Chunk: ({:.1}, {:.1}) | Slice: {:?}</text>
475: "##,
476:         origin.x, origin.z, slice
477:     ));
478: 
479:     svg.push_str("</svg>\n");
480:     svg
481: }

483: fn point_to_polyline_distance(x: f32, z: f32, path: &[crate::entities::models::Position]) -> f32 {
484:     let mut min_dist = f32::MAX;
485:     for seg in path.windows(2) {
486:         let p1 = seg[0];
487:         let p2 = seg[1];
488:         let dist = point_to_segment_distance(x, z, p1.x, p1.z, p2.x, p2.z);
489:         if dist < min_dist {
490:             min_dist = dist;
491:         }
492:     }
493:     min_dist
494: }
495: 
496: fn point_to_segment_distance(x: f32, z: f32, x1: f32, z1: f32, x2: f32, z2: f32) -> f32 {
497:     let dx = x2 - x1;
498:     let dz = z2 - z1;
499:     let len2 = dx * dx + dz * dz;
500:     if len2 == 0.0 {
501:         let t_dx = x - x1;
502:         let t_dz = z - z1;
503:         return (t_dx * t_dx + t_dz * t_dz).sqrt();
504:     }
505:     let t = ((x - x1) * dx + (z - z1) * dz) / len2;
506:     let t_clamped = t.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
507:     let proj_x = x1 + t_clamped * dx;
508:     let proj_z = z1 + t_clamped * dz;
509:     let diff_x = x - proj_x;
510:     let diff_z = z - proj_z;
511:     (diff_x * diff_x + diff_z * diff_z).sqrt()
512: }
513: 
514: pub fn render_large_voxel_blueprint_svg(
515:     combined_cells: &[u8],
516:     total_w: usize,
517:     total_d: usize,
518:     rx_origin: f32,
519:     rz_origin: f32,
520:     voxel_scale: f32,
521:     size_world: f32,
522:     slice: BlueprintSlice,
523:     semantics: Option<&RegionPlan>,
524:     is_bw: bool,
525: ) -> String {
526:     let scale = 10.0; // 10 pixels per world unit
527:     let size_px = size_world * scale;
528: 
529:     let mut svg = String::new();
530:     if is_bw {
531:         svg.push_str(&format!(
532:             r##"<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 {} {}" width="{}" height="{}">
533:   <style>
534:     .bg {{ fill: #ffffff; }}
535:     .voxel-wall {{ fill: #000000; }}
536:     .voxel-red-wall {{ fill: #000000; }}
537:     .voxel-light {{ fill: #ff0000; }}
538:     .voxel-red-light {{ fill: #ff0000; }}
539:   </style>
540:   <rect class="bg" width="{}" height="{}" />
541: "##,
542:             size_px, size_px, size_px, size_px, size_px, size_px
543:         ));
544:     } else {
545:         svg.push_str(&format!(
546:             r##"<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 {} {}" width="{}" height="{}">
547:   <style>
548:     .bg {{ fill: #070a13; }}
549:     .grid {{ stroke: #1e293b; stroke-width: 0.5; }}
550:     .chunk-grid {{ stroke: #f43f5e; stroke-width: 1.0; stroke-dasharray: 4,4; fill: none; }}
551:     .chunk-label {{ fill: #f43f5e; font-family: monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; }}
552:     
553:     .assembly {{ fill: #1e293b; fill-opacity: 0.25; stroke: #475569; stroke-width: 1.0; }}
554:     .assembly-corrupt {{ fill: #a21caf; fill-opacity: 0.2; stroke: #d946ef; stroke-width: 1.0; }}
555:     .assembly-label {{ fill: #94a3b8; font-family: monospace; font-size: 9px; font-weight: bold; }}
556:     .corridor-main {{ stroke: #083344; stroke-width: 3.0; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; fill: none; }}
557:     .corridor-secondary {{ stroke: #1e1b4b; stroke-width: 2.0; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; fill: none; }}
558: 
559:     .voxel-wall {{ fill: #1e293b; stroke: #475569; stroke-width: 0.25; }}
560:     .voxel-red-wall {{ fill: #7f1d1d; stroke: #b91c1c; stroke-width: 0.25; }}
561:     .voxel-floor {{ fill: #78350f; fill-opacity: 0.4; stroke: #92400e; stroke-width: 0.1; }}
562:     .voxel-grass {{ fill: #14532d; fill-opacity: 0.4; stroke: #166534; stroke-width: 0.1; }}
563:     .voxel-water {{ fill: #1e3a8a; fill-opacity: 0.4; stroke: #1d4ed8; stroke-width: 0.1; }}
564:     .voxel-ceiling {{ fill: #334155; fill-opacity: 0.4; stroke: #475569; stroke-width: 0.1; }}
565:     .voxel-light {{ fill: #fef08a; stroke: #ca8a04; stroke-width: 0.25; }}
566:     .voxel-red-light {{ fill: #fecaca; stroke: #dc2626; stroke-width: 0.25; }}
567: 
568:     .title-bg {{ fill: #0f172a; fill-opacity: 0.95; stroke: #475569; stroke-width: 1.5; }}
569:     .title-text {{ fill: #f8fafc; font-family: monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: bold; }}
570:     .title-sub {{ fill: #94a3b8; font-family: monospace; font-size: 9px; }}
571:   </style>
572:   <rect class="bg" width="{}" height="{}" />
573: "##,
574:             size_px, size_px, size_px, size_px, size_px, size_px
575:         ));
576:     }
577: 
578:     // Helpers
579:     let to_svg_x = |wx: f32| -> f32 { (wx - rx_origin) * scale };
580:     let to_svg_y = |wz: f32| -> f32 { size_px - (wz - rz_origin) * scale };
581: 
582:     // 1. Draw semantics first (corridors and assemblies)
583:     if !is_bw {
584:         if let Some(plan) = semantics {
585:             // Assemblies
586:             for a in &plan.assemblies {
587:                 let mut points_str = String::new();
588:                 for &(vx, vz) in &a.footprint.vertices {
589:                     points_str.push_str(&format!("{},{} ", to_svg_x(vx), to_svg_y(vz)));
590:                 }
591:                 let class_name = if a.corruption.misalignment.0 != 0.0 || a.corruption.misalignment.1 != 0.0 || a.corruption.abandoned {
592:                     "assembly-corrupt"
593:                 } else {
594:                     "assembly"
595:                 };
596:                 svg.push_str(&format!(
597:                     r##"  <polygon class="{}" points="{}" />
598: "##,
599:                     class_name, points_str
600:                 ));
601:             }
602: 
603:             // Corridors
604:             for c in &plan.corridors {
605:                 if c.path.len() >= 2 {
606:                     let mut d_str = String::new();
607:                     for (idx, p) in c.path.iter().enumerate() {
608:                         let prefix = if idx == 0 { "M" } else { "L" };
609:                         d_str.push_str(&format!("{} {},{} ", prefix, to_svg_x(p.x), to_svg_y(p.z)));
610:                     }
611:                     let class_name = if c.spine_kind == SpaceProgram::MainCorridor {
612:                         "corridor-main"
613:                     } else {
614:                         "corridor-secondary"
615:                     };
616:                     svg.push_str(&format!(
617:                         r##"  <path class="{}" d="{}" stroke-width="{}" />
618: "##,
619:                         class_name, d_str, c.width * scale
620:                     ));
621:                 }
622:             }
623:         }
624:     }
625: 
626:     // 2. Draw 5-unit background grid lines
627:     if !is_bw {
628:         let grid_step = 5.0 * scale;
629:         let mut grid_val = 0.0;
630:         while grid_val < size_px {
631:             svg.push_str(&format!(
632:                 r##"  <line class="grid" x1="{}" y1="0" x2="{}" y2="{}" />
633:   <line class="grid" x1="0" y1="{}" x2="{}" y2="{}" />
634: "##,
635:                 grid_val, grid_val, size_px, grid_val, size_px, grid_val
636:             ));
637:             grid_val += grid_step;
638:         }
639:     }
640: 
641:     // 3. Draw voxels
642:     let voxel_px = voxel_scale * scale;
643:     for z in 0..total_d {
644:         for x in 0..total_w {
645:             let idx = z * total_w + x;
646:             let val = combined_cells[idx];
647:             if val == 0 {
648:                 continue; // Air is transparent to show background plan
649:             }
650: 
651:             let class_name = match val {
652:                 1 => "voxel-wall",
653:                 2 => "voxel-red-wall",
654:                 3 => "voxel-light",
655:                 4 => "voxel-red-light",
656:                 5 if !is_bw => "voxel-floor",
657:                 6 if !is_bw => "voxel-grass",
658:                 7 if !is_bw => "voxel-water",
659:                 9 if !is_bw => "voxel-ceiling",
660:                 _ => continue,
661:             };
662: 
663:             let svg_x = x as f32 * voxel_px;
664:             let svg_y = size_px - (z + 1) as f32 * voxel_px;
665: 
666:             // In BW mode, we don't want strokes on elements
667:             let stroke_attr = if is_bw { "" } else { "" };
668: 
669:             svg.push_str(&format!(
670:                 r##"  <rect class="{}" x="{}" y="{}" width="{}" height="{}"{} />
671: "##,
672:                 class_name, svg_x, svg_y, voxel_px, voxel_px, stroke_attr
673:             ));
674:         }
675:     }
676: 
677:     // 4. Draw chunk boundaries on top
678:     if !is_bw {
679:         let chunk_size = if voxel_scale <= 0.1 { 20.0 } else { 10.0 };
680:         let steps = (size_world / chunk_size).round() as i32;
681:         for i in 0..steps {
682:             for j in 0..steps {
683:                 let min_x = rx_origin + i as f32 * chunk_size;
684:                 let min_z = rz_origin + j as f32 * chunk_size;
685:                 let svg_min_x = to_svg_x(min_x);
686:                 let svg_max_x = to_svg_x(min_x + chunk_size);
687:                 let svg_min_y = to_svg_y(min_z + chunk_size);
688:                 let svg_max_y = to_svg_y(min_z);
689: 
690:                 let w_px = svg_max_x - svg_min_x;
691:                 let h_px = svg_max_y - svg_min_y;
692: 
693:                 let chunk_coord_x = (min_x / chunk_size).round() as i64;
694:                 let chunk_coord_z = (min_z / chunk_size).round() as i64;
695: 
696:                 svg.push_str(&format!(
697:                     r##"  <rect class="chunk-grid" x="{}" y="{}" width="{}" height="{}" />
698:   <text class="chunk-label" x="{}" y="{}" text-anchor="start" dominant-baseline="hanging">[{}, {}]</text>
699: "##,
700:                     svg_min_x, svg_min_y, w_px, h_px,
701:                     svg_min_x + 6.0, svg_min_y + 6.0, chunk_coord_x, chunk_coord_z
702:                 ));
703:             }
704:         }
705:     }
706: 
707:     // 5. Title Block
708:     if !is_bw {
709:         let title_x = size_px - 230.0;
710:         let title_y = size_px - 140.0;
711:         svg.push_str(&format!(
712:             r##"  <g transform="translate({}, {})">
713:     <rect class="title-bg" width="215" height="125" rx="6" />
714:     <text class="title-text" x="15" y="25">VOXEL MAP BLUEPRINT</text>
715:     <text class="title-sub" x="15" y="45">Slice Mode: {:?}</text>
716:     <text class="title-sub" x="15" y="60">Region: ({:.1}, {:.1})</text>
717:     <text class="title-sub" x="15" y="75">Region Size: {:.1}m x {:.1}m</text>
718:     <text class="title-sub" x="15" y="90">Voxel Scale: {}m</text>
719:     <text class="title-sub" x="15" y="105">Resolution: {}x{} cells</text>
720:   </g>
721: "##,
722:             title_x, title_y,
723:             slice,
724:             rx_origin, rz_origin,
725:             size_world, size_world,
726:             voxel_scale,
727:             total_w, total_d
728:         ));
729:     }
730: 
731:     svg.push_str("</svg>\n");
732:     svg
733: }

  1: /// Per-chunk voxel blueprint renderer.
  2: ///
  3: /// # Why a separate module?
  4: ///
  5: /// The existing `render_large_voxel_blueprint_svg` stitches N×N chunks into
  6: /// one giant SVG and is designed for batch export.  This module renders a
  7: /// *single* chunk — typically a 50×50 voxel grid at default spec — so the
  8: /// WASM call completes in < 5 ms and the browser can display the result
  9: /// instantly without a reload delay.
 10: ///
 11: /// # Architecture (Clean Architecture – Interface Adapter layer)
 12: ///
 13: /// This module occupies the Interface Adapter layer: it takes domain entities
 14: /// (`VoxelGrid`, `RegionPlan`, `Position`) and converts them into a string
 15: /// artifact (SVG) for the browser presentation layer.  It contains no
 16: /// business logic; all meaning lives in the entities it receives.
 17: 
 18: use crate::domain::entities::architecture::{
 19:     RegionPlan, SpaceProgram,
 20: };
 21: use crate::domain::entities::voxel_grid::{
 22:     VoxelGrid,
 23:     VOXEL_WALL, VOXEL_RED_WALL, VOXEL_FLOOR, VOXEL_CEILING,
 24:     VOXEL_LIGHT, VOXEL_RED_LIGHT, VOXEL_GRASS, VOXEL_WATER, VOXEL_TREE,

 40:     /// Draw hairline grid lines between every voxel cell.
 41:     pub show_grid: bool,

 45:     pub show_semantics: bool,

 69: /// Convert a single world-space axis value into the chunk-local voxel float
 70: /// coordinate.  The VoxelGrid interior starts at index 1 (there is a 1-cell
 71: /// padding border), so we add +1.0 to align semantic world objects with the
 72: /// rendered cells.
 73: #[inline]
 74: fn world_to_voxel(world: f32, chunk_origin: f32, voxel_scale: f32) -> f32 {
 75:     (world - chunk_origin) / voxel_scale + 1.0
 76: }
 77: 
 78: /// Clip an axis-aligned rectangle given in voxel coordinates to the grid's
 79: /// interior region [1, grid_dim-1].  Returns `None` if the result is empty.
 80: ///
 81: /// Why +1 / -1 bounds? The VoxelGrid has a 1-cell padding on every face; the
 82: /// "real" chunk interior occupies [1, width-1] × [1, depth-1].
 83: #[inline]
 84: fn clip_rect(
 85:     x0: f32, z0: f32, x1: f32, z1: f32,
 86:     grid_w: f32, grid_d: f32,
 87: ) -> Option<(f32, f32, f32, f32)> {
 88:     let cx0 = x0.max(1.0);
 89:     let cz0 = z0.max(1.0);
 90:     let cx1 = x1.min(grid_w - 1.0);
 91:     let cz1 = z1.min(grid_d - 1.0);
 92:     if cx1 > cx0 && cz1 > cz0 { Some((cx0, cz0, cx1, cz1)) } else { None }
 93: }

117: /// Priority value for material layering: higher priority wins when a voxel
118: /// column contains multiple material types.
119: #[inline]
120: const fn material_priority(voxel: u8) -> u8 {
121:     match voxel {
122:         VOXEL_WALL | VOXEL_RED_WALL | VOXEL_TREE => 4,
123:         VOXEL_LIGHT | VOXEL_RED_LIGHT             => 3,
124:         VOXEL_CEILING                             => 2,
125:         VOXEL_FLOOR | VOXEL_GRASS | VOXEL_WATER   => 1,
126:         _                                         => 0,
127:     }
128: }

130: /// Map a winning material byte to its CSS class name.
131: #[inline]
132: const fn material_class(voxel: u8) -> &'static str {
133:     match voxel {
134:         VOXEL_WALL      => "vw",
135:         VOXEL_RED_WALL  => "vrw",
136:         VOXEL_TREE      => "vwt",
137:         VOXEL_LIGHT     => "vli",
138:         VOXEL_RED_LIGHT => "vrli",
139:         VOXEL_CEILING   => "vce",
140:         VOXEL_FLOOR     => "vfl",
141:         VOXEL_GRASS     => "vgr",
142:         VOXEL_WATER     => "vwa",
143:         _               => "vair",
144:     }
145: }

152: ///
153: /// # Render order (matches the spec)
154: /// 1. Dark background (set on the `<svg>` element itself).
155: /// 2. Per-voxel cell fills (column-collapsed material colour).
156: /// 3. Hairline voxel grid lines.
157: /// 4. Semantic bounding-box fills at ~13% opacity.
158: /// 5. Semantic outlines with contrasting stroke colour.
159: /// 6. Door / portal markers (green boxes).
160: /// 7. Text labels on each semantic box.
161: /// 8. Header bar and legend.
162: ///
163: /// # Arguments
164: /// * `grid`         – The generated `VoxelGrid` for this chunk.
165: /// * `plan`         – The `RegionPlan` that covers this chunk's world region.
166: /// * `chunk_origin` – World-space (x, z) of the chunk's min corner.
167: /// * `voxel_scale`  – World units per voxel (0.2 for low-spec, 0.1 for high-spec).
168: /// * `options`      – Display toggles.
169: pub fn render_chunk_voxel_blueprint_svg(
170:     grid: &VoxelGrid,
171:     plan: &RegionPlan,
172:     chunk_origin: Position,
173:     voxel_scale: f32,
174:     options: VoxelBlueprintOptions,
175: ) -> String {
176:     let ppv = options.pixels_per_voxel;
177: 
178:     let gw = grid.width();   // includes 1-cell padding on each side
179:     let gd = grid.depth();
180:     let gh = grid.height();
181: 
182:     let canvas_w = gw as f32 * ppv;
183:     let canvas_h = gd as f32 * ppv;
184: 
185:     // Derive chunk grid coordinates for the header label.
186:     // Interior cell count = width - 2 (strip the padding border).
187:     let interior = (gw as i32 - 2).max(1) as f32;
188:     let chunk_size_world = interior * voxel_scale;
189:     let cx_idx = if chunk_size_world > 0.0 {
190:         (chunk_origin.x / chunk_size_world).floor() as i32
191:     } else { 0 };
192:     let cz_idx = if chunk_size_world > 0.0 {
193:         (chunk_origin.z / chunk_size_world).floor() as i32
194:     } else { 0 };
195: 
196:     // ── Coordinate transform closures ─────────────────────────────────
197:     //
198:     // SVG Y axis is flipped: Y=0 is the top of the canvas, Y=canvas_h is the
199:     // bottom.  We want world-Z increasing upward, so:
200:     //   svg_y  = canvas_h - (vz + 1) * ppv   for integer voxel index vz
201:     //   svg_y  = canvas_h - vz_float * ppv    for float voxel coordinate
202:     //
203:     // The +1 in the integer version accounts for the padding border offset
204:     // already baked into the float version via world_to_voxel().
205: 
206:     let vox_px_x = |vx: usize| -> f32 { vx as f32 * ppv };
207:     let vox_px_y = |vz: usize| -> f32 { canvas_h - (vz + 1) as f32 * ppv };
208: 
209:     // World coord → float voxel index (accounts for padding offset).
210:     let w2vx = |wx: f32| -> f32 { world_to_voxel(wx, chunk_origin.x, voxel_scale) };
211:     let w2vz = |wz: f32| -> f32 { world_to_voxel(wz, chunk_origin.z, voxel_scale) };
212: 
213:     // Float voxel → SVG pixel.
214:     let vpx = |vx_f: f32| -> f32 { vx_f * ppv };
215:     let vpy_top = |vz_f: f32| -> f32 { canvas_h - vz_f * ppv };   // top edge of a box whose Z min = vz_f
216: 
217:     let label_fs  = (ppv * 1.1).max(7.0_f32).min(13.0_f32);
218:     let label_sm  = (ppv * 0.85).max(5.5_f32).min(10.0_f32);
219: 
220:     // ── Build SVG string ───────────────────────────────────────────────
221:     let mut svg = String::with_capacity(256 * 1024);
222: 
223:     // Header.
224:     svg.push_str(&format!(
225:         r#"<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
226:   viewBox="0 0 {cw} {ch}" width="{cw}" height="{ch}"
227:   style="display:block;background:#0b0f19;font-family:monospace">
228: <defs>
229:   <style>
230:     .vw   {{ fill:#1c2333 }}
231:     .vrw  {{ fill:#3b0b0b }}
232:     .vwt  {{ fill:#251510 }}
233:     .vli  {{ fill:#ff2222 }}
234:     .vrli {{ fill:#ff6666 }}
235:     .vce  {{ fill:#1a1f2e }}
236:     .vfl  {{ fill:#1a120880 }}
237:     .vgr  {{ fill:#0d1f0d80 }}
238:     .vwa  {{ fill:#0a102080 }}
239:     .vair {{ fill:#0b1422 }}
240:     .vgrid{{ stroke:#1e2d40; stroke-width:0.4; fill:none }}
241:     .lbl  {{ font-size:{lfs}px; dominant-baseline:hanging; pointer-events:none }}
242:     .lsm  {{ font-size:{lsm}px; dominant-baseline:hanging; pointer-events:none }}
243:   </style>
244: </defs>
245: "#,
246:         cw = canvas_w, ch = canvas_h,
247:         lfs = label_fs, lsm = label_sm,
248:     ));
249: 
250:     // ── Pass 1: voxel fills ────────────────────────────────────────────
251:     if options.show_voxels {
252:         svg.push_str("<g id=\"voxels\">\n");
253:         for vz in 0..gd {
254:             for vx in 0..gw {
255:                 // Column collapse: scan all Y layers, keep highest-priority material.
256:                 let mut winning: u8 = 0;
257:                 let mut winning_pri: u8 = 0;
258:                 for vy in 0..gh {
259:                     let v = grid.get(vx, vy, vz);
260:                     // Skip ceiling/light voxels when show_ceiling is off.
261:                     if !options.show_ceiling
262:                         && (v == VOXEL_CEILING || v == VOXEL_LIGHT || v == VOXEL_RED_LIGHT)
263:                     {
264:                         continue;
265:                     }
266:                     let pri = material_priority(v);
267:                     if pri > winning_pri {
268:                         winning_pri = pri;
269:                         winning = v;
270:                     }
271:                 }
272:                 let px = vox_px_x(vx);
273:                 let py = vox_px_y(vz);
274:                 let cls = material_class(winning);
275:                 svg.push_str(&format!(
276:                     "<rect class=\"{cls}\" x=\"{px}\" y=\"{py}\" width=\"{ppv}\" height=\"{ppv}\"/>\n"
277:                 ));
278:             }
279:         }
280:         svg.push_str("</g>\n");
281:     }
282: 
283:     // ── Pass 2: voxel grid lines ───────────────────────────────────────
284:     if options.show_grid {
285:         svg.push_str("<g id=\"grid\" class=\"vgrid\">\n");
286:         for vx in 0..=gw {
287:             let px = vx as f32 * ppv;
288:             svg.push_str(&format!(
289:                 "<line x1=\"{px}\" y1=\"0\" x2=\"{px}\" y2=\"{canvas_h}\"/>\n"
290:             ));
291:         }
292:         for vz in 0..=gd {
293:             let py = vz as f32 * ppv;
294:             svg.push_str(&format!(
295:                 "<line x1=\"0\" y1=\"{py}\" x2=\"{canvas_w}\" y2=\"{py}\"/>\n"
296:             ));
297:         }
298:         svg.push_str("</g>\n");
299:     }
300: 
301:     // ── Pass 3+4+5: semantic overlays ─────────────────────────────────
302:     if options.show_semantics {
303:         svg.push_str("<g id=\"semantics\" pointer-events=\"none\">\n");
304: 
305:         // Inner macro: emit one semantic bounding box clipped to the chunk.
306:         //
307:         // Why a macro? The borrow checker forbids closures that capture `svg`
308:         // mutably while also borrowing coordinate-transform closures.  A macro
309:         // expands inline and avoids the borrow conflict entirely.
310:         macro_rules! emit_box {
311:             ($wx0:expr, $wz0:expr, $wx1:expr, $wz1:expr,
312:              $fill:literal, $stroke:literal, $dash:expr, $label:expr) => {{
313:                 let vx0 = w2vx($wx0);
314:                 let vz0 = w2vz($wz0);
315:                 let vx1 = w2vx($wx1);
316:                 let vz1 = w2vz($wz1);
317:                 let (rx0, rz0, rx1, rz1) = (vx0.min(vx1), vz0.min(vz1),
318:                                              vx0.max(vx1), vz0.max(vz1));
319:                 if let Some((cx0, cz0, cx1, cz1)) =
320:                     clip_rect(rx0, rz0, rx1, rz1, gw as f32, gd as f32)
321:                 {
322:                     // SVG box: top-left corner is the largest Z (because Y is flipped).
323:                     let sx  = vpx(cx0);
324:                     let sy  = vpy_top(cz1);  // SVG top = world Z max
325:                     let bw  = vpx(cx1) - sx;
326:                     let bh  = vpy_top(cz0) - sy; // world Z min → SVG bottom
327:                     let da: &str = if $dash { "stroke-dasharray=\"5,3\"" } else { "" };
328:                     svg.push_str(&format!(
329:                         "<rect fill=\"{fill}\" fill-opacity=\"0.13\" stroke=\"{stroke}\" stroke-width=\"1.5\" {da} x=\"{sx}\" y=\"{sy}\" width=\"{bw}\" height=\"{bh}\"/>\n",
330:                         fill = $fill, stroke = $stroke, da = da,
331:                         sx = sx, sy = sy, bw = bw, bh = bh,
332:                     ));
333:                     if options.show_labels {
334:                         let label_str: &str = $label;
335:                         if !label_str.is_empty() {
336:                             svg.push_str(&format!(
337:                                 "<text class=\"lbl\" x=\"{tx}\" y=\"{ty}\" fill=\"{stroke}\">{label}</text>\n",
338:                                 tx = sx + 3.0, ty = sy + 3.0,
339:                                 stroke = $stroke, label = label_str,
340:                             ));
341:                         }
342:                     }
343:                 }
344:             }};
345:         }
346: 
347:         // Corridors — draw each path segment's bounding rect ± half-width.
348:         // We draw per-segment rather than the whole path AABB so that
349:         // L-shaped corridors clip correctly at the chunk boundary.
350:         for spine in &plan.corridors {
351:             if spine.path.len() < 2 { continue; }
352:             let hw = spine.width * 0.5;
353:             let (fill, stroke, label_text) = match spine.spine_kind {
354:                 SpaceProgram::MainCorridor =>
355:                     ("#00ffff", "#00e5ff",
356:                      format!("{} · {:.1}m", program_label(spine.spine_kind), spine.width)),
357:                 _ =>
358:                     ("#a855f7", "#c084fc",
359:                      format!("{} · {:.1}m", program_label(spine.spine_kind), spine.width)),
360:             };
361:             for seg in spine.path.windows(2) {
362:                 let (a, b) = (seg[0], seg[1]);
363:                 let x0 = a.x.min(b.x) - hw;
364:                 let z0 = a.z.min(b.z) - hw;
365:                 let x1 = a.x.max(b.x) + hw;
366:                 let z1 = a.z.max(b.z) + hw;
367:                 if fill == "#00ffff" {
368:                     emit_box!(x0, z0, x1, z1, "#00ffff", "#00e5ff", false, label_text.as_str());
369:                 } else {
370:                     emit_box!(x0, z0, x1, z1, "#a855f7", "#c084fc", false, label_text.as_str());
371:                 }
372:             }
373:         }
374: 
375:         // Assemblies (rooms).
376:         for asm in &plan.assemblies {
377:             let (mx, mz, xx, xz) = asm.footprint.bounds();
378:             let label_text = format!("#{} {}", asm.id, program_label(asm.program));
379:             if asm.corruption.abandoned {
380:                 emit_box!(mx, mz, xx, xz, "#ff00ff", "#e879f9", false, label_text.as_str());
381:             } else {
382:                 emit_box!(mx, mz, xx, xz, "#ffffff", "#cbd5e1", false, label_text.as_str());
383:             }
384: 
385:             // Sub-spaces within the assembly.
386:             for space in &asm.spaces {
387:                 let (sx0, sz0, sx1, sz1) = space.footprint.bounds();
388:                 emit_box!(sx0, sz0, sx1, sz1, "#94a3b8", "#64748b", false,
389:                           program_label(space.program));
390:             }
391: 
392:             // Ceiling zones (dashed gold).
393:             for cz in &asm.ceiling_zones {
394:                 let (zx0, zz0, zx1, zz1) = cz.area.bounds();
395:                 let clabel = format!("VAULT · {:.1}m", cz.height_units);
396:                 emit_box!(zx0, zz0, zx1, zz1, "#ca8a04", "#fbbf24", true, clabel.as_str());
397:             }
398: 
399:             // Openings / portals (green).
400:             for opening in &asm.entrances {
401:                 let hw = opening.width * 0.5;
402:                 let (ox0, oz0, ox1, oz1) = if opening.through_x_wall {
403:                     (opening.center.x - hw, opening.center.z - voxel_scale,
404:                      opening.center.x + hw, opening.center.z + voxel_scale)
405:                 } else {
406:                     (opening.center.x - voxel_scale, opening.center.z - hw,
407:                      opening.center.x + voxel_scale, opening.center.z + hw)
408:                 };
409:                 let plabel = format!("PORTAL · {:.1}m", opening.width);
410:                 emit_box!(ox0, oz0, ox1, oz1, "#10b981", "#34d399", false, plabel.as_str());
411:             }
412:         }
413: 
414:         svg.push_str("</g>\n");
415:     }
416: 
417:     // ── Chunk boundary dashed border ──────────────────────────────────
418:     let bi = 0.5_f32;
419:     svg.push_str(&format!(
420:         "<rect id=\"chunk-border\" x=\"{bi}\" y=\"{bi}\" width=\"{bw}\" height=\"{bh}\" \
421:          fill=\"none\" stroke=\"#6b7280\" stroke-width=\"1.5\" stroke-dasharray=\"6,4\"/>\n",
422:         bi = bi,
423:         bw = canvas_w - bi * 2.0,
424:         bh = canvas_h - bi * 2.0,
425:     ));
426: 
427:     // ── Header strip ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
428:     let header = format!(
429:         "CHUNK ({cx}, {cz})  ·  {ic}×{ic} voxels  ·  {vs}m/voxel",
430:         cx = cx_idx, cz = cz_idx,
431:         ic = interior as usize, vs = voxel_scale,
432:     );
433:     let header_h = ppv * 1.8;
434:     svg.push_str(&format!(
435:         "<rect x=\"0\" y=\"0\" width=\"{cw}\" height=\"{hh}\" fill=\"#0f172a\" fill-opacity=\"0.9\"/>\n\
436:          <text class=\"lbl\" x=\"6\" y=\"5\" fill=\"#38bdf8\" font-weight=\"bold\">{header}</text>\n",
437:         cw = canvas_w, hh = header_h, header = header,
438:     ));
439: 
440:     // ── Legend ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
441:     if options.show_labels {
442:         let legend_items: &[(&str, &str)] = &[
443:             ("vw",   "WALL"),
444:             ("vrw",  "RED WALL"),
445:             ("vli",  "LIGHT"),
446:             ("vrli", "RED LIGHT"),
447:             ("vfl",  "FLOOR"),
448:             ("vce",  "CEILING"),
449:         ];
450:         let legend_col_w = ppv * 8.5;
451:         let legend_row_h = ppv * 1.1;
452:         let legend_x = canvas_w - legend_col_w - 4.0;
453:         let legend_total_h = legend_row_h * (legend_items.len() as f32) + 6.0;
454:         let legend_y = canvas_h - legend_total_h - 4.0;
455:         svg.push_str(&format!(
456:             "<rect x=\"{lx}\" y=\"{ly}\" width=\"{lw}\" height=\"{lh}\" \
457:              fill=\"#0f172a\" fill-opacity=\"0.88\" rx=\"3\"/>\n",
458:             lx = legend_x, ly = legend_y,
459:             lw = legend_col_w, lh = legend_total_h,
460:         ));
461:         for (i, (cls, label)) in legend_items.iter().enumerate() {
462:             let ry = legend_y + 3.0 + i as f32 * legend_row_h;
463:             svg.push_str(&format!(
464:                 "<rect class=\"{cls}\" x=\"{sx}\" y=\"{ry}\" width=\"{ppv}\" height=\"{ppv}\"/>\n\
465:                  <text class=\"lsm\" x=\"{tx}\" y=\"{ry}\" fill=\"#94a3b8\">{label}</text>\n",
466:                 cls = cls,
467:                 sx = legend_x + 3.0,
468:                 ry = ry, ppv = ppv,
469:                 tx = legend_x + ppv + 6.0,
470:                 label = label,
471:             ));
472:         }
473:     }
474: 
475:     svg.push_str("</svg>\n");
476:     svg
477: }
````

  1: //! Shared material/environment semantics for Level 0.
  2: //!
  3: //! Generation decides *meaning* here — wall treatment, carpet depth and
  4: //! condition, floor state, ceiling character, fixture policy, ambience, and
  5: //! stability class — and every consumer (voxelization, renderers via the
  6: //! material palette, engine audio hooks, debug tooling) derives from the same
  7: //! profile instead of re-inventing ad hoc zone checks.
  8: 
  9: use crate::domain::entities::voxel_grid::{
 10:     VOXEL_DAMAGED_WALL, VOXEL_DEEP_CARPET, VOXEL_DRY_CARPET, VOXEL_FLOOR, VOXEL_FLUID,
 11:     VOXEL_GLIMMER, VOXEL_LIGHT, VOXEL_PALE_WALL, VOXEL_RED_LIGHT, VOXEL_RED_WALL,
 12:     VOXEL_STICKY_CARPET, VOXEL_WALL,
 13: };
 14: 
 15: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
 16: pub enum WallTreatment {
 17:     /// Ordinary Level 0 yellow wallpaper.
 18:     YellowWallpaper,
 19:     /// Pale bone-tinted arch-room masonry.
 20:     PaleArch,
 21:     /// Rough, damaged blackout-expanse surface.
 22:     RoughBlackout,
 23:     /// Peeled wallpaper with crimson underneath (red-room contamination).
 24:     CrimsonPeeled,
 25: }
 26: 
 27: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
 28: pub enum CarpetDepth {
 29:     Shallow,
 30:     Normal,
 31:     Deep,
 32: }
 33: 
 34: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
 35: pub enum CarpetCondition {
 36:     Dry,
 37:     Damp,
 38:     /// Wet, sticky, coarse — the red-room approach and interior.
 39:     WetSticky,
 40: }
 41: 
 42: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
 43: pub enum FloorState {
 44:     Level,
 45:     /// Recessed basin pooling dark ankle-deep fluid (visual-only; collision
 46:     /// stays flat so no random unavoidable deaths).
 47:     RecessedFluid,
 48:     /// A genuine opening (pit lattice). The player is relocated on entry.
 49:     Open,
 50: }
 51: 
 52: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
 53: pub enum CeilingCharacter {
 54:     Compressed,
 55:     Dropped,
 56:     Open,
 57:     Vaulted,
 58: }
 59: 
 60: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
 61: pub enum FixturePolicy {
 62:     /// Dense office fluorescent grid.
 63:     OfficeGrid,
 64:     /// Wider, sparser rhythm (expanses).
 65:     SparseWide,
 66:     /// Only the cool recovery-skeleton glimmers.
 67:     GlimmerSkeleton,
 68:     /// Every fixture burns red (red rooms).
 69:     RedPressure,
 70:     /// Sparse warm pendants (arch rooms).
 71:     WarmPendant,
 72:     /// No fixtures at all.
 73:     Unlit,
 74: }
 75: 
 76: /// Ambience the space asks for. Audio playback does not exist yet; this is
 77: /// the shared cue contract a future audio driver consumes, and what debug
 78: /// tooling reports today.
 79: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
 80: pub enum AudioAmbience {
 81:     FluorescentBuzz,
 82:     FadingBuzz,
 83:     BlackoutSilence,
 84:     /// Directional glimmer/buzz cue toward the recovery skeleton.
 85:     GlimmerCue,
 86:     RedPressure,
 87: }
 88: 
 89: /// How a space participates in the spatial-reality contract.
 90: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
 91: pub enum StabilityClass {
 92:     /// Never accepts epoch input by type (arch rooms). The fixed landmark
 93:     /// the mutable world is measured against.
 94:     ImmutableAnchor,
 95:     /// Ordinary static Level 0 fabric — deterministic and epoch-independent.
 96:     StaticSpace,
 97:     /// May re-hash in the committed wake behind the player (pillar and
 98:     /// blackout expanses).
 99:     WakeRemappable,
100:     /// Regenerates as a closed loop through explicit threshold events
101:     /// (red rooms).
102:     ThresholdLoop,
103: }
104: 
105: /// One compact semantic profile for a column/space of Level 0.
106: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
107: pub struct EnvironmentProfile {
108:     pub wall: WallTreatment,
109:     pub carpet_depth: CarpetDepth,
110:     pub carpet_condition: CarpetCondition,
111:     pub floor: FloorState,
112:     pub ceiling: CeilingCharacter,
113:     pub fixtures: FixturePolicy,
114:     pub audio: AudioAmbience,
115:     pub stability: StabilityClass,
116: }
117: 
118: impl EnvironmentProfile {
119:     pub const fn level0_fabric() -> Self {
120:         Self {
121:             wall: WallTreatment::YellowWallpaper,
122:             carpet_depth: CarpetDepth::Normal,
123:             carpet_condition: CarpetCondition::Damp,
124:             floor: FloorState::Level,
125:             ceiling: CeilingCharacter::Dropped,
126:             fixtures: FixturePolicy::OfficeGrid,
127:             audio: AudioAmbience::FluorescentBuzz,
128:             stability: StabilityClass::StaticSpace,
129:         }
130:     }
131: 
132:     /// Calmer, drier, paler than ordinary Level 0.
133:     pub const fn pillar_expanse() -> Self {
134:         Self {
135:             wall: WallTreatment::YellowWallpaper,
136:             carpet_depth: CarpetDepth::Shallow,
137:             carpet_condition: CarpetCondition::Dry,
138:             floor: FloorState::Level,
139:             ceiling: CeilingCharacter::Open,
140:             fixtures: FixturePolicy::SparseWide,
141:             audio: AudioAmbience::FluorescentBuzz,
142:             stability: StabilityClass::WakeRemappable,
143:         }
144:     }
145: 
146:     /// `depth` is the normalized distance into the footprint (0 boundary,
147:     /// 1 core): the approach earns its darkness gradually.
148:     pub fn blackout(depth: f32) -> Self {
149:         Self {
150:             wall: if depth > 0.15 {
151:                 WallTreatment::RoughBlackout
152:             } else {
153:                 WallTreatment::YellowWallpaper
154:             },
155:             carpet_depth: CarpetDepth::Normal,
156:             carpet_condition: CarpetCondition::Damp,
157:             floor: if depth > 0.35 {
158:                 FloorState::RecessedFluid
159:             } else {
160:                 FloorState::Level
161:             },
162:             ceiling: if depth > 0.68 {
163:                 CeilingCharacter::Compressed
164:             } else {
165:                 CeilingCharacter::Dropped
166:             },
167:             fixtures: if depth > 0.22 {
168:                 FixturePolicy::GlimmerSkeleton
169:             } else {
170:                 FixturePolicy::OfficeGrid
171:             },
172:             audio: if depth > 0.55 {
173:                 AudioAmbience::BlackoutSilence
174:             } else if depth > 0.22 {
175:                 AudioAmbience::GlimmerCue
176:             } else {
177:                 AudioAmbience::FadingBuzz
178:             },
179:             stability: StabilityClass::WakeRemappable,
180:         }
181:     }
182: 
183:     /// `contamination` is 0 outside the warning band, 1 at the threshold.
184:     pub fn red_room(contamination: f32) -> Self {
185:         Self {
186:             wall: if contamination > 0.33 {
187:                 WallTreatment::CrimsonPeeled
188:             } else {
189:                 WallTreatment::YellowWallpaper
190:             },
191:             carpet_depth: CarpetDepth::Deep,
192:             carpet_condition: CarpetCondition::WetSticky,
193:             floor: FloorState::Level,
194:             ceiling: CeilingCharacter::Compressed,
195:             fixtures: FixturePolicy::RedPressure,
196:             audio: AudioAmbience::RedPressure,
197:             stability: StabilityClass::ThresholdLoop,
198:         }
199:     }
200: 
201:     pub const fn archway_room() -> Self {
202:         Self {
203:             wall: WallTreatment::PaleArch,
204:             carpet_depth: CarpetDepth::Deep,
205:             carpet_condition: CarpetCondition::WetSticky,
206:             floor: FloorState::Level,
207:             ceiling: CeilingCharacter::Dropped,
208:             fixtures: FixturePolicy::WarmPendant,
209:             audio: AudioAmbience::FluorescentBuzz,
210:             stability: StabilityClass::ImmutableAnchor,
211:         }
212:     }
213: 
214:     /// The wall material this profile voxelizes as.
215:     pub fn wall_voxel(&self) -> u8 {
216:         match self.wall {
217:             WallTreatment::YellowWallpaper => VOXEL_WALL,
218:             WallTreatment::PaleArch => VOXEL_PALE_WALL,
219:             WallTreatment::RoughBlackout => VOXEL_DAMAGED_WALL,
220:             WallTreatment::CrimsonPeeled => VOXEL_RED_WALL,
221:         }
222:     }
223: 
224:     /// The floor material this profile voxelizes as.
225:     pub fn floor_voxel(&self) -> u8 {
226:         if self.floor == FloorState::RecessedFluid {
227:             return VOXEL_FLUID;
228:         }
229:         match (self.carpet_depth, self.carpet_condition) {
230:             (CarpetDepth::Shallow, _) | (_, CarpetCondition::Dry) => VOXEL_DRY_CARPET,
231:             (CarpetDepth::Deep, CarpetCondition::WetSticky) => match self.wall {
232:                 WallTreatment::CrimsonPeeled => VOXEL_STICKY_CARPET,
233:                 _ => VOXEL_DEEP_CARPET,
234:             },
235:             (CarpetDepth::Deep, _) => VOXEL_DEEP_CARPET,
236:             _ => VOXEL_FLOOR,
237:         }
238:     }
239: 
240:     /// The fixture material this profile voxelizes as.
241:     pub fn light_voxel(&self) -> u8 {
242:         match self.fixtures {
243:             FixturePolicy::GlimmerSkeleton => VOXEL_GLIMMER,
244:             FixturePolicy::RedPressure => VOXEL_RED_LIGHT,
245:             _ => VOXEL_LIGHT,
246:         }
247:     }
248: }
249: 
250: #[cfg(test)]
251: mod tests {
252:     use super::*;
253: 
254:     #[test]
255:     fn profiles_map_to_distinct_materials() {
256:         let fabric = EnvironmentProfile::level0_fabric();
257:         let pillar = EnvironmentProfile::pillar_expanse();
258:         let blackout = EnvironmentProfile::blackout(0.9);
259:         let red = EnvironmentProfile::red_room(1.0);
260:         let arch = EnvironmentProfile::archway_room();
261: 
262:         assert_eq!(fabric.wall_voxel(), VOXEL_WALL);
263:         assert_eq!(fabric.floor_voxel(), VOXEL_FLOOR);
264:         assert_eq!(pillar.floor_voxel(), VOXEL_DRY_CARPET);
265:         assert_eq!(blackout.wall_voxel(), VOXEL_DAMAGED_WALL);
266:         assert_eq!(blackout.floor_voxel(), VOXEL_FLUID);
267:         assert_eq!(blackout.light_voxel(), VOXEL_GLIMMER);
268:         assert_eq!(red.wall_voxel(), VOXEL_RED_WALL);
269:         assert_eq!(red.floor_voxel(), VOXEL_STICKY_CARPET);
270:         assert_eq!(red.light_voxel(), VOXEL_RED_LIGHT);
271:         assert_eq!(arch.wall_voxel(), VOXEL_PALE_WALL);
272:         assert_eq!(arch.floor_voxel(), VOXEL_DEEP_CARPET);
273:     }
274: 
275:     #[test]
276:     fn blackout_gradient_earns_its_darkness() {
277:         let approach = EnvironmentProfile::blackout(0.1);
278:         assert_eq!(approach.wall, WallTreatment::YellowWallpaper);
279:         assert_eq!(approach.fixtures, FixturePolicy::OfficeGrid);
280:         let core = EnvironmentProfile::blackout(0.9);
281:         assert_eq!(core.ceiling, CeilingCharacter::Compressed);
282:         assert_eq!(core.audio, AudioAmbience::BlackoutSilence);
283:     }
284: 
285:     #[test]
286:     fn arch_rooms_are_immutable_anchors() {
287:         assert_eq!(
288:             EnvironmentProfile::archway_room().stability,
289:             StabilityClass::ImmutableAnchor
290:         );
291:     }
292: }

 1: /// Position represents a 2D coordinate in the continuous noise space.
 2: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
 3: pub struct Position {
 4:     pub x: f32,
 5:     pub z: f32,
 6: }
 7: 
 8: impl Position {
 9:     pub fn new(x: f32, z: f32) -> Self {
10:         Self { x, z }
11:     }
12: 
13:     pub fn distance(&self, other: &Position) -> f32 {
14:         ((self.x - other.x).powi(2) + (self.z - other.z).powi(2)).sqrt()
15:     }
16: }
17: 
18: #[cfg(test)]

 1: use std::time::{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};
 2: 
 3: use crate::use_cases::ports::TelemetryPort;
 4: 
 5: /// Native (non-wasm) TelemetryPort adapter: stdout + `SystemTime`.
 6: /// This is the Frameworks & Drivers implementation of the port defined by the
 7: /// Use Case layer in `use_cases::ports`. The wasm front end provides its own
 8: /// implementation backed by `performance.now()` and `console.log`.
 9: pub struct StdTelemetry;
10: 
11: impl TelemetryPort for StdTelemetry {
12:     fn now_micros(&self) -> u64 {
13:         SystemTime::now()
14:             .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
15:             .map(|d| d.as_micros() as u64)
16:             .unwrap_or(0)
17:     }
18: 
19:     fn log(&self, message: &str) {
20:         let secs = SystemTime::now()
21:             .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
22:             .unwrap_or_default()
23:             .as_secs();
24:         println!("[{}] {}", secs, message);
25:     }
26: }

 137:             uProjectionMatrixInverse: { value: new THREE.Matrix4() },
 138:             uViewMatrixInverse: { value: new THREE.Matrix4() },
 139:             cameraPosition: { value: new THREE.Vector3() },
 140:             uNodeTexture: { value: new THREE.Texture() },
 141:             // Temporal reprojection: frame index (0/1) for checkerboard alternation
 142:             uFrameIndex: { value: 0 }
 143:         };
 144: 
 145:         // Hybrid rasterization: one BoxGeometry mesh per loaded chunk
 146:         let baseSvoMaterial;
 147:         let svoBoxGeometry;
 148:         const lightPool = [];

 154:         const perfTelemetry = {

 156:             fpsAccum: 0,

 167:         async function init() {
 168:             camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
 169:             scene = new THREE.Scene();

 172: 
 173:             // Lighting hum
 174:             const ambient = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffeedd, 0.05);
 175:             scene.add(ambient);
 176: 
 177:             // Dynamic PointLights (used for Greedy Meshing mode)
 178:             for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
 179:                 const pl = new THREE.PointLight(0xffeedd, 0.0, 15.0);
 180:                 pl.decay = 2.0;
 181:                 pl.castShadow = true;
 182:                 pl.shadow.bias = -0.002;
 183:                 pl.shadow.mapSize.width = 512;
 184:                 pl.shadow.mapSize.height = 512;
 185:                 scene.add(pl);
 186:                 lightPool.push(pl);
 187:             }
 188: 
 189:             scene.add(camera);
 190:             controls = new PointerLockControls(camera, document.body);
 191: 
 192:             const instructions = document.getElementById('instructions');
 193:             svoCanvas = document.getElementById('svo-canvas');
 194:             
 195:             instructions.addEventListener('click', () => {
 196:                 if (initialLoaded) {
 197:                     if (rendererMode === 'svo') {

 199:                     } else {
 200:                         controls.lock();
 201:                     }
 202:                 }
 203:             });
 204:             
 205:             controls.addEventListener('lock', () => {
 206:                 instructions.style.display = 'none';
 207:             });
 208:             
 209:             controls.addEventListener('unlock', () => {
 210:                 if (rendererMode === 'greedy') {
 211:                     instructions.style.display = 'flex';
 212:                 }
 213:             });
 214: 
 215:             document.addEventListener('pointerlockchange', () => {
 216:                 if (rendererMode === 'svo') {
 217:                     if (document.pointerLockElement === svoCanvas) {
 218:                         instructions.style.display = 'none';
 219:                     } else {
 220:                         instructions.style.display = 'flex';
 221:                     }
 222:                 }
 223:             });
 224: 
 225:             // SVO Mouse look listener
 226:             document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
 227:                 if (document.pointerLockElement === svoCanvas) {
 228:                     playerYaw -= e.movementX * 0.002;
 229:                     playerPitch -= e.movementY * 0.002;
 230:                     playerPitch = Math.max(-Math.PI / 2 + 0.05, Math.min(Math.PI / 2 - 0.05, playerPitch));
 231:                 }
 232:             });
 233: 
 234:             scene.add(controls.getObject());
 235: 
 236:             // Keybindings
 237:             const onKeyDown = (e) => {
 238:                 switch (e.code) {
 239:                     case 'KeyW': moveForward = true; break;
 240:                     case 'KeyA': moveLeft = true; break;
 241:                     case 'KeyS': moveBackward = true; break;
 242:                     case 'KeyD': moveRight = true; break;
 243:                 }
 244:             };
 245:             const onKeyUp = (e) => {
 246:                 switch (e.code) {
 247:                     case 'KeyW': moveForward = false; break;
 248:                     case 'KeyA': moveLeft = false; break;
 249:                     case 'KeyS': moveBackward = false; break;
 250:                     case 'KeyD': moveRight = false; break;
 251:                 }
 252:             };
 253:             document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
 254:             document.addEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp);
 255: 
 256:             // Toggle Button Handler
 257:             const toggleBtn = document.getElementById('renderer-toggle');
 258:             toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
 259:                 if (rendererMode === 'svo') {
 260:                     rendererMode = 'greedy';
 261:                     toggleBtn.innerText = 'Switch to SVO Raymarching';
 262:                     // Show greedy meshes, hide raymarching quad
 263:                     raymarchQuad.visible = false;
 264:                     for (let chunk of greedyChunks.values()) {
 265:                         chunk.meshes.forEach(m => m.visible = true);
 266:                     }

 268:

 273:                     // Sync player coordinates to Three.js camera
 274:                     camera.position.copy(playerPos);
 275:                     camera.rotation.set(playerPitch, playerYaw, 0, 'YXZ');
 276: 
 277:                     if (document.pointerLockElement === svoCanvas) {
 278:                         document.exitPointerLock();

 280:                 } else {
 281:                     rendererMode = 'svo';
 282:                     toggleBtn.innerText = 'Switch to Greedy Meshing';
 283:                     // Hide greedy meshes, show raymarching quad
 284:                     raymarchQuad.visible = true;
 285:                     for (let chunk of greedyChunks.values()) {
 286:                         chunk.meshes.forEach(m => m.visible = false);
 287:                     }
 288:                     lightPool.forEach(l => l.intensity = 0.0);
 289: 
 290:                     // Toggle canvas visibility

 292:                     renderer.domElement.style.display = 'none';
 293: 
 294:                     // Sync Three.js camera to player coordinates
 295:                     playerPos.copy(camera.position);
 296:                     playerYaw = camera.rotation.y;
 297:                     playerPitch = camera.rotation.x;
 298: 
 299:                     if (controls.isLocked) {

 302:                 }
 303:                 updateChunks(true);
 304:             });
 305: 
 306:             // Spec Toggle Button Handler (Low Spec vs High Spec)
 307:             const specToggleBtn = document.getElementById('spec-toggle');
 308:             specToggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
 309:                 if (specMode === 'high') {
 310:                     specMode = 'low';
 311:                     clientChunkSize = 10.0;
 312:                     clientChunkRadius = 1; // 3x3 chunks loading area for low-end
 313:                     specToggleBtn.innerText = 'Spec Mode: LOW';
 314:                     specToggleBtn.style.color = '#ff4444';
 315:                     specToggleBtn.style.borderColor = '#ff4444';
 316:                 } else {
 317:                     specMode = 'high';
 318:                     clientChunkSize = 20.0;
 319:                     clientChunkRadius = 2; // 5x5 chunks loading area for high-end
 320:                     specToggleBtn.innerText = 'Spec Mode: HIGH';
 321:                     specToggleBtn.style.color = '#ffcc44';
 322:                     specToggleBtn.style.borderColor = '#ffcc44';
 323:                 }
 324:                 
 325:                 // Clear existing chunks to force clean scale reload
 326:                 for (let key of svoChunks.keys()) { unloadChunk(key); }
 327:                 for (let key of greedyChunks.keys()) { unloadChunk(key); }
 328:                 
 329:                 updateChunks(true);
 330:             });
 331: 
 332:             // Set up WebGLRenderer
 333:             renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
 334:             renderer.setPixelRatio(window.devicePixelRatio);
 335:             renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
 336:             renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
 337:             renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
 338:             document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
 339: 
 340:             // Set up UnrealBloomPass
 341:             composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
 342:             composer.addPass(new RenderPass(scene, camera));
 343:             
 344:             const bloomPass = new UnrealBloomPass(
 345:                 new THREE.Vector2(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight),
 346:                 1.2, // bloom strength
 347:                 0.3, // bloom radius
 348:                 0.85 // bloom threshold (high threshold so only emissive light voxels glow)
 349:             );
 350:             composer.addPass(bloomPass);
 351: 
 352:             // Compile the SVO Raymarching Material and Mesh
 353:             setupRaymarchQuad();
 354: 
 355:             // Initialize raw WebGL2 SVO Raymarcher
 356:             rawWebGL.init(svoCanvas);
 357:
