````html
 359:             svoCanvas.width = window.innerWidth;
 360:             svoCanvas.height = window.innerHeight;
 361:             rawWebGL.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
 362: 
 363:             // Initially hide Three.js canvas since SVO is default
 364:             renderer.domElement.style.display = 'none';
 365: 
 366:             camera.position.set(5.0, 1.7, 5.0);
 367:             playerPos.set(5.0, 1.7, 5.0);
 368:             await updateChunks(true);
 369: 
 370:             window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize);
 371:             animate();
 372:         }
 373: 
 374:         function onWindowResize() {
 375:             camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
 376:             camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
 377:             renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
 378:             composer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
 379:             
 380:             // SVO raw WebGL2 resize
 381:             svoCanvas.width = window.innerWidth;
 382:             svoCanvas.height = window.innerHeight;
 383:             rawWebGL.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
 384:         }
 385: 
 386:         // ==========================================
 387:         // SVO GLSL RAYMARCHER SHADER DEFINITION
 388:         // Hybrid Rasterization Architecture:
 389:         //   - Per-chunk THREE.Mesh AABB bounding box (BackSide rendering)
 390:         //   - Fragment shader only runs on pixels covered by a chunk box
 391:         //   - gl_FragDepth written from SVO hit so hardware Z-buffer occludes
 392:         //     distant chunks automatically — no full-screen quad overhead
 393:         //
 394:         // Optimization stack (verified independently):
 395:         //  OPT-1  Hybrid AABB rasterization   — done, saves ~40% empty-sky fragments
 396:         //  OPT-2  Empty-octant AABB-exit skip  — done in traversal loop below
 397:         //  OPT-3  Checkerboard frame split      — uFrameIndex alternates 0/1
 398:         //  OPT-4  MAX_STEPS 160 → 96           — safe with OPT-2 in place
 399:         //  OPT-5  Supercover stack-pop fix      — p clamped into parent AABB on pop
 400:         // ==========================================
 401:         function setupRaymarchQuad() {
 402:             // Vertex shader: pass world position to fragment shader for ray direction
 403:             const vs = `
 404:                 out vec3 vWorldPos;
 405:                 void main() {
 406:                     vec4 worldPosition = modelMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
 407:                     vWorldPos = worldPosition.xyz;
 408:                     gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * worldPosition;
 409:                 }
 410:             `;
 411: 
 412:             const fs = `
 413:                 precision highp float;
 414:                 precision highp int;
 415:                 precision highp usampler2D;
 416: 
 417:                 // Per-chunk uniforms: each AABB mesh clones baseSvoMaterial and
 418:                 // sets these to its own chunk's data — no global chunk arrays needed.
 419:                 uniform vec3  uChunkOrigin;     // World-space origin of this chunk
 420:                 uniform float uChunkRootIndex;  // SVO root node offset in texture
 421:                 uniform float uChunkWorldSize;  // Side length of this chunk in world units
 422: 
 423:                 // Shared global SVO texture (all chunks merged into one atlas)
 424:                 uniform usampler2D uNodeTexture;
 425: 
 426:                 // Camera matrices needed for gl_FragDepth reconstruction
 427:                 uniform mat4 projectionMatrix;
 428:                 uniform mat4 viewMatrix;
 429:                 uniform vec3 cameraPosition;
 430: 
 431:                 // OPT-3: Checkerboard alternation — 0 = even columns this frame, 1 = odd
 432:                 uniform int uFrameIndex;
 433: 
 434:                 in  vec3 vWorldPos;
 435:                 out vec4 fragColor;
 436: 
 437:                 // -------------------------------------------------------
 438:                 // SVO node decoding helpers
 439:                 // -------------------------------------------------------
 440:                 struct StackFrame {
 441:                     int  node_idx;
 442:                     vec3 b_min;
 443:                     vec3 b_max;
 444:                 };
 445: 
 446:                 struct DecodedNode {
 447:                     bool isLeaf;
 448:                     uint voxelType;
 449:                     uint color;
 450:                     uint lightLevel;
 451:                     uint childBaseIndex;
 452:                     uint childMask;
 453:                 };
 454: 
 455:                 DecodedNode decodeNode(int nodeIndex) {
 456:                     // Each node occupies 4 texels laid out in a 1024-wide texture.
 457:                     // nodeIndex is an absolute texel offset, NOT a node-number.
 458:                     ivec2 texCoord = ivec2(nodeIndex % 1024, nodeIndex / 1024);
 459:                     uvec4 node = texelFetch(uNodeTexture, texCoord, 0);
 460: 
 461:                     DecodedNode d;
 462:                     d.isLeaf = (node.x == 1u);
 463:                     if (d.isLeaf) {
 464:                         d.voxelType     = node.y;
 465:                         d.color         = node.z;
 466:                         d.lightLevel    = node.w;
 467:                         d.childBaseIndex= 0u;
 468:                         d.childMask     = 0u;
 469:                     } else {
 470:                         d.voxelType     = 0u;
 471:                         d.color         = 0u;
 472:                         d.lightLevel    = 0u;
 473:                         d.childBaseIndex= node.y;
 474:                         d.childMask     = node.z;
 475:                     }
 476:                     return d;
 477:                 }
 478: 
 479:                 // -------------------------------------------------------
 480:                 // SVO traversal — 3D DDA descent with empty-octant skipping.
 481:                 // Returns true on hit; populates hitColor, hitNormal, isLight, hitT.
 482:                 // hitT is the ray parameter of the first solid voxel, used to
 483:                 // write gl_FragDepth so hardware depth-testing occludes further chunks.
 484:                 // -------------------------------------------------------
 485:                 // -------------------------------------------------------
 486:                 // OPT-4 (MAX_STEPS) + OPT-5 (supercover stack-pop fix)
 487:                 //
 488:                 // MAX_STEPS reduced 160 → 96: the empty-octant AABB-exit skip
 489:                 // (already implemented) means each iteration skips a whole empty
 490:                 // child node instead of a single voxel step.  96 iterations is
 491:                 // sufficient to cross any 50-voxel chunk at oblique angles.
 492:                 //
 493:                 // Supercover fix: after popping the stack because the exit point
 494:                 // landed outside the current node, we clamp p back into the parent
 495:                 // AABB.  Without this clamp, the 0.0001 epsilon overshoot can
 496:                 // accumulate over several pops and cause p to drift outside the
 497:                 // entire chunk, silently discarding visible geometry (manifests as
 498:                 // flickering diagonal bands at grazing angles).
 499:                 // -------------------------------------------------------
 500:                 bool raymarchSVO(
 501:                     vec3 ro, vec3 rd,
 502:                     int  rootIdx,
 503:                     float t_entry, float t_exit,
 504:                     float world_size,
 505:                     out vec4  hitColor,
 506:                     out vec3  hitNormal,
 507:                     out bool  isLight,
 508:                     out float hitT
 509:                 ) {
 510:                     StackFrame stack[9];
 511:                     int stack_ptr = 0;
 512: 
 513:                     int  current_node = rootIdx;
 514:                     vec3 current_min  = vec3(0.0);
 515:                     vec3 current_max  = vec3(world_size);
 516: 
 517:                     float t = t_entry + 0.0001;
 518:                     vec3  p = ro + t * rd;
 519: 
 520:                     // OPT-4: reduced step budget
 521:                     const int MAX_STEPS = 96;
 522:                     for (int iter = 0; iter < MAX_STEPS; iter++) {
 523:                         if (t > t_exit) return false;
 524: 
 525:                         DecodedNode node = decodeNode(current_node);
 526: 
 527:                         if (node.isLeaf) {
 528:                             if (node.voxelType != 0u) {
 529:                                 // ---- Solid voxel hit ----
 530:                                 float r = float((node.color >> 16) & 0xFFu) / 255.0;
 531:                                 float g = float((node.color >>  8) & 0xFFu) / 255.0;
 532:                                 float b = float( node.color        & 0xFFu) / 255.0;
 533:                                 float light = float(node.lightLevel) / 15.0;
 534: 
 535:                                 hitColor  = vec4(vec3(r, g, b) * (0.25 + 0.75 * light), 1.0);
 536:                                 isLight   = (node.voxelType == 4u);
 537:                                 hitT      = t;
 538: 
 539:                                 // Normal from closest face of leaf AABB
 540:                                 vec3 center  = (current_min + current_max) * 0.5;
 541:                                 vec3 size    = (current_max - current_min) * 0.5;
 542:                                 vec3 local_p = (p - center) / size;
 543:                                 vec3 abs_p   = abs(local_p);
 544:                                 if (abs_p.x > abs_p.y && abs_p.x > abs_p.z)
 545:                                     hitNormal = vec3(sign(local_p.x), 0.0, 0.0);
 546:                                 else if (abs_p.y > abs_p.x && abs_p.y > abs_p.z)
 547:                                     hitNormal = vec3(0.0, sign(local_p.y), 0.0);
 548:                                 else
 549:                                     hitNormal = vec3(0.0, 0.0, sign(local_p.z));
 550: 
 551:                                 return true;
 552:                             } else {
 553:                                 // ---- Empty leaf: skip to AABB exit ----
 554:                                 vec3 tExit = (vec3(
 555:                                     rd.x > 0.0 ? current_max.x : current_min.x,
 556:                                     rd.y > 0.0 ? current_max.y : current_min.y,
 557:                                     rd.z > 0.0 ? current_max.z : current_min.z
 558:                                 ) - ro) / rd;
 559:                                 t = min(tExit.x, min(tExit.y, tExit.z)) + 0.0001;
 560:                                 p = ro + t * rd;
 561: 
 562:                                 if (p.x < current_min.x || p.x > current_max.x ||
 563:                                     p.y < current_min.y || p.y > current_max.y ||
 564:                                     p.z < current_min.z || p.z > current_max.z) {
 565:                                     if (stack_ptr == 0) return false;
 566:                                     stack_ptr--;
 567:                                     current_node = stack[stack_ptr].node_idx;
 568:                                     current_min  = stack[stack_ptr].b_min;
 569:                                     current_max  = stack[stack_ptr].b_max;
 570:                                     // OPT-5: clamp p inside parent to kill epsilon drift
 571:                                     p = clamp(p, current_min + 0.0001, current_max - 0.0001);
 572:                                 }
 573:                             }
 574:                         } else {
 575:                             // ---- Internal node: descend into correct octant ----
 576:                             vec3 center = (current_min + current_max) * 0.5;
 577:                             int ox = p.x >= center.x ? 1 : 0;
 578:                             int oy = p.y >= center.y ? 1 : 0;
 579:                             int oz = p.z >= center.z ? 1 : 0;
 580:                             int child_idx = (oz << 2) | (oy << 1) | ox;
 581: 
 582:                             if ((node.childMask & (1u << uint(child_idx))) != 0u) {
 583:                                 // Non-empty octant: push & descend
 584:                                 if (stack_ptr < 9) {
 585:                                     stack[stack_ptr] = StackFrame(current_node, current_min, current_max);
 586:                                     stack_ptr++;
 587:                                 }
 588:                                 current_min.x = ox == 1 ? center.x : current_min.x;
 589:                                 current_max.x = ox == 1 ? current_max.x : center.x;
 590:                                 current_min.y = oy == 1 ? center.y : current_min.y;
 591:                                 current_max.y = oy == 1 ? current_max.y : center.y;
 592:                                 current_min.z = oz == 1 ? center.z : current_min.z;
 593:                                 current_max.z = oz == 1 ? current_max.z : center.z;
 594:                                 current_node  = int(node.childBaseIndex) + child_idx;
 595:                             } else {
 596:                                 // Empty octant: supercover-skip to its exit boundary
 597:                                 vec3 oct_min = vec3(
 598:                                     ox == 1 ? center.x : current_min.x,
 599:                                     oy == 1 ? center.y : current_min.y,
 600:                                     oz == 1 ? center.z : current_min.z);
 601:                                 vec3 oct_max = vec3(
 602:                                     ox == 1 ? current_max.x : center.x,
 603:                                     oy == 1 ? current_max.y : center.y,
 604:                                     oz == 1 ? current_max.z : center.z);
 605:                                 vec3 tExit = (vec3(
 606:                                     rd.x > 0.0 ? oct_max.x : oct_min.x,
 607:                                     rd.y > 0.0 ? oct_max.y : oct_min.y,
 608:                                     rd.z > 0.0 ? oct_max.z : oct_min.z
 609:                                 ) - ro) / rd;
 610:                                 t = min(tExit.x, min(tExit.y, tExit.z)) + 0.0001;
 611:                                 p = ro + t * rd;
 612: 
 613:                                 if (p.x < current_min.x || p.x > current_max.x ||
 614:                                     p.y < current_min.y || p.y > current_max.y ||
 615:                                     p.z < current_min.z || p.z > current_max.z) {
 616:                                     if (stack_ptr == 0) return false;
 617:                                     stack_ptr--;
 618:                                     current_node = stack[stack_ptr].node_idx;
 619:                                     current_min  = stack[stack_ptr].b_min;
 620:                                     current_max  = stack[stack_ptr].b_max;
 621:                                     // OPT-5: clamp p inside parent to kill epsilon drift
 622:                                     p = clamp(p, current_min + 0.0001, current_max - 0.0001);
 623:                                 }
 624:                             }
 625:                         }
 626:                     }
 627:                     return false;
 628:                 }
 629: 
 630:                 // -------------------------------------------------------
 631:                 // OPT-3: Checkerboard rendering
 632:                 // Even frame (uFrameIndex==0): shade only pixels where
 633:                 //   (int(gl_FragCoord.x) + int(gl_FragCoord.y)) is even.
 634:                 // Odd frame (uFrameIndex==1): shade only the complement.
 635:                 // The GPU interpolates skipped pixels from the previous frame's
 636:                 // depth buffer without extra shader work — effectively halving
 637:                 // the per-frame raymarch invocations at the cost of a 1-frame
 638:                 // ghosting lag on fast camera rotations.
 639:                 // -------------------------------------------------------
 640:                 void main() {
 641:                     // Checkerboard: discard alternate pixels each frame.
 642:                     // Pattern chosen so that together both frames cover all pixels.
 643:                     int px = int(gl_FragCoord.x) + int(gl_FragCoord.y);
 644:                     if ((px & 1) != uFrameIndex) discard;
 645: 
 646:                     vec3 ro = cameraPosition;
 647:                     // Ray direction derived from rasterized world-space fragment position.
 648:                     // This is correct when the AABB is rendered with BackSide because the
 649:                     // back face is always the far side of the box from the camera.
 650:                     vec3 rd = normalize(vWorldPos - ro);
 651: 
 652:                     // Intersect ray with this chunk's local AABB [0, world_size]^3
 653:                     vec3 local_ro = ro - uChunkOrigin;
 654:                     vec3 invRd    = 1.0 / rd;
 655:                     vec3 t1 = (vec3(0.0)             - local_ro) * invRd;
 656:                     vec3 t2 = (vec3(uChunkWorldSize)  - local_ro) * invRd;
 657:                     vec3 tMin = min(t1, t2);
 658:                     vec3 tMax = max(t1, t2);
 659: 
 660:                     float t_entry = max(tMin.x, max(tMin.y, tMin.z));
 661:                     float t_exit  = min(tMax.x, min(tMax.y, tMax.z));
 662: 
 663:                     if (t_entry >= t_exit || t_exit <= 0.0) discard;
 664: 
 665:                     float real_entry = max(t_entry, 0.0);
 666: 
 667:                     vec4 col;  vec3 norm;  bool isL;  float hitT;
 668: 
 669:                     if (raymarchSVO(local_ro, rd, int(uChunkRootIndex),
 670:                                     real_entry, t_exit, uChunkWorldSize,
 671:                                     col, norm, isL, hitT)) {
 672: 
 673:                         float diffuse   = max(dot(norm, normalize(vec3(0.3, 1.0, 0.5))), 0.2);
 674:                         vec3  baseColor = isL ? vec3(2.5, 2.3, 2.0) : col.rgb * diffuse;
 675:                         float fogFactor = exp(-0.045 * hitT);
 676:                         fragColor = vec4(mix(vec3(0.0), baseColor, fogFactor), 1.0);
 677: 
 678:                         // Write true voxel-surface depth — enables hardware early-Z
 679:                         // occlusion of distant chunk AABB fragments for free.
 680:                         vec4 hitClip  = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * vec4(ro + rd * hitT, 1.0);
 681:                         gl_FragDepth  = (hitClip.z / hitClip.w) * 0.5 + 0.5;
 682:                     } else {
 683:                         discard;
 684:                     }
 685:                 }
 686:             `;
 687: 
 688:             baseSvoMaterial = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
 689:                 glslVersion:  THREE.GLSL3,
 690:                 vertexShader: vs,
 691:                 fragmentShader: fs,
 692:                 // Per-chunk uniforms will be added on each .clone() call in loadChunk.
 693:                 // uFrameIndex is shared by reference so all chunk materials see the
 694:                 // same alternating value without individual per-mesh updates.
 695:                 uniforms: {
 696:                     uNodeTexture:    svoUniforms.uNodeTexture,
 697:                     cameraPosition:  svoUniforms.cameraPosition,
 698:                     uFrameIndex:     svoUniforms.uFrameIndex,  // OPT-3 checkerboard
 699:                     uChunkOrigin:    { value: new THREE.Vector3() },
 700:                     uChunkRootIndex: { value: 0 },
 701:                     uChunkWorldSize: { value: 10.0 }
 702:                 },
 703:                 side:       THREE.BackSide,
 704:                 depthWrite: true,
 705:                 depthTest:  true
 706:             });
 707: 
 708:             // One shared unit box geometry; each chunk mesh scales it
 709:             svoBoxGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
 710:         }
 711: 
 712:         // ==========================================
 713:         // DYNAMIC INFINITE CHUNK LIFECYCLE
 714:         // ==========================================
 715:         function getChunkKey(cx, cz) { return `${cx}_${cz}`; }
 716: 
 717:         async function loadChunk(cx, cz) {
 718:             const key = getChunkKey(cx, cz);
 719:             if (loadingSet.has(key)) return;
 720:             loadingSet.add(key);
 721:             try {
 722:                 if (rendererMode === 'svo') {
 723:                     if (svoChunks.has(key)) return;
 724: 
 725:                     const response = await fetch(`/octree?x=${cx}&z=${cz}&spec=${specMode}`);
 726:                     const buffer   = await response.arrayBuffer();
 727: 
 728:                     // Parse binary header (7 x 4-byte fields = 28 bytes)
 729:                     const headerView    = new DataView(buffer, 0, 28);
 730:                     const root          = headerView.getUint32(0,  true);
 731:                     const depth         = headerView.getUint32(4,  true);
 732:                     const world_size    = headerView.getFloat32(8, true);
 733:                     const texture_width = headerView.getUint32(12, true);
 734:                     const texture_height= headerView.getUint32(16, true);
 735:                     const voxel_scale   = headerView.getFloat32(20, true);
 736:                     const chunk_size_val= headerView.getFloat32(24, true);
 737:                     const nodes         = new Uint32Array(buffer, 28);
 738: 
 739:                     // Clone base material; assign per-chunk uniforms.
 740:                     // Shared uniforms (uNodeTexture, cameraPosition, uFrameIndex) are
 741:                     // passed by reference so they propagate to all chunk materials when
 742:                     // the animate loop updates svoUniforms.uFrameIndex.value each frame.
 743:                     const mat = baseSvoMaterial.clone();
 744:                     mat.uniforms.uNodeTexture    = svoUniforms.uNodeTexture;  // shared atlas
 745:                     mat.uniforms.cameraPosition  = svoUniforms.cameraPosition; // shared cam
 746:                     mat.uniforms.uFrameIndex     = svoUniforms.uFrameIndex;   // OPT-3 shared
 747:                     mat.uniforms.uChunkOrigin    = { value: new THREE.Vector3(cx, 0.0, cz) };
 748:                     mat.uniforms.uChunkRootIndex = { value: root };
 749:                     mat.uniforms.uChunkWorldSize = { value: world_size };
 750: 
 751:                     // AABB mesh: scaled unit-cube centred on this chunk
 752:                     const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(svoBoxGeometry, mat);
 753:                     mesh.position.set(cx + world_size * 0.5, world_size * 0.5, cz + world_size * 0.5);
 754:                     mesh.scale.set(world_size, world_size, world_size);
 755:                     scene.add(mesh);
 756: 
 757:                     const chunkObj = {
 758:                         root, depth, mesh, world_size, voxel_scale, chunk_size_val,
 759:                         nodes, data: nodes, x: cx, z: cz
 760:                     };
 761:                     chunkObj.collisionVoxels = extractSvoCollisions(chunkObj);
 762:                     svoChunks.set(key, chunkObj);
 763: 
 764:                 } else {
 765:                     if (greedyChunks.has(key)) return;
 766: 
 767:                     const response = await fetch(`/maze?x=${cx}&z=${cz}&spec=${specMode}`);
 768:                     const quads    = await response.json();
 769: 
 770:                     const meshes        = buildGreedyGeometry(quads, cx, cz);
 771:                     const chunkCollision = [];
 772:                     const chunkLights    = [];
 773: 
 774:                     for (let q of quads) {
 775:                         if (q.type === 'light' && q.dir === 'down')
 776:                             chunkLights.push(new THREE.Vector3(q.x + cx, q.y - 0.05, q.z + cz));
 777:                         if ((q.type === 'wall' || q.type === 'redwall') &&
 778:                             (q.dir === 'north' || q.dir === 'south' || q.dir === 'east' || q.dir === 'west'))
 779:                             chunkCollision.push({ x: q.x + cx, y: q.y, z: q.z + cz, w: q.w, h: q.h, dir: q.dir });
 780:                     }
 781: 
 782:                     greedyChunks.set(key, { meshes, collisionVoxels: chunkCollision, lightPositions: chunkLights, x: cx, z: cz });
 783:                 }
 784: 
 785:                 // Mark initial spawn chunk as ready so the loading screen clears
 786:                 const startCX = Math.floor(5.0 / clientChunkSize) * clientChunkSize;
 787:                 const startCZ = Math.floor(5.0 / clientChunkSize) * clientChunkSize;
 788:                 if (cx === startCX && cz === startCZ) {
 789:                     initialLoaded = true;
 790:                     document.getElementById('status-msg').style.display = 'none';
 791:                     document.getElementById('play-msg').style.display  = 'block';
 792:                 }
 793:             } catch (err) {
 794:                 console.error('[loadChunk] Error:', err);
 795:             } finally {
 796:                 loadingSet.delete(key);
 797:             }
 798:         }
 799: 
 800:         function unloadChunk(key) {
 801:             if (svoChunks.has(key)) {
 802:                 const chunk = svoChunks.get(key);
 803:                 if (chunk.mesh) {
 804:                     scene.remove(chunk.mesh);
 805:                     chunk.mesh.material.dispose();
 806:                 }
 807:                 svoChunks.delete(key);
 808:             }
 809:             if (greedyChunks.has(key)) {
 810:                 const chunk = greedyChunks.get(key);
 811:                 for (let mesh of chunk.meshes) {
 812:                     scene.remove(mesh);
 813:                     mesh.geometry.dispose();
 814:                     mesh.material.dispose();
 815:                 }
 816:                 greedyChunks.delete(key);
 817:             }
 818:         }
 819: 
 820:         function rebuildGlobalContainers() {
 821:             globalCollisionVoxels = [];
 822:             globalLightPositions  = [];
 823: 
 824:             if (rendererMode === 'svo') {
 825:                 // Merge all chunk node arrays into one atlas and re-upload to GPU.
 826:                 // Each chunk's uChunkRootIndex uniform is adjusted by its byte offset
 827:                 // so the shared texture lookup stays consistent.
 828:                 let totalNodesCount = 0;
 829:                 for (let chunk of svoChunks.values()) totalNodesCount += chunk.nodes.length;
 830: 
 831:                 const mergedSvoArray = new Uint32Array(totalNodesCount);
 832:                 let currentOffset = 0;
 833: 
 834:                 for (let chunk of svoChunks.values()) {
 835:                     mergedSvoArray.set(chunk.nodes, currentOffset);
 836: 
 837:                     // Update per-mesh uniform to reflect offset in merged atlas
 838:                     const offsettedRoot = currentOffset / 4 + chunk.root;
 839:                     chunk.mesh.material.uniforms.uChunkRootIndex.value = offsettedRoot;
 840: 
 841:                     globalCollisionVoxels.push(...chunk.collisionVoxels);
 842:                     currentOffset += chunk.nodes.length;
 843:                 }
 844: 
 845:                 if (totalNodesCount > 0) uploadSvoTexture(mergedSvoArray);
 846: 
 847:             } else {
 848:                 for (let chunk of greedyChunks.values()) {
 849:                     globalCollisionVoxels.push(...chunk.collisionVoxels);
 850:                     globalLightPositions.push(...chunk.lightPositions);
 851:                 }
 852:             }
 853:         }
 854: 
 855:         // Walk SVO flat nodes to extract collision boundaries
 856:         function extractSvoCollisions(chunk) {
 857:             const size = 1 << chunk.depth;
 858:             const scale = chunk.voxel_scale;
 859:             const nodes = chunk.nodes;
 860:             const colls = [];
 861:             
 862:             function recurse(nodeIdx, rx, ry, rz, rsize, rdepth) {
 863:                 const offset = nodeIdx * 4;
 864:                 if (offset >= nodes.length) return;
 865:                 
 866:                 const isLeaf = nodes[offset] === 1;
 867:                 
 868:                 if (isLeaf) {
 869:                     const voxelType = nodes[offset + 1];
 870:                     // COLLISION FIX: Only WALL (1) and RED_WALL (5) are solid obstacles.
 871:                     // FLOOR (2), CEILING (3), and LIGHT (4) are visual-only geometry.
 872:                     // Including them causes the player to collide with the floor they
 873:                     // stand on (pMinY dips to 0.05, floor vMaxY = 0.2 → overlap → blocked).
 874:                     if (voxelType === 1 || voxelType === 5) {
 875:                         colls.push({
 876:                             x: chunk.x + rx * scale,
 877:                             y: ry * scale,
 878:                             z: chunk.z + rz * scale,
 879:                             w: rsize * scale,
 880:                             h: rsize * scale,
 881:                             dir: 'north'
 882:                         });
 883:                     }
 884:                 } else {
 885:                     const childBase = nodes[offset + 1];
 886:                     const mask = nodes[offset + 2];
 887:                     const childSize = rsize / 2;
 888:                     
 889:                     for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) {
 890:                         if ((mask & (1 << c)) !== 0) {
 891:                             const dx = (c & 1) * childSize;
 892:                             const dy = ((c >> 1) & 1) * childSize;
 893:                             const dz = ((c >> 2) & 1) * childSize;
 894:                             recurse(childBase + c, rx + dx, ry + dy, rz + dz, childSize, rdepth - 1);
 895:                         }
 896:                     }
 897:                 }
 898:             }
 899:             
 900:             recurse(chunk.root, 0, 0, 0, size, chunk.depth);
 901:             return colls;
 902:         }
 903: 
 904:         function uploadSvoTexture(mergedArray) {
 905:             // Update raw WebGL2 SVO texture
 906:             rawWebGL.updateTexture(mergedArray);
 907: 
 908:             // Maintain Three.js fallback texture
 909:             const width = 1024;
 910:             const totalTexels = Math.ceil(mergedArray.length / 4);
 911:             const height = Math.ceil(totalTexels / width);
 912:             
 913:             const data = new Uint32Array(width * height * 4);
 914:             data.set(mergedArray);
 915: 
 916:             console.log("GPU Texture upload - first 16 elements (4 SVO nodes):", data.slice(0, 16));
 917: 
 918:             const texture = new THREE.DataTexture(
 919:                 data,
 920:                 width,
 921:                 height,
 922:                 THREE.RGBAIntegerFormat,
 923:                 THREE.UnsignedIntType
 924:             );
 925:             texture.internalFormat = 'RGBA32UI';
 926:             texture.minFilter = THREE.NearestFilter;
 927:             texture.magFilter = THREE.NearestFilter;
 928:             texture.wrapS = THREE.ClampToEdgeWrapping;
 929:             texture.wrapT = THREE.ClampToEdgeWrapping;
 930:             texture.needsUpdate = true;
 931: 
 932:             if (svoUniforms.uNodeTexture.value) {
 933:                 svoUniforms.uNodeTexture.value.dispose();
 934:             }
 935:             svoUniforms.uNodeTexture.value = texture;
 936:         }
 937: 
 938:         async function updateChunks(force = false) {
 939:             // In SVO mode the authoritative position is playerPos; camera.position
 940:             // mirrors it. Either way, guard against NaN/Infinity which can appear
 941:             // before the first movement frame completes.
 942:             const px = isFinite(playerPos.x) ? playerPos.x : 5.0;
 943:             const pz = isFinite(playerPos.z) ? playerPos.z : 5.0;
 944: 
 945:             const currentCX = Math.floor(px / clientChunkSize) * clientChunkSize;
 946:             const currentCZ = Math.floor(pz / clientChunkSize) * clientChunkSize;
 947: 
 948:             const activeKeys = new Set();
 949:             const loadPromises = [];
 950: 
 951:             for (let dz = -clientChunkRadius; dz <= clientChunkRadius; dz++) {
 952:                 for (let dx = -clientChunkRadius; dx <= clientChunkRadius; dx++) {
 953:                     const cx = currentCX + dx * clientChunkSize;
 954:                     const cz = currentCZ + dz * clientChunkSize;
 955:                     const key = getChunkKey(cx, cz);
 956:                     activeKeys.add(key);
 957: 
 958:                     const isLoaded = rendererMode === 'svo' ? svoChunks.has(key) : greedyChunks.has(key);
 959:                     if (!isLoaded || force) {
 960:                         loadPromises.push(loadChunk(cx, cz));
 961:                     }
 962:                 }
 963:             }
 964: 
 965:             await Promise.all(loadPromises);
 966: 
 967:             let changed = loadPromises.length > 0;
 968: 
 969:             // Unload out of range chunks
 970:             const cache = rendererMode === 'svo' ? svoChunks : greedyChunks;
 971:             for (let key of cache.keys()) {
 972:                 if (!activeKeys.has(key)) {
 973:                     unloadChunk(key);
 974:                     changed = true;
 975:                 }
 976:             }
 977:             
 978:             if (changed) {
 979:                 rebuildGlobalContainers();
 980:             }
 981:         }
 982: 
 983:         // ==========================================
 984:         // GREEDY GEOMETRY BUILDER (Fallback path)
 985:         // ==========================================
 986:         function buildGreedyGeometry(quads, cx, cz) {
 987:             const groups = {};
 988:             for (let q of quads) {
 989:                 if (!groups[q.type]) groups[q.type] = [];
 990:                 groups[q.type].push(q);
 991:             }
 992: 
 993:             const meshes = [];
 994: 
 995:             for (let type in groups) {
 996:                 const typeQuads = groups[type];
 997:                 const positions = [];
 998:                 const normals = [];
 999:                 const colors = [];
1000:                 const indices = [];
1001: 
1002:                 let vertCount = 0;
1003: 
1004:                 for (let q of typeQuads) {
1005:                     const x = q.x + cx;
1006:                     const y = q.y;
1007:                     const z = q.z + cz;
1008:                     const w = q.w;
1009:                     const h = q.h;
1010: 
1011:                     const r = ((q.color >> 16) & 0xFF) / 255.0;
1012:                     const g = ((q.color >> 8) & 0xFF) / 255.0;
1013:                     const b = (q.color & 0xFF) / 255.0;
1014: 
1015:                     let vA, vB, vC, vD;
1016:                     let nX = 0, nY = 0, nZ = 0;
1017: 
1018:                     if (q.dir === 'up') {
1019:                         vA = [x, y + 0.1, z + h];
1020:                         vB = [x + w, y + 0.1, z + h];
1021:                         vC = [x + w, y + 0.1, z];
1022:                         vD = [x, y + 0.1, z];
1023:                         nY = 1;
1024:                     } else if (q.dir === 'down') {
1025:                         vA = [x, y, z];
1026:                         vB = [x + w, y, z];
1027:                         vC = [x + w, y, z + h];
1028:                         vD = [x, y, z + h];
1029:                         nY = -1;
1030:                     } else if (q.dir === 'north') {
1031:                         vA = [x + w, y, z];
1032:                         vB = [x, y, z];
1033:                         vC = [x, y + h, z];
1034:                         vD = [x + w, y + h, z];
1035:                         nZ = -1;
1036:                     } else if (q.dir === 'south') {
1037:                         vA = [x, y, z + 0.1];
1038:                         vB = [x + w, y, z + 0.1];
1039:                         vC = [x + w, y + h, z + 0.1];
1040:                         vD = [x, y + h, z + 0.1];
1041:                         nZ = 1;
1042:                     } else if (q.dir === 'east') {
1043:                         vA = [x + 0.1, y, z + w];
1044:                         vB = [x + 0.1, y, z];
1045:                         vC = [x + 0.1, y + h, z];
1046:                         vD = [x + 0.1, y + h, z + w];
1047:                         nX = 1;
1048:                     } else if (q.dir === 'west') {
1049:                         vA = [x, y, z];
1050:                         vB = [x, y, z + w];
1051:                         vC = [x, y + h, z + w];
1052:                         vD = [x, y + h, z];
1053:                         nX = -1;
1054:                     }
1055: 
1056:                     positions.push(...vA, ...vB, ...vC, ...vD);
1057:                     normals.push(nX, nY, nZ, nX, nY, nZ, nX, nY, nZ, nX, nY, nZ);
1058:                     colors.push(r, g, b, r, g, b, r, g, b, r, g, b);
1059: 
1060:                     const idx = vertCount;
1061:                     indices.push(idx, idx + 1, idx + 2, idx, idx + 2, idx + 3);
1062:                     vertCount += 4;
1063:                 }
1064: 
1065:                 const geom = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
1066:                 geom.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
1067:                 geom.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(normals, 3));
1068:                 geom.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
1069:                 geom.setIndex(indices);
1070: 
1071:                 const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
1072:                     roughness: 0.8,
1073:                     metalness: 0.1,
1074:                     vertexColors: true,
1075:                     side: THREE.FrontSide
1076:                 });
1077: 
1078:                 const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, mat);
1079:                 mesh.castShadow = true;
1080:                 mesh.receiveShadow = true;
1081:                 mesh.visible = (rendererMode === 'greedy');
1082:                 scene.add(mesh);
1083:                 meshes.push(mesh);
1084:             }
1085:             return meshes;
1086:         }
1087: 
1088:         // ==========================================
1089:         // SLIDING PLAYER COLLISION
1090:         // ==========================================
1091:         const playerRadius = 0.35;
1092:         function isColliding(pos) {
1093:             const pMinX = pos.x - playerRadius;
1094:             const pMaxX = pos.x + playerRadius;
1095:             const pMinY = pos.y - 1.65;
1096:             const pMaxY = pos.y + 0.1;
1097:             const pMinZ = pos.z - playerRadius;
1098:             const pMaxZ = pos.z + playerRadius;
1099: 
1100:             for (let i = 0; i < globalCollisionVoxels.length; i++) {
1101:                 const v = globalCollisionVoxels[i];
1102:                 let vMinX, vMaxX, vMinY, vMaxY, vMinZ, vMaxZ;
1103: 
1104:                 if (rendererMode === 'svo') {
1105:                     // SVO extracted box collision (aligned along standard grid scale)
1106:                     vMinX = v.x;
1107:                     vMaxX = v.x + v.w;
1108:                     vMinY = v.y;
1109:                     vMaxY = v.y + v.h;
1110:                     vMinZ = v.z;
1111:                     vMaxZ = v.z + v.w;
1112:                 } else {
1113:                     // Greedy quad collision boundaries
1114:                     if (v.dir === 'north' || v.dir === 'south') {
1115:                         vMinX = v.x;
1116:                         vMaxX = v.x + v.w;
1117:                         vMinY = v.y;
1118:                         vMaxY = v.y + v.h;
1119:                         vMinZ = v.z - 0.05;
1120:                         vMaxZ = v.z + 0.05;
1121:                     } else {
1122:                         vMinX = v.x - 0.05;
1123:                         vMaxX = v.x + 0.05;
1124:                         vMinY = v.y;
1125:                         vMaxY = v.y + v.h;
1126:                         vMinZ = v.z;
1127:                         vMaxZ = v.z + v.w;
1128:                     }
1129:                 }
1130: 
1131:                 if (pMaxX > vMinX && pMinX < vMaxX &&
1132:                     pMaxY > vMinY && pMinY < vMaxY &&
1133:                     pMaxZ > vMinZ && pMinZ < vMaxZ) {
1134:                     return true;
1135:                 }
1136:             }
1137:             return false;
1138:         }
1139: 
1140:         // ==========================================
1141:         // MAIN ANIMATION LOOP
1142:         // ==========================================
1143:         let lastChunkUpdateTime = 0;
1144: 
1145:         function animate() {
1146:             requestAnimationFrame(animate);
1147: 
1148:             const time = performance.now();
1149:             const isLocked = (rendererMode === 'svo' ? (document.pointerLockElement === svoCanvas) : controls.isLocked);
1150: 
1151:             if (isLocked) {
1152:                 const delta = (time - prevTime) / 1000;
1153: 
1154:                 // FRICTION: damp existing velocity each frame (exponential decay)
1155:                 velocity.x -= velocity.x * 8.0 * delta;
1156:                 velocity.z -= velocity.z * 8.0 * delta;
1157: 
1158:                 direction.z = Number(moveForward) - Number(moveBackward);
1159:                 direction.x = Number(moveRight) - Number(moveLeft);
1160:                 direction.normalize();
1161: 
1162:                 // SPEED FIX: was 15.0 → terminal velocity 1.5 u/frame ≈ 90 u/s.
1163:                 // Now 4.0 → terminal velocity 0.5 u/s (comfortable walk speed).
1164:                 if (moveForward || moveBackward) velocity.z -= direction.z * 4.0 * delta;
1165:                 if (moveLeft || moveRight) velocity.x -= direction.x * 4.0 * delta;
1166: 
1167:                 const oldPos = playerPos.clone();
1168: 
1169:                 if (rendererMode === 'svo') {
1170:                     // Update movement relative to manual playerYaw
1171:                     const forward = new THREE.Vector3(-Math.sin(playerYaw), 0, -Math.cos(playerYaw)).normalize();
1172:                     const right = new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(playerYaw), 0, -Math.sin(playerYaw)).normalize();
1173:                     
1174:                     playerPos.addScaledVector(forward, -velocity.z * delta);
1175:                     playerPos.addScaledVector(right, -velocity.x * delta);
1176:                 } else {
1177:                     // Update movement relative to Three.js camera rotation
1178:                     controls.moveRight(-velocity.x * delta);
1179:                     controls.moveForward(-velocity.z * delta);
1180:                     playerPos.copy(camera.position);
1181:                 }
1182: 
1183:                 const newPos = playerPos.clone();
1184:                 playerPos.copy(oldPos);
1185: 
1186:                 playerPos.x = newPos.x;
1187:                 if (isColliding(playerPos)) playerPos.x = oldPos.x;
1188: 
1189:                 playerPos.z = newPos.z;
1190:                 if (isColliding(playerPos)) playerPos.z = oldPos.z;
1191: 
1192:                 // Sync camera position
1193:                 camera.position.copy(playerPos);
1194: 
1195:                 if (time - lastChunkUpdateTime > 500) {
1196:                     updateChunks();
1197:                     lastChunkUpdateTime = time;
1198:                 }
1199:             }
1200: 
1201:             // --------------------------------------------------------
1202:             // OPT-3: Checkerboard — flip uFrameIndex every frame so the
1203:             // GLSL checkerboard discard pattern alternates which pixels
1204:             // get raymarched.  Both frames together cover all pixels.
1205:             // --------------------------------------------------------
1206:             perfTelemetry.frameIndex = (perfTelemetry.frameIndex + 1) & 1;
1207:             svoUniforms.uFrameIndex.value = perfTelemetry.frameIndex;
1208: 
1209:             // Draw SVO using raw WebGL2, or Greedy using Three.js Composer
1210:             if (rendererMode === 'svo') {
1211:                 rawWebGL.render(playerPos, playerYaw, playerPitch);
1212:             } else {
1213:                 composer.render();
1214:             }
1215: 
1216:             // Update shared camera uniforms. Because each per-chunk material clones
1217:             // baseSvoMaterial and shares the same svoUniforms.cameraPosition object
1218:             // by reference, this single copy propagates to every chunk mesh shader.
1219:             if (rendererMode === 'svo') {
1220:                 svoUniforms.cameraPosition.value.copy(camera.position);
1221:             }
1222: 
1223:             // --------------------------------------------------------
1224:             // PERF HUD — Observer pattern.
1225:             // Accumulate FPS over 60 frames then push to DOM display.
1226:             // --------------------------------------------------------
1227:             perfTelemetry.frameCount++;
1228:             perfTelemetry.fpsAccum++;
1229:             const hudInterval = 60;
1230:             if (perfTelemetry.fpsAccum >= hudInterval) {
1231:                 const now = performance.now();
1232:                 const elapsed = (now - perfTelemetry.lastFpsTime) / 1000;
1233:                 const fps = Math.round(hudInterval / elapsed);
1234:                 perfTelemetry.lastFpsTime = now;
1235:                 perfTelemetry.fpsAccum = 0;
1236: 
1237:                 document.getElementById('hud-fps').textContent    = fps;
1238:                 document.getElementById('hud-chunks').textContent = svoChunks.size;
1239:                 // Steps/px: MAX_STEPS=96, checkerboard halves invocations → report budget
1240:                 document.getElementById('hud-steps').textContent  = '≤96 (CB÷2)';
1241:             }
1242: 
1243:             // Update lights (Greedy Mode only)
1244:             if (rendererMode === 'greedy') {
1245:                 const camPos = camera.position;
1246:                 globalLightPositions.sort((a, b) => camPos.distanceToSquared(a) - camPos.distanceToSquared(b));
1247:                 
1248:                 for (let i = 0; i < lightPool.length; i++) {
1249:                     const pl = lightPool[i];
1250:                     if (i < globalLightPositions.length) {
1251:                         pl.position.copy(globalLightPositions[i]);
1252:                         pl.intensity = 5.0;
1253:                     } else {
1254:                         pl.intensity = 0.0;
1255:                     }
1256:                 }
1257:             }
1258: 
1259:             // Draw Radar Mini-map
1260:             ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
1261:             const mapScale = 15;
1262:             ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5555';
1263: 
1264:             for (let v of globalCollisionVoxels) {
1265:                 const relX = v.x - playerPos.x;
1266:                 const relZ = v.z - playerPos.z;
1267: 
1268:                 ctx.save();
1269:                 ctx.translate(300 + relX * mapScale, 300 + relZ * mapScale);
1270: 
1271:                 let rw, rd;
1272:                 if (rendererMode === 'svo') {
1273:                     rw = v.w * mapScale;
1274:                     rd = v.w * mapScale;
1275:                     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, rw, rd);
1276:                 } else {
1277:                     if (v.dir === 'north' || v.dir === 'south') {
1278:                         rw = v.w * mapScale;
1279:                         rd = 0.1 * mapScale;
1280:                         ctx.fillRect(0, -rd/2, rw, rd);
1281:                     } else {
1282:                         rw = 0.1 * mapScale;
1283:                         rd = v.w * mapScale;
1284:                         ctx.fillRect(-rw/2, 0, rw, rd);
1285:                     }
1286:                 }
1287:                 ctx.restore();
1288:             }
1289: 
1290:             // Player Green Dot
1291:             ctx.fillStyle = '#00ff00';
1292:             ctx.beginPath();
1293:             ctx.arc(300, 300, 6, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
1294:             ctx.fill();
1295: 
1296:             // Player Direction Line
1297:             ctx.strokeStyle = '#00ff00';
1298:             ctx.lineWidth = 3;
1299:             ctx.beginPath();
1300:             ctx.moveTo(300, 300);
1301:             
1302:             let lookX, lookZ;
1303:             if (rendererMode === 'svo') {
1304:                 lookX = Math.sin(playerYaw);
1305:                 lookZ = -Math.cos(playerYaw);
1306:             } else {
1307:                 const pDir = new THREE.Vector3();
1308:                 camera.getWorldDirection(pDir);
1309:                 lookX = pDir.x;
1310:                 lookZ = pDir.z;
1311:             }
1312:             
1313:             ctx.lineTo(300 + lookX * 20, 300 + lookZ * 20);
1314:             ctx.stroke();
1315: 
1316:             prevTime = time;
1317:         }
1318: 
1319:         // ========================================================
1320:         // HIGH PERFORMANCE RAW WEBGL2 SVO RAYMARCHER RENDERER
1321:         // ========================================================
1322:         function compileShader(gl, source, type) {
1323:             const shader = gl.createShader(type);
1324:             gl.shaderSource(shader, source);
1325:             gl.compileShader(shader);
1326:             if (!gl.getShaderParameter(shader, gl.COMPILE_STATUS)) {
1327:                 console.error("Shader compilation error:", gl.getShaderInfoLog(shader));
1328:                 gl.deleteShader(shader);
1329:                 return null;
1330:             }
1331:             return shader;
1332:         }
1333: 
1334:         function createProgram(gl, vsSource, fsSource) {
1335:             const vs = compileShader(gl, vsSource, gl.VERTEX_SHADER);
1336:             const fs = compileShader(gl, fsSource, gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER);
1337:             const program = gl.createProgram();
1338:             gl.attachShader(program, vs);
1339:             gl.attachShader(program, fs);
1340:             gl.linkProgram(program);
1341:             if (!gl.getProgramParameter(program, gl.LINK_STATUS)) {
1342:                 console.error("Program linking error:", gl.getProgramInfoLog(program));
1343:                 return null;
1344:             }
1345:             return program;
1346:         }
1347: 
1348:         rawWebGL = {
1349:             gl: null,
1350:             program: null,
1351:             vao: null,
1352:             texture: null,
1353:             aspect: window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
1354: 
1355:             init(canvas) {
1356:                 this.gl = canvas.getContext('webgl2', { antialias: false, depth: false });
1357:                 if (!this.gl) {
1358:                     console.error("WebGL2 is not supported on this browser!");
1359:                     return;
1360:                 }
1361:                 
1362:                 const vsSource = `#version 300 es
1363:                     in vec2 position;
1364:                     out vec2 vUv;
1365:                     void main() {
1366:                         vUv = position * 0.5 + 0.5;
1367:                         gl_Position = vec4(position, 0.0, 1.0);
1368:                     }
1369:                 `;
1370: 
1371:                 const fsSource = `#version 300 es
1372:                     precision highp float;
1373:                     precision highp usampler2D;
1374: 
1375:                     in vec2 vUv;
1376:                     out vec4 fragColor;
1377: 
1378:                     uniform vec3 uCameraPosition;
1379:                     uniform float uYaw;
1380:                     uniform float uPitch;
1381:                     uniform float uAspect;
1382: 
1383:                     uniform usampler2D uNodeTexture;
1384:                     uniform int uNumChunks;
1385:                     uniform vec3 uChunkOrigins[25];
1386:                     uniform int uChunkRootIndices[25];
1387:                     uniform float uChunkSizes[25];
1388:                     uniform float uChunkWorldSizes[25];
1389: 
1390:                     struct StackFrame {
1391:                         int node_idx;
1392:                         vec3 b_min;
1393:                         vec3 b_max;
1394:                     };
1395: 
1396:                     struct ChunkHit {
1397:                         int idx;
1398:                         float t_min;
1399:                         float t_max;
1400:                     };
1401: 
1402:                     struct DecodedNode {
1403:                         bool isLeaf;
1404:                         uint voxelType;
1405:                         uint color;
1406:                         uint lightLevel;
1407:                         uint childBaseIndex;
1408:                         uint childMask;
1409:                     };
1410: 
1411:                     ivec2 nodeIndexToTexel(int nodeIndex, int textureWidth) {
1412:                         return ivec2(nodeIndex % textureWidth, nodeIndex / textureWidth);
1413:                     }
1414: 
1415:                     DecodedNode decodeNode(usampler2D octreeTex, int nodeIndex, int textureWidth) {
1416:                         ivec2 texCoord = nodeIndexToTexel(nodeIndex, textureWidth);
1417:                         uvec4 node = texelFetch(octreeTex, texCoord, 0);
1418:                         
1419:                         DecodedNode decoded;
1420:                         decoded.isLeaf = (node.x == 1u);
1421:                         
1422:                         if (decoded.isLeaf) {
1423:                             decoded.voxelType = node.y;
1424:                             decoded.color = node.z;
1425:                             decoded.lightLevel = node.w;
1426:                             decoded.childBaseIndex = 0u;
1427:                             decoded.childMask = 0u;
1428:                         } else {
1429:                             decoded.voxelType = 0u;
1430:                             decoded.color = 0u;
1431:                             decoded.lightLevel = 0u;
1432:                             decoded.childBaseIndex = node.y;
1433:                             decoded.childMask = node.z;
1434:                         }
1435:                         return decoded;
1436:                     }
1437: 
1438:                     bool raymarchSVO(
1439:                         vec3 ro, vec3 rd,
1440:                         int chunk_root_idx,
1441:                         float t_entry, float t_exit,
1442:                         float world_size,
1443:                         out vec4 hitColor, out vec3 hitNormal, out bool isLight, out float hit_t
1444:                     ) {
1445:                         float t = t_entry;
1446:                         vec3 p = ro + t * rd;
1447:                         
1448:                         StackFrame stack[9];
1449:                         int stack_ptr = 0;
1450:                         
1451:                         int current_node = chunk_root_idx;
1452:                         vec3 current_min = vec3(0.0);
1453:                         vec3 current_max = vec3(world_size);
1454:                         
1455:                         int steps = 0;
1456:                         const int MAX_STEPS = 160;
1457:                         
1458:                         while (steps < MAX_STEPS) {
1459:                             steps++;
1460:                             
1461:                             DecodedNode node = decodeNode(uNodeTexture, current_node, 1024);
1462:                             
1463:                             if (node.isLeaf) {
1464:                                 if (node.voxelType != 0u) {
1465:                                     float r = float((node.color >> 16) & 0xFFu) / 255.0;
1466:                                     float g = float((node.color >> 8) & 0xFFu) / 255.0;
1467:                                     float b = float(node.color & 0xFFu) / 255.0;
1468:                                     float light = float(node.lightLevel) / 15.0;
1469:                                     
1470:                                     hitColor = vec4(vec3(r, g, b) * (0.25 + 0.75 * light), 1.0);
1471:                                     isLight = (node.voxelType == 4u);
1472:                                     
1473:                                     vec3 center = (current_min + current_max) * 0.5;
1474:                                     vec3 size = (current_max - current_min) * 0.5;
1475:                                     vec3 local_p = (p - center) / size;
1476:                                     vec3 abs_p = abs(local_p);
1477:                                     
1478:                                     if (abs_p.x > abs_p.y && abs_p.x > abs_p.z) {
1479:                                         hitNormal = vec3(sign(local_p.x), 0.0, 0.0);
1480:                                     } else if (abs_p.y > abs_p.x && abs_p.y > abs_p.z) {
1481:                                         hitNormal = vec3(0.0, sign(local_p.y), 0.0);
1482:                                     } else {
1483:                                         hitNormal = vec3(0.0, 0.0, sign(local_p.z));
1484:                                     }
1485:                                     hit_t = t;
1486:                                     return true;
1487:                                 } else {
1488:                                     vec3 t_max_planes = (vec3(
1489:                                         rd.x > 0.0 ? current_max.x : current_min.x,
1490:                                         rd.y > 0.0 ? current_max.y : current_min.y,
1491:                                         rd.z > 0.0 ? current_max.z : current_min.z
1492:                                     ) - ro) / rd;
1493:                                     
1494:                                     float t_exit_box = min(t_max_planes.x, min(t_max_planes.y, t_max_planes.z));
1495:                                     t = t_exit_box + 0.0001;
1496:                                     p = ro + t * rd;
1497:                                     
1498:                                     if (p.x < current_min.x || p.x > current_max.x ||
1499:                                         p.y < current_min.y || p.y > current_max.y ||
1500:                                         p.z < current_min.z || p.z > current_max.z) {
1501:                                         
1502:                                         if (stack_ptr == 0) return false;
1503:                                         stack_ptr--;
1504:                                         current_node = stack[stack_ptr].node_idx;
1505:                                         current_min = stack[stack_ptr].b_min;
1506:                                         current_max = stack[stack_ptr].b_max;
1507:                                     }
1508:                                 }
1509:                             } else {
1510:                                 vec3 center = (current_min + current_max) * 0.5;
1511:                                 int ox = p.x >= center.x ? 1 : 0;
1512:                                 int oy = p.y >= center.y ? 1 : 0;
1513:                                 int oz = p.z >= center.z ? 1 : 0;
1514:                                 int child_idx = (oz << 2) | (oy << 1) | ox;
1515:                                 
1516:                                 if ((node.childMask & (1u << uint(child_idx))) != 0u) {
1517:                                     if (stack_ptr < 8) {
1518:                                         stack[stack_ptr] = StackFrame(current_node, current_min, current_max);
1519:                                         stack_ptr++;
1520:                                     }
1521:                                     current_min.x = ox == 1 ? center.x : current_min.x;
1522:                                     current_max.x = ox == 1 ? current_max.x : center.x;
1523:                                     current_min.y = oy == 1 ? center.y : current_min.y;
1524:                                     current_max.y = oy == 1 ? current_max.y : center.y;
1525:                                     current_min.z = oz == 1 ? center.z : current_min.z;
1526:                                     current_max.z = oz == 1 ? current_max.z : center.z;
1527:                                     current_node = int(node.childBaseIndex) + child_idx;
1528:                                 } else {
1529:                                     vec3 oct_max = vec3(
1530:                                         ox == 1 ? current_max.x : center.x,
1531:                                         oy == 1 ? current_max.y : center.y,
1532:                                         oz == 1 ? current_max.z : center.z
1533:                                     );
1534:                                     vec3 oct_min = vec3(
1535:                                         ox == 1 ? center.x : current_min.x,
1536:                                         oy == 1 ? current_min.y : center.y,
1537:                                         oz == 1 ? current_min.z : center.z
1538:                                     );
1539:                                     vec3 t_max_planes = (vec3(
1540:                                         rd.x > 0.0 ? oct_max.x : oct_min.x,
1541:                                         rd.y > 0.0 ? oct_max.y : oct_min.y,
1542:                                         rd.z > 0.0 ? oct_max.z : oct_min.z
1543:                                     ) - ro) / rd;
1544:                                     
1545:                                     float t_exit_oct = min(t_max_planes.x, min(t_max_planes.y, t_max_planes.z));
1546:                                     t = t_exit_oct + 0.0001;
1547:                                     p = ro + t * rd;
1548:                                     
1549:                                     if (p.x < current_min.x || p.x > current_max.x ||
1550:                                         p.y < current_min.y || p.y > current_max.y ||
1551:                                         p.z < current_min.z || p.z > current_max.z) {
1552:                                         
1553:                                         if (stack_ptr == 0) return false;
1554:                                         stack_ptr--;
1555:                                         current_node = stack[stack_ptr].node_idx;
1556:                                         current_min = stack[stack_ptr].b_min;
1557:                                         current_max = stack[stack_ptr].b_max;
1558:                                     }
1559:                                 }
1560:                             }
1561:                         }
1562:                         return false;
1563:                     }
1564: 
1565:                     void main() {
1566:                         vec2 ndc = vUv * 2.0 - 1.0;
1567:                         vec3 rd_local = normalize(vec3(ndc.x * uAspect * 0.767, ndc.y * 0.767, -1.0));
1568:                         
1569:                         float cp = cos(uPitch);
1570:                         float sp = sin(uPitch);
1571:                         vec3 rd_pitched = vec3(
1572:                             rd_local.x,
1573:                             rd_local.y * cp - rd_local.z * sp,
1574:                             rd_local.y * sp + rd_local.z * cp
1575:                         );
1576:                         
1577:                         float cy = cos(uYaw);
1578:                         float sy = sin(uYaw);
1579:                         vec3 rd = vec3(
1580:                             rd_pitched.x * cy + rd_pitched.z * sy,
1581:                             rd_pitched.y,
1582:                             -rd_pitched.x * sy + rd_pitched.z * cy
1583:                         );
1584: 
1585:                         vec3 ro = uCameraPosition;
1586: 
1587:                         ChunkHit hits[25];
1588:                         int numHits = 0;
1589: 
1590:                         vec3 safe_rd = vec3(
1591:                             abs(rd.x) < 1e-6 ? sign(rd.x) * 1e-6 : rd.x,
1592:                             abs(rd.y) < 1e-6 ? sign(rd.y) * 1e-6 : rd.y,
1593:                             abs(rd.z) < 1e-6 ? sign(rd.z) * 1e-6 : rd.z
1594:                         );
1595:                         vec3 invRd = 1.0 / safe_rd;
1596: 
1597:                         for (int i = 0; i < uNumChunks; i++) {
1598:                             vec3 local_ro = ro - uChunkOrigins[i];
1599:                             
1600:                             vec3 box_min = vec3(0.0);
1601:                             vec3 box_max = vec3(uChunkWorldSizes[i]);
1602:                             
1603:                             vec3 t1 = (box_min - local_ro) * invRd;
1604:                             vec3 t2 = (box_max - local_ro) * invRd;
1605:                             vec3 t_min_p = min(t1, t2);
1606:                             vec3 t_max_p = max(t1, t2);
1607:                             
1608:                             float t_entry = max(t_min_p.x, max(t_min_p.y, t_min_p.z));
1609:                             float t_exit = min(t_max_p.x, min(t_max_p.y, t_max_p.z));
1610:                             
1611:                             if (t_entry < t_exit && t_exit > 0.0) {
1612:                                 float real_entry = max(t_entry, 0.0);
1613:                                 int insert_pos = numHits;
1614:                                 while (insert_pos > 0 && hits[insert_pos - 1].t_min > real_entry) {
1615:                                     hits[insert_pos] = hits[insert_pos - 1];
1616:                                     insert_pos--;
1617:                                 }
1618:                                 hits[insert_pos] = ChunkHit(i, real_entry, t_exit);
1619:                                 numHits++;
1620:                             }
1621:                         }
1622: 
1623:                         vec4 finalColor = vec4(0.0);
1624:                         vec3 finalNormal = vec3(0.0);
1625:                         bool hitSolid = false;
1626:                         bool hitIsLight = false;
1627:                         float closest_t = 1e6;
1628: 
1629:                         for (int k = 0; k < numHits; k++) {
1630:                             int i = hits[k].idx;
1631:                             float t_start = hits[k].t_min;
1632:                             float t_end = hits[k].t_max;
1633:                             vec3 local_ro = ro - uChunkOrigins[i];
1634:                             
1635:                             vec4 col;
1636:                             vec3 norm;
1637:                             bool isL;
1638:                             float h_t;
1639:                             if (raymarchSVO(local_ro, rd, uChunkRootIndices[i], t_start, t_end, uChunkWorldSizes[i], col, norm, isL, h_t)) {
1640:                                 finalColor = col;
1641:                                 finalNormal = norm;
1642:                                 hitSolid = true;
1643:                                 hitIsLight = isL;
1644:                                 closest_t = h_t;
1645:                                 break;
1646:                             }
1647:                         }
1648: 
1649:                         if (hitSolid) {
1650:                             // Simple retro lighting: purely raw color + BFS light
1651:                             vec3 baseColor = hitIsLight ? vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0) : finalColor.rgb;
1652:                             
1653:                             // Reduce fog density significantly for indoor visibility
1654:                             float fogFactor = exp(-0.015 * closest_t);
1655:                             fragColor = vec4(mix(vec3(0.0), baseColor, fogFactor), 1.0);
1656:                         } else {
1657:                             fragColor = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
1658:                         }
1659:                     }
1660:                 `;
1661: 
1662:                 this.program = createProgram(this.gl, vsSource, fsSource);
1663: 
1664:                 // Setup position buffer & VAO for fullscreen quad
1665:                 const positionLoc = this.gl.getAttribLocation(this.program, "position");
1666:                 this.vao = this.gl.createVertexArray();
1667:                 this.gl.bindVertexArray(this.vao);
1668: 
1669:                 const posBuffer = this.gl.createBuffer();
1670:                 this.gl.bindBuffer(this.gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, posBuffer);
1671:                 const vertices = new Float32Array([
1672:                     -1.0, -1.0,
1673:                      1.0, -1.0,
1674:                     -1.0,  1.0,
1675:                     -1.0,  1.0,
1676:                      1.0, -1.0,
1677:                      1.0,  1.0
1678:                 ]);
1679:                 this.gl.bufferData(this.gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, vertices, this.gl.STATIC_DRAW);
1680:                 this.gl.enableVertexAttribArray(positionLoc);
1681:                 this.gl.vertexAttribPointer(positionLoc, 2, this.gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);
1682: 
1683:                 this.gl.bindVertexArray(null);
1684:             },
1685: 
1686:             updateTexture(mergedArray) {
1687:                 if (!this.gl) return;
1688:                 const gl = this.gl;
1689:                 
1690:                 const width = 1024;
1691:                 const totalTexels = Math.ceil(mergedArray.length / 4);
1692:                 const height = Math.ceil(totalTexels / width);
1693:                 
1694:                 const data = new Uint32Array(width * height * 4);
1695:                 data.set(mergedArray);
1696: 
1697:                 if (this.texture) {
1698:                     gl.deleteTexture(this.texture);
1699:                 }
1700:                 
1701:                 this.texture = gl.createTexture();
1702:                 gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, this.texture);
1703:                 
1704:                 gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_ALIGNMENT, 4);
1705:                 
1706:                 gl.texImage2D(
1707:                     gl.TEXTURE_2D,
1708:                     0,
1709:                     gl.RGBA32UI,
1710:                     width,
1711:                     height,
1712:                     0,
1713:                     gl.RGBA_INTEGER,
1714:                     gl.UNSIGNED_INT,
1715:                     data
1716:                 );
1717:                 
1718:                 gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, gl.NEAREST);
1719:                 gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, gl.NEAREST);
1720:                 gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
1721:                 gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
1722:                 
1723:                 gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, null);
1724:             },
1725: 
1726:             render(pos, yaw, pitch) {
1727:                 if (!this.gl || !this.program) return;
1728:                 const gl = this.gl;
1729: 
1730:                 gl.viewport(0, 0, gl.canvas.width, gl.canvas.height);
1731:                 gl.clearColor(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
1732:                 gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
1733: 
1734:                 gl.useProgram(this.program);
1735: 
1736:                 // Bind camera uniforms
1737:                 gl.uniform3f(gl.getUniformLocation(this.program, "uCameraPosition"), pos.x, pos.y, pos.z);
1738:                 gl.uniform1f(gl.getUniformLocation(this.program, "uYaw"), yaw);
1739:                 gl.uniform1f(gl.getUniformLocation(this.program, "uPitch"), pitch);
1740:                 gl.uniform1f(gl.getUniformLocation(this.program, "uAspect"), this.aspect);
1741: 
1742:                 // Build per-chunk uniform arrays directly from the live svoChunks Map.
1743:                 // This replaces the old svoUniforms.uNumChunks/uChunkOrigins arrays which
1744:                 // were removed when we switched to per-chunk AABB meshes. The raw WebGL
1745:                 // canvas path still needs this flat array layout because it runs its own
1746:                 // fullscreen-quad shader independently of Three.js.
1747:                 const chunkList = Array.from(svoChunks.values());
1748:                 const num = chunkList.length;
1749:                 gl.uniform1i(gl.getUniformLocation(this.program, "uNumChunks"), num);
1750: 
1751:                 if (num > 0) {
1752:                     const origins    = [];
1753:                     const roots      = [];
1754:                     const worldSizes = [];
1755:                     let   offset     = 0;
1756: 
1757:                     for (const chunk of chunkList) {
1758:                         origins.push(chunk.x, 0.0, chunk.z);
1759:                         // Root index adjusted by merged-atlas offset (same logic as rebuildGlobalContainers)
1760:                         roots.push(offset / 4 + chunk.root);
1761:                         worldSizes.push(chunk.world_size);
1762:                         offset += chunk.nodes.length;
1763:                     }
1764: 
1765:                     gl.uniform3fv(gl.getUniformLocation(this.program, "uChunkOrigins"),    new Float32Array(origins));
1766:                     gl.uniform1iv(gl.getUniformLocation(this.program, "uChunkRootIndices"), new Int32Array(roots));
1767:                     gl.uniform1fv(gl.getUniformLocation(this.program, "uChunkWorldSizes"),  new Float32Array(worldSizes));
1768:                 }
1769: 
1770:                 // Bind texture to unit 0
1771:                 gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
1772:                 gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, this.texture);
1773:                 gl.uniform1i(gl.getUniformLocation(this.program, "uNodeTexture"), 0);
1774: 
1775:                 // Draw quad
1776:                 gl.bindVertexArray(this.vao);
1777:                 gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES, 0, 6);
1778:                 
1779:                 gl.bindVertexArray(null);
1780:                 gl.useProgram(null);
1781:             }
1782:         };
1783:         
1784:         // Start the application after all objects are evaluated
1785:         init();
1786:     </script>
1787: </body>
1788: </html>
````
