````rust
   1: //! # wasm_frontend — browser client for the vackrooms voxel engine
   2: //!
   3: //! This crate is the *outer rings* of the engine's Clean Architecture when it
   4: //! runs in a browser. The dependency rule points strictly inward:
   5: //!
   6: //! ```text
   7: //! drivers (web-sys, WebGL2, DOM)        <- wasm32 only
   8: //!    |
   9: //! adapters (input mapping, SVO atlas, local chunk source)
  10: //!    |
  11: //! application (player physics, streaming policy, frame orchestration, ports)
  12: //!    |
  13: //! vackrooms core (entities + use cases: VoxelGrid, SVO, generation, lighting)
  14: //! ```
  15: //!
  16: //! * `application` and `adapters` are platform-agnostic and unit-tested with
  17: //!   plain `cargo test` on the host.
  18: //! * `drivers` is the only module that talks to the browser, and it is only
  19: //!   compiled for `wasm32`.
  20: //! * The `#[wasm_bindgen(start)]` entry point below is the composition root:
  21: //!   it wires concrete drivers into the application's ports.
  22: 
  23: pub mod adapters;
  24: pub mod application;
  25: 
  26: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
  27: pub mod drivers;
  28: 
  29: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
  30: use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicU32, Ordering};
  31: 
  32: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
  33: pub static DOOM_CONTROLS: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
  34: 
  35: /// Mouse look inversion (Y axis).
  36: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
  37: pub static INVERT_Y: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
  38: 
  39: /// Mouse sensitivity multiplier, stored as f32 bits. 1.0 = default.
  40: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
  41: pub static MOUSE_SENSITIVITY_BITS: AtomicU32 = AtomicU32::new(0x3F80_0000); // 1.0f32
  42: 
  43: /// Manual internal-resolution override as f32 bits; 0.0 = automatic
  44: /// (adaptive governor).
  45: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
  46: pub static RENDER_SCALE_BITS: AtomicU32 = AtomicU32::new(0);
  47: 
  48: /// Anomaly debug overlay visibility (settings switch and the F3 key).
  49: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
  50: pub static ANOMALY_DEBUG: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
  51: 
  52: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
  53: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
  54: pub fn set_anomaly_debug(enabled: bool) {
  55:     ANOMALY_DEBUG.store(enabled, Ordering::Relaxed);
  56: }
  57: 
  58: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
  59: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
  60: pub fn set_doom_controls(enabled: bool) {
  61:     DOOM_CONTROLS.store(enabled, Ordering::Relaxed);
  62: }
  63: 
  64: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
  65: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
  66: pub fn set_invert_y(enabled: bool) {
  67:     INVERT_Y.store(enabled, Ordering::Relaxed);
  68: }
  69: 
  70: /// Mouse/touch look sensitivity multiplier (clamped to 0.1–5.0).
  71: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
  72: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
  73: pub fn set_mouse_sensitivity(multiplier: f32) {
  74:     let m = if multiplier.is_finite() {
  75:         multiplier.clamp(0.1, 5.0)
  76:     } else {
  77:         1.0
  78:     };
  79:     MOUSE_SENSITIVITY_BITS.store(m.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
  80: }
  81: 
  82: /// Forces the internal render resolution scale (0.25–1.0), or restores the
  83: /// adaptive governor when `scale` is 0.
  84: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
  85: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
  86: pub fn set_render_scale(scale: f32) {
  87:     let s = if scale.is_finite() && scale > 0.0 {
  88:         scale.clamp(0.25, 1.0)
  89:     } else {
  90:         0.0
  91:     };
  92:     RENDER_SCALE_BITS.store(s.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
  93: }
  94: 
  95: /// CPU render settings: scale override.
  96: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
  97: pub static CPU_SCALE_BITS: AtomicU32 = AtomicU32::new(0x3F80_0000); // 1.0f32
  98: /// CPU render settings: lod cutoff.
  99: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 100: pub static CPU_LOD_CUTOFF_BITS: AtomicU32 = AtomicU32::new(0x3F80_0000); // 1.0f32
 101: /// CPU render settings: max splat half px.
 102: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 103: pub static CPU_MAX_SPLAT_HALF_BITS: AtomicU32 = AtomicU32::new(0x4140_0000); // 12.0f32
 104: /// CPU render settings: max draw distance.
 105: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 106: pub static CPU_MAX_DRAW_DISTANCE_BITS: AtomicU32 = AtomicU32::new(0x42C0_0000); // 96.0f32
 107: /// CPU render settings: shadow mode (0 = Off, 1 = Hero).
 108: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 109: pub static CPU_SHADOWS: AtomicU32 = AtomicU32::new(0);
 110: 
 111: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 112: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
 113: pub fn set_cpu_scale(scale: f32) {
 114:     let s = if scale.is_finite() {
 115:         scale.clamp(0.25, 1.0)
 116:     } else {
 117:         1.0
 118:     };
 119:     CPU_SCALE_BITS.store(s.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
 120: }
 121: 
 122: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 123: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
 124: pub fn set_cpu_lod_cutoff(cutoff: f32) {
 125:     let c = if cutoff.is_finite() {
 126:         cutoff.clamp(0.25, 2.0)
 127:     } else {
 128:         1.0
 129:     };
 130:     CPU_LOD_CUTOFF_BITS.store(c.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
 131: }
 132: 
 133: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 134: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
 135: pub fn set_cpu_max_splat_half(half: f32) {
 136:     let h = if half.is_finite() {
 137:         half.clamp(2.0, 16.0)
 138:     } else {
 139:         12.0
 140:     };
 141:     CPU_MAX_SPLAT_HALF_BITS.store(h.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
 142: }
 143: 
 144: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 145: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
 146: pub fn set_cpu_max_draw_distance(dist: f32) {
 147:     let d = if dist.is_finite() {
 148:         dist.clamp(16.0, 256.0)
 149:     } else {
 150:         96.0
 151:     };
 152:     CPU_MAX_DRAW_DISTANCE_BITS.store(d.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
 153: }
 154: 
 155: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 156: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
 157: pub fn set_cpu_shadows(mode: u32) {
 158:     CPU_SHADOWS.store(mode, Ordering::Relaxed);
 159: }
 160: 
 161: /// Renderer optimization toggles as a bitfield — see
 162: /// [`application::render_settings::RenderToggles`]. Initialized from the URL
 163: /// query at boot; the settings menu flips individual switches afterwards.
 164: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 165: pub static RENDER_TOGGLE_BITS: AtomicU32 = AtomicU32::new(u32::MAX);
 166: 
 167: /// Flips one renderer optimization switch by name (`"hiz"`, `"f2b"`,
 168: /// `"mips"`, `"beam_occlusion"`, `"shadows"`, `"cells"`, `"cull"`,
 169: /// `"budget"`, `"dither"`, `"timer"`). Unknown names are ignored.
 170: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 171: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
 172: pub fn set_render_toggle(name: &str, enabled: bool) {
 173:     let mut toggles = get_render_toggles();
 174:     toggles.set(name, enabled);
 175:     RENDER_TOGGLE_BITS.store(toggles.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
 176: }
 177: 
 178: /// Returns one renderer switch by its short URL name. This small diagnostic
 179: /// export lets the settings UI and browser smoke tests verify the effective
 180: /// state after URL and local-preference overrides have been composed.
 181: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 182: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
 183: pub fn render_toggle_enabled(name: &str) -> Option<bool> {
 184:     get_render_toggles().enabled(name)
 185: }
 186: 
 187: /// Snapshot of the toggle switchboard, taken once per frame by each driver
 188: /// and passed by value into the platform-free render code.
 189: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 190: pub fn get_render_toggles() -> crate::application::render_settings::RenderToggles {
 191:     let bits = RENDER_TOGGLE_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
 192:     if bits == u32::MAX {
 193:         crate::application::render_settings::RenderToggles::default()
 194:     } else {
 195:         crate::application::render_settings::RenderToggles::from_bits(bits)
 196:     }
 197: }
 198: 
 199: /// Boot-time initialization from the URL query (`?rt_<name>=0|1`).
 200: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 201: pub fn init_render_toggles(query: &str) {
 202:     let toggles = crate::application::render_settings::parse_render_toggles(query);
 203:     RENDER_TOGGLE_BITS.store(toggles.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
 204: }
 205: 
 206: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 207: pub fn get_cpu_settings() -> crate::adapters::cpu_splatter::CpuRenderSettings {
 208:     let scale = f32::from_bits(CPU_SCALE_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
 209:     let lod_cutoff = f32::from_bits(CPU_LOD_CUTOFF_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
 210:     let max_splat_half = f32::from_bits(CPU_MAX_SPLAT_HALF_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
 211:     let max_draw_dist = f32::from_bits(CPU_MAX_DRAW_DISTANCE_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
 212:     let shadow_mode = CPU_SHADOWS.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
 213: 
 214:     crate::adapters::cpu_splatter::CpuRenderSettings {
 215:         internal_scale: scale,
 216:         lod_cutoff_px: lod_cutoff,
 217:         max_splat_half_px: max_splat_half,
 218:         max_draw_distance: max_draw_dist,
 219:         shadows: if shadow_mode == 1 {
 220:             crate::adapters::cpu_splatter::CpuShadowMode::Hero
 221:         } else {
 222:             crate::adapters::cpu_splatter::CpuShadowMode::Off
 223:         },
 224:         ..crate::adapters::cpu_splatter::CpuRenderSettings::default()
 225:     }
 226: }
 227: 
 228: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 229: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
 230: pub fn get_blueprint_svg(seed: u32, rx: i32, rz: i32, voxel_scale: f32, size_world: f32) -> String {
 231:     let noise = vackrooms::frameworks_drivers::simple_noise::SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
 232:     let plan = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::generate_region_plan(
 233:         seed,
 234:         vackrooms::entities::models::Position::new(rx as f32 * size_world, rz as f32 * size_world),
 235:         size_world,
 236:         &vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::low_spec(),
 237:         &noise,
 238:     );
 239:     let chunk_size = if voxel_scale <= 0.1 { 20.0 } else { 10.0 };
 240:     let mut chunk_bounds = Vec::new();
 241:     let steps = (size_world / chunk_size).round() as i32;
 242:     for i in 0..steps {
 243:         for j in 0..steps {
 244:             let min_x = rx as f32 * size_world + i as f32 * chunk_size;
 245:             let min_z = rz as f32 * size_world + j as f32 * chunk_size;
 246:             let chunk_coord_x = (min_x / chunk_size).round() as i64;
 247:             let chunk_coord_z = (min_z / chunk_size).round() as i64;
 248:             chunk_bounds.push(vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::ChunkBounds {
 249:                 min_x,
 250:                 min_z,
 251:                 max_x: min_x + chunk_size,
 252:                 max_z: min_z + chunk_size,
 253:                 label: format!("[{}, {}]", chunk_coord_x, chunk_coord_z),
 254:             });
 255:         }
 256:     }
 257: 
 258:     let options = vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintOptions {
 259:         pixels_per_unit: 10.0,
 260:         show_chunk_grid: true,
 261:         show_fixtures: true,
 262:         show_structure: true,
 263:         seed,
 264:         level: 0,
 265:         voxel_scale,
 266:     };
 267:     vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::render_region_blueprint_svg(
 268:         &plan,
 269:         &chunk_bounds,
 270:         options,
 271:     )
 272: }
 273: 
 274: /// Compact geometry feed for the canvas debug map. This deliberately returns
 275: /// planning primitives rather than SVG so the page can redraw cheaply while
 276: /// panning, zooming, or changing overlays.
 277: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 278: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
 279: pub fn get_debug_region_json(seed: u32, region_x: i32, region_z: i32) -> String {
 280:     use std::fmt::Write;
 281:     use vackrooms::domain::entities::architecture::SpaceProgram;
 282: 
 283:     let noise = vackrooms::frameworks_drivers::simple_noise::SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
 284:     let size = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::REGION_SIZE;
 285:     let origin =
 286:         vackrooms::entities::models::Position::new(region_x as f32 * size, region_z as f32 * size);
 287:     let config = vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
 288:     let plan = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::generate_region_plan(
 289:         seed, origin, size, &config, &noise,
 290:     );
 291:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(8192);
 292:     write!(
 293:         out,
 294:         "{{\"origin\":[{:.1},{:.1}],\"size\":{:.1},\"walls\":[",
 295:         origin.x, origin.z, size
 296:     )
 297:     .unwrap();
 298:     let mut first = true;
 299:     for assembly in &plan.assemblies {
 300:         let vertices = &assembly.footprint.vertices;
 301:         for pair in vertices
 302:             .iter()
 303:             .zip(vertices.iter().cycle().skip(1))
 304:             .take(vertices.len())
 305:         {
 306:             if !first {
 307:                 out.push(',');
 308:             }
 309:             first = false;
 310:             write!(
 311:                 out,
 312:                 "[{:.1},{:.1},{:.1},{:.1}]",
 313:                 pair.0.0, pair.0.1, pair.1.0, pair.1.1
 314:             )
 315:             .unwrap();
 316:         }
 317:     }
 318:     out.push_str("],\"corridors\":[");
 319:     first = true;
 320:     for corridor in &plan.corridors {
 321:         for pair in corridor.path.windows(2) {
 322:             if !first {
 323:                 out.push(',');
 324:             }
 325:             first = false;
 326:             write!(
 327:                 out,
 328:                 "[{:.1},{:.1},{:.1},{:.1},{:.1}]",
 329:                 pair[0].x, pair[0].z, pair[1].x, pair[1].z, corridor.width
 330:             )
 331:             .unwrap();
 332:         }
 333:     }
 334:     out.push_str("],\"lights\":[");
 335:     first = true;
 336:     for assembly in &plan.assemblies {
 337:         for fixture in &assembly.fixtures {
 338:             if !first {
 339:                 out.push(',');
 340:             }
 341:             first = false;
 342:             write!(
 343:                 out,
 344:                 "[{:.1},{:.1},{:.1},{:.1},{}]",
 345:                 fixture.at.x, fixture.at.z, fixture.half_x, fixture.half_z, fixture.lit
 346:             )
 347:             .unwrap();
 348:         }
 349:     }
 350:     out.push_str("],\"rooms\":[");
 351:     first = true;
 352:     for assembly in &plan.assemblies {
 353:         let b = assembly.footprint.bounds();
 354:         if !first {
 355:             out.push(',');
 356:         }
 357:         first = false;
 358:         let kind = match assembly.program {
 359:             SpaceProgram::MainCorridor => "corridor",
 360:             SpaceProgram::AbandonedExpansion => "abandoned",
 361:             _ => "room",
 362:         };
 363:         write!(
 364:             out,
 365:             "[{:.1},{:.1},{:.1},{:.1},\"{}\"]",
 366:             b.0, b.1, b.2, b.3, kind
 367:         )
 368:         .unwrap();
 369:     }
 370:     out.push_str("],\"anomalies\":[");
 371:     first = true;
 372:     for anomaly in &plan.anomalies {
 373:         if !first {
 374:             out.push(',');
 375:         }
 376:         first = false;
 377:         let b = anomaly.footprint.bounds();
 378:         write!(
 379:             out,
 380:             "[\"{:?}\",\"{:016x}\",{:.1},{:.1},{:.1},{:.1},{}]",
 381:             anomaly.kind,
 382:             anomaly.id,
 383:             b.min_x,
 384:             b.min_z,
 385:             b.max_x,
 386:             b.max_z,
 387:             anomaly.gates.len(),
 388:         )
 389:         .unwrap();
 390:     }
 391:     out.push_str("]}");
 392:     out
 393: }
 394: 
 395: /// Debug payload for one generated chunk: a compact material slice plus the
 396: /// plan objects that explain why those voxels were placed.
 397: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 398: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
 399: pub fn get_debug_chunk_json(seed: u32, chunk_x: f32, chunk_z: f32, voxel_scale: f32) -> String {
 400:     use std::fmt::Write;
 401:     use vackrooms::domain::entities::architecture::SpaceProgram;
 402:     use vackrooms::domain::entities::voxel_grid::{
 403:         VOXEL_CEILING, VOXEL_DAMAGED_WALL, VOXEL_DEEP_CARPET, VOXEL_DRY_CARPET, VOXEL_FLOOR,
 404:         VOXEL_FLUID, VOXEL_GLIMMER, VOXEL_GRASS, VOXEL_LIGHT, VOXEL_PALE_WALL, VOXEL_RED_LIGHT,
 405:         VOXEL_RED_WALL, VOXEL_STICKY_CARPET, VOXEL_TREE, VOXEL_WALL, VOXEL_WATER,
 406:     };
 407: 
 408:     let noise = vackrooms::frameworks_drivers::simple_noise::SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
 409:     let config = if voxel_scale <= 0.1 {
 410:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::high_spec()
 411:     } else {
 412:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::low_spec()
 413:     };
 414:     let chunk_origin = vackrooms::entities::models::Position::new(chunk_x, chunk_z);
 415:     let generator =
 416:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GenerateChunkArchitectureUseCase::new(&noise);
 417:     let grid = generator.execute(chunk_origin, seed, config.clone());
 418:     let region_size = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::REGION_SIZE;
 419:     let region_origin = vackrooms::entities::models::Position::new(
 420:         (chunk_x / region_size).floor() * region_size,
 421:         (chunk_z / region_size).floor() * region_size,
 422:     );
 423:     let plan = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::generate_region_plan(
 424:         seed,
 425:         region_origin,
 426:         region_size,
 427:         &config,
 428:         &noise,
 429:     );
 430:     let width = grid.width().saturating_sub(2);
 431:     let depth = grid.depth().saturating_sub(2);
 432:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(width * depth + 4096);
 433:     write!(
 434:         out,
 435:         "{{\"origin\":[{:.1},{:.1}],\"scale\":{:.3},\"width\":{},\"depth\":{},\"cells\":\"",
 436:         chunk_x, chunk_z, voxel_scale, width, depth
 437:     )
 438:     .unwrap();
 439:     // One top-down material per column. Priority keeps red lights and walls
 440:     // visible while still exposing floor/ceiling coverage in the same slice.
 441:     for z in 0..depth {
 442:         for x in 0..width {
 443:             let mut material = b'.';
 444:             for y in 0..grid.height() {
 445:                 material = match grid.get(x + 1, y, z + 1) {
 446:                     VOXEL_RED_LIGHT => b'R',
 447:                     VOXEL_LIGHT => b'L',
 448:                     VOXEL_GLIMMER => b'g',
 449:                     VOXEL_RED_WALL => b'X',
 450:                     VOXEL_WALL | VOXEL_TREE => b'#',
 451:                     VOXEL_PALE_WALL => b'P',
 452:                     VOXEL_DAMAGED_WALL => b'D',
 453:                     VOXEL_CEILING => {
 454:                         if material == b'.' {
 455:                             b'^'
 456:                         } else {
 457:                             material
 458:                         }
 459:                     }
 460:                     VOXEL_FLOOR | VOXEL_GRASS | VOXEL_WATER => {
 461:                         if material == b'.' {
 462:                             b'_'
 463:                         } else {
 464:                             material
 465:                         }
 466:                     }
 467:                     VOXEL_DRY_CARPET => {
 468:                         if material == b'.' {
 469:                             b','
 470:                         } else {
 471:                             material
 472:                         }
 473:                     }
 474:                     VOXEL_DEEP_CARPET | VOXEL_STICKY_CARPET => {
 475:                         if material == b'.' {
 476:                             b'~'
 477:                         } else {
 478:                             material
 479:                         }
 480:                     }
 481:                     VOXEL_FLUID => {
 482:                         if material == b'.' {
 483:                             b'w'
 484:                         } else {
 485:                             material
 486:                         }
 487:                     }
 488:                     _ => material,
 489:                 };
 490:             }
 491:             out.push(material as char);
 492:         }
 493:     }
 494:     out.push_str("\",\"corridors\":[");
 495:     let mut first = true;
 496:     for corridor in &plan.corridors {
 497:         for pair in corridor.path.windows(2) {
 498:             if !first {
 499:                 out.push(',');
 500:             }
 501:             first = false;
 502:             write!(
 503:                 out,
 504:                 "[{:.2},{:.2},{:.2},{:.2},{:.2},{}]",
 505:                 (pair[0].x - chunk_x) / voxel_scale,
 506:                 (pair[0].z - chunk_z) / voxel_scale,
 507:                 (pair[1].x - chunk_x) / voxel_scale,
 508:                 (pair[1].z - chunk_z) / voxel_scale,
 509:                 corridor.width / voxel_scale,
 510:                 if corridor.spine_kind == SpaceProgram::MainCorridor {
 511:                     0
 512:                 } else {
 513:                     1
 514:                 }
 515:             )
 516:             .unwrap();
 517:         }
 518:     }
 519:     out.push_str("],\"boxes\":[");
 520:     first = true;
 521:     let mut box_out = |kind: &str, label: &str, bounds: (f32, f32, f32, f32), color: u8| {
 522:         if !first {
 523:             out.push(',');
 524:         }
 525:         first = false;
 526:         write!(
 527:             out,
 528:             "[\"{}\",\"{}\",{:.2},{:.2},{:.2},{:.2},{}]",
 529:             kind,
 530:             label,
 531:             (bounds.0 - chunk_x) / voxel_scale,
 532:             (bounds.1 - chunk_z) / voxel_scale,
 533:             (bounds.2 - bounds.0) / voxel_scale,
 534:             (bounds.3 - bounds.1) / voxel_scale,
 535:             color
 536:         )
 537:         .unwrap();
 538:     };
 539:     for assembly in &plan.assemblies {
 540:         let b = assembly.footprint.bounds();
 541:         let label = match assembly.program {
 542:             SpaceProgram::AbandonedExpansion => "ABANDONED",
 543:             _ => "ASSEMBLY",
 544:         };
 545:         box_out("assembly", label, b, 0);
 546:         for space in &assembly.spaces {
 547:             box_out("space", "SUB-ROOM", space.footprint.bounds(), 0);
 548:         }
 549:         for ceiling in &assembly.ceiling_zones {
 550:             box_out("ceiling", "CEILING ZONE", ceiling.area.bounds(), 0);
 551:         }
 552:         let s = &assembly.structure;
 553:         let b = assembly.footprint.bounds();
 554:         box_out(
 555:             "structure",
 556:             "COLUMN GRID",
 557:             (b.0 + s.phase.0, b.1 + s.phase.1, b.2, b.3),
 558:             0,
 559:         );
 560:         for opening in &assembly.entrances {
 561:             let half = opening.width * 0.5;
 562:             let b = if opening.through_x_wall {
 563:                 (
 564:                     opening.center.x - half,
 565:                     opening.center.z - 0.12,
 566:                     opening.center.x + half,
 567:                     opening.center.z + 0.12,
 568:                 )
 569:             } else {
 570:                 (
 571:                     opening.center.x - 0.12,
 572:                     opening.center.z - half,
 573:                     opening.center.x + 0.12,
 574:                     opening.center.z + half,
 575:                 )
 576:             };
 577:             box_out("portal", "PORTAL", b, 0);
 578:         }
 579:     }
 580:     for anomaly in &plan.anomalies {
 581:         let b = anomaly.footprint.bounds();
 582:         let label = match anomaly.kind {
 583:             vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::AnomalyKind::PillarExpanse => "PILLAR EXPANSE",
 584:             vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::AnomalyKind::BlackoutExpanse => "BLACKOUT",
 585:             vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::AnomalyKind::PitLattice => "PIT LATTICE",
 586:             vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::AnomalyKind::RedRoom => "RED LOOP",
 587:             vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::AnomalyKind::ArchwayRoom => "ARCH ANCHOR",
 588:         };
 589:         box_out("anomaly", label, (b.min_x, b.min_z, b.max_x, b.max_z), 1);
 590:         // Anomaly-aware developer visibility: gates (threshold planes) and
 591:         // the immutable skeleton lane, keyed by instance id in the label.
 592:         for gate in anomaly.traversal_gates() {
 593:             let gb = match gate.axis {
 594:                 vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::Axis2::X => {
 595:                     (gate.plane - 0.1, gate.span_min, gate.plane + 0.1, gate.span_max)
 596:                 }
 597:                 vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::Axis2::Z => {
 598:                     (gate.span_min, gate.plane - 0.1, gate.span_max, gate.plane + 0.1)
 599:                 }
 600:             };
 601:             let glabel = format!(
 602:                 "{} {:08X}",
 603:                 match gate.kind {
 604:                     vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::TraversalGateKind::Remap => "GATE",
 605:                     vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::TraversalGateKind::RedThreshold =>
 606:                         "THRESHOLD",
 607:                     vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::TraversalGateKind::RedLoop => "RED LOOP",
 608:                     vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::TraversalGateKind::RedEscape => "ESCAPE",
 609:                 },
 610:                 (gate.instance_id & 0xFFFF_FFFF) as u32
 611:             );
 612:             box_out("gate", &glabel, gb, 1);
 613:         }
 614:         if anomaly.kind != vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::AnomalyKind::RedRoom
 615:             && anomaly.kind != vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::AnomalyKind::ArchwayRoom
 616:         {
 617:             let lane_a = anomaly.world_coords(-anomaly.footprint.half_x, 0.0);
 618:             let lane_b = anomaly.world_coords(anomaly.footprint.half_x, 0.0);
 619:             let hw = anomaly.skeleton_half_width;
 620:             let lane = (
 621:                 lane_a.x.min(lane_b.x) - hw,
 622:                 lane_a.z.min(lane_b.z) - hw,
 623:                 lane_a.x.max(lane_b.x) + hw,
 624:                 lane_a.z.max(lane_b.z) + hw,
 625:             );
 626:             box_out("skeleton", "PROTECTED ROUTE", lane, 1);
 627:         }
 628:     }
 629:     out.push_str("],\"fixtures\":[");
 630:     first = true;
 631:     for assembly in &plan.assemblies {
 632:         for fixture in &assembly.fixtures {
 633:             if !first {
 634:                 out.push(',');
 635:             }
 636:             first = false;
 637:             write!(
 638:                 out,
 639:                 "[{:.2},{:.2},{:.2},{:.2},{}]",
 640:                 (fixture.at.x - chunk_x) / voxel_scale,
 641:                 (fixture.at.z - chunk_z) / voxel_scale,
 642:                 fixture.half_x / voxel_scale,
 643:                 fixture.half_z / voxel_scale,
 644:                 fixture.lit
 645:             )
 646:             .unwrap();
 647:         }
 648:     }
 649:     out.push_str("]}");
 650:     out
 651: }

 653: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 654: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
 655: pub fn get_chunk_blueprint_svg(
 656:     seed: u32,
 657:     chunk_x: f32,
 658:     chunk_z: f32,
 659:     voxel_scale: f32,
 660:     layer: String,

 663:     let chunk_pos = vackrooms::entities::models::Position::new(chunk_x, chunk_z);
 664: 
 665:     let config = if voxel_scale <= 0.1 {

 669:     };

 675:     let region_size = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::REGION_SIZE;
 676:     let rx = (chunk_x / region_size).floor() * region_size;
 677:     let rz = (chunk_z / region_size).floor() * region_size;
 678:     let semantics = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::generate_region_plan(
 679:         seed,

 686:     let slice = match layer.as_str() {
 687:         "floor" => vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::FloorPlan,

 689:         "ceiling" => vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::CeilingPlan,
 690:         _ => vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::Composite,

 692: 
 693:     vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::render_voxel_chunk_svg(
 694:         &grid,

 696:         &config,

 702: /// Fast single-chunk voxel blueprint with semantic overlays.
 703: ///
 704: /// Why fast? This renders only one 50×50 (or 200×200 for high-spec) voxel
 705: /// grid instead of stitching N×N chunks, so it completes in < 5 ms inside
 706: /// WASM.  The browser can call this on every keypress without delay.
 707: ///
 708: /// Arguments (all passed from JavaScript):
 709: /// * `seed`          – World seed.
 710: /// * `chunk_x`       – Chunk origin X in world units (chunk_index * chunk_size).
 711: /// * `chunk_z`       – Chunk origin Z in world units.
 712: /// * `voxel_scale`   – Metres per voxel (0.2 default, 0.1 high-spec).
 713: /// * `pixels_per_voxel` – SVG pixels per cell (8–12 is comfortable).
 714: /// * `show_grid`     – Draw hairline grid lines.
 715: /// * `show_semantics`– Draw corridor / room / door overlays.
 716: /// * `show_ceiling`  – Include ceiling and light voxels.
 717: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 718: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
 719: pub fn get_chunk_voxel_blueprint_svg(
 720:     seed: u32,
 721:     chunk_x: f32,
 722:     chunk_z: f32,
 723:     voxel_scale: f32,
 724:     pixels_per_voxel: f32,
 725:     show_grid: bool,
 726:     show_semantics: bool,
 727:     show_ceiling: bool,
 728: ) -> String {
 729:     let noise = vackrooms::frameworks_drivers::simple_noise::SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
 730:     let chunk_pos = vackrooms::entities::models::Position::new(chunk_x, chunk_z);
 731: 
 732:     let config = if voxel_scale <= 0.1 {
 733:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::high_spec()
 734:     } else {
 735:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::low_spec()
 736:     };
 737: 
 738:     // Generate the voxel grid for this single chunk.
 739:     let generator =
 740:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GenerateChunkArchitectureUseCase::new(&noise);
 741:     let grid = generator.execute(chunk_pos, seed, config.clone());
 742: 
 743:     // Generate the region plan covering this chunk (for semantic overlays).
 744:     let region_size = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::REGION_SIZE;
 745:     let rx = (chunk_x / region_size).floor() * region_size;
 746:     let rz = (chunk_z / region_size).floor() * region_size;
 747:     let plan = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::generate_region_plan(
 748:         seed,
 749:         vackrooms::entities::models::Position::new(rx, rz),
 750:         region_size,
 751:         &config,
 752:         &noise,
 753:     );
 754: 
 755:     let options = vackrooms::adapters::chunk_voxel_renderer::VoxelBlueprintOptions {
 756:         pixels_per_voxel: pixels_per_voxel.max(4.0).min(20.0),
 757:         show_grid,
 758:         show_voxels: true,
 759:         show_semantics,
 760:         show_labels: show_semantics, // labels only make sense when boxes are visible
 761:         show_ceiling,
 762:     };
 763: 
 764:     vackrooms::adapters::chunk_voxel_renderer::render_chunk_voxel_blueprint_svg(
 765:         &grid,
 766:         &plan,
 767:         chunk_pos,
 768:         voxel_scale,
 769:         options,
 770:     )
 771: }

 773: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 774: #[wasm_bindgen::prelude::wasm_bindgen]
 775: pub fn get_large_voxel_blueprint_svg(
 776:     seed: u32,
 777:     rx_val: i32,
 778:     rz_val: i32,
 779:     voxel_scale: f32,
 780:     size_world: f32,
 781:     layer: String,
 782: ) -> String {
 783:     let noise = vackrooms::frameworks_drivers::simple_noise::SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
 784: 
 785:     let config = if voxel_scale <= 0.1 {
 786:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::high_spec()
 787:     } else {
 788:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GeneratorConfig::low_spec()
 789:     };
 790: 
 791:     let chunk_size = config.chunk_size;
 792:     let steps = (size_world / chunk_size).round() as i32;
 793: 
 794:     // Generate the region plan
 795:     let rx_origin = rx_val as f32 * size_world;
 796:     let rz_origin = rz_val as f32 * size_world;
 797:     let semantics = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::generate_region_plan(
 798:         seed,
 799:         vackrooms::entities::models::Position::new(rx_origin, rz_origin),
 800:         size_world,
 801:         &config,
 802:         &noise,
 803:     );
 804: 
 805:     // Generate all chunks and combine them
 806:     let generator =
 807:         vackrooms::use_cases::generate_chunk::GenerateChunkArchitectureUseCase::new(&noise);
 808: 
 809:     let chunk_w = (chunk_size / voxel_scale).round() as usize;
 810:     let chunk_d = (chunk_size / voxel_scale).round() as usize;
 811: 
 812:     let total_w = steps as usize * chunk_w;
 813:     let total_d = steps as usize * chunk_d;
 814: 
 815:     let mut combined_cells = vec![0u8; total_w * total_d];
 816: 
 817:     let slice = match layer.as_str() {
 818:         "floor" => vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::FloorPlan,
 819:         "wall" => vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::WallPlan,
 820:         "ceiling" => vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::CeilingPlan,
 821:         _ => vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::Composite,
 822:     };
 823: 
 824:     for i in 0..steps {
 825:         for j in 0..steps {
 826:             let chunk_x = rx_origin + i as f32 * chunk_size;
 827:             let chunk_z = rz_origin + j as f32 * chunk_size;
 828:             let grid = generator.execute(
 829:                 vackrooms::entities::models::Position::new(chunk_x, chunk_z),
 830:                 seed,
 831:                 config.clone(),
 832:             );
 833: 
 834:             // Copy chunk voxels to combined grid
 835:             for cz in 0..chunk_d {
 836:                 for cx in 0..chunk_w {
 837:                     let vx = cx + 1;
 838:                     let vz = cz + 1;
 839: 
 840:                     let mut has_wall = false;
 841:                     let mut has_red_wall = false;
 842:                     let mut has_light = false;
 843:                     let mut has_red_light = false;
 844:                     let mut has_floor = false;
 845:                     let mut has_ceiling = false;
 846:                     let mut has_tree = false;
 847:                     let mut has_grass = false;
 848:                     let mut has_water = false;
 849: 
 850:                     for y in 0..grid.height() {
 851:                         match grid.get(vx, y, vz) {
 852:                             1 => has_wall = true,
 853:                             5 => has_red_wall = true,
 854:                             4 => has_light = true,
 855:                             9 => has_red_light = true,
 856:                             2 => has_floor = true,
 857:                             3 => has_ceiling = true,
 858:                             8 => has_tree = true,
 859:                             6 => has_grass = true,
 860:                             7 => has_water = true,
 861:                             _ => {}
 862:                         }
 863:                     }
 864: 
 865:                     let cell_type = match slice {
 866:                         vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::FloorPlan => {
 867:                             if has_wall || has_red_wall || has_tree {
 868:                                 if has_red_wall { 2 } else { 1 }
 869:                             } else if has_floor || has_grass || has_water {
 870:                                 if has_water {
 871:                                     7
 872:                                 } else if has_grass {
 873:                                     6
 874:                                 } else {
 875:                                     5
 876:                                 }
 877:                             } else {
 878:                                 0
 879:                             }
 880:                         }
 881:                         vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::WallPlan => {
 882:                             if has_wall || has_red_wall || has_tree {
 883:                                 if has_red_wall { 2 } else { 1 }
 884:                             } else {
 885:                                 0
 886:                             }
 887:                         }
 888:                         vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::CeilingPlan => {
 889:                             if has_light || has_red_light {
 890:                                 if has_red_light { 4 } else { 3 }
 891:                             } else if has_ceiling {
 892:                                 9
 893:                             } else {
 894:                                 0
 895:                             }
 896:                         }
 897:                         vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::BlueprintSlice::Composite => {
 898:                             if has_wall || has_red_wall || has_tree {
 899:                                 if has_red_wall { 2 } else { 1 }
 900:                             } else if has_light || has_red_light {
 901:                                 if has_red_light { 4 } else { 3 }
 902:                             } else if has_floor || has_grass || has_water {
 903:                                 if has_water {
 904:                                     7
 905:                                 } else if has_grass {
 906:                                     6
 907:                                 } else {
 908:                                     5
 909:                                 }
 910:                             } else {
 911:                                 0
 912:                             }
 913:                         }
 914:                     };
 915: 
 916:                     let target_x = i as usize * chunk_w + cx;
 917:                     let target_z = j as usize * chunk_d + cz;
 918:                     let idx = target_z * total_w + target_x;
 919:                     combined_cells[idx] = cell_type;
 920:                 }
 921:             }
 922:         }
 923:     }
 924: 
 925:     vackrooms::adapters::blueprint_renderer::render_large_voxel_blueprint_svg(
 926:         &combined_cells,
 927:         total_w,
 928:         total_d,
 929:         rx_origin,
 930:         rz_origin,
 931:         voxel_scale,
 932:         size_world,
 933:         slice,
 934:         Some(&semantics),
 935:         false,
 936:     )
 937: }

 939: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 940: mod entry {
 941:     use wasm_bindgen::prelude::*;
 942: 
 943:     /// Composition root. Runs automatically when the wasm module is
 944:     /// instantiated by `static/index.html`.
 945:     ///
 946:     /// `static/worker.js` instantiates this same module inside a Web Worker
 947:     /// with `#[wasm_bindgen(start)]` skipped (`init` is passed
 948:     /// `{ skip_start: true }` is not available for start fns, so instead the
 949:     /// worker checks for a missing DOM and bails out here).
 950:     #[wasm_bindgen(start)]
 951:     pub fn start() -> Result<(), JsValue> {
 952:         console_error_panic_hook::set_once();
 953:         // Inside a Web Worker there is no `window`/DOM: this module was
 954:         // loaded as the generation worker, which drives itself through
 955:         // `worker_init`/`worker_generate` instead of `boot`.
 956:         if web_sys::window().is_none() {
 957:             return Ok(());
 958:         }
 959:         crate::drivers::browser::boot()
 960:     }
 961: }
 962: 
 963: /// Generation-worker entry points. A worker is a second instance of this
 964: /// same wasm module: `worker_init` builds a chunk source from the *same*
 965: /// URL query the main thread used (identical world by construction), and
 966: /// `worker_generate` runs the full chunk pipeline — architectural
 967: /// generation, BFS lighting, greedy mesh + face instances, SVO build and
 968: /// serialization, collision extraction — returning one transferable byte
 969: /// buffer (see `adapters::chunk_codec`).
 970: #[cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")]
 971: mod worker_entry {
 972:     use std::cell::RefCell;
 973: 
 974:     use wasm_bindgen::prelude::*;
 975: 
 976:     use crate::adapters::chunk_codec::encode_chunk_payload;
 977:     use crate::adapters::local_chunk_source::LocalChunkSource;
 978:     use crate::adapters::query_config::generator_setup_from_query;
 979:     use crate::application::ports::ChunkSourcePort;
 980:     use vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::RealitySnapshot;
 981:     use vackrooms::frameworks_drivers::simple_noise::SimpleNoiseProvider;
 982: 
 983:     thread_local! {
 984:         static SOURCE: RefCell<Option<LocalChunkSource<SimpleNoiseProvider>>> =
 985:             const { RefCell::new(None) };
 986:     }
 987: 
 988:     /// `default_seed` must match the main thread's `WORLD_SEED`.
 989:     #[wasm_bindgen]
 990:     pub fn worker_init(query: &str, default_seed: u32) {
 991:         let (seed, config) = generator_setup_from_query(query, default_seed);
 992:         SOURCE.with(|s| {
 993:             *s.borrow_mut() = Some(LocalChunkSource::new(
 994:                 SimpleNoiseProvider::new(),
 995:                 seed,
 996:                 config,
 997:             ));
 998:         });
 999:     }
1000: 
1001:     #[wasm_bindgen]
1002:     pub fn worker_generate(
1003:         _request_id: u32,
1004:         origin_x: f32,
1005:         origin_z: f32,
1006:         level: u32,
1007:         lod: u8,
1008:         reality_words: Vec<u32>,
1009:     ) -> Vec<u8> {
1010:         let reality = RealitySnapshot::from_words(&reality_words)
1011:             .expect("worker_generate received an invalid reality snapshot");
1012:         SOURCE.with(|s| {
1013:             let source = s.borrow();
1014:             let source = source
1015:                 .as_ref()
1016:                 .expect("worker_generate called before worker_init");
1017:             encode_chunk_payload(
1018:                 &source.load_with_reality(origin_x, origin_z, level, lod, &reality),
1019:             )
1020:         })
1021:     }
1022: }

  95:     /// The same chunk at a coarser level of detail: voxels double per LOD
  96:     /// step, so lod 1 costs ~1/8 of lod 0 to generate, light, and serialize.
  97:     /// `svo_world_size()` is invariant across LODs (half the voxels at twice
  98:     /// the scale), so payloads of any LOD are interchangeable to the renderer.
  99:     pub fn at_lod(mut self, lod: u8) -> Self {
 100:         self.voxel_scale *= (1u32 << lod.min(4)) as f32;
 101:         self
 102:     }

 104:     pub fn svo_depth(&self) -> u32 {
 105:         let voxels = (self.chunk_size / self.voxel_scale).round().max(1.0) as u32;
 106:         voxels.next_power_of_two().trailing_zeros()
 107:     }
 108: 
 109:     pub fn svo_world_size(&self) -> f32 {
 110:         let size = 1 << self.svo_depth();
 111:         size as f32 * self.voxel_scale
 112:     }
 113: }
