 125: /// Flyweight Room Stamps
 126: #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
 127: struct RoomStamp {
 128:     width: usize,
 129:     depth: usize,
 130:     data: Vec<u8>,
 131: }
 132: 
 133: impl RoomStamp {
 134:     fn cubicles() -> Self {
 135:         let width = 20;
 136:         let depth = 20;
 137:         let mut data = vec![0; width * depth];
 138:         for z in 2..8 {
 139:             data[z * width + 5] = 1;
 140:         }
 141:         for x in 2..8 {
 142:             data[5 * width + x] = 1;
 143:         }
 144:         for z in 12..18 {
 145:             data[z * width + 15] = 1;
 146:         }
 147:         for x in 12..18 {
 148:             data[15 * width + x] = 1;
 149:         }
 150:         Self { width, depth, data }
 151:     }
 152: 
 153:     fn showroom() -> Self {
 154:         let width = 16;
 155:         let depth = 16;
 156:         let mut data = vec![0; width * depth];
 157:         for z in 2..6 {
 158:             for x in 2..6 {
 159:                 data[z * width + x] = 2;
 160:             }
 161:             for x in 10..14 {
 162:                 data[z * width + x] = 2;
 163:             }
 164:         }
 165:         for z in 10..14 {
 166:             for x in 2..6 {
 167:                 data[z * width + x] = 2;
 168:             }
 169:             for x in 10..14 {
 170:                 data[z * width + x] = 2;
 171:             }
 172:         }
 173:         Self { width, depth, data }
 174:     }
 175: 
 176:     fn waiting() -> Self {
 177:         let width = 20;
 178:         let depth = 20;
 179:         let mut data = vec![0; width * depth];
 180:         for x in 4..16 {
 181:             data[6 * width + x] = 3;
 182:             data[14 * width + x] = 3;
 183:         }
 184:         Self { width, depth, data }
 185:     }
 186: 
 187:     fn storage() -> Self {
 188:         let width = 12;
 189:         let depth = 16;
 190:         let mut data = vec![0; width * depth];
 191:         for z in 2..14 {
 192:             data[z * width + 2] = 1;
 193:             data[z * width + 9] = 1;
 194:         }
 195:         Self { width, depth, data }
 196:     }
 197: 
 198:     fn lounge() -> Self {
 199:         let width = 18;
 200:         let depth = 18;
 201:         let mut data = vec![0; width * depth];
 202:         for z in 6..12 {
 203:             for x in 6..12 {
 204:                 if z == 6 || z == 11 || x == 6 || x == 11 {
 205:                     data[z * width + x] = 3;
 206:                 }
 207:             }
 208:         }
 209:         Self { width, depth, data }
 210:     }
 211: 
 212:     fn server_room() -> Self {
 213:         let width = 14;
 214:         let depth = 20;
 215:         let mut data = vec![0; width * depth];
 216:         for x in [3, 7, 10].iter() {
 217:             for z in 2..18 {
 218:                 if z % 4 != 0 {
 219:                     data[z * width + x] = 2;
 220:                 }
 221:             }
 222:         }
 223:         Self { width, depth, data }
 224:     }
 225: 
 226:     fn cafeteria() -> Self {
 227:         let width = 24;
 228:         let depth = 24;
 229:         let mut data = vec![0; width * depth];
 230:         for z in [4, 10, 16, 20].iter() {
 231:             for x in [4, 10, 16, 20].iter() {
 232:                 data[z * width + x] = 1;
 233:                 data[*z * width + x + 1] = 1;
 234:                 data[(z + 1) * width + x] = 1;
 235:                 data[(z + 1) * width + x + 1] = 1;
 236:             }
 237:         }
 238:         Self { width, depth, data }
 239:     }
 240: 
 241:     fn maintenance() -> Self {
 242:         let width = 10;
 243:         let depth = 10;
 244:         let mut data = vec![0; width * depth];
 245:         data[2 * width + 2] = 2;
 246:         data[2 * width + 7] = 2;
 247:         data[7 * width + 2] = 2;
 248:         data[7 * width + 7] = 2;
 249:         data[4 * width + 4] = 3;
 250:         data[4 * width + 5] = 3;
 251:         data[5 * width + 4] = 3;
 252:         data[5 * width + 5] = 3;
 253:         Self { width, depth, data }
 254:     }
 255: 
 256:     fn stairway() -> Self {
 257:         let width = 16;
 258:         let depth = 16;
 259:         let mut data = vec![0; width * depth];
 260:         for z in 0..16 {
 261:             for x in 0..16 {
 262:                 if x > 9 {
 263:                     data[z * width + x] = 4; // raised
 264:                 } else if x == 9 {
 265:                     data[z * width + x] = 5; // step 2
 266:                 } else if x == 8 {
 267:                     data[z * width + x] = 6; // step 1
 268:                 }
 269:             }
 270:         }
 271:         Self { width, depth, data }
 272:     }
 273: }
 274: 
 275: pub struct GenerateChunkArchitectureUseCase<'a> {
 276:     noise_provider: &'a dyn NoiseProvider,
 277:     telemetry: &'a dyn TelemetryPort,
 278: }
 279: 
 280: impl<'a> GenerateChunkArchitectureUseCase<'a> {
 281:     /// Constructs the use case with silent telemetry (tests, wasm default).
 282:     pub fn new(noise_provider: &'a dyn NoiseProvider) -> Self {
 283:         Self {
 284:             noise_provider,
 285:             telemetry: &NULL_TELEMETRY,
 286:         }
 287:     }
 288: 
 289:     /// Constructs the use case with an injected telemetry sink (native server,
 290:     /// browser console, ...). Keeps the Dependency Rule intact: the use case
 291:     /// only knows the TelemetryPort trait.
 292:     pub fn with_telemetry(
 293:         noise_provider: &'a dyn NoiseProvider,
 294:         telemetry: &'a dyn TelemetryPort,
 295:     ) -> Self {
 296:         Self {
 297:             noise_provider,
 298:             telemetry,
 299:         }
 300:     }
 301: 
 302:     pub fn execute(&self, chunk_pos: Position, seed: u32, config: GeneratorConfig) -> VoxelGrid {
 303:         self.execute_with_reality(chunk_pos, seed, config, &RealitySnapshot::default())
 304:     }
 305: 
 306:     /// Generates a chunk against an immutable encounter-state snapshot.
 307:     /// The snapshot is part of the request identity in the browser pipeline;
 308:     /// generation itself remains pure and replayable.
 309:     pub fn execute_with_reality(
 310:         &self,
 311:         chunk_pos: Position,
 312:         seed: u32,
 313:         config: GeneratorConfig,
 314:         reality: &RealitySnapshot,
 315:     ) -> VoxelGrid {
 316:         // Pluggable levels: everything except the legacy office blueprint
 317:         // (level 1, kept inline below) goes through the LevelGenerator port.
 318:         // Level 0 is the architecturally *planned* Backrooms: region plans
 319:         // (circulation -> assemblies -> corruption) drive the voxelization.
 320:         if config.level == 0 || config.level == 34 {
 321:             use crate::use_cases::backrooms_level::BackroomsLevel;
 322:             use crate::use_cases::grassland_level::GrasslandLevel;
 323:             use crate::use_cases::level_generator::LevelGenerator;
 324: 
 325:             let start_micros = self.telemetry.now_micros();
 326:             let generator: &dyn LevelGenerator = if config.level == 0 {
 327:                 &BackroomsLevel
 328:             } else {
 329:                 &GrasslandLevel
 330:             };
 331:             let mut grid = generator.generate_with_reality(
 332:                 chunk_pos,
 333:                 seed,
 334:                 config,
 335:                 self.noise_provider,
 336:                 reality,
 337:             );
 338:             crate::domain::use_cases::calculate_lighting::calculate_voxel_lighting(&mut grid);
 339:             crate::domain::use_cases::path_tracer::bake_face_occlusion(&mut grid);
 340: 
 341:             let elapsed_micros = self.telemetry.now_micros().saturating_sub(start_micros);
 342:             self.telemetry.log(&format!(
 343:                 "[TELEMETRY] level {} chunk generated. Duration={}us, Grid={}x{}x{}",
 344:                 config.level,
 345:                 elapsed_micros,
 346:                 grid.width(),
 347:                 grid.height(),
 348:                 grid.depth()
 349:             ));
 350:             return grid;
 351:         }
 352: 
 353:         let start_micros = self.telemetry.now_micros();
 354: 
 355:         let width = (config.chunk_size / config.voxel_scale).round() as usize;
 356:         let depth = (config.chunk_size / config.voxel_scale).round() as usize;
 357: 
 358:         // Cell voxel borders derive from world space (cells are 5.0 units) so
 359:         // every LOD of a chunk puts its walls on the same world planes.
 360:         // Truncating a fixed voxels-per-cell instead compresses the maze at
 361:         // scales where 5.0/voxel_scale is fractional.
 362:         let cell_border = |c: usize| (c as f32 * 5.0 / config.voxel_scale).round() as usize;
 363:         let cell_w = ((config.chunk_size / 5.0).round() as usize).max(1);
 364:         let cell_d = cell_w;
 365: 
 366:         let mut abstract_grid = Grid::new(cell_w, cell_d);
 367: 
 368:         // --- ZONE ASSIGNMENT PASS ---
 369:         let mut max_chunk_height_units = 3.0_f32;
 370:         for cz in 0..cell_d {
 371:             for cx in 0..cell_w {
 372:                 let wx = chunk_pos.x * config.chunk_size + (cx as f32) * 5.0;
 373:                 let wz = chunk_pos.z * config.chunk_size + (cz as f32) * 5.0;
 374: 
 375:                 // Low frequency noise for zone clustering
 376:                 let n = self.noise_provider.evaluate_2d(
 377:                     seed ^ 0x2b8f_a43c,
 378:                     crate::entities::models::Position::new(wx * 0.05, wz * 0.05),
 379:                 ); // n is in [-1, 1]
 380: 
 381:                 use crate::domain::entities::cell::MicrobiomeZone;
 382:                 let mut zone = MicrobiomeZone::Standard;
 383: 
 384:                 if n < -0.7 {
 385:                     zone = MicrobiomeZone::Blackout;
 386:                 } else if n < -0.4 {
 387:                     zone = MicrobiomeZone::Holes;
 388:                 } else if n > 0.85 - (config.tuning.atria as f32 * 0.1) {
 389:                     zone = MicrobiomeZone::Atrium;
 390:                 } else if n > 0.6 {
 391:                     zone = MicrobiomeZone::PillarField;
 392:                 } else if n > 0.4 {
 393:                     zone = MicrobiomeZone::Arch;
 394:                 } else if n > 0.2 && n < 0.25 {
 395:                     zone = MicrobiomeZone::RedRoom;
 396:                 }
 397: 
 398:                 if let Some(cell) = abstract_grid.get_mut(cx, cz) {
 399:                     cell.zone = zone;
 400:                 }
 401: 
 402:                 let cell_h = match zone {
 403:                     MicrobiomeZone::Atrium => 12.0,  // 4.0 * 3.0x
 404:                     MicrobiomeZone::Blackout => 3.2, // 4.0 * 0.8x
 405:                     _ => 4.0,
 406:                 };
 407:                 if cell_h > max_chunk_height_units {
 408:                     max_chunk_height_units = cell_h;
 409:                 }
 410:             }
 411:         }
 412: 
 413:         let height = (max_chunk_height_units / config.voxel_scale).ceil() as usize + 2; // +2 for floor and ceiling bounds
 414: 
 415:         self.telemetry.log(&format!(
 416:             "[INFO] Entering GenerateChunkArchitectureUseCase::execute. Args: chunk_pos={:?}, seed={}, chunk_size={} (Voxel dimensions: {}x{}x{})",
 417:             chunk_pos, seed, config.chunk_size, width, height, depth
 418:         ));
 419: 
 420:         let mut grid = VoxelGrid::new(width, height, depth);
 421: 
 422:         // STARTING HUB OVERRIDE: Chunk (0,0) is a massive open plaza that feeds seamlessly into the maze
 423:         if chunk_pos.x.abs() < 1.0 && chunk_pos.z.abs() < 1.0 {
 424:             for z in 0..depth {
 425:                 for x in 0..width {
 426:                     grid.set(x, 0, z, VOXEL_FLOOR);
 427:                     grid.set(x, height - 1, z, VOXEL_CEILING);
 428: 
 429:                     // Add some scattered lights to the ceiling and floor so it's bright
 430:                     if x > 0 && z > 0 && x % 20 == 0 && z % 20 == 0 {
 431:                         grid.set(x, height - 1, z, VOXEL_LIGHT);
 432:                         grid.set(x, 0, z, VOXEL_LIGHT);
 433:                     }
 434:                 }
 435:             }
 436:             crate::domain::use_cases::calculate_lighting::calculate_voxel_lighting(&mut grid);
 437:             return grid;
 438:         }
 439: 
 440:         // ==========================================
 441:         // DYNAMIC GENERATION (Growing Tree & BSP)
 442:         // ==========================================
 443:         let mut rng = StdRng::seed_from_u64(
 444:             (seed as u64) ^ (chunk_pos.x.to_bits() as u64) ^ (chunk_pos.z.to_bits() as u64),
 445:         );
 446:         // Per-voxel cosmetic noise (floor holes, dotted pillars) draws from
 447:         // its own stream: the number of those draws depends on voxel
 448:         // resolution, and letting them share the structural RNG would
 449:         // desynchronize wall/door placement between LODs of the same chunk.
 450:         let mut detail_rng = StdRng::seed_from_u64(
 451:             (seed as u64)
 452:                 ^ (chunk_pos.x.to_bits() as u64)
 453:                 ^ (chunk_pos.z.to_bits() as u64)
 454:                 ^ 0xD57A_11ED,
 455:         );
 456: 
 457:         let maze_gen = GrowingTreeGenerator {
 458:             junction_density: config.tuning.junction_density,
 459:         };
 460:         maze_gen.generate(&mut abstract_grid, &mut rng);
 461: 
 462:         // Organic room segmentation
 463:         let mut rooms = Vec::new();
 464:         let mut room_grid = vec![None; cell_w * cell_d];
 465: 
 466:         // Tunable parameters
 467:         let num_room_attempts = 15;
 468:         for _ in 0..num_room_attempts {
 469:             let cx = rng.random_range(0..cell_w);
 470:             let cz = rng.random_range(0..cell_d);
 471:             let rw = rng.random_range(1..=3);
 472:             let rd = rng.random_range(1..=3);
 473: 
 474:             if cx + rw <= cell_w && cz + rd <= cell_d {
 475:                 let mut overlap = false;
 476:                 for i in 0..rw {
 477:                     for j in 0..rd {
 478:                         if room_grid[(cz + j) * cell_w + cx + i].is_some() {
 479:                             overlap = true;
 480:                         }
 481:                     }
 482:                 }
 483:                 if !overlap {
 484:                     let room_id = rooms.len();
 485:                     for i in 0..rw {
 486:                         for j in 0..rd {
 487:                             room_grid[(cz + j) * cell_w + cx + i] = Some(room_id);
 488:                             if let Some(cell) = abstract_grid.get_mut(cx + i, cz + j) {
 489:                                 if j > 0 {
 490:                                     cell.walls[0] = false;
 491:                                 }
 492:                                 if i < rw - 1 {
 493:                                     cell.walls[1] = false;
 494:                                 }
 495:                                 if j < rd - 1 {
 496:                                     cell.walls[2] = false;
 497:                                 }
 498:                                 if i > 0 {
 499:                                     cell.walls[3] = false;
 500:                                 }
 501:                             }
 502:                         }
 503:                     }
 504:                     rooms.push(Room {
 505:                         name: "Organic",
 506:                         x0: cell_border(cx),
 507:                         x1: cell_border(cx + rw) - 1,
 508:                         z0: cell_border(cz),
 509:                         z1: cell_border(cz + rd) - 1,
 510:                     });
 511:                 }
 512:             }
 513:         }
 514: 
 515:         // Hallway reservation (Part 1)
 516:         let mut non_room_indices = Vec::new();
 517:         for i in 0..(cell_w * cell_d) {
 518:             if room_grid[i].is_none() {
 519:                 non_room_indices.push(i);
 520:             }
 521:         }
 522: 
 523:         let target_corridors = (non_room_indices.len() as f32 * 0.20) as usize;
 524:         let mut corridor_count = 0;
 525: 
 526:         use rand::seq::SliceRandom;
 527:         non_room_indices.shuffle(&mut rng);
 528: 
 529:         for &idx in &non_room_indices {
 530:             if corridor_count >= target_corridors {
 531:                 break;
 532:             }
 533:             let cx = idx % cell_w;
 534:             let cz = idx / cell_w;
 535:             if abstract_grid.get(cx, cz).unwrap().is_corridor {
 536:                 continue;
 537:             }
 538: 
 539:             abstract_grid.get_mut(cx, cz).unwrap().is_corridor = true;
 540:             corridor_count += 1;
 541: 
 542:             // Extend North
 543:             let mut current_cz = cz;
 544:             while current_cz > 0 && !abstract_grid.get(cx, current_cz).unwrap().walls[0] {
 545:                 current_cz -= 1;
 546:                 if room_grid[current_cz * cell_w + cx].is_some()
 547:                     || abstract_grid.get(cx, current_cz).unwrap().is_corridor
 548:                 {
 549:                     break;
 550:                 }
 551:                 abstract_grid.get_mut(cx, current_cz).unwrap().is_corridor = true;
 552:                 corridor_count += 1;
 553:             }
 554:             // Extend South
 555:             let mut current_cz = cz;
 556:             while current_cz < cell_d - 1 && !abstract_grid.get(cx, current_cz).unwrap().walls[2] {
 557:                 current_cz += 1;
 558:                 if room_grid[current_cz * cell_w + cx].is_some()
 559:                     || abstract_grid.get(cx, current_cz).unwrap().is_corridor
 560:                 {
 561:                     break;
 562:                 }
 563:                 abstract_grid.get_mut(cx, current_cz).unwrap().is_corridor = true;
 564:                 corridor_count += 1;
 565:             }
 566:             // Extend West
 567:             let mut current_cx = cx;
 568:             while current_cx > 0 && !abstract_grid.get(current_cx, cz).unwrap().walls[3] {
 569:                 current_cx -= 1;
 570:                 if room_grid[cz * cell_w + current_cx].is_some()
 571:                     || abstract_grid.get(current_cx, cz).unwrap().is_corridor
 572:                 {
 573:                     break;
 574:                 }
 575:                 abstract_grid.get_mut(current_cx, cz).unwrap().is_corridor = true;
 576:                 corridor_count += 1;
 577:             }
 578:             // Extend East
 579:             let mut current_cx = cx;
 580:             while current_cx < cell_w - 1 && !abstract_grid.get(current_cx, cz).unwrap().walls[1] {
 581:                 current_cx += 1;
 582:                 if room_grid[cz * cell_w + current_cx].is_some()
 583:                     || abstract_grid.get(current_cx, cz).unwrap().is_corridor
 584:                 {
 585:                     break;
 586:                 }
 587:                 abstract_grid.get_mut(current_cx, cz).unwrap().is_corridor = true;
 588:                 corridor_count += 1;
 589:             }
 590:         }
 591: 
 592:         // Draw abstract grid to VoxelGrid
 593:         for cz in 0..cell_d {
 594:             for cx in 0..cell_w {
 595:                 let cell = abstract_grid.get(cx, cz).unwrap();
 596:                 let v_x0 = cell_border(cx);
 597:                 let v_z0 = cell_border(cz);
 598:                 let v_x1 = (cell_border(cx + 1) - 1).min(width - 1);
 599:                 let v_z1 = (cell_border(cz + 1) - 1).min(depth - 1);
 600: 
 601:                 use crate::domain::entities::cell::MicrobiomeZone;
 602:                 let cell_h_units = match cell.zone {
 603:                     MicrobiomeZone::Atrium => 12.0,
 604:                     MicrobiomeZone::Blackout => 3.2,
 605:                     _ => 4.0,
 606:                 };
 607:                 let wall_max_y = (cell_h_units / config.voxel_scale).ceil() as usize;
 608:                 let door_max_y = (2.5 / config.voxel_scale).ceil() as usize; // Doorways are 2.5 units tall
 609: 
 610:                 let wall_type = VOXEL_WALL;
 611: 
 612:                 // Floors and Ceilings
 613:                 for vx in v_x0..=v_x1 {
 614:                     for vz in v_z0..=v_z1 {
 615:                         grid.set(vx, 0, vz, VOXEL_FLOOR);
 616: 
 617:                         if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::Holes {
 618:                             if vx > v_x0 + 5 && vx < v_x1 - 5 && vz > v_z0 + 5 && vz < v_z1 - 5 {
 619:                                 if detail_rng.random_bool(0.05) {
 620:                                     grid.set(vx, 0, vz, VOXEL_AIR);
 621:                                 }
 622:                             }
 623:                         }
 624: 
 625:                         if cell.zone != MicrobiomeZone::Atrium {
 626:                             // Normal ceilings with hanging light
 627:                             grid.set(vx, wall_max_y, vz, VOXEL_CEILING); // Always close the ceiling
 628:                             if cell.zone != MicrobiomeZone::Blackout
 629:                                 && (vx % 10 == 0 && vz % 10 == 0)
 630:                             {
 631:                                 if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::RedRoom {
 632:                                     grid.set(
 633:                                         vx,
 634:                                         wall_max_y - 1,
 635:                                         vz,
 636:                                         crate::domain::entities::voxel_grid::VOXEL_RED_LIGHT,
 637:                                     );
 638:                                 } else {
 639:                                     grid.set(vx, wall_max_y - 1, vz, VOXEL_LIGHT);
 640:                                 }
 641:                             }
 642:                             for y in (wall_max_y + 1)..height {
 643:                                 grid.set(vx, y, vz, VOXEL_CEILING);
 644:                             }
 645:                         } else {
 646:                             // Atrium ceiling and bright hanging light
 647:                             grid.set(vx, wall_max_y, vz, VOXEL_CEILING);
 648:                             if vx % 10 == 0 && vz % 10 == 0 {
 649:                                 grid.set(vx, wall_max_y - 1, vz, VOXEL_LIGHT);
 650:                             }
 651:                         }
 652:                     }
 653:                 }
 654: 
 655:                 if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::PillarField {
 656:                     for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
 657:                         grid.set(v_x0, y, v_z0, wall_type);
 658:                         grid.set(v_x1, y, v_z0, wall_type);
 659:                         grid.set(v_x0, y, v_z1, wall_type);
 660:                         grid.set(v_x1, y, v_z1, wall_type);
 661:                         if detail_rng.random_bool(0.3) {
 662:                             grid.set((v_x0 + v_x1 + 1) / 2, y, (v_z0 + v_z1 + 1) / 2, wall_type);
 663:                         }
 664:                     }
 665:                     continue;
 666:                 }
 667: 
 668:                 // South Wall (z1)
 669:                 if cz < cell_d - 1 {
 670:                     let same_room = room_grid[cz * cell_w + cx]
 671:                         == room_grid[(cz + 1) * cell_w + cx]
 672:                         && room_grid[cz * cell_w + cx].is_some();
 673: 
 674:                     if !same_room {
 675:                         let width_choice = rng.random_range(0..100);
 676:                         let hole_units = if width_choice < 15 {
 677:                             1.2
 678:                         } else if width_choice < 85 {
 679:                             2.0
 680:                         } else {
 681:                             3.5
 682:                         };
 683:                         let hole_w = (hole_units / config.voxel_scale) as usize;
 684:                         // Drawn in centimetres of the 5.0-unit cell span, not
 685:                         // voxels, so every LOD picks the same door position.
 686:                         let hole_cm = (hole_units * 100.0) as u32;
 687:                         let max_offset_cm = 500u32.saturating_sub(hole_cm + 50);
 688:                         let offset_cm = if max_offset_cm > 50 {
 689:                             rng.random_range(50..max_offset_cm)
 690:                         } else {
 691:                             50
 692:                         };
 693:                         let offset = (offset_cm as f32 / 100.0 / config.voxel_scale) as usize;
 694:                         let hole_x0 = v_x0 + offset;
 695:                         let hole_x1 = hole_x0 + hole_w;
 696: 
 697:                         for vx in v_x0..=v_x1 {
 698:                             let in_hole = vx >= hole_x0 && vx < hole_x1;
 699:                             if cell.walls[2] || !in_hole {
 700:                                 for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
 701:                                     grid.set(vx, y, v_z1, wall_type);
 702:                                 }
 703:                             } else if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::Arch {
 704:                                 let dx =
 705:                                     (vx as isize - (hole_x0 + hole_w / 2) as isize).abs() as usize;
 706:                                 let arch_top = door_max_y;
 707:                                 let block_y = arch_top.saturating_sub(dx);
 708:                                 for y in block_y..=wall_max_y {
 709:                                     grid.set(vx, y, v_z1, wall_type);
 710:                                 }
 711:                             } else {
 712:                                 for y in door_max_y..=wall_max_y {
 713:                                     grid.set(vx, y, v_z1, wall_type);
 714:                                 }
 715:                             }
 716:                         }
 717:                     }
 718:                 } else if cz == cell_d - 1 {
 719:                     // Chunk boundary (force holes for connectivity)
 720:                     let hole_w = (2.0 / config.voxel_scale) as usize;
 721:                     let hole_x0 = (v_x0 + v_x1 + 1) / 2 - hole_w / 2;
 722:                     for vx in v_x0..=v_x1 {
 723:                         let is_hole = vx >= hole_x0 && vx < hole_x0 + hole_w;
 724:                         if !is_hole {
 725:                             for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
 726:                                 grid.set(vx, y, v_z1, wall_type);
 727:                             }
 728:                         } else if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::Arch {
 729:                             let dx = (vx as isize - (hole_x0 + hole_w / 2) as isize).abs() as usize;
 730:                             let arch_top = door_max_y;
 731:                             let block_y = arch_top.saturating_sub(dx);
 732:                             for y in block_y..=wall_max_y {
 733:                                 grid.set(vx, y, v_z1, wall_type);
 734:                             }
 735:                         } else {
 736:                             for y in door_max_y..=wall_max_y {
 737:                                 grid.set(vx, y, v_z1, wall_type);
 738:                             }
 739:                         }
 740:                     }
 741:                 }
 742: 
 743:                 // East Wall (x1)
 744:                 if cx < cell_w - 1 {
 745:                     let same_room = room_grid[cz * cell_w + cx] == room_grid[cz * cell_w + cx + 1]
 746:                         && room_grid[cz * cell_w + cx].is_some();
 747: 
 748:                     if !same_room {
 749:                         let width_choice = rng.random_range(0..100);
 750:                         let hole_units = if width_choice < 15 {
 751:                             1.2
 752:                         } else if width_choice < 85 {
 753:                             2.0
 754:                         } else {
 755:                             3.5
 756:                         };
 757:                         let hole_w = (hole_units / config.voxel_scale) as usize;
 758:                         // Centimetre draw, same reasoning as the south wall.
 759:                         let hole_cm = (hole_units * 100.0) as u32;
 760:                         let max_offset_cm = 500u32.saturating_sub(hole_cm + 50);
 761:                         let offset_cm = if max_offset_cm > 50 {
 762:                             rng.random_range(50..max_offset_cm)
 763:                         } else {
 764:                             50
 765:                         };
 766:                         let offset = (offset_cm as f32 / 100.0 / config.voxel_scale) as usize;
 767:                         let hole_z0 = v_z0 + offset;
 768:                         let hole_z1 = hole_z0 + hole_w;
 769: 
 770:                         for vz in v_z0..=v_z1 {
 771:                             let in_hole = vz >= hole_z0 && vz < hole_z1;
 772:                             if cell.walls[1] || !in_hole {
 773:                                 for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
 774:                                     grid.set(v_x1, y, vz, wall_type);
 775:                                 }
 776:                             } else if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::Arch {
 777:                                 let dz =
 778:                                     (vz as isize - (hole_z0 + hole_w / 2) as isize).abs() as usize;
 779:                                 let arch_top = door_max_y;
 780:                                 let block_y = arch_top.saturating_sub(dz);
 781:                                 for y in block_y..=wall_max_y {
 782:                                     grid.set(v_x1, y, vz, wall_type);
 783:                                 }
 784:                             } else {
 785:                                 for y in door_max_y..=wall_max_y {
 786:                                     grid.set(v_x1, y, vz, wall_type);
 787:                                 }
 788:                             }
 789:                         }
 790:                     }
 791:                 } else if cx == cell_w - 1 {
 792:                     let hole_w = (2.0 / config.voxel_scale) as usize;
 793:                     let hole_z0 = (v_z0 + v_z1 + 1) / 2 - hole_w / 2;
 794:                     for vz in v_z0..=v_z1 {
 795:                         let is_hole = vz >= hole_z0 && vz < hole_z0 + hole_w;
 796:                         if !is_hole {
 797:                             for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
 798:                                 grid.set(v_x1, y, vz, wall_type);
 799:                             }
 800:                         } else if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::Arch {
 801:                             let dz = (vz as isize - (hole_z0 + hole_w / 2) as isize).abs() as usize;
 802:                             let arch_top = door_max_y;
 803:                             let block_y = arch_top.saturating_sub(dz);
 804:                             for y in block_y..=wall_max_y {
 805:                                 grid.set(v_x1, y, vz, wall_type);
 806:                             }
 807:                         } else {
 808:                             for y in door_max_y..=wall_max_y {
 809:                                 grid.set(v_x1, y, vz, wall_type);
 810:                             }
 811:                         }
 812:                     }
 813:                 }
 814: 
 815:                 // Draw narrower corridors for 2+ consecutive runs
 816:                 let mut is_ns_hall = false;
 817:                 let mut is_ew_hall = false;
 818:                 if cell.is_corridor {
 819:                     let mut ns_run = 1;
 820:                     if !cell.walls[0]
 821:                         && cz > 0
 822:                         && abstract_grid.get(cx, cz - 1).unwrap().is_corridor
 823:                     {
 824:                         ns_run += 1;
 825:                     }
 826:                     if !cell.walls[2]
 827:                         && cz < cell_d - 1
 828:                         && abstract_grid.get(cx, cz + 1).unwrap().is_corridor
 829:                     {
 830:                         ns_run += 1;
 831:                     }
 832: 
 833:                     let mut ew_run = 1;
 834:                     if !cell.walls[1]
 835:                         && cx < cell_w - 1
 836:                         && abstract_grid.get(cx + 1, cz).unwrap().is_corridor
 837:                     {
 838:                         ew_run += 1;
 839:                     }
 840:                     if !cell.walls[3]
 841:                         && cx > 0
 842:                         && abstract_grid.get(cx - 1, cz).unwrap().is_corridor
 843:                     {
 844:                         ew_run += 1;
 845:                     }
 846: 
 847:                     if ns_run >= 2 {
 848:                         is_ns_hall = true;
 849:                     }
 850:                     if ew_run >= 2 {
 851:                         is_ew_hall = true;
 852:                     }
 853:                 }
 854: 
 855:                 if is_ns_hall && !is_ew_hall {
 856:                     let inset_x = ((v_x1 - v_x0 + 1).saturating_sub(26)) / 2;
 857:                     for vx in v_x0..=(v_x0 + inset_x) {
 858:                         for vz in v_z0..=v_z1 {
 859:                             for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
 860:                                 grid.set(vx, y, vz, wall_type);
 861:                             }
 862:                         }
 863:                     }
 864:                     for vx in (v_x1 - inset_x)..=v_x1 {
 865:                         for vz in v_z0..=v_z1 {
 866:                             for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
 867:                                 grid.set(vx, y, vz, wall_type);
 868:                             }
 869:                         }
 870:                     }
 871:                 } else if is_ew_hall && !is_ns_hall {
 872:                     let inset_z = ((v_z1 - v_z0 + 1).saturating_sub(26)) / 2;
 873:                     for vz in v_z0..=(v_z0 + inset_z) {
 874:                         for vx in v_x0..=v_x1 {
 875:                             for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
 876:                                 grid.set(vx, y, vz, wall_type);
 877:                             }
 878:                         }
 879:                     }
 880:                     for vz in (v_z1 - inset_z)..=v_z1 {
 881:                         for vx in v_x0..=v_x1 {
 882:                             for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
 883:                                 grid.set(vx, y, vz, wall_type);
 884:                             }
 885:                         }
 886:                     }
 887:                 } else if is_ns_hall && is_ew_hall {
 888:                     let inset_x = ((v_x1 - v_x0 + 1).saturating_sub(26)) / 2;
 889:                     let inset_z = ((v_z1 - v_z0 + 1).saturating_sub(26)) / 2;
 890:                     for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
 891:                         for vx in v_x0..=(v_x0 + inset_x) {
 892:                             for vz in v_z0..=(v_z0 + inset_z) {
 893:                                 grid.set(vx, y, vz, wall_type);
 894:                             }
 895:                         }
 896:                         for vx in (v_x1 - inset_x)..=v_x1 {
 897:                             for vz in v_z0..=(v_z0 + inset_z) {
 898:                                 grid.set(vx, y, vz, wall_type);
 899:                             }
 900:                         }
 901:                         for vx in v_x0..=(v_x0 + inset_x) {
 902:                             for vz in (v_z1 - inset_z)..=v_z1 {
 903:                                 grid.set(vx, y, vz, wall_type);
 904:                             }
 905:                         }
 906:                         for vx in (v_x1 - inset_x)..=v_x1 {
 907:                             for vz in (v_z1 - inset_z)..=v_z1 {
 908:                                 grid.set(vx, y, vz, wall_type);
 909:                             }
 910:                         }
 911:                     }
 912:                 }
 913:             }
 914:         }
 915: 
 916:         // Chunk Boundaries (North and West)
 917:         for cz in 0..cell_d {
 918:             let cell = abstract_grid.get(0, cz).unwrap();
 919:             use crate::domain::entities::cell::MicrobiomeZone;
 920:             let cell_h_units = match cell.zone {
 921:                 MicrobiomeZone::Atrium => 12.0,
 922:                 MicrobiomeZone::Blackout => 3.2,
 923:                 _ => 4.0,
 924:             };
 925:             let wall_max_y = (cell_h_units / config.voxel_scale).ceil() as usize;
 926:             let door_max_y = (2.5 / config.voxel_scale).ceil() as usize;
 927:             let wall_type = if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::RedRoom {
 928:                 VOXEL_RED_WALL
 929:             } else {
 930:                 VOXEL_WALL
 931:             };
 932: 
 933:             if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::PillarField {
 934:                 continue;
 935:             }
 936: 
 937:             let v_z0 = cell_border(cz);
 938:             let v_z1 = (cell_border(cz + 1) - 1).min(depth - 1);
 939:             let hole_w = (2.0 / config.voxel_scale) as usize;
 940:             let hole_z0 = (v_z0 + v_z1 + 1) / 2 - hole_w / 2;
 941:             for vz in v_z0..=v_z1 {
 942:                 let is_hole = vz >= hole_z0 && vz < hole_z0 + hole_w;
 943:                 if !is_hole {
 944:                     for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
 945:                         grid.set(0, y, vz, wall_type);
 946:                     }
 947:                 } else if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::Arch {
 948:                     let dz = (vz as isize - (hole_z0 + hole_w / 2) as isize).abs() as usize;
 949:                     let arch_top = door_max_y;
 950:                     let block_y = arch_top.saturating_sub(dz);
 951:                     for y in block_y..=wall_max_y {
 952:                         grid.set(0, y, vz, wall_type);
 953:                     }
 954:                 } else {
 955:                     for y in door_max_y..=wall_max_y {
 956:                         grid.set(0, y, vz, wall_type);
 957:                     }
 958:                 }
 959:             }
 960:         }
 961:         for cx in 0..cell_w {
 962:             let cell = abstract_grid.get(cx, 0).unwrap();
 963:             use crate::domain::entities::cell::MicrobiomeZone;
 964:             let cell_h_units = match cell.zone {
 965:                 MicrobiomeZone::Atrium => 12.0,
 966:                 MicrobiomeZone::Blackout => 3.2,
 967:                 _ => 4.0,
 968:             };
 969:             let wall_max_y = (cell_h_units / config.voxel_scale).ceil() as usize;
 970:             let door_max_y = (2.5 / config.voxel_scale).ceil() as usize;
 971:             let wall_type = if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::RedRoom {
 972:                 VOXEL_RED_WALL
 973:             } else {
 974:                 VOXEL_WALL
 975:             };
 976: 
 977:             if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::PillarField {
 978:                 continue;
 979:             }
 980: 
 981:             let v_x0 = cell_border(cx);
 982:             let v_x1 = (cell_border(cx + 1) - 1).min(width - 1);
 983:             let hole_w = (2.0 / config.voxel_scale) as usize;
 984:             let hole_x0 = (v_x0 + v_x1 + 1) / 2 - hole_w / 2;
 985:             for vx in v_x0..=v_x1 {
 986:                 let is_hole = vx >= hole_x0 && vx < hole_x0 + hole_w;
 987:                 if !is_hole {
 988:                     for y in 1..=wall_max_y {
 989:                         grid.set(vx, y, 0, wall_type);
 990:                     }
 991:                 } else if cell.zone == MicrobiomeZone::Arch {
 992:                     let dx = (vx as isize - (hole_x0 + hole_w / 2) as isize).abs() as usize;
 993:                     let arch_top = door_max_y;
 994:                     let block_y = arch_top.saturating_sub(dx);
 995:                     for y in block_y..=wall_max_y {
 996:                         grid.set(vx, y, 0, wall_type);
 997:                     }
 998:                 } else {
 999:                     for y in door_max_y..=wall_max_y {
1000:                         grid.set(vx, y, 0, wall_type);
1001:                     }
1002:                 }
1003:             }
1004:         }
1005: 
1006:         // Apply Room Stamps to generated rooms
1007:         let stamps = vec![
1008:             RoomStamp::cubicles(),
1009:             RoomStamp::showroom(),
1010:             RoomStamp::waiting(),
1011:             RoomStamp::storage(),
1012:             RoomStamp::lounge(),
1013:             RoomStamp::server_room(),
1014:             RoomStamp::cafeteria(),
1015:             RoomStamp::maintenance(),
1016:         ];
1017: 
1018:         for room in &rooms {
1019:             let mut possible_stamps = Vec::new();
1020:             for stamp in &stamps {
1021:                 let max_stamps_w = (room.x1 - room.x0) / stamp.width.max(1);
1022:                 let max_stamps_d = (room.z1 - room.z0) / stamp.depth.max(1);
1023:                 if max_stamps_w > 0 && max_stamps_d > 0 {
1024:                     possible_stamps.push(stamp);
1025:                 }
1026:             }
1027:             // Both rolls happen whether or not a stamp fits: which stamps fit
1028:             // depends on voxel resolution, and skipping draws would
1029:             // desynchronize the structural RNG between LODs of the chunk.
1030:             let stamp_roll = rng.random_range(0..usize::MAX);
1031:             let stairs_roll = rng.random_bool(0.15 * (config.tuning.stairs_density as f64));
1032:             if !possible_stamps.is_empty() {
1033:                 let mut stamp = possible_stamps[stamp_roll % possible_stamps.len()];
1034: 
1035:                 // Low-frequency stairs chance override
1036:                 let stairway = RoomStamp::stairway();
1037:                 if stairs_roll {
1038:                     stamp = &stairway;
1039:                 }
1040: 
1041:                 let spacing = (6.0 * (config.voxel_scale / 0.1)) as usize;
1042:                 let mut start_x = room.x0 + spacing;
1043:                 while start_x + stamp.width <= room.x1.saturating_sub(spacing) {
1044:                     let mut start_z = room.z0 + spacing;
1045:                     while start_z + stamp.depth <= room.z1.saturating_sub(spacing) {
1046:                         if self.validate_stamp_placement(&grid, room, stamp, start_x, start_z) {
1047:                             self.place_stamp(&mut grid, stamp, start_x, start_z);
1048:                         }
1049:                         start_z += stamp.depth + spacing;
1050:                     }
1051:                     start_x += stamp.width + spacing;
1052:                 }
1053:             }
1054: 
1055:             // Basic room lighting
1056:             let cx = (room.x0 + room.x1) / 2;
1057:             let is_strip = rng.random_bool(0.3); // 30% chance for strip lights
1058:             let mut z = room.z0 + 8;
1059: 
1060:             while z <= room.z1.saturating_sub(8) {
1061:                 if is_strip {
1062:                     for offset in 0..4 {
1063:                         if z + offset <= room.z1 {
1064:                             grid.set(cx, height - 1, z + offset, VOXEL_LIGHT);
1065:                         }
1066:                     }
1067:                 } else {
1068:                     grid.set(cx, height - 1, z, VOXEL_LIGHT);
1069:                 }
1070:                 z += 12;
1071:             }
1072:         }
1073: 
1074:         // Basic corridor lighting
1075:         for cz in (8..depth).step_by(16) {
1076:             for cx in (8..width).step_by(16) {
1077:                 if grid.get(cx, height - 1, cz) == VOXEL_CEILING && grid.get(cx, 1, cz) == VOXEL_AIR
1078:                 {
1079:                     grid.set(cx, height - 1, cz, VOXEL_LIGHT);
1080:                 }
1081:             }
1082:         }
1083: 
1084:         // ==========================================
1085:         // LIGHTING PROPAGATION (BFS Flood fill only)
1086:         // ==========================================
1087:         crate::domain::use_cases::calculate_lighting::calculate_voxel_lighting(&mut grid);
1088: 
1089:         // Bake directional face occlusion
1090:         crate::domain::use_cases::path_tracer::bake_face_occlusion(&mut grid);
1091: 
1092:         let elapsed_micros = self.telemetry.now_micros().saturating_sub(start_micros);
1093:         self.telemetry.log(&format!(
1094:             "[TELEMETRY] execute completed. Duration={}us, OutputVoxelGridSize={}x{}x{}",
1095:             elapsed_micros,
1096:             grid.width(),
1097:             grid.height(),
1098:             grid.depth()
1099:         ));
1100: 
1101:         grid
1102:     }
1103: 
1104:     fn validate_stamp_placement(
1105:         &self,
1106:         grid: &VoxelGrid,
1107:         room: &Room,
1108:         stamp: &RoomStamp,
1109:         start_x: usize,
1110:         start_z: usize,
1111:     ) -> bool {
1112:         if start_x < room.x0
1113:             || start_x + stamp.width > room.x1
1114:             || start_z < room.z0
1115:             || start_z + stamp.depth > room.z1
1116:         {
1117:             return false;
1118:         }
1119: 
1120:         for lz in 0..stamp.depth {
1121:             for lx in 0..stamp.width {
1122:                 let vx = start_x + lx;
1123:                 let vz = start_z + lz;
1124:                 if stamp.data[lz * stamp.width + lx] > 0 {
1125:                     if grid.get(vx, 1, vz) != VOXEL_AIR && grid.get(vx, 1, vz) != VOXEL_FLOOR {
1126:                         return false;
1127:                     }
1128:                 }
1129:             }
1130:         }
1131: 
1132:         true
1133:     }
1134: 
1135:     fn place_stamp(&self, grid: &mut VoxelGrid, stamp: &RoomStamp, start_x: usize, start_z: usize) {
1136:         let max_y = grid.height() - 2;
1137:         for sz in 0..stamp.depth {
1138:             for sx in 0..stamp.width {
1139:                 let val = stamp.data[sz * stamp.width + sx];
1140:                 let vx = start_x + sx;
1141:                 let vz = start_z + sz;
1142:                 if val == 1 {
1143:                     for y in 1..=3 {
1144:                         grid.set(vx, y, vz, VOXEL_WALL);
1145:                     }
1146:                 } else if val == 2 {
1147:                     for y in 1..=max_y {
1148:                         grid.set(vx, y, vz, VOXEL_WALL);
1149:                     }
1150:                 } else if val == 3 {
1151:                     for y in 1..=1 {
1152:                         grid.set(vx, y, vz, VOXEL_WALL);
1153:                     }
1154:                 } else if val == 4 {
1155:                     // Raised floor
1156:                     grid.set(vx, 1, vz, VOXEL_FLOOR);
1157:                     grid.set(vx, 2, vz, VOXEL_FLOOR);
1158:                 } else if val == 5 {
1159:                     // Step 1
1160:                     grid.set(vx, 1, vz, VOXEL_FLOOR);
1161:                 } else if val == 6 { // Step 2
1162:                     // Just floor, already set
1163:                 }
1164:             }
1165:         }
1166:     }
1167: }

1202:     #[test]
1203:     fn coarse_chunk_generates_the_same_layout_smaller() {
1204:         let noise = MockNoiseProvider { value: 0.0 };
1205:         let generator = GenerateChunkArchitectureUseCase::new(&noise);
1206:         let fine = generator.execute(
1207:             Position::new(10.0, 10.0),
1208:             42,
1209:             GeneratorConfig::low_spec().with_level(1),
1210:         );
1211:         let coarse = generator.execute(
1212:             Position::new(10.0, 10.0),
1213:             42,
1214:             GeneratorConfig::low_spec().with_level(1).at_lod(1),
1215:         );
1216:         assert_eq!(coarse.width() * 2, fine.width());
1217:         assert_eq!(coarse.depth() * 2, fine.depth());
1218:         // Same maze at half resolution. Cell sizes truncate differently per
1219:         // scale (5.0/0.4 = 12 voxels vs 25 at fine), so wall planes may land
1220:         // one fine voxel off; an LOD proxy only needs walls to line up to
1221:         // within that tolerance.
1222:         let wall = crate::domain::entities::voxel_grid::VOXEL_WALL;
1223:         let mut wall_match = 0usize;
1224:         let mut wall_total = 0usize;
1225:         for z in 0..coarse.depth() {
1226:             for x in 0..coarse.width() {
1227:                 if coarse.get(x, 1, z) != wall {
1228:                     continue;
1229:                 }
1230:                 wall_total += 1;
1231:                 let (fx, fz) = (x * 2, z * 2);
1232:                 let mut near = false;
1233:                 for dz in -1i32..=2 {
1234:                     for dx in -1i32..=2 {
1235:                         let (sx, sz) = (fx as i32 + dx, fz as i32 + dz);
1236:                         if sx >= 0
1237:                             && sz >= 0
1238:                             && (sx as usize) < fine.width()
1239:                             && (sz as usize) < fine.depth()
1240:                             && fine.get(sx as usize, 1, sz as usize) == wall
1241:                         {
1242:                             near = true;
1243:                         }
1244:                     }
1245:                 }
1246:                 if near {
1247:                     wall_match += 1;
1248:                 }
1249:             }
1250:         }
1251:         assert!(wall_total > 0, "coarse chunk must still contain walls");
1252:         assert!(
1253:             wall_match * 10 >= wall_total * 9,
1254:             "coarse walls should lie within one fine voxel of fine walls: {wall_match}/{wall_total}"
1255:         );
1256:     }

1385:     #[test]
1386:     fn test_microbiome_zones_generation_and_contiguous() {
1387:         use crate::domain::entities::cell::MicrobiomeZone;
1388:         use crate::frameworks_drivers::simple_noise::SimpleNoiseProvider;
1389: 
1390:         let noise = SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
1391:         let config = GeneratorConfig::high_spec().with_level(1);
1392:         let chunk_size = config.chunk_size;
1393:         let mut zones = std::collections::HashSet::new();
1394: 
1395:         let seed = 42;
1396:         let mut grid_zones = vec![MicrobiomeZone::Standard; 100];
1397: 
1398:         for cz in 0..10 {
1399:             for cx in 0..10 {
1400:                 let wx = 10.0 * chunk_size + (cx as f32) * 5.0;
1401:                 let wz = 10.0 * chunk_size + (cz as f32) * 5.0;
1402:                 let n = noise.evaluate_2d(
1403:                     seed ^ 0x2b8f_a43c,
1404:                     crate::entities::models::Position::new(wx * 0.05, wz * 0.05),
1405:                 );
1406: 
1407:                 let zone = if n < -0.7 {
1408:                     MicrobiomeZone::Blackout
1409:                 } else if n < -0.4 {
1410:                     MicrobiomeZone::Holes
1411:                 } else if n > 0.85 - (config.tuning.atria as f32 * 0.1) {
1412:                     MicrobiomeZone::Atrium
1413:                 } else if n > 0.6 {
1414:                     MicrobiomeZone::PillarField
1415:                 } else if n > 0.4 {
1416:                     MicrobiomeZone::Arch
1417:                 } else if n > 0.2 && n < 0.25 {
1418:                     MicrobiomeZone::RedRoom
1419:                 } else {
1420:                     MicrobiomeZone::Standard
1421:                 };
1422: 
1423:                 zones.insert(zone);
1424:                 grid_zones[cz * 10 + cx] = zone;
1425:             }
1426:         }
1427: 
1428:         assert!(zones.len() >= 2, "Expected at least 2 distinct zones");
1429: 
1430:         let mut same_neighbor_count = 0;
1431:         let mut total_neighbors = 0;
1432:         for cz in 1..9 {
1433:             for cx in 1..9 {
1434:                 let z = grid_zones[cz * 10 + cx];
1435:                 total_neighbors += 4;
1436:                 if grid_zones[(cz - 1) * 10 + cx] == z {
1437:                     same_neighbor_count += 1;
1438:                 }
1439:                 if grid_zones[(cz + 1) * 10 + cx] == z {
1440:                     same_neighbor_count += 1;
1441:                 }
1442:                 if grid_zones[cz * 10 + cx - 1] == z {
1443:                     same_neighbor_count += 1;
1444:                 }
1445:                 if grid_zones[cz * 10 + cx + 1] == z {
1446:                     same_neighbor_count += 1;
1447:                 }
1448:             }
1449:         }
1450: 
1451:         assert!(
1452:             same_neighbor_count as f32 / total_neighbors as f32 > 0.6,
1453:             "Expected zones to be highly contiguous"
1454:         );
1455:     }

299: /// A fully prepared chunk as the application consumes it.
300: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
301: pub struct ChunkPayload {
302:     /// Root node index local to this chunk's `nodes` array.
303:     pub root: u32,
304:     /// GPU-serialized SVO nodes (row-padded, 4 u32 per node).
305:     pub nodes: Vec<u32>,
306:     /// Side length of the SVO cube in world units.
307:     pub world_size: f32,
308:     /// Greedy surface mesh used by the default raster path.
309:     pub surface: SurfaceMeshPayload,
310:     /// Solid-voxel bounding boxes in world space, for player collision.
311:     pub collision: Vec<Aabb>,
312:     /// Semantic threshold planes derived by the same generation snapshot as
313:     /// the voxel grid. The engine folds crossings into the next reality.
314:     pub traversal_gates: Vec<TraversalGate>,
315:     /// Authored floor openings with deterministic recovery destinations.
316:     pub pit_hazards: Vec<PitHazard>,
317: }

319: /// One background chunk-load order, echoed back verbatim with its result so
320: /// the engine can reject stale work (wrong level, chunk no longer desired,
321: /// or already refined past this LOD).
322: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
323: pub struct ChunkRequest {
324:     /// Monotonic identity assigned by the engine. A completion may only
325:     /// clear the pending entry carrying this exact id; this prevents a late
326:     /// result from an evicted/re-requested chunk from cancelling newer work.
327:     pub request_id: u32,
328:     pub origin_x: f32,
329:     pub origin_z: f32,
330:     pub level: u32,
331:     pub lod: u8,
332:     /// Immutable encounter state used to generate this chunk. It is part of
333:     /// request identity, not ambient worker state.
334:     pub reality: RealitySnapshot,
335: }
336: 
337: impl ChunkRequest {
338:     /// Exact identity check for asynchronous completion validation. Origins
339:     /// compare by bits so this remains an identity operation rather than an
340:     /// approximate spatial comparison.
341:     pub fn is_same_request(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
342:         self.request_id == other.request_id
343:             && self.origin_x.to_bits() == other.origin_x.to_bits()
344:             && self.origin_z.to_bits() == other.origin_z.to_bits()
345:             && self.level == other.level
346:             && self.lod == other.lod
347:             && self.reality == other.reality
348:     }
349: }
350: 
351: /// A finished background load.
352: #[derive(Debug)]
353: pub struct CompletedChunk {
354:     pub request: ChunkRequest,
355:     pub payload: ChunkPayload,
356: }
357: 
358: /// Abstraction over where chunks come from. The browser build implements
359: /// this with in-wasm procedural generation (`adapters::local_chunk_source`)
360: /// or a Web Worker pool (`drivers::worker_source`); a networked build could
361: /// implement it with HTTP fetches instead.
362: pub trait ChunkSourcePort {
363:     /// Loads the chunk at `origin` for the given Backrooms level
364:     /// (0 = backrooms, 34 = grassland; see the core's `level_generator`).
365:     ///
366:     /// `lod` selects the level of detail: 0 is full resolution and each
367:     /// step doubles the voxel size, costing ~1/8 as much to produce. Any
368:     /// LOD of a chunk covers the same world cube (`world_size` invariant),
369:     /// so payloads are interchangeable to the renderer.
370:     fn load(&self, origin_x: f32, origin_z: f32, level: u32, lod: u8) -> ChunkPayload;
371: 
372:     /// Loads against an explicit immutable reality snapshot. Stateless
373:     /// sources retain source compatibility through the default implementation;
374:     /// procedural sources override this and route the snapshot into generation.
375:     fn load_with_reality(
376:         &self,
377:         origin_x: f32,
378:         origin_z: f32,
379:         level: u32,
380:         lod: u8,
381:         reality: &RealitySnapshot,
382:     ) -> ChunkPayload {
383:         let _ = reality;
384:         self.load(origin_x, origin_z, level, lod)
385:     }
386: 
387:     /// True when the source generates in the background. The engine then
388:     /// drives it with [`Self::request`]/[`Self::poll_completed`] instead of
389:     /// the blocking [`Self::load`], keeping the frame loop responsive.
390:     fn is_async(&self) -> bool {
391:         false
392:     }
393: 
394:     /// Queues a background load. Deduplication is the caller's concern.
395:     fn request(&mut self, _request: ChunkRequest) {}
396: 
397:     /// Takes every finished background load. Results may arrive in any
398:     /// order and may be stale; the caller validates against its own state.
399:     fn poll_completed(&mut self) -> Vec<CompletedChunk> {
400:         Vec::new()
401:     }
402: }

  97: /// Adaptive internal-resolution governor. Low-spec machines get fewer rays
  98: /// per frame by rendering at a reduced backing-store resolution; the driver
  99: /// applies the scale to the canvas. Hysteresis + cooldown prevent flapping.
 100: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
 101: pub struct PerfGovernor {
 102:     ema_frame_ms: f32,
 103:     scale: f32,
 104:     cooldown_frames: u32,
 105:     /// Frames since the last scale-up attempt (saturating).
 106:     frames_since_raise: u32,
 107:     /// While positive, scale-ups are locked out because a recent raise
 108:     /// immediately overloaded the GPU and had to be reverted (anti-flap).
 109:     raise_lockout_frames: u32,
 110: }
 111: 
 112: impl PerfGovernor {
 113:     const SCALES: [f32; 4] = [0.5, 0.65, 0.8, 1.0];
 114:     /// A drop this soon after a raise counts as a failed raise.
 115:     const RAISE_PROBE_FRAMES: u32 = 600;
 116:     /// How long a failed raise blocks further raise attempts (~1 min).
 117:     const RAISE_LOCKOUT_FRAMES: u32 = 3600;
 118: 
 119:     pub fn new() -> Self {
 120:         Self {
 121:             ema_frame_ms: 16.0,
 122:             scale: 0.8,
 123:             cooldown_frames: 0,
 124:             frames_since_raise: u32::MAX,
 125:             raise_lockout_frames: 0,
 126:         }
 127:     }
 128: 
 129:     pub fn scale(&self) -> f32 {
 130:         self.scale
 131:     }
 132: 
 133:     pub fn update(&mut self, frame_ms: f32) {
 134:         self.ema_frame_ms = self.ema_frame_ms * 0.95 + frame_ms.clamp(0.0, 100.0) * 0.05;
 135:         self.frames_since_raise = self.frames_since_raise.saturating_add(1);
 136:         self.raise_lockout_frames = self.raise_lockout_frames.saturating_sub(1);
 137:         if self.cooldown_frames > 0 {
 138:             self.cooldown_frames -= 1;
 139:             return;
 140:         }
 141:         let idx = Self::SCALES
 142:             .iter()
 143:             .position(|&s| s == self.scale)
 144:             .unwrap_or(2);
 145:         if self.ema_frame_ms > 33.0 && idx > 0 {
 146:             // Sustained under ~30 fps: drop one resolution step. If this
 147:             // happens right after a raise, the raise failed — lock raises
 148:             // out for a while so the scale doesn't oscillate.
 149:             if self.frames_since_raise < Self::RAISE_PROBE_FRAMES {
 150:                 self.raise_lockout_frames = Self::RAISE_LOCKOUT_FRAMES;
 151:             }
 152:             self.scale = Self::SCALES[idx - 1];
 153:             self.cooldown_frames = 120;
 154:         } else if self.ema_frame_ms < 17.5
 155:             && idx + 1 < Self::SCALES.len()
 156:             && self.raise_lockout_frames == 0
 157:         {
 158:             // Holding 60Hz vsync (rAF EMA floors at ~16.7 ms, so a lower
 159:             // threshold would never fire): probe one resolution step up.
 160:             self.scale = Self::SCALES[idx + 1];
 161:             self.cooldown_frames = 240;
 162:             self.frames_since_raise = 0;
 163:         }
 164:     }
 165: }

 167: /// The single coarse LOD used for progressive availability: every missing
 168: /// chunk is first loaded at this LOD (voxels 2x the size, ~1/8 the cost) so

 170: const COARSE_LOD: u8 = 1;
 171: /// Budget units one fine load costs; a coarse load costs 1. Coarse generation
 172: /// touches ~1/8 the voxels but has fixed per-chunk overhead, so 4 (not 8)
 173: /// keeps the worst-case tick cost at the old two-fine-loads level.

 266: impl Engine {
 267:     pub fn new(

 289:             },
