 291:             pool: AtlasPool::new(),
 292:             world: CollisionWorld::new(),
 293:             draws: Vec::new(),
 294:             atlas_nodes: 0,
 295:             governor: PerfGovernor::new(),
 296:             renderer,
 297:             source,
 298:             pending: HashMap::new(),
 299:             completed_backlog: Vec::new(),
 300:             next_request_id: 1,
 301:             reality: RealitySnapshot::default(),
 302:             forced_reloads: HashSet::new(),
 303:             last_safe_position: config.spawn,
 304:             level: config.initial_level,
 305:             push_seconds: 0.0,
 306:             noclip_cooldown: 0.0,
 307:             rng: (config.seed as u64).wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15) | 1,
 308:             flares: Vec::new(),
 309:             flare_sequence: 0,
 310:             distance_m: 0.0,
 311:             time_seconds: 0.0,
 312:             config,
 313:         }
 314:     }
 315: 
 316:     fn rng_next01(&mut self) -> f32 {
 317:         self.rng ^= self.rng << 13;
 318:         self.rng ^= self.rng >> 7;
 319:         self.rng ^= self.rng << 17;
 320:         (self.rng >> 40) as f32 / (1u64 << 24) as f32
 321:     }
 322: 
 323:     /// Backrooms lore made mechanical: holding a walk into solid wall long
 324:     /// enough occasionally phases the player through reality.
 325:     fn update_noclip(&mut self, dt: f32, input: &InputFrame, old_pos: [f32; 3]) {
 326:         self.noclip_cooldown = (self.noclip_cooldown - dt).max(0.0);
 327: 
 328:         let i = input.intent;
 329:         let pushing = input.locked && (i.forward || i.backward || i.left || i.right);
 330:         let dx = self.player.position[0] - old_pos[0];
 331:         let dz = self.player.position[2] - old_pos[2];
 332:         let pinned = pushing && (dx * dx + dz * dz) < 0.002 * 0.002;
 333: 
 334:         if !pinned {
 335:             self.push_seconds = 0.0;
 336:             return;
 337:         }
 338:         self.push_seconds += dt;
 339:         if self.push_seconds < NOCLIP_PUSH_SECONDS || self.noclip_cooldown > 0.0 {
 340:             return;
 341:         }
 342:         self.noclip_cooldown = 1.0;
 343:         if self.rng_next01() < NOCLIP_CHANCE {
 344:             self.noclip();
 345:         }
 346:     }
 347: 
 348:     /// Phase between Level 0 and the grassland: drop every resident chunk so
 349:     /// the streamer rebuilds the world from the new level's generator.
 350:     fn noclip(&mut self) {
 351:         self.level = if self.level == LEVEL_BACKROOMS {
 352:             LEVEL_GRASSLAND
 353:         } else {
 354:             LEVEL_BACKROOMS
 355:         };
 356:         self.store.retain_keys(&[]);
 357:         // In-flight loads are for the old level; their completions will be
 358:         // rejected by the level check, and clearing pending lets the new
 359:         // level re-request the same keys immediately.
 360:         self.pending.clear();
 361:         self.completed_backlog.clear();
 362:         self.forced_reloads.clear();
 363:         // The whole world is regenerated: drop the pool so the next stream
 364:         // pass relayouts and re-uploads from scratch.
 365:         self.pool = AtlasPool::new();
 366:         self.renderer.clear_surfaces();
 367:         self.world.rebuild([].iter());
 368:         self.draws.clear();
 369:         self.push_seconds = 0.0;
 370:         // Flares are world objects of the level they were lit in.
 371:         self.flares.clear();
 372:         // Into the grassland you phase in place; the way back drops you at
 373:         // the spawn clearing so you can't rematerialize inside a wall.
 374:         if self.level == LEVEL_BACKROOMS {
 375:             self.player.relocate(self.config.spawn);
 376:         }
 377:         self.last_safe_position = self.player.position;
 378:     }
 379: 
 380:     /// The active Backrooms level id.
 381:     pub fn level(&self) -> u32 {
 382:         self.level
 383:     }
 384: 
 385:     /// Per-level atmosphere shared by every renderer: the grassland is an
 386:     /// open daylight plane, everything else keeps the interior palette.
 387:     pub fn environment(&self) -> Environment {
 388:         if self.level == LEVEL_GRASSLAND {
 389:             Environment::daylight()
 390:         } else {
 391:             Environment::interior()
 392:         }
 393:     }
 394: 
 395:     /// Immutable encounter-state snapshot currently used to key generation.
 396:     /// A later traversal layer will own safe snapshot transitions; exposing
 397:     /// the current value here does not itself mutate or remap the world.
 398:     pub fn reality_snapshot(&self) -> &RealitySnapshot {
 399:         &self.reality
 400:     }
 401: 
 402:     /// Advances the simulation one frame and issues the draw.
 403:     pub fn tick(&mut self, dt_seconds: f32, input: &InputFrame) {
 404:         // Clamp dt so a background-tab hitch can't teleport the player.
 405:         let dt = dt_seconds.clamp(0.0, 0.1);
 406:         self.governor.update(dt_seconds * 1000.0);
 407:         self.time_seconds += dt as f64;
 408: 
 409:         let old_pos = self.player.position;
 410:         if input.locked {
 411:             self.player.apply_look(input.look_dx, input.look_dy);
 412:             self.player.step(dt, &input.intent, &self.world);
 413: 
 414:             // Pedometer: measured here — immediately after the one
 415:             // collision-resolved integration step — so relocations that
 416:             // happen later in the tick (pit recovery, noclip, red-loop
 417:             // handling) and out-of-band teleports can never inflate it.
 418:             // Look input contributes nothing: only position deltas count.
 419:             let dx = self.player.position[0] - old_pos[0];
 420:             let dz = self.player.position[2] - old_pos[2];
 421:             let step = (dx * dx + dz * dz).sqrt();
 422:             // Anything faster than sprint speed in one frame is a
 423:             // discontinuity, not walking.
 424:             if step < 1.0 {
 425:                 self.distance_m += step as f64;
 426:             }
 427:         }
 428:         self.update_flares(dt, input);
 429:         self.update_anomalies(old_pos);
 430:         self.update_noclip(dt, input, old_pos);
 431: 
 432:         self.stream_chunks();
 433: 
 434:         // Front-to-back chunk order: the shader marches chunks nearest-first
 435:         // and its per-pixel insertion sort degenerates to a single linear
 436:         // pass when the uniform table is already sorted by camera distance.
 437:         let cam = self.player.position;
 438:         self.draws.sort_by(|a, b| {
 439:             let d2 = |c: &ChunkDraw| {
 440:                 let h = c.world_size * 0.5;
 441:                 let dx = c.origin[0] + h - cam[0];
 442:                 let dy = c.origin[1] + h - cam[1];
 443:                 let dz = c.origin[2] + h - cam[2];
 444:                 dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz
 445:             };
 446:             d2(a).total_cmp(&d2(b))
 447:         });
 448: 
 449:         let frame = FrameParams {
 450:             camera_pos: self.player.position,
 451:             yaw: self.player.yaw,
 452:             pitch: self.player.pitch,
 453:             flashlight: input.flashlight,
 454:             dynamic_lights: self.flare_lights(),
 455:             dynamic_light_count: self.flare_light_count(),
 456:             environment: self.environment(),
 457:         };
 458:         self.renderer.draw(&frame, &self.draws);
 459:     }
 460: 
 461:     /// Ages, caps, and drops flares. Placement prefers a spot slightly ahead
 462:     /// of the player's feet but never inside solid geometry; the fallback is
 463:     /// the player's own (guaranteed valid) position.
 464:     fn update_flares(&mut self, dt: f32, input: &InputFrame) {
 465:         for flare in &mut self.flares {
 466:             flare.age_seconds += dt;
 467:         }
 468:         self.flares
 469:             .retain(|flare| flare.age_seconds < FLARE_LIFETIME_S);
 470: 
 471:         if !(input.drop_flare && input.locked) {
 472:             return;
 473:         }
 474:         let fwd = self.player.forward();
 475:         let eye = self.player.position;
 476:         let ahead = [eye[0] + fwd[0] * 0.9, eye[1], eye[2] + fwd[2] * 0.9];
 477:         let spot = if self.world.collides(ahead) {
 478:             eye
 479:         } else {
 480:             ahead
 481:         };
 482:         if self.flares.len() >= FLARE_CAP {
 483:             // Oldest first by construction; no count UI, no modal — the
 484:             // oldest flare simply retires.
 485:             self.flares.remove(0);
 486:         }
 487:         self.flare_sequence += 1;
 488:         self.flares.push(Flare {
 489:             position: [spot[0], FLARE_HEIGHT, spot[2]],
 490:             age_seconds: 0.0,
 491:             sequence: self.flare_sequence,
 492:         });
 493:     }
 494: 
 495:     /// A regenerated chunk may lawfully differ (wake remaps beyond the
 496:     /// eviction ring). A flare standing where new geometry now stands would
 497:     /// desynchronize render and collision, so the deterministic policy is:
 498:     /// remaps never move a flare through a wall — a buried flare is
 499:     /// extinguished the moment the world around it becomes solid.
 500:     fn extinguish_buried_flares(&mut self) {
 501:         if self.flares.is_empty() {
 502:             return;
 503:         }
 504:         let world = &self.world;
 505:         self.flares.retain(|flare| {
 506:             let probe = [
 507:                 flare.position[0],
 508:                 flare.position[1] + 0.2,
 509:                 flare.position[2],
 510:             ];
 511:             !world.boxes().iter().any(|b| Self::point_in_aabb(probe, b))
 512:         });
 513:     }
 514: 
 515:     fn point_in_aabb(p: [f32; 3], b: &crate::application::collision::Aabb) -> bool {
 516:         p[0] >= b.min[0]
 517:             && p[0] <= b.max[0]
 518:             && p[1] >= b.min[1]
 519:             && p[1] <= b.max[1]
 520:             && p[2] >= b.min[2]
 521:             && p[2] <= b.max[2]
 522:     }
 523: 
 524:     /// The nearest active flares as per-frame dynamic lights, distance
 525:     /// culled, with CPU-side flicker and end-of-life fade baked into the
 526:     /// intensity so renderers stay clockless.
 527:     fn flare_lights(&self) -> [DynamicLight; MAX_DYNAMIC_LIGHTS] {
 528:         let mut out = [DynamicLight::default(); MAX_DYNAMIC_LIGHTS];
 529:         for (slot, flare) in self.nearest_flares().into_iter().enumerate() {
 530:             let fade = (flare.remaining_seconds() / (FLARE_LIFETIME_S * 0.1)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
 531:             let phase = self.time_seconds as f32 * 13.0 + flare.sequence as f32 * 1.7;
 532:             let flicker = 0.85 + 0.15 * phase.sin() * (phase * 0.37).cos();
 533:             out[slot] = DynamicLight {
 534:                 position: flare.position,
 535:                 color: [1.0, 0.45, 0.18],
 536:                 radius: FLARE_LIGHT_RADIUS,
 537:                 intensity: 1.6 * fade * flicker,
 538:             };
 539:         }
 540:         out
 541:     }
 542: 
 543:     fn flare_light_count(&self) -> u8 {
 544:         self.nearest_flares().len() as u8
 545:     }
 546: 
 547:     fn nearest_flares(&self) -> Vec<&Flare> {
 548:         let cam = self.player.position;
 549:         let mut near: Vec<&Flare> = self
 550:             .flares
 551:             .iter()
 552:             .filter(|f| {
 553:                 let dx = f.position[0] - cam[0];
 554:                 let dz = f.position[2] - cam[2];
 555:                 dx * dx + dz * dz < FLARE_CULL_DISTANCE * FLARE_CULL_DISTANCE
 556:             })
 557:             .collect();
 558:         near.sort_by(|a, b| {
 559:             let d2 = |f: &Flare| {
 560:                 let dx = f.position[0] - cam[0];
 561:                 let dz = f.position[2] - cam[2];
 562:                 dx * dx + dz * dz
 563:             };
 564:             d2(a).total_cmp(&d2(b))
 565:         });
 566:         near.truncate(MAX_DYNAMIC_LIGHTS);
 567:         near
 568:     }
 569: 
 570:     /// Active flares (world-space runtime state), oldest first.
 571:     pub fn flares(&self) -> &[Flare] {
 572:         &self.flares
 573:     }
 574: 
 575:     /// Session pedometer reading in meters.
 576:     pub fn distance_m(&self) -> f32 {
 577:         self.distance_m as f32
 578:     }
 579: 
 580:     /// Squared distance from the player to the nearest point of a chunk's
 581:     /// 2D footprint; 0 inside the chunk. Drives the fine/coarse LOD choice.
 582:     fn chunk_dist2(&self, origin_x: f32, origin_z: f32) -> f32 {
 583:         let cs = self.config.chunk_size;
 584:         let (px, pz) = (self.player.position[0], self.player.position[2]);
 585:         let dx = (origin_x - px).max(px - (origin_x + cs)).max(0.0);
 586:         let dz = (origin_z - pz).max(pz - (origin_z + cs)).max(0.0);
 587:         dx * dx + dz * dz
 588:     }
 589: 
 590:     fn update_anomalies(&mut self, old_pos: [f32; 3]) {
 591:         if self.level != LEVEL_BACKROOMS {
 592:             self.last_safe_position = self.player.position;
 593:             return;
 594:         }
 595: 
 596:         let hazards: Vec<_> = self.store.all_pit_hazards().copied().collect();
 597:         if let Some(hazard) = hazards
 598:             .iter()
 599:             .find(|h| h.contains(self.player.position[0], self.player.position[2]))
 600:         {
 601:             let authored = [
 602:                 hazard.recovery.x,
 603:                 self.player.position[1],
 604:                 hazard.recovery.z,
 605:             ];
 606:             let recovery = if self.world.collides(authored) {
 607:                 self.last_safe_position
 608:             } else {
 609:                 authored
 610:             };
 611:             self.player.relocate(recovery);
 612:             self.last_safe_position = recovery;
 613:             return;
 614:         }
 615: 
 616:         let mut gates: Vec<_> = self.store.all_traversal_gates().copied().collect();
 617:         gates.sort_by_key(|g| g.id);
 618:         gates.dedup_by_key(|g| g.id);
 619:         for gate in gates {
 620:             let Some(direction) = gate.crossing(
 621:                 [old_pos[0], old_pos[2]],
 622:                 [self.player.position[0], self.player.position[2]],
 623:             ) else {
 624:                 continue;
 625:             };
 626:             if gate.kind == TraversalGateKind::RedThreshold && direction != gate.forward {
 627:                 continue;
 628:             }
 629:             let next_reality = self.reality.with_advanced_gate(&gate, direction);
 630:             if next_reality == self.reality {
 631:                 continue;
 632:             }
 633:             self.reality = next_reality;
 634: 
 635:             if gate.anomaly_kind == AnomalyKind::RedRoom {
 636:                 // A committed Red Room selects another infinite Level 0
 637:                 // address. Every resident chunk belongs to the old address,
 638:                 // so replacing only the vestibule would splice two realities
 639:                 // at an arbitrary streaming boundary.
 640:                 let targets: Vec<_> = self
 641:                     .store
 642:                     .iter_ordered()
 643:                     .map(|chunk| chunk_key(chunk.origin.0, chunk.origin.1))
 644:                     .collect();
 645:                 for key in targets {
 646:                     // A pre-threshold refinement for this key is no longer
 647:                     // authoritative; its late completion cannot clear the new
 648:                     // exact request identity.
 649:                     self.pending.remove(&key);
 650:                     self.forced_reloads.insert(key);
 651:                 }
 652:             }
 653:         }
 654:         self.last_safe_position = self.player.position;
 655:     }
 656: 
 657:     fn make_request_for(
 658:         &mut self,
 659:         origin_x: f32,
 660:         origin_z: f32,
 661:         lod: u8,
 662:         reality: RealitySnapshot,
 663:     ) -> ChunkRequest {
 664:         let request_id = self.next_request_id;
 665:         self.next_request_id = self.next_request_id.wrapping_add(1);
 666:         if self.next_request_id == 0 {
 667:             self.next_request_id = 1;
 668:         }
 669:         ChunkRequest {
 670:             request_id,
 671:             origin_x,
 672:             origin_z,
 673:             level: self.level,
 674:             lod,
 675:             reality,
 676:         }
 677:     }
 678: 
 679:     fn make_request(&mut self, origin_x: f32, origin_z: f32, lod: u8) -> ChunkRequest {
 680:         self.make_request_for(origin_x, origin_z, lod, self.reality.clone())
 681:     }
 682: 
 683:     /// Installs finished background loads, discarding stale work: a result
 684:     /// for the wrong level (noclip happened), for a chunk that left the
 685:     /// streaming footprint, or for a LOD no better than what is already
 686:     /// resident. Refinement stays monotonic exactly like the sync path.
 687:     ///
 688:     /// Installs are metered by the same per-tick cost budget as synchronous
 689:     /// loads (coarse = 1, fine = `FINE_LOAD_COST`): when a burst of worker
 690:     /// results lands in one frame, the overflow waits in
 691:     /// `completed_backlog` instead of stacking mesh uploads and collision
 692:     /// rebuilds into a single frame.
 693:     fn install_completed(
 694:         &mut self,
 695:         keep: &[ChunkKey],
 696:         loaded: &mut Vec<ChunkKey>,
 697:         changed: &mut bool,
 698:     ) {
 699:         let fresh = self.source.poll_completed();
 700:         self.completed_backlog.extend(fresh);
 701:         let mut budget = (self.config.max_loads_per_tick as u32 * FINE_LOAD_COST).max(1);
 702:         let mut deferred: Vec<CompletedChunk> = Vec::new();
 703:         for done in self.completed_backlog.drain(..).collect::<Vec<_>>() {
 704:             let install_cost = if done.request.lod == 0 {
 705:                 FINE_LOAD_COST
 706:             } else {
 707:                 1
 708:             };
 709:             if budget < install_cost {
 710:                 deferred.push(done);
 711:                 continue;
 712:             }
 713:             let req = &done.request;
 714:             let key = chunk_key(req.origin_x, req.origin_z);
 715:             // A completion is authoritative only while the exact order it
 716:             // echoes is still pending. In particular, an old result for the
 717:             // same chunk must not remove a newer pending request.
 718:             let is_current = self
 719:                 .pending
 720:                 .get(&key)
 721:                 .is_some_and(|pending| pending.is_same_request(req));
 722:             if !is_current {
 723:                 continue;
 724:             }
 725:             self.pending.remove(&key);
 726:             if req.level != self.level || !keep.contains(&key) {
 727:                 continue;
 728:             }
 729:             let is_forced = self.forced_reloads.contains(&key);
 730:             let improves = match self.store.get(key) {
 731:                 None => true,
 732:                 // LOD is monotonic only inside one exact reality. A chunk
 733:                 // from a replaced reality is replaced even if its old LOD was
 734:                 // finer; comparing their LODs would preserve stale geometry.
 735:                 Some(resident) if resident.is_in_reality(&req.reality) => req.lod < resident.lod,
 736:                 Some(_) => is_forced,
 737:             };
 738:             if !improves {
 739:                 continue;
 740:             }
 741:             if is_forced {
 742:                 let player = player_aabb(self.player.position);
 743:                 if done
 744:                     .payload
 745:                     .collision
 746:                     .iter()
 747:                     .any(|solid| solid.intersects(&player))
 748:                 {
 749:                     // Safety beats the effect: keep the old resident reality
 750:                     // but do not abandon the transition. Defer this chunk and
 751:                     // restore its pending status so we try again next tick.
 752:                     self.pending.insert(key, req.clone());
 753:                     deferred.push(done);
 754:                     continue;
 755:                 }
 756:             }
 757:             budget -= install_cost;
 758:             self.store.insert(
 759:                 key,
 760:                 LoadedChunk::new(
 761:                     (req.origin_x, req.origin_z),
 762:                     req.lod,
 763:                     req.reality.clone(),
 764:                     done.payload,
 765:                 ),
 766:             );
 767:             if !loaded.contains(&key) {
 768:                 loaded.push(key);
 769:             }
 770:             *changed = true;
 771:             self.forced_reloads.remove(&key);
 772:         }
 773:         self.completed_backlog = deferred;
 774:         // Drop pending entries that left the footprint so their slots free
 775:         // up; a late completion for them is discarded by the keep check.
 776:         self.pending
 777:             .retain(|key, request| keep.contains(key) && request.level == self.level);
 778:     }
 779: 
 780:     /// Tops up the background request queue: coarse availability for every
 781:     /// missing chunk (nearest first), then at most one fine refinement in
 782:     /// flight at a time, mirroring the sync path's priorities.
 783:     fn issue_requests(&mut self, desired: &[(f32, f32)], desired_visual: &[(f32, f32)]) {
 784:         // Keep roughly a worker pool's worth of requests in flight; more
 785:         // would just build a stale backlog behind a moving player.
 786:         let max_pending = (self.config.max_loads_per_tick * 2).max(4);
 787: 
 788:         let forced: Vec<_> = self
 789:             .forced_reloads
 790:             .iter()
 791:             .filter_map(|&key| {
 792:                 self.store
 793:                     .get(key)
 794:                     .map(|chunk| (key, chunk.origin.0, chunk.origin.1, chunk.lod))
 795:             })
 796:             .collect();
 797:         for (key, ox, oz, lod) in forced {
 798:             if self.pending.len() >= max_pending {
 799:                 break;
 800:             }
 801:             if !self.pending.contains_key(&key) {
 802:                 let request = self.make_request(ox, oz, lod);
 803:                 self.pending.insert(key, request.clone());
 804:                 self.source.request(request);
 805:             }
 806:         }
 807: 
 808:         for &(ox, oz) in desired_visual {
 809:             if self.pending.len() >= max_pending {
 810:                 break;
 811:             }
 812:             let key = chunk_key(ox, oz);
 813:             if !self.store.contains(key) && !self.pending.contains_key(&key) {
 814:                 let request = self.make_request(ox, oz, COARSE_LOD);
 815:                 self.pending.insert(key, request.clone());
 816:                 self.source.request(request);
 817:             }
 818:         }
 819: 
 820:         let fine_in_flight = self.pending.values().any(|request| request.lod == 0);
 821:         if fine_in_flight || self.pending.len() >= max_pending {
 822:             return;
 823:         }
 824:         let fine_d2 = self.config.fine_distance * self.config.fine_distance;
 825:         let target = desired.iter().copied().find(|&(ox, oz)| {
 826:             let key = chunk_key(ox, oz);
 827:             self.chunk_dist2(ox, oz) <= fine_d2
 828:                 && !self.pending.contains_key(&key)
 829:                 && self.store.get(key).is_some_and(|c| c.lod > 0)
 830:         });
 831:         if let Some((ox, oz)) = target {
 832:             let key = chunk_key(ox, oz);
 833:             let resident_reality = self.store.get(key).unwrap().reality.clone();
 834:             let request = self.make_request_for(ox, oz, 0, resident_reality);
 835:             self.pending.insert(key, request.clone());
 836:             self.source.request(request);
 837:         }
 838:     }
 839: 
 840:     /// Progressive, error-driven chunk streaming.
 841:     ///
 842:     /// Availability first: every missing chunk (nearest first) loads at the
 843:     /// cheap coarse LOD, so the whole footprint renders before any chunk is
 844:     /// refined. Refinement second: with leftover budget, the nearest
 845:     /// resident coarse chunk within `fine_distance` reloads at full
 846:     /// resolution in place. Chunks beyond `fine_distance` stay coarse — at
 847:     /// that range a coarse voxel projects to about a fine voxel's pixels —
 848:     /// and refinement is monotonic while resident, so there is no flapping.
 849:     ///
 850:     /// Both phases share one per-tick cost budget (coarse = 1 unit, fine =
 851:     /// `FINE_LOAD_COST`), keeping the worst-case tick at the old cost of
 852:     /// `max_loads_per_tick` fine loads. Newly loaded and refined chunks
 853:     /// upload only their own atlas slot rows; a full re-upload only happens
 854:     /// on pool relayouts (first load, bigger chunks, level switch) or on
 855:     /// back ends without partial-update support.
 856:     fn stream_chunks(&mut self) {
 857:         let surface_renderer = self.renderer.uses_surface_meshes();
 858:         let desired = self
 859:             .policy
 860:             .desired_origins(self.player.position[0], self.player.position[2]);
 861:         let desired_visual = self
 862:             .visual_policy
 863:             .desired_origins(self.player.position[0], self.player.position[2]);
 864:         let keep: Vec<_> = desired_visual
 865:             .iter()
 866:             .map(|&(x, z)| chunk_key(x, z))
 867:             .collect();
 868: 
 869:         // Free the atlas slots of chunks about to be evicted.
 870:         let evicted: Vec<ChunkKey> = self
 871:             .store
 872:             .iter_ordered()
 873:             .map(|c| chunk_key(c.origin.0, c.origin.1))
 874:             .filter(|k| !keep.contains(k))
 875:             .collect();
 876:         let mut changed = self.store.retain_keys(&keep);
 877:         self.forced_reloads.retain(|key| keep.contains(key));
 878:         if surface_renderer {
 879:             if !evicted.is_empty() {
 880:                 self.renderer.remove_surfaces(&evicted);
 881:             }
 882:         } else {
 883:             for key in evicted {
 884:                 self.pool.release(key);
 885:             }
 886:         }
 887: 
 888:         let mut loaded: Vec<ChunkKey> = Vec::new();
 889:         if self.source.is_async() {
 890:             // Background pipeline: install validated completions, then top
 891:             // up the request queue. The frame never blocks on generation.
 892:             self.install_completed(&keep, &mut loaded, &mut changed);
 893:             self.issue_requests(&desired, &desired_visual);
 894:         } else {
 895:             let mut budget = self.config.max_loads_per_tick as u32 * FINE_LOAD_COST;
 896: 
 897:             // Red-room closure is a semantic transition, not ordinary LOD
 898:             // work. Rebuild the small affected set first and install each
 899:             // complete payload atomically across its geometry/collision/light
 900:             // views. The threshold bend keeps this set out of direct sight.
 901:             let forced: Vec<_> = self
 902:                 .forced_reloads
 903:                 .iter()
 904:                 .filter_map(|&key| {
 905:                     self.store
 906:                         .get(key)
 907:                         .map(|c| (key, c.origin.0, c.origin.1, c.lod))
 908:                 })
 909:                 .collect();
 910:             for (key, ox, oz, lod) in forced {
 911:                 let payload = self
 912:                     .source
 913:                     .load_with_reality(ox, oz, self.level, lod, &self.reality);
 914:                 let player = player_aabb(self.player.position);
 915:                 if payload
 916:                     .collision
 917:                     .iter()
 918:                     .any(|solid| solid.intersects(&player))
 919:                 {
 920:                     self.forced_reloads.remove(&key);
 921:                     continue;
 922:                 }
 923:                 self.store.insert(
 924:                     key,
 925:                     LoadedChunk::new((ox, oz), lod, self.reality.clone(), payload),
 926:                 );
 927:                 self.forced_reloads.remove(&key);
 928:                 loaded.push(key);
 929:                 changed = true;
 930:             }
 931: 
 932:             // Phase 1 — availability: missing chunks come in coarse, nearest
 933:             // first. Only a leftover budget flows into refinement, so a moving
 934:             // player always fills holes before sharpening anything.
 935:             for &(ox, oz) in &desired_visual {
 936:                 if budget == 0 {
 937:                     break;
 938:                 }
 939:                 let key = chunk_key(ox, oz);
 940:                 if !self.store.contains(key) {
 941:                     let payload = self.source.load_with_reality(
 942:                         ox,
 943:                         oz,
 944:                         self.level,
 945:                         COARSE_LOD,
 946:                         &self.reality,
 947:                     );
 948:                     self.store.insert(
 949:                         key,
 950:                         LoadedChunk::new((ox, oz), COARSE_LOD, self.reality.clone(), payload),
 951:                     );
 952:                     loaded.push(key);
 953:                     budget -= 1;
 954:                     changed = true;
 955:                 }
 956:             }
 957: 
 958:             // Phase 2 — refinement: nearest coarse chunk inside the fine ring.
 959:             let fine_d2 = self.config.fine_distance * self.config.fine_distance;
 960:             while budget >= FINE_LOAD_COST {
 961:                 let target = desired.iter().copied().find(|&(ox, oz)| {
 962:                     self.chunk_dist2(ox, oz) <= fine_d2
 963:                         && self.store.get(chunk_key(ox, oz)).is_some_and(|c| c.lod > 0)
 964:                 });
 965:                 let Some((ox, oz)) = target else { break };
 966:                 let key = chunk_key(ox, oz);
 967:                 let resident_reality = self.store.get(key).unwrap().reality.clone();
 968:                 let payload =
 969:                     self.source
 970:                         .load_with_reality(ox, oz, self.level, 0, &resident_reality);
 971:                 self.store.insert(
 972:                     key,
 973:                     LoadedChunk::new((ox, oz), 0, resident_reality, payload),
 974:                 );
 975:                 if !loaded.contains(&key) {
 976:                     loaded.push(key);
 977:                 }
 978:                 budget -= FINE_LOAD_COST;
 979:                 changed = true;
 980:             }
 981:         }
 982: 
 983:         if !changed {
 984:             return;
 985:         }
 986: 
 987:         // The default path uploads only changed/replaced meshes. It keeps
 988:         // the SVO payload in memory for collision and exact debug queries,
 989:         // but avoids atlas rebasing and per-pixel traversal entirely.
 990:         if surface_renderer {
 991:             let surface_updates: Vec<SurfaceChunk<'_>> = loaded
 992:                 .iter()
 993:                 .filter_map(|&key| {
 994:                     self.store.get(key).map(|chunk| SurfaceChunk {
 995:                         key,
 996:                         origin: [chunk.origin.0, 0.0, chunk.origin.1],
 997:                         mesh: &chunk.payload.surface,
 998:                     })
 999:                 })
1000:                 .collect();
1001:             if !surface_updates.is_empty() {
1002:                 self.renderer.upload_surfaces(&surface_updates);
1003:             }
1004: 
1005:             self.draws.clear();
1006:             for chunk in self.store.iter_ordered() {
1007:                 self.draws.push(ChunkDraw {
1008:                     origin: [chunk.origin.0, 0.0, chunk.origin.1],
1009:                     root_index: 0,
1010:                     world_size: chunk.payload.world_size,
1011:                 });
1012:             }
1013:             self.draws.truncate(MAX_CHUNKS);
1014:             self.atlas_nodes = self
1015:                 .store
1016:                 .iter_ordered()
1017:                 .map(|c| c.payload.nodes.len() / 4)
1018:                 .sum();
1019:             let boxes: Vec<_> = self.store.all_collision_boxes().copied().collect();
1020:             self.world.rebuild(boxes.iter());
1021:             self.extinguish_buried_flares();
1022:             return;
1023:         }
1024: 
1025:         // Size the pool for the streaming footprint and the largest chunk.
1026:         let num_slots = ((2 * self.policy.radius + 1).pow(2) as usize).min(MAX_CHUNKS);
1027:         let rows = self
1028:             .store
1029:             .iter_ordered()
1030:             .map(|c| payload_rows(&c.payload))
1031:             .max()
1032:             .unwrap_or(1)
1033:             .max(1);
1034:         let mut need_full = self.pool.ensure_layout(num_slots, rows);
1035: 
1036:         if !need_full {
1037:             for &key in &loaded {
1038:                 let uploaded = match self.pool.assign(key) {
1039:                     Some(slot) => {
1040:                         let payload = &self.store.get(key).expect("just inserted").payload;
1041:                         let block = self.pool.rebased_block(slot, payload);
1042:                         let first_row = self.pool.slot_first_row(slot) as u32;
1043:                         self.renderer.upload_atlas_rows(first_row, &block)
1044:                     }
1045:                     None => false,
1046:                 };
1047:                 if !uploaded {
1048:                     need_full = true;
1049:                     break;
1050:                 }
1051:             }
1052:         }
1053: 
1054:         if need_full {
1055:             let keys: Vec<ChunkKey> = self
1056:                 .store
1057:                 .iter_ordered()
1058:                 .map(|c| chunk_key(c.origin.0, c.origin.1))
1059:                 .collect();
1060:             for key in keys {
1061:                 let _ = self.pool.assign(key);
1062:             }
1063:             let texels = self
1064:                 .pool
1065:                 .full_texels(|k| self.store.get(k).map(|c| &c.payload));
1066:             self.renderer.upload_atlas(&texels);
1067:         }
1068: 
1069:         self.draws.clear();
1070:         for chunk in self.store.iter_ordered() {
1071:             let key = chunk_key(chunk.origin.0, chunk.origin.1);
1072:             if let Some(offset) = self.pool.node_offset_of(key) {
1073:                 self.draws.push(ChunkDraw {
1074:                     origin: [chunk.origin.0, 0.0, chunk.origin.1],
1075:                     root_index: (offset + chunk.payload.root as usize) as i32,
1076:                     world_size: chunk.payload.world_size,
1077:                 });
1078:             }
1079:         }
1080:         self.draws.truncate(MAX_CHUNKS);
1081:         self.atlas_nodes = self
1082:             .store
1083:             .iter_ordered()
1084:             .map(|c| c.payload.nodes.len() / 4)
1085:             .sum();
1086: 
1087:         let boxes: Vec<_> = self.store.all_collision_boxes().copied().collect();
1088:         self.world.rebuild(boxes.iter());
1089:         self.extinguish_buried_flares();
1090:     }

1114:     /// Multi-line plain-text report of the live anomaly machinery, for the
1115:     /// debug overlay: reality-snapshot epochs, resident traversal gates and
1116:     /// pit hazards (nearest first), and the streaming pipeline counters.
1117:     /// Pure formatting over engine state — no browser types, natively
1118:     /// testable.
1119:     pub fn anomaly_debug_text(&self) -> String {
1120:         use std::fmt::Write;
1121:         let p = self.player.position;
1122:         let mut out = String::with_capacity(1024);
1123:         let _ = writeln!(
1124:             out,
1125:             "pos ({:.1}, {:.1}, {:.1})  level {}  yaw {:.2}",
1126:             p[0], p[1], p[2], self.level, self.player.yaw
1127:         );
1128:         let _ = writeln!(
1129:             out,
1130:             "chunks {} resident ({} fine) | pending {} | backlog {} | forced reloads {}",
1131:             self.store.len(),
1132:             self.store.iter_ordered().filter(|c| c.lod == 0).count(),
1133:             self.pending.len(),
1134:             self.completed_backlog.len(),
1135:             self.forced_reloads.len(),
1136:         );
1137:         let _ = writeln!(
1138:             out,
1139:             "flares {} | push {:.2}s",
1140:             self.flares.len(),
1141:             self.push_seconds
1142:         );
1143: 
1144:         let stamps = self.reality.stamps();
1145:         let _ = writeln!(out, "reality: {} stamp(s)", stamps.len());
1146:         for stamp in stamps {
1147:             let _ = writeln!(
1148:                 out,
1149:                 "  {:016x} epoch {}  plane {:.1} {:?} {:?}",
1150:                 stamp.instance_id,
1151:                 stamp.epoch,
1152:                 stamp.gate_plane(),
1153:                 stamp.gate_axis,
1154:                 stamp.travel_direction,
1155:             );
1156:         }
1157: 
1158:         let mut gates: Vec<_> = self.store.all_traversal_gates().copied().collect();
1159:         gates.sort_by_key(|g| g.id);
1160:         gates.dedup_by_key(|g| g.id);
1161:         gates.sort_by(|a, b| {
1162:             let d = |g: &vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::TraversalGate| match g.axis {
1163:                 vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::Axis2::X => (g.plane - p[0]).abs(),
1164:                 vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::Axis2::Z => (g.plane - p[2]).abs(),
1165:             };
1166:             d(a).total_cmp(&d(b))
1167:         });
1168:         let _ = writeln!(out, "gates resident: {}", gates.len());
1169:         for gate in gates.iter().take(6) {
1170:             let dist = match gate.axis {
1171:                 vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::Axis2::X => (gate.plane - p[0]).abs(),
1172:                 vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::Axis2::Z => (gate.plane - p[2]).abs(),
1173:             };
1174:             let epoch = self.reality.lookup(gate.instance_id).map_or(0, |s| s.epoch);
1175:             let _ = writeln!(
1176:                 out,
1177:                 "  {:?}/{:?} of {:?} {:08x}  plane {:.1} on {:?}  d={:.1}  epoch {}",
1178:                 gate.kind,
1179:                 gate.forward,
1180:                 gate.anomaly_kind,
1181:                 (gate.instance_id & 0xFFFF_FFFF) as u32,
1182:                 gate.plane,
1183:                 gate.axis,
1184:                 dist,
1185:                 epoch,
1186:             );
1187:         }
1188: 
1189:         let mut pits: Vec<_> = self.store.all_pit_hazards().copied().collect();
1190:         pits.sort_by_key(|h| h.id);
1191:         pits.dedup_by_key(|h| h.id);
1192:         pits.sort_by(|a, b| {
1193:             let d = |h: &vackrooms::domain::entities::anomaly::PitHazard| {
1194:                 let dx = h.center.x - p[0];
1195:                 let dz = h.center.z - p[2];
1196:                 dx * dx + dz * dz
1197:             };
1198:             d(a).total_cmp(&d(b))
1199:         });
1200:         let _ = writeln!(out, "pit hazards resident: {}", pits.len());
1201:         for pit in pits.iter().take(4) {
1202:             let dx = pit.center.x - p[0];
1203:             let dz = pit.center.z - p[2];
1204:             let _ = writeln!(
1205:                 out,
1206:                 "  {:08x} at ({:.1}, {:.1})  half {:.1}  d={:.1}  recovery ({:.1}, {:.1})",
1207:                 (pit.id & 0xFFFF_FFFF) as u32,
1208:                 pit.center.x,
1209:                 pit.center.z,
1210:                 pit.half_side,
1211:                 (dx * dx + dz * dz).sqrt(),
1212:                 pit.recovery.x,
1213:                 pit.recovery.z,
1214:             );
1215:         }
1216:         out
1217:     }

1219:     pub fn stats(&self) -> HudStats {
1220:         let spawn_key = chunk_key(
1221:             (self.config.spawn[0] / self.config.chunk_size).floor() * self.config.chunk_size,
1222:             (self.config.spawn[2] / self.config.chunk_size).floor() * self.config.chunk_size,
1223:         );
1224:         HudStats {
1225:             resident_chunks: self.store.len(),
1226:             fine_chunks: self.store.iter_ordered().filter(|c| c.lod == 0).count(),
1227:             atlas_nodes: self.atlas_nodes,
1228:             collision_boxes: self.world.len(),
1229:             resolution_scale: self.governor.scale(),
1230:             ready: self.store.contains(spawn_key),
1231:             distance_m: self.distance_m as f32,
1232:         }
1233:     }
1234: }

1248:         draws: Rc<RefCell<Vec<usize>>>,
1249:         /// When true the renderer accepts partial row updates like the GPU
1250:         /// driver; when false it forces the full-upload fallback.

1252:     }

1258:         fn upload_atlas_rows(&mut self, first_row: u32, _texels: &[u32]) -> bool {
1259:             if self.supports_rows {
1260:                 self.row_uploads.borrow_mut().push(first_row);
1261:             }
1262:             self.supports_rows
1263:         }

1329:     /// Background source double: records requests, completes only what the
1330:     /// test explicitly finishes, and panics on any blocking load.
1331:     #[derive(Default)]
1332:     struct AsyncFakeSource {
1333:         requests: Rc<RefCell<Vec<ChunkRequest>>>,
1334:         ready: Rc<RefCell<Vec<crate::application::ports::CompletedChunk>>>,
1335:     }
1336: 
1337:     impl ChunkSourcePort for AsyncFakeSource {
1338:         fn load(&self, _x: f32, _z: f32, _level: u32, _lod: u8) -> ChunkPayload {
1339:             unreachable!("async sources must never be block-loaded by the engine");
1340:         }
1341:         fn is_async(&self) -> bool {
1342:             true
1343:         }
1344:         fn request(&mut self, request: ChunkRequest) {
1345:             self.requests.borrow_mut().push(request);
1346:         }
1347:         fn poll_completed(&mut self) -> Vec<crate::application::ports::CompletedChunk> {
1348:             self.ready.borrow_mut().drain(..).collect()
1349:         }
1350:     }
1351: 
1352:     fn completed(request: ChunkRequest) -> crate::application::ports::CompletedChunk {
1353:         let payload = FlatChunkSource.load(
1354:             request.origin_x,
1355:             request.origin_z,
1356:             request.level,
1357:             request.lod,
1358:         );
1359:         crate::application::ports::CompletedChunk { request, payload }
1360:     }

1362:     fn test_request(
1363:         request_id: u32,
1364:         origin_x: f32,
1365:         origin_z: f32,
1366:         level: u32,
1367:         lod: u8,
1368:     ) -> ChunkRequest {
1369:         ChunkRequest {
1370:             request_id,
1371:             origin_x,
1372:             origin_z,
1373:             level,
1374:             lod,
1375:             reality: RealitySnapshot::default(),
1376:         }
1377:     }
1378: 
1379:     #[test]
1380:     fn async_source_streams_without_blocking_and_refines_monotonically() {
1381:         let source = AsyncFakeSource::default();
1382:         let requests = source.requests.clone();
1383:         let ready = source.ready.clone();
1384:         let mut engine = Engine::new(
1385:             EngineConfig::default(),
1386:             Box::new(RecordingRenderer::default()),
1387:             Box::new(source),
1388:         );
1389:         let input = InputFrame::default();
1390: 
1391:         // First tick issues requests but installs nothing — the frame
1392:         // never waits for generation.
1393:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1394:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().resident_chunks, 0);
1395:         assert!(!engine.stats().ready);
1396:         assert!(!requests.borrow().is_empty());
1397: 
1398:         // Fulfil whatever is asked until the footprint is fine everywhere.
1399:         for _ in 0..40 {
1400:             let fulfil: Vec<_> = requests.borrow_mut().drain(..).collect();
1401:             for req in fulfil {
1402:                 ready.borrow_mut().push(completed(req));
1403:             }
1404:             engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1405:         }
1406:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().resident_chunks, 9);
1407:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().fine_chunks, 9);
1408:         assert!(engine.stats().ready);
1409: 
1410:         // Steady state: no further requests.
1411:         let before = requests.borrow().len();
1412:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1413:         assert_eq!(requests.borrow().len(), before);
1414:     }
1415: 
1416:     #[test]
1417:     fn worker_result_bursts_install_across_ticks_not_in_one_frame() {
1418:         let source = AsyncFakeSource::default();
1419:         let ready = source.ready.clone();
1420:         let mut engine = Engine::new(
1421:             EngineConfig::default(),
1422:             Box::new(RecordingRenderer::default()),
1423:             Box::new(source),
1424:         );
1425:         let input = InputFrame::default();
1426:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1427: 
1428:         // A worst-case burst: fine results for all nine footprint chunks
1429:         // land in the same frame.
1430:         let desired = engine
1431:             .policy
1432:             .desired_origins(engine.player.position[0], engine.player.position[2]);
1433:         let mut id = 90_000;
1434:         for (ox, oz) in desired {
1435:             let req = test_request(id, ox, oz, 0, 0);
1436:             id += 1;
1437:             engine.pending.insert(chunk_key(ox, oz), req.clone());
1438:             ready.borrow_mut().push(completed(req));
1439:         }
1440: 
1441:         // Budget: max_loads_per_tick (2) fine-equivalents per tick, so the
1442:         // burst spreads over ceil(9 / 2) ticks instead of hitching one frame.
1443:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1444:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().fine_chunks, 2);
1445:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1446:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().fine_chunks, 4);
1447:         for _ in 0..3 {
1448:             engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1449:         }
1450:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().fine_chunks, 9, "backlog must fully drain");
1451:     }

1453:     #[test]
1454:     fn anomaly_debug_text_reports_reality_and_gates() {

1522:     fn old_completion_cannot_clear_a_newer_request_for_the_same_chunk() {

1525:         let ready = source.ready.clone();
1526:         let mut engine = Engine::new(

1529:             Box::new(source),
1530:         );
1531:         let input = InputFrame::default();
1532:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1533: 
1534:         let current = requests.borrow()[0].clone();
1535:         let key = chunk_key(current.origin_x, current.origin_z);
1536:         let mut stale = current.clone();
1537:         stale.request_id = stale.request_id.wrapping_sub(1);
1538:         ready.borrow_mut().push(completed(stale));
1539:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1540: 
1541:         assert!(
1542:             engine
1543:                 .pending
1544:                 .get(&key)
1545:                 .is_some_and(|pending| pending.is_same_request(&current)),
1546:             "a stale completion must leave the newer request pending"
1547:         );
1548:         assert!(engine.store.get(key).is_none());
1549: 
1550:         ready.borrow_mut().push(completed(current.clone()));
1551:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1552:         let installed = engine.store.get(key).expect("current completion installs");
1553:         assert!(installed.is_in_reality(&current.reality));
1554:     }

1623:     #[test]
1624:     fn streams_coarse_first_then_refines_nearest_first() {
1625:         let (mut engine, uploads, _draws) = engine_with_recorder();
1626:         let input = InputFrame::default();
1627: 
1628:         // 9 chunks are desired (radius 1). The per-tick budget is
1629:         // max_loads_per_tick * FINE_LOAD_COST = 8 units; a coarse load costs
1630:         // 1, a fine load 4. Tick 1: eight coarse loads — the world is
1631:         // visible (and `ready`) after one tick instead of five.
1632:         engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1633:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().resident_chunks, 8);
1634:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().fine_chunks, 0);
1635:         assert!(engine.stats().ready, "coarse spawn chunk flips ready");
1636: 
1637:         // Tick 2: the last coarse load + one refinement. Ticks 3-6: two
1638:         // refinements each; every chunk is within fine_distance (15) here.
1639:         for expected_fine in [1usize, 3, 5, 7, 9] {
1640:             engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1641:             assert_eq!(engine.stats().resident_chunks, 9);
1642:             assert_eq!(engine.stats().fine_chunks, expected_fine);
1643:         }
1644:         assert_eq!(uploads.borrow().len(), 6, "one upload per changed tick");
1645: 
1646:         // Subsequent ticks should not load anything or re-upload.
1647:         for _ in 0..5 {
1648:             engine.tick(1.0 / 60.0, &input);
1649:         }
1650:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().resident_chunks, 9);
1651:         assert_eq!(engine.stats().fine_chunks, 9);
1652:         assert_eq!(uploads.borrow().len(), 6);
1653:     }

1901:         }

1903:         for _ in 0..600 {

1907:         let settled = governor.scale();
