## File: src/use_cases/backrooms_level.rs
````rust
   1: //! Level 0 — the Backrooms proper.
   2: //!
   3: //! Everything is a pure function of *world-space* coordinates, so chunks tile
   4: //! seamlessly no matter which order they stream in. The goal is *believable
   5: //! building architecture* with depth — not flat mazes:
   6: //!
   7: //! * **Ceiling regions** use broad smooth fields instead of a low default
   8: //!   slab: regular dropped ceilings are 3.2--3.6 u, open expanses 3.8--4.4 u,
   9: //!   vaults 4.5--5.4 u, and compression zones are rare deliberate contrast.
  10: //! * **Halls**: one dominant cross-region route is wide enough to read as
  11: //!   circulation through a vast building, with at most two interior branches.
  12: //!   Its edge walls persist in long runs and open into large rooms or fabric,
  13: //!   not a repeated doorway grid.
  14: //! * **Fabric**: the default fill *is* the labyrinth — an irregular warren
  15: //!   of rooms on a hidden 7.2 u lattice, chained through hashed doorways
  16: //!   (binary-tree rule guarantees global connectivity chunk-locally) and
  17: //!   merged by porosity-driven wall dropout so no grid is ever readable.
  18: //!   Open expanses are the exception that punctuates it, never the default.
  19: 
  20: use crate::domain::entities::anomaly::{
  21:     AnomalyInstance, AnomalyKind, Axis2, RealitySnapshot, TraversalGate, TraversalGateKind,
  22:     WorldBounds,
  23: };
  24: use crate::domain::entities::architecture::{
  25:     AssemblyInstance, CeilingLanguage, CirculationSpine, RegionPlan, SpaceProgram,
  26:     StructuralSystem, StructuralSystemInstance,
  27: };
  28: use crate::domain::entities::voxel_grid::{VOXEL_FLOOR, VOXEL_LIGHT, VOXEL_WALL, VoxelGrid};
  29: use crate::entities::models::Position;
  30: use crate::use_cases::anomalies::geometry::sample_anomaly;
  31: use crate::use_cases::generate_chunk::{GeneratorConfig, LevelTuning};
  32: use crate::use_cases::infinite_level::InfiniteRegionWindow;
  33: use crate::use_cases::level_generator::LevelGenerator;
  34: use crate::use_cases::level_zero::{ColumnField, voxelize_columns};
  35: use crate::use_cases::ports::NoiseProvider;
  36: use crate::use_cases::red_rooms::{
  37:     geometry::sample_red_room, recursive_level::RecursiveLevelWindow,
  38: };
  39: use crate::use_cases::region_plan::{PLAN_WALL_T, region_index, spawn_point};
  40: 
  41: /// Ceiling height of the tallest (atrium) vaults, world units.
  42: pub const MAX_CEILING_UNITS: f32 = 5.4;
  43: /// Total grid height: headroom above the tallest vault.
  44: pub const GRID_HEIGHT_UNITS: f32 = 5.8;
  45: 
  46: const DOOR_WIDTH: f32 = 1.2;
  47: const DOOR_HEIGHT: f32 = 2.2;
  48: 
  49: /// The default fabric room lattice. Rooms are chained through hashed
  50: /// doorways and merged by wall dropout, so the cell size never reads as a
  51: /// grid from inside — it is the scale of the labyrinth, not its shape.
  52: const FABRIC_CELL: f32 = 7.2;
  53: 
  54: /// Column grid spacing inside expanses.
  55: const EXPANSE_COLUMN_PERIOD: f32 = 7.2;
  56: 
  57: /// Ceiling light panel spacing. The coffer beam grid shares this period,
  58: /// but beams are now a renderer shading pattern (see the splat fragment
  59: /// shader's 2.8 u grid), never stepped ceiling geometry.
  60: const LIGHT_PERIOD: f32 = 2.8;
  61: 
  62: /// Runtime direct lights sit below their visible ceiling panel. Tall atria
  63: /// need a longer pendant drop so the light reaches occupied space and casts
  64: /// useful column shadows instead of flattening against the vault.
  65: fn runtime_light_height(ceiling_units: f32, is_atrium: bool) -> f32 {
  66:     let pendant_drop = if is_atrium { 1.6 } else { 1.1 };
  67:     (ceiling_units - pendant_drop).max(2.4)
  68: }
  69: 
  70: fn gate_crosses_bounds(gate: &TraversalGate, bounds: WorldBounds) -> bool {
  71:     match gate.axis {
  72:         Axis2::X => {
  73:             gate.plane >= bounds.min_x - 0.01
  74:                 && gate.plane <= bounds.max_x + 0.01
  75:                 && gate.span_max >= bounds.min_z
  76:                 && gate.span_min <= bounds.max_z
  77:         }
  78:         Axis2::Z => {
  79:             gate.plane >= bounds.min_z - 0.01
  80:                 && gate.plane <= bounds.max_z + 0.01
  81:                 && gate.span_max >= bounds.min_x
  82:                 && gate.span_min <= bounds.max_x
  83:         }
  84:     }
  85: }
  86: 
  87: /// Within this radius of the spawn point the main corridor keeps both of its
  88: /// edge walls fully intact: the first thing the player reads is an
  89: /// unambiguous walled corridor, not a dissolved edge into open fabric. The
  90: /// world only starts opening up once that grammar has been established.
  91: const SPAWN_READABLE_RADIUS: f32 = 26.0;
  92: 
  93: pub struct BackroomsLevel;
  94: 
  95: /// What one (x, z) column of the level looks like.
  96: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
  97: pub(crate) struct ColumnPlan {
  98:     /// Whether the walkable floor slab exists under this column.
  99:     pub floor: bool,
 100:     /// Floor-to-ceiling solid (wall or pillar).
 101:     pub solid: bool,
 102:     /// Ceiling height in world units (top of the walkable space).
 103:     pub ceiling_units: f32,
 104:     /// Ceiling light above this column.
 105:     pub light: bool,
 106:     /// The light above this column burns red (red-room corruption). Only
 107:     /// ever true inside an assembly whose whole room is the anomaly.
 108:     pub red_light: bool,
 109:     /// Solid band hanging from the ceiling down to this height (door
 110:     /// lintels). The space below stays walkable.
 111:     pub lintel_from_units: Option<f32>,
 112:     /// Glowing sconce band on a solid column (atrium pillars).
 113:     pub sconce: bool,
 114:     /// Material used for solid columns and lintels (a wall-treatment voxel
 115:     /// from the shared
 116:     /// [`crate::domain::entities::environment::EnvironmentProfile`] semantics).
 117:     pub wall_material: u8,
 118:     /// Material of the floor slab (carpet depth/condition/fluid semantics).
 119:     pub floor_material: u8,
 120:     /// Material of the fixture voxel when `light` is set (warm fluorescent,
 121:     /// red pressure, or cool glimmer).
 122:     pub light_material: u8,
 123: }
 124: 
 125: impl ColumnPlan {
 126:     /// An open ordinary-fabric column with the default Level 0 materials.
 127:     pub(crate) fn open(ceiling_units: f32) -> Self {
 128:         Self {
 129:             floor: true,
 130:             solid: false,
 131:             ceiling_units,
 132:             light: false,
 133:             red_light: false,
 134:             lintel_from_units: None,
 135:             sconce: false,
 136:             wall_material: VOXEL_WALL,
 137:             floor_material: VOXEL_FLOOR,
 138:             light_material: VOXEL_LIGHT,
 139:         }
 140:     }
 141: }
 142: 
 143: /// The broad ceiling hierarchy that gives Level 0 scale without turning the
 144: /// whole map into a warehouse. It is local implementation detail rather than
 145: /// a world semantic: assemblies and corridors may override it.
 146: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
 147: enum FabricCeilingBand {
 148:     Compression,
 149:     Regular,
 150:     Expanse,
 151:     Vault,
 152: }
 153: 
 154: impl BackroomsLevel {
 155:     /// Smooth world-space noise in [-1, 1]. `scale` stretches the provider's
 156:     /// built-in ~20 u wavelength: wavelength = 20 / scale.
 157:     fn n(noise: &dyn NoiseProvider, seed: u32, salt: u32, x: f32, z: f32, scale: f32) -> f32 {
 158:         noise.evaluate_2d(seed ^ salt, Position::new(x * scale, z * scale))
 159:     }
 160: 
 161:     /// Decorrelated per-cell hash in [0, 1): samples the value noise exactly
 162:     /// on its lattice (provider frequency is 0.05, so inputs that are
 163:     /// multiples of 20 hit lattice points), where it is uniform rather than
 164:     /// interpolation-smoothed toward zero.
 165:     fn cell_hash(noise: &dyn NoiseProvider, seed: u32, salt: u32, cx: i64, cz: i64) -> f32 {
 166:         let v = noise.evaluate_2d(
 167:             seed ^ salt,
 168:             Position::new(cx as f32 * 20.0, cz as f32 * 20.0),
 169:         );
 170:         (v * 0.5 + 0.5).clamp(0.0, 0.999)
 171:     }
 172: 
 173:     /// Broad, low-frequency ceiling territory. The thresholds are chosen to
 174:     /// bias the sampled world toward regular dropped ceilings while retaining
 175:     /// meaningful regions of open volume and rare compression.
 176:     fn fabric_ceiling_band(
 177:         noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
 178:         seed: u32,
 179:         wx: f32,
 180:         wz: f32,
 181:     ) -> FabricCeilingBand {
 182:         // Regular dropped ceiling — the labyrinth fabric — is the default
 183:         // condition of Level 0. Expanses and vaults are deliberate
 184:         // punctuation the maze occasionally opens into, never the baseline.
 185:         let field = Self::n(noise, seed, 0xAA10, wx, wz, 0.18);
 186:         if field < -0.60 {
 187:             FabricCeilingBand::Compression
 188:         } else if field < 0.52 {
 189:             FabricCeilingBand::Regular
 190:         } else if field < 0.76 {
 191:             FabricCeilingBand::Expanse
 192:         } else {
 193:             FabricCeilingBand::Vault
 194:         }
 195:     }
 196: 
 197:     /// Ceiling heights are architectural tiers, not terrain. The common
 198:     /// bands are perfectly flat; open volumes vary per ~8 u ceiling *zone*
 199:     /// (one suspended-grid bay run), never per column, and every height
 200:     /// snaps to the fine voxel lattice so voxelization cannot add
 201:     /// sub-voxel stair-stepping on top.
 202:     fn fabric_ceiling_height(
 203:         noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
 204:         seed: u32,
 205:         wx: f32,
 206:         wz: f32,
 207:         band: FabricCeilingBand,
 208:     ) -> f32 {
 209:         const ZONE: f32 = 8.0;
 210:         let zone_x = (wx / ZONE).floor() * ZONE + ZONE * 0.5;
 211:         let zone_z = (wz / ZONE).floor() * ZONE + ZONE * 0.5;
 212:         let detail = Self::n(noise, seed, 0xB300, zone_x, zone_z, 0.72);
 213:         let (height, lo, hi) = match band {
 214:             FabricCeilingBand::Compression => (2.6, 2.5, 2.8),
 215:             FabricCeilingBand::Regular => (3.4, 3.2, 3.6),
 216:             FabricCeilingBand::Expanse => (4.1 + 0.3 * detail, 3.8, 4.4),
 217:             FabricCeilingBand::Vault => (4.95 + 0.45 * detail, 4.5, 5.4),
 218:         };
 219:         // Snap to the fine voxel lattice, then clamp last: 21 * 0.2 is
 220:         // 4.2000003 in f32 and must not escape the band's range.
 221:         ((height / 0.2).round() * 0.2).clamp(lo, hi)
 222:     }
 223: 
 224:     /// Is (wx, wz) inside an open expanse of the fabric?
 225:     fn in_expanse(noise: &dyn NoiseProvider, seed: u32, wx: f32, wz: f32) -> bool {
 226:         matches!(
 227:             Self::fabric_ceiling_band(noise, seed, wx, wz),
 228:             FabricCeilingBand::Expanse | FabricCeilingBand::Vault
 229:         )
 230:     }
 231: 
 232:     /// The *fabric* column plan at world position (wx, wz): the endless,
 233:     /// unplanned office fill between planned corridors and assemblies.
 234:     pub(crate) fn column_plan(
 235:         noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
 236:         seed: u32,
 237:         tuning: &LevelTuning,
 238:         wx: f32,
 239:         wz: f32,
 240:     ) -> ColumnPlan {
 241:         // ---- ceiling field -------------------------------------------------
 242:         let ceiling_band = Self::fabric_ceiling_band(noise, seed, wx, wz);
 243:         let ceiling_units = Self::fabric_ceiling_height(noise, seed, wx, wz, ceiling_band);
 244: 
 245:         // In open and vaulted regions, partitions dissolve and only sparse
 246:         // structural columns remain. The cheap dropped-ceiling material is
 247:         // therefore carried through unexpectedly large space.
 248:         let expanse = matches!(
 249:             ceiling_band,
 250:             FabricCeilingBand::Expanse | FabricCeilingBand::Vault
 251:         );
 252: 
 253:         // Coffer beams are shading detail in the renderer, not geometry: a
 254:         // 0.2 u drop at a 0.2 u voxel scale turned every beam into a
 255:         // full-voxel step and read as noisy terrain overhead. The splat
 256:         // shader darkens the same COFFER_PERIOD grid instead.
 257: 
 258:         // ---- solids ------------------------------------------------------
 259:         let mut solid = false;
 260:         let mut lintel_from_units: Option<f32> = None;
 261:         let sconce = false;
 262: 
 263:         if expanse {
 264:             // Sparse structural columns hold the expanse ceiling up.
 265:             let cx = (wx / EXPANSE_COLUMN_PERIOD).floor() as i64;
 266:             let cz = (wz / EXPANSE_COLUMN_PERIOD).floor() as i64;
 267:             let on_site = wx.rem_euclid(EXPANSE_COLUMN_PERIOD) < 0.45
 268:                 && wz.rem_euclid(EXPANSE_COLUMN_PERIOD) < 0.45;
 269:             if on_site && Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, 0xF200, cx, cz) < 0.7 * tuning.pillars {
 270:                 solid = true;
 271:             }
 272:         } else {
 273:             // The default fabric *is* the Backrooms labyrinth: an irregular
 274:             // warren of yellow rooms chained through hashed doorways.
 275:             // Connectivity is a binary-tree rule — every cell knocks a
 276:             // doorway through its west *or* its north wall — so all rooms
 277:             // connect without a chunk ever seeing its neighbors. Smoothly
 278:             // drifting porosity (whole walls dropped, wider thresholds,
 279:             // second doorways) breaks the lattice read: it plays as one
 280:             // endless wrong building, never as "a maze section".
 281:             let t = PLAN_WALL_T;
 282:             let fx = wx.rem_euclid(FABRIC_CELL);
 283:             let fz = wz.rem_euclid(FABRIC_CELL);
 284:             let (in_w, in_n) = (fx < t, fz < t);
 285:             if in_w && in_n {
 286:                 // Junction posts anchor every corner; where the walls
 287:                 // around them have dropped they survive as column stubs.
 288:                 solid = tuning.walls > 0.0;
 289:             } else if in_w || in_n {
 290:                 let cx = (wx / FABRIC_CELL).floor() as i64;
 291:                 let cz = (wz / FABRIC_CELL).floor() as i64;
 292:                 // 0 = tight labyrinth, 1 = broken-open suites; drifts over
 293:                 // ~180 u so density changes read as neighborhoods, not zones.
 294:                 let porosity =
 295:                     (Self::n(noise, seed, 0x9010, wx, wz, 0.11) * 0.5 + 0.5).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
 296:                 let opens_west = Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, 0x9200, cx, cz) < 0.5;
 297:                 let (wall_salt, door_salt, opens_here) = if in_w {
 298:                     (0x9300u32, 0x9500u32, opens_west)
 299:                 } else {
 300:                     (0x9400u32, 0x9600u32, !opens_west)
 301:                 };
 302:                 // Whole-wall dropout merges rooms into larger wrong shapes.
 303:                 // Porosity varies along a run, so drops end ragged rather
 304:                 // than on clean cell boundaries. The walls knob scales
 305:                 // survival: 0 empties the fabric, 2 approaches a full grid.
 306:                 let survive = (0.92 - 0.42 * porosity) * tuning.walls.clamp(0.0, 1.5);
 307:                 if Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, wall_salt, cx, cz) < survive {
 308:                     let along = if in_w { fz } else { fx };
 309:                     // The binary-tree wall always gets its doorway; porous
 310:                     // neighborhoods often cut a second one.
 311:                     let extra = Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, door_salt ^ 0x1F, cx, cz)
 312:                         < 0.18 + 0.42 * porosity;
 313:                     if opens_here || extra {
 314:                         let dh = Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, door_salt, cx, cz);
 315:                         let width = DOOR_WIDTH + 0.2 + 2.2 * porosity;
 316:                         let pos = t + (FABRIC_CELL - 2.0 * t - width) * dh;
 317:                         if along >= pos && along < pos + width {
 318:                             // Narrow thresholds sometimes keep a lintel:
 319:                             // framed evidence of doors that once existed.
 320:                             if width < 2.0
 321:                                 && Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, door_salt ^ 0x2E, cx, cz) < 0.35
 322:                             {
 323:                                 lintel_from_units = Some(DOOR_HEIGHT);
 324:                             }
 325:                         } else {
 326:                             solid = true;
 327:                         }
 328:                     } else {
 329:                         solid = true;
 330:                     }
 331:                 }
 332:             }
 333:         }
 334: 
 335:         // ---- lights ------------------------------------------------------
 336:         let light = if !solid {
 337:             // Open regions keep a longer, sparser fluorescent rhythm; the
 338:             // regular dropped ceiling retains the denser office grid.
 339:             let panel_period = if expanse { 4.8 } else { LIGHT_PERIOD };
 340:             let lx = (wx - panel_period * 0.5).rem_euclid(panel_period);
 341:             let lz = (wz - panel_period * 0.5).rem_euclid(panel_period);
 342:             let cell_x = (wx / panel_period).floor() as i64;
 343:             let cell_z = (wz / panel_period).floor() as i64;
 344:             let keep = if expanse { 0.66 } else { 0.78 } * tuning.lights;
 345:             let alive = Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, 0xE900, cell_x, cell_z) < keep;
 346:             lx < 0.45 && lz < 0.45 && alive
 347:         } else {
 348:             false
 349:         };
 350: 
 351:         ColumnPlan {
 352:             floor: true,
 353:             solid,
 354:             ceiling_units,
 355:             light,
 356:             red_light: false,
 357:             lintel_from_units,
 358:             sconce,
 359:             wall_material: VOXEL_WALL,
 360:             floor_material: VOXEL_FLOOR,
 361:             light_material: VOXEL_LIGHT,
 362:         }
 363:     }
 364: 
 365:     /// Region plans for every region a chunk (plus a margin) overlaps.
 366:     pub(crate) fn region_plans_for(
 367:         chunk_pos: Position,
 368:         chunk_size: f32,
 369:         seed: u32,
 370:         config: &GeneratorConfig,
 371:         noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
 372:     ) -> Vec<((i64, i64), RegionPlan)> {
 373:         InfiniteRegionWindow::around_chunk(chunk_pos, chunk_size, 1.0, seed, config, noise)
 374:             .iter()
 375:             .map(|(key, plan)| (key, plan.clone()))
 376:             .collect()
 377:     }
 378: 
 379:     /// Is (wx, wz) on a structural column of this system?
 380:     fn on_column(st: &StructuralSystemInstance, wx: f32, wz: f32) -> bool {
 381:         if st.system == StructuralSystem::CoreAndShell {
 382:             // Core-and-shell designers hide columns in walls; none inside.
 383:             return false;
 384:         }
 385:         let mut mx = (wx - st.phase.0).rem_euclid(st.bay_x);
 386:         let mz = (wz - st.phase.1).rem_euclid(st.bay_z);
 387:         if st.system == StructuralSystem::OffsetGrid {
 388:             let row = ((wz - st.phase.1) / st.bay_z).floor() as i64;
 389:             if row.rem_euclid(2) == 1 {
 390:                 mx = (wx - st.phase.0 + st.bay_x * 0.5).rem_euclid(st.bay_x);
 391:             }
 392:         }
 393:         mx < st.column_side && mz < st.column_side
 394:     }
 395: 
 396:     /// Column plan for a point inside an assembly footprint or its
 397:     /// surrounding wall band (`inside == false`).
 398:     fn assembly_column(
 399:         a: &AssemblyInstance,
 400:         inside: bool,
 401:         renovator: Option<&StructuralSystemInstance>,
 402:         tuning: &LevelTuning,
 403:         wx: f32,
 404:         wz: f32,
 405:     ) -> ColumnPlan {
 406:         let walls_on = tuning.walls > 0.0;
 407:         let zone = a.ceiling_zones.first();
 408:         let mut ceiling_units = zone.map_or(3.4, |c| c.height_units);
 409:         match zone.map(|c| c.language) {
 410:             // Coffered reads as a shading pattern now (see the splat
 411:             // shader), not stepped geometry.
 412:             Some(CeilingLanguage::ExposedSoffit) => ceiling_units -= 0.2,
 413:             _ => {}
 414:         }
 415:         let mut plan = ColumnPlan::open(ceiling_units);
 416: 
 417:         // Entrances pierce the wall band (and win over everything solid).
 418:         for e in &a.entrances {
 419:             let (da, db) = if e.through_x_wall {
 420:                 ((wx - e.center.x).abs(), (wz - e.center.z).abs())
 421:             } else {
 422:                 ((wz - e.center.z).abs(), (wx - e.center.x).abs())
 423:             };
 424:             if da < e.width * 0.5 && db <= PLAN_WALL_T + 0.05 {
 425:                 plan.lintel_from_units = walls_on
 426:                     .then_some(e.lintel_units.unwrap_or(0.0))
 427:                     .filter(|u| *u > 0.0);
 428:                 return plan;
 429:             }
 430:         }
 431: 
 432:         if !inside {
 433:             // Perimeter wall band.
 434:             plan.solid = walls_on;
 435:             return plan;
 436:         }
 437: 
 438:         // Interior partitions: walls on space boundaries that are not the
 439:         // footprint perimeter, each with a centered doorway.
 440:         let fb = a.footprint.bounds();
 441:         if walls_on {
 442:             for s in &a.spaces {
 443:                 let sb = s.footprint.bounds();
 444:                 if wz >= sb.1 && wz <= sb.3 {
 445:                     for plane in [sb.0, sb.2] {
 446:                         if (plane - fb.0).abs() > 0.1
 447:                             && (plane - fb.2).abs() > 0.1
 448:                             && (wx - plane).abs() < PLAN_WALL_T * 0.5
 449:                         {
 450:                             let door_c = (sb.1 + sb.3) * 0.5;
 451:                             if (wz - door_c).abs() < 0.6 {
 452:                                 plan.lintel_from_units = Some(DOOR_HEIGHT);
 453:                             } else {
 454:                                 plan.solid = true;
 455:                             }
 456:                         }
 457:                     }
 458:                 }
 459:                 if wx >= sb.0 && wx <= sb.2 {
 460:                     for plane in [sb.1, sb.3] {
 461:                         if (plane - fb.1).abs() > 0.1
 462:                             && (plane - fb.3).abs() > 0.1
 463:                             && (wz - plane).abs() < PLAN_WALL_T * 0.5
 464:                         {
 465:                             let door_c = (sb.0 + sb.2) * 0.5;
 466:                             if (wx - door_c).abs() < 0.6 {
 467:                                 plan.lintel_from_units = Some(DOOR_HEIGHT);
 468:                             } else {
 469:                                 plan.solid = true;
 470:                             }
 471:                         }
 472:                     }
 473:                 }
 474:             }
 475:         }
 476: 
 477:         // Structure: the original grid, plus the renovator's contradictory
 478:         // grid where a renovation overlays the assembly.
 479:         if tuning.pillars > 0.0 && !plan.solid {
 480:             if Self::on_column(&a.structure, wx, wz) {
 481:                 plan.solid = true;
 482:             }
 483:             if let Some(r) = renovator {
 484:                 if a.corruption.renovation_overlay && Self::on_column(r, wx, wz) {
 485:                     // Renovation columns intrude on the original bay rhythm;
 486:                     // the contradiction itself is the corruption. They stay
 487:                     // ordinary wall material — Level 0 has no red masonry.
 488:                     plan.solid = true;
 489:                 }
 490:             }
 491:         }
 492: 
 493:         // Fixtures, tied to the assembly's ceiling modules. In a red room
 494:         // every fixture burns red: the anomaly is the room's light, applied
 495:         // after all geometry decisions and on the same fixture spacing.
 496:         if !plan.solid && tuning.lights > 0.0 {
 497:             for f in &a.fixtures {
 498:                 if f.lit && (wx - f.at.x).abs() <= f.half_x && (wz - f.at.z).abs() <= f.half_z {
 499:                     plan.light = true;
 500:                     plan.red_light = a.corruption.red_room;
 501:                     break;
 502:                 }
 503:             }
 504:         }
 505:         plan
 506:     }
 507: 
 508:     fn corridor_ceiling(
 509:         spine: &CirculationSpine,
 510:         noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
 511:         seed: u32,
 512:         wx: f32,
 513:         wz: f32,
 514:     ) -> f32 {
 515:         // Slow, quantized drift: one sample per 12 u corridor zone snapped
 516:         // to the voxel lattice, so long runs hold one height and then step
 517:         // once — instead of per-column ripple overhead.
 518:         const DRIFT_ZONE: f32 = 12.0;
 519:         let zone_x = (wx / DRIFT_ZONE).floor() * DRIFT_ZONE + DRIFT_ZONE * 0.5;
 520:         let zone_z = (wz / DRIFT_ZONE).floor() * DRIFT_ZONE + DRIFT_ZONE * 0.5;
 521:         let drift = Self::n(
 522:             noise,
 523:             seed,
 524:             0xCA00_u32.wrapping_add(spine.id),
 525:             zone_x,
 526:             zone_z,
 527:             0.35,
 528:         );
 529:         let (height, lo, hi) = match spine.spine_kind {
 530:             SpaceProgram::MainCorridor => (3.8 + 0.4 * drift, 3.4, 4.2),
 531:             SpaceProgram::SecondaryHall => (3.3 + 0.3 * drift, 3.0, 3.6),
 532:             _ => (3.4, 3.4, 3.4),
 533:         };
 534:         // Snap first, clamp last (f32 lattice snap can overshoot the band).
 535:         ((height / 0.2).round() * 0.2).clamp(lo, hi)
 536:     }
 537: 
 538:     /// Whether a corridor-side wall dissolves into the adjacent room/fabric.
 539:     /// Main-route openings take 8--10 u from a 32 u macro span: around a
 540:     /// quarter to a third of an eligible edge is directly open, while the
 541:     /// remaining wall runs stay long enough to avoid a doorway cadence.
 542:     fn corridor_edge_opens(
 543:         spine: &CirculationSpine,
 544:         noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
 545:         seed: u32,
 546:         along: f32,
 547:         is_horizontal: bool,
 548:         wx: f32,
 549:         wz: f32,
 550:     ) -> bool {
 551:         // The opening spine sequence is sacred: near spawn the corridor keeps
 552:         // both edge walls so the player's first minute reads as circulation
 553:         // through a building, before any dissolution into fabric.
 554:         let sp = spawn_point(seed);
 555:         let spawn_d2 = (wx - sp.x) * (wx - sp.x) + (wz - sp.z) * (wz - sp.z);
 556:         if spawn_d2 < SPAWN_READABLE_RADIUS * SPAWN_READABLE_RADIUS {
 557:             return false;
 558:         }
 559: 
 560:         if Self::in_expanse(noise, seed, wx, wz) {
 561:             return true;
 562:         }
 563: 
 564:         let span = 32.0;
 565:         let section = (along / span).floor() as i64;
 566:         let perpendicular = if is_horizontal { wz } else { wx };
 567:         let side = (perpendicular / spine.width.max(1.0)).floor() as i64;
 568:         let salt = 0xCB00_u32.wrapping_add(spine.id);
 569:         let width_hash = Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, salt, section, side);
 570:         let phase_hash = Self::cell_hash(noise, seed, salt ^ 0x19, section, side);
 571:         let (width, start) = match spine.spine_kind {
 572:             SpaceProgram::MainCorridor => (8.0 + 2.0 * width_hash, 6.0 + 10.0 * phase_hash),
 573:             _ => (4.0 + 1.6 * width_hash, 10.0 + 8.0 * phase_hash),
 574:         };
 575:         let offset = along.rem_euclid(span);
 576:         offset >= start && offset < start + width
 577:     }
 578: 
 579:     /// The architectural column plan: corridor beats assembly beats fabric.
 580:     #[cfg(test)]
 581:     pub(crate) fn plan_column(
 582:         plan: &RegionPlan,
 583:         noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
 584:         seed: u32,
 585:         tuning: &LevelTuning,
 586:         wx: f32,
 587:         wz: f32,
 588:     ) -> ColumnPlan {
 589:         Self::plan_column_in_reality(
 590:             plan,
 591:             noise,
 592:             seed,
 593:             &GeneratorConfig::low_spec().with_tuning(*tuning),
 594:             &RealitySnapshot::empty(),
 595:             wx,
 596:             wz,
 597:         )
 598:     }
 599: 
 600:     pub(crate) fn plan_column_in_reality(
 601:         plan: &RegionPlan,
 602:         noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
 603:         seed: u32,
 604:         config: &GeneratorConfig,
 605:         reality: &RealitySnapshot,
 606:         wx: f32,
 607:         wz: f32,
 608:     ) -> ColumnPlan {
 609:         let tuning = &config.tuning;
 610:         // -- circulation ----------------------------------------------------
 611:         let mut in_corridor = false;
 612:         let mut corridor_ceiling = 0.0f32;
 613:         let mut corridor_light = false;
 614:         let mut corridor_wall = false;
 615:         let mut corridor_gap = false;
 616:         for s in &plan.corridors {
 617:             let (d, along, is_horizontal) = s.nearest(wx, wz);
 618:             let half = s.width * 0.5;
 619:             if d <= half {
 620:                 in_corridor = true;
 621:                 corridor_ceiling =
 622:                     corridor_ceiling.max(Self::corridor_ceiling(s, noise, seed, wx, wz));
 623:                 // Light strip modules follow the corridor in world space.
 624:                 if d < 0.45 && along.rem_euclid(4.0) < 1.0 {
 625:                     corridor_light = true;
 626:                 }
 627:             } else if d <= half + PLAN_WALL_T {
 628:                 corridor_wall = true;
 629:                 corridor_ceiling =
 630:                     corridor_ceiling.max(Self::corridor_ceiling(s, noise, seed, wx, wz));
 631:                 if Self::corridor_edge_opens(s, noise, seed, along, is_horizontal, wx, wz) {
 632:                     corridor_gap = true;
 633:                 }
 634:             }
 635:         }
 636:         if in_corridor {
 637:             return ColumnPlan {
 638:                 light: corridor_light && tuning.lights > 0.0,
 639:                 ..ColumnPlan::open(corridor_ceiling)
 640:             };
 641:         }
 642: 
 643:         // Archway anchors take precedence over every hostile family, and any
 644:         // hostile column within an anchor's margin generates as if no epoch
 645:         // had ever advanced: arch rooms and their surroundings are immune to
 646:         // non-Euclidean transformation by construction, not by policy.
 647:         if let Some(anchor) = plan
 648:             .anomalies
 649:             .iter()
 650:             .find(|a| a.kind == AnomalyKind::ArchwayRoom && a.contains(wx, wz))
 651:         {
 652:             return sample_anomaly(anchor, noise, seed, config, reality, wx, wz);
 653:         }
 654:         let near_anchor = plan.anomalies.iter().any(|a| {
 655:             a.kind == AnomalyKind::ArchwayRoom
 656:                 && a.footprint.bounds().expanded(3.2).contains(wx, wz)
 657:         });
 658: 
 659:         if let Some(instance) = plan
 660:             .anomalies
 661:             .iter()
 662:             .filter(|a| {
 663:                 a.kind != AnomalyKind::RedRoom
 664:                     && a.kind != AnomalyKind::ArchwayRoom
 665:                     && a.contains(wx, wz)
 666:             })
 667:             .max_by(|a, b| {
 668:                 a.normalized_depth(wx, wz)
 669:                     .total_cmp(&b.normalized_depth(wx, wz))
 670:             })
 671:         {
 672:             let frozen = RealitySnapshot::empty();
 673:             let effective_reality = if near_anchor { &frozen } else { reality };
 674:             return sample_anomaly(instance, noise, seed, config, effective_reality, wx, wz);
 675:         }
 676: 
 677:         // -- assemblies -------------------------------------------------------
 678:         {
 679:             let renovator_structure = plan.architects.get(1).map(|g| StructuralSystemInstance {
 680:                 system: g.structural_system,
 681:                 bay_x: 3.6,
 682:                 bay_z: 4.4,
 683:                 phase: (1.6, 2.4),
 684:                 column_side: 0.4,
 685:             });
 686:             for a in &plan.assemblies {
 687:                 let b = a.footprint.bounds();
 688:                 let t = PLAN_WALL_T;
 689:                 if wx < b.0 - t || wx > b.2 + t || wz < b.1 - t || wz > b.3 + t {
 690:                     continue;
 691:                 }
 692:                 let inside = a.footprint.contains(wx, wz);
 693:                 let base =
 694:                     Self::assembly_column(a, inside, renovator_structure.as_ref(), tuning, wx, wz);
 695:                 if a.corruption.red_room
 696:                     && let Some(red) = plan.anomalies.iter().find(|r| {
 697:                         r.kind == AnomalyKind::RedRoom
 698:                             && r.footprint
 699:                                 .bounds()
 700:                                 .expanded(PLAN_WALL_T + 0.05)
 701:                                 .contains(wx, wz)
 702:                     })
 703:                 {
 704:                     return sample_red_room(red, base, config, reality, wx, wz);
 705:                 }
 706:                 return base;
 707:             }
 708:         }
 709: 
 710:         // -- corridor edge walls through fabric -------------------------------
 711:         if corridor_wall && tuning.walls > 0.0 && !corridor_gap {
 712:             return ColumnPlan {
 713:                 solid: true,
 714:                 ..ColumnPlan::open(corridor_ceiling.max(3.2))
 715:             };
 716:         }
 717: 
 718:         // -- the endless unplanned office fabric -------------------------------
 719:         Self::column_plan(noise, seed, tuning, wx, wz)
 720:     }
 721: }
 722: 
 723: impl LevelGenerator for BackroomsLevel {
 724:     fn generate(
 725:         &self,
 726:         chunk_pos: Position,
 727:         seed: u32,
 728:         config: GeneratorConfig,
 729:         noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
 730:     ) -> VoxelGrid {
 731:         self.generate_with_reality(chunk_pos, seed, config, noise, &RealitySnapshot::empty())
 732:     }
 733: 
 734:     fn generate_with_reality(
 735:         &self,
 736:         chunk_pos: Position,
 737:         seed: u32,
 738:         config: GeneratorConfig,
 739:         noise: &dyn NoiseProvider,
 740:         reality: &RealitySnapshot,
 741:     ) -> VoxelGrid {
 742:         let s = config.voxel_scale;
 743:         let width = (config.chunk_size / s).round() as usize;
 744:         let depth = (config.chunk_size / s).round() as usize;
 745:         let height = (GRID_HEIGHT_UNITS / s) as usize;
 746:         let mut grid = VoxelGrid::new(width, height, depth);
 747: 
 748:         // Base plans remain available for the authored threshold and for
 749:         // ordinary reality. A committed Red Room adds a second, explicitly
 750:         // addressed Level 0 window instead of smuggling offsets and seeds
 751:         // through the voxel loop.
 752:         let plans =
 753:             BackroomsLevel::region_plans_for(chunk_pos, config.chunk_size, seed, &config, noise);
 754:         let recursive_level = RecursiveLevelWindow::around_chunk(
 755:             chunk_pos,
 756:             config.chunk_size,
 757:             1.0,
 758:             seed,
 759:             config,
 760:             noise,
 761:             reality,
 762:         );
 763: 
 764:         // Architecture first: plan every region this chunk overlaps.
 765:         let plan_of = |wx: f32, wz: f32| -> &RegionPlan {
 766:             let key = (region_index(wx), region_index(wz));
 767:             plans
 768:                 .iter()
 769:                 .find(|(k, _)| *k == key)
 770:                 .map(|(_, p)| p)
 771:                 .expect("region window covers the requested voxel halo")
 772:         };
 773: 
 774:         // Export semantic crossings/hazards from the same immutable plans as
 775:         // voxel geometry. Neighboring region plans repeat macro instances, so
 776:         // deduplicate by stable IDs before the payload reaches the engine.
 777:         let chunk_bounds = WorldBounds::new(
 778:             chunk_pos.x,
 779:             chunk_pos.z,
 780:             chunk_pos.x + config.chunk_size,
 781:             chunk_pos.z + config.chunk_size,
 782:         );
 783:         let mut seen_instances = std::collections::HashSet::new();
 784:         let mut seen_gates = std::collections::HashSet::new();
 785:         let mut seen_hazards = std::collections::HashSet::new();
 786:         let authored_bounds = recursive_level.as_ref().map_or(chunk_bounds, |recursive| {
 787:             recursive.to_recursive_bounds(chunk_bounds)
 788:         });
 789:         let mut export_interactions = |plan: &RegionPlan| {
 790:             for anomaly in &plan.anomalies {
 791:                 if !seen_instances.insert(anomaly.id)
 792:                     || !anomaly
 793:                         .footprint
 794:                         .bounds()
 795:                         .intersects(authored_bounds.expanded(1.0))
 796:                 {
 797:                     continue;
 798:                 }
 799:                 for gate in anomaly.traversal_gates() {
 800:                     if gate_crosses_bounds(gate, authored_bounds) && seen_gates.insert(gate.id) {
 801:                         grid.traversal_gates.push(
 802:                             recursive_level
 803:                                 .as_ref()
 804:                                 .map_or(*gate, |recursive| recursive.project_gate(*gate)),
 805:                         );
 806:                     }
 807:                 }
 808:                 for hazard in anomaly.pit_hazards_for_bounds(authored_bounds) {
 809:                     if seen_hazards.insert(hazard.id) {
 810:                         grid.pit_hazards.push(
 811:                             recursive_level
 812:                                 .as_ref()
 813:                                 .map_or(hazard, |recursive| recursive.project_hazard(hazard)),
 814:                         );
 815:                     }
 816:                 }
 817:             }
 818:         };
 819:         if let Some(recursive) = &recursive_level {
 820:             for (_, plan) in recursive.iter() {
 821:                 export_interactions(plan);
 822:             }
 823:         } else {
 824:             for (_, plan) in &plans {
 825:                 export_interactions(plan);
 826:             }
 827:         }
 828:         drop(export_interactions);
 829: 
 830:         // The recursive branch supplies its own anomaly semantics, while the
 831:         // encounter that opened it retains one checkpoint in visible space.
 832:         // Alternating across that authored plane advances the closed loop.
 833:         if let Some(recursive) = &recursive_level {
 834:             for gate in plans
 835:                 .iter()
 836:                 .flat_map(|(_, plan)| plan.anomalies.iter())
 837:                 .filter(|anomaly| anomaly.id == recursive.instance_id())
 838:                 .flat_map(AnomalyInstance::traversal_gates)
 839:                 .filter(|gate| gate.kind == TraversalGateKind::RedLoop)
 840:             {
 841:                 if gate_crosses_bounds(gate, chunk_bounds) && seen_gates.insert(gate.id) {
 842:                     grid.traversal_gates.push(*gate);
 843:                 }
 844:             }
 845:         }
 846: 
 847:         use crate::domain::entities::architecture::{LightKind, RuntimeLight};
 848:         let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();
 849:         let mut collect_runtime_lights = |plan: &RegionPlan| {
 850:             for a in &plan.assemblies {
 851:                 if a.corruption.abandoned {
 852:                     continue;
 853:                 }
 854:                 for f in &a.fixtures {
 855:                     if !f.lit {
 856:                         continue;
 857:                     }
 858:                     let rendered_at = recursive_level
 859:                         .as_ref()
 860:                         .map_or(f.at, |recursive| recursive.project_position(f.at));
 861:                     let key = (rendered_at.x.to_bits(), rendered_at.z.to_bits());
 862:                     if !seen.insert(key) {
 863:                         continue;
 864:                     }
 865: 
 866:                     let (sample_at, fixture_plan) = if let Some(recursive) = &recursive_level {
 867:                         recursive
 868:                             .plan_at(rendered_at)
 869:                             .expect("recursive region window covers its projected fixtures")
 870:                     } else {
 871:                         (f.at, plan_of(f.at.x, f.at.z))
 872:                     };
 873: 
 874:                     // Region-scale anomaly interiors own their fixture
 875:                     // rhythm. Do not leak an overwritten assembly's runtime
 876:                     // light into a blackout/pillar/pit payload.
 877:                     if fixture_plan.anomalies.iter().any(|anomaly| {
 878:                         anomaly.kind != AnomalyKind::RedRoom
 879:                             && anomaly.contains(sample_at.x, sample_at.z)
 880:                     }) {
 881:                         continue;
 882:                     }
 883: 
 884:                     let cx = rendered_at.x - chunk_pos.x;
 885:                     let cz = rendered_at.z - chunk_pos.z;
 886:                     if cx >= -15.0
 887:                         && cx <= config.chunk_size + 15.0
 888:                         && cz >= -15.0
 889:                         && cz <= config.chunk_size + 15.0
 890:                     {
 891:                         let ceiling_units = a
 892:                             .ceiling_zones
 893:                             .iter()
 894:                             .find(|z| z.area.contains(f.at.x, f.at.z))
 895:                             .map(|z| z.height_units)
 896:                             .unwrap_or(4.0);
 897:                         let is_atrium = matches!(
 898:                             a.program,
 899:                             crate::domain::entities::architecture::SpaceProgram::Atrium
 900:                         );
 901:                         let y = runtime_light_height(ceiling_units, is_atrium);
 902: 
 903:                         let kind = if f.half_x > f.half_z * 2.0 || f.half_z > f.half_x * 2.0 {
 904:                             LightKind::Strip
 905:                         } else {
 906:                             LightKind::CeilingPanel
 907:                         };
 908: 
 909:                         // Runtime lights are collected before voxelization, so
 910:                         // query the architectural column plan rather than the
 911:                         // still-empty grid when rejecting pillar intersections.
 912:                         let is_buried = if let Some(recursive) = &recursive_level {
 913:                             BackroomsLevel::plan_column_in_reality(
 914:                                 fixture_plan,
 915:                                 noise,
 916:                                 recursive.seed(),
 917:                                 recursive.config(),
 918:                                 reality,
 919:                                 sample_at.x,
 920:                                 sample_at.z,
 921:                             )
 922:                             .solid
 923:                         } else {
 924:                             BackroomsLevel::plan_column_in_reality(
 925:                                 fixture_plan,
 926:                                 noise,
 927:                                 seed,
 928:                                 &config,
 929:                                 reality,
 930:                                 sample_at.x,
 931:                                 sample_at.z,
 932:                             )
 933:                             .solid
 934:                         };
 935: 
 936:                         if !is_buried {
 937:                             // Red rooms are exposed purely by their light
 938:                             // color; the fixtures keep the room's spacing.
 939:                             let rgb = if recursive_level.is_some() || a.corruption.red_room {
 940:                                 [1.0, 0.22, 0.16]
 941:                             } else {
 942:                                 [1.0, 0.95, 0.8]
 943:                             };
 944:                             grid.runtime_lights.push(RuntimeLight {
 945:                                 world_pos: [rendered_at.x, y, rendered_at.z],
 946:                                 half_size: [f.half_x, f.half_z],
 947:                                 rgb,
 948:                                 range: if is_atrium { 24.0 } else { 16.0 },
 949:                                 intensity: if is_atrium { 4.0 } else { 1.0 },
 950:                                 enabled: true,
 951:                                 kind,
 952:                             });
 953:                         }
 954:                     }
 955:                 }
 956:             }
 957:         };
 958:         if let Some(recursive) = &recursive_level {
 959:             for (_, plan) in recursive.iter() {
 960:                 collect_runtime_lights(plan);
 961:             }
 962:         } else {
 963:             for (_, plan) in &plans {
 964:                 collect_runtime_lights(plan);
 965:             }
 966:         }
 967: 
 968:         // Plan every column plus a 1-voxel margin: ceiling skirts must seal
 969:         // height steps across chunk borders too.
 970:         let plan_at = |lx: i64, lz: i64| -> ColumnPlan {
 971:             let wx = chunk_pos.x + (lx as f32 + 0.5) * s;
 972:             let wz = chunk_pos.z + (lz as f32 + 0.5) * s;
 973: 
 974:             if let Some(recursive) = &recursive_level {
 975:                 let (recursive_point, plan) = recursive
 976:                     .plan_at(Position::new(wx, wz))
 977:                     .expect("recursive region window covers the voxel halo");
 978:                 let mut column = BackroomsLevel::plan_column_in_reality(
 979:                     plan,
 980:                     noise,
 981:                     recursive.seed(),
 982:                     recursive.config(),
 983:                     reality,
 984:                     recursive_point.x,
 985:                     recursive_point.z,
 986:                 );
 987:                 column.red_light = true;
 988:                 column
 989:             } else {
 990:                 BackroomsLevel::plan_column_in_reality(
 991:                     plan_of(wx, wz),
 992:                     noise,
 993:                     seed,
 994:                     &config,
 995:                     reality,
 996:                     wx,
 997:                     wz,
 998:                 )
 999:             }
1000:         };
1001: 
1002:         let columns = ColumnField::sample(width, depth, plan_at);
1003:         voxelize_columns(&mut grid, &columns, s);
1004: 
1005:         grid
1006:     }
1007: }

1009: #[cfg(test)]
1010: mod tests {
1011:     use super::*;
1012:     use crate::domain::entities::voxel_grid::{VOXEL_AIR, VOXEL_STICKY_CARPET};
1013:     use crate::frameworks_drivers::simple_noise::SimpleNoiseProvider;
1014:     use crate::use_cases::generate_chunk::LevelTuning;
1015:     use crate::use_cases::region_plan::REGION_SIZE;
1016: 
1017:     fn generate(ox: f32, oz: f32) -> VoxelGrid {
1018:         BackroomsLevel.generate(
1019:             Position::new(ox, oz),
1020:             42,
1021:             GeneratorConfig::low_spec(),
1022:             &SimpleNoiseProvider::new(),
1023:         )
1024:     }
1025: 
1026:     fn is_open(grid: &VoxelGrid, x: usize, z: usize) -> bool {
1027:         grid.get(x, 1, z) == VOXEL_AIR
1028:     }
1029: 
1030:     /// Walkable-plane connectivity: nearly all open floor must be mutually
1031:     /// reachable (walls always leave doorways, pillars never seal a region).
1032:     /// We exclude a 2-voxel border to avoid edge-of-chunk artifacts where
1033:     /// walls at boundaries form isolated strips that would be connected by
1034:     /// the adjacent chunk at runtime.
1035:     #[test]
1036:     fn walkable_plane_is_connected() {
1037:         let grid = generate(0.0, 0.0);
1038:         let (w, d) = (grid.width(), grid.depth());
1039:         let margin = 2usize; // exclude edge voxels
1040: 
1041:         let open: Vec<(usize, usize)> = (margin..w - margin)
1042:             .flat_map(|x| (margin..d - margin).map(move |z| (x, z)))
1043:             .filter(|&(x, z)| is_open(&grid, x, z))
1044:             .collect();
1045:         assert!(
1046:             open.len() > (w - 2 * margin) * (d - 2 * margin) / 2,
1047:             "backrooms must be mostly open space"
1048:         );
1049: 
1050:         // BFS from the first open interior voxel.
1051:         let &(sx, sz) = open.first().expect("some open floor exists");
1052:         let mut visited = vec![false; w * d];
1053:         let mut queue = std::collections::VecDeque::from([(sx, sz)]);
1054:         visited[sx * d + sz] = true;
1055:         let mut reached = 0usize;
1056:         while let Some((x, z)) = queue.pop_front() {
1057:             reached += 1;
1058:             for (dx, dz) in [(1i64, 0i64), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)] {
1059:                 let (nx, nz) = (x as i64 + dx, z as i64 + dz);
1060:                 if nx < margin as i64
1061:                     || nz < margin as i64
1062:                     || nx >= (w - margin) as i64
1063:                     || nz >= (d - margin) as i64
1064:                 {
1065:                     continue;
1066:                 }
1067:                 let (nx, nz) = (nx as usize, nz as usize);
1068:                 if !visited[nx * d + nz] && is_open(&grid, nx, nz) {
1069:                     visited[nx * d + nz] = true;
1070:                     queue.push_back((nx, nz));
1071:                 }
1072:             }
1073:         }
1074:         let ratio = reached as f32 / open.len() as f32;
1075:         assert!(
1076:             ratio > 0.95,
1077:             "only {:.0}% of open floor is reachable from spawn",
1078:             ratio * 100.0
1079:         );
1080:     }
1081: 
1082:     /// Adjacent chunks must agree at their shared border: the column at
1083:     /// world position g is the same whether it came from chunk A's last
1084:     /// column or chunk B's first.
1085:     #[test]
1086:     fn chunks_tile_seamlessly() {
1087:         let noise = SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
1088:         let config = GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
1089:         let a = generate(0.0, 0.0);
1090:         let b = generate(10.0, 0.0);
1091:         let w = a.width();
1092: 
1093:         let plans =
1094:             BackroomsLevel::region_plans_for(Position::new(0.0, 0.0), 20.0, 42, &config, &noise);
1095:         for z in 0..a.depth() {
1096:             for (grid, lx, gx) in [(&a, w - 1, w - 1), (&b, 0usize, w)] {
1097:                 let wx = (gx as f32 + 0.5) * config.voxel_scale;
1098:                 let wz = (z as f32 + 0.5) * config.voxel_scale;
1099:                 let key = (
1100:                     crate::use_cases::region_plan::region_index(wx),
1101:                     crate::use_cases::region_plan::region_index(wz),
1102:                 );
1103:                 let plan = plans
1104:                     .iter()
1105:                     .find(|(k, _)| *k == key)
1106:                     .map(|(_, p)| p)
1107:                     .unwrap();
1108:                 let expect =
1109:                     BackroomsLevel::plan_column(plan, &noise, 42, &LevelTuning::default(), wx, wz);
1110:                 let got_solid = grid.get(lx, 1, z) == VOXEL_WALL;
1111:                 assert_eq!(
1112:                     got_solid, expect.solid,
1113:                     "column mismatch at world x={gx} z={z}"
1114:                 );
1115:             }
1116:         }
1117:     }

1119:     #[test]
1120:     fn recursive_level_zero_is_independent_of_output_partition() {
1121:         use crate::domain::entities::anomaly::{
1122:             AnomalyStateStamp, Axis2, AxisDirection, RedRoomPhase,
1123:         };
1124: 
1125:         // A committed encounter selects a deterministic recursive Level 0
1126:         // address.  The ID is intentionally wider than f32 can represent so
1127:         // this also protects the integer-first branch derivation.
1128:         let reality = RealitySnapshot::new(vec![AnomalyStateStamp::new(
1129:             0xDEAD_BEEF_1234_5678,
1130:             1,
1131:             4.8,
1132:             Axis2::X,
1133:             AxisDirection::Positive,
1134:             RedRoomPhase::Sealed,
1135:             0,
1136:             0xCAFE,
1137:         )]);
1138:         let noise = SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
1139:         let small_config = GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
1140:         let mut large_config = small_config;
1141:         large_config.chunk_size = 20.0;
1142: 
1143:         let large = BackroomsLevel.generate_with_reality(
1144:             Position::new(0.0, 0.0),
1145:             42,
1146:             large_config,
1147:             &noise,
1148:             &reality,
1149:         );
1150:         let chunks = [
1151:             BackroomsLevel.generate_with_reality(
1152:                 Position::new(0.0, 0.0),
1153:                 42,
1154:                 small_config,
1155:                 &noise,
1156:                 &reality,
1157:             ),
1158:             BackroomsLevel.generate_with_reality(
1159:                 Position::new(10.0, 0.0),
1160:                 42,
1161:                 small_config,
1162:                 &noise,
1163:                 &reality,
1164:             ),
1165:             BackroomsLevel.generate_with_reality(
1166:                 Position::new(0.0, 10.0),
1167:                 42,
1168:                 small_config,
1169:                 &noise,
1170:                 &reality,

1200:     /// The plan is authoritative: corridor centerlines must be carved open
1201:     /// in the voxelized chunks they cross.
1202:     #[test]
1203:     fn corridors_from_the_plan_are_carved_open() {
1204:         let noise = SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
1205:         let config = GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
1206:         let plans =
1207:             BackroomsLevel::region_plans_for(Position::new(0.0, 0.0), 80.0, 42, &config, &noise);
1208:         let plan = &plans.iter().find(|(k, _)| *k == (0, 0)).unwrap().1;
1209:         let spine = &plan.corridors[0];
1210: 
1211:         let mut checked = 0;
1212:         for seg in spine.path.windows(2) {
1213:             let (p0, p1) = (seg[0], seg[1]);
1214:             let steps = 8;
1215:             for k in 1..steps {
1216:                 let t = k as f32 / steps as f32;
1217:                 let (wx, wz) = (p0.x + (p1.x - p0.x) * t, p0.z + (p1.z - p0.z) * t);
1218:                 // Stay inside region (0,0) and off chunk edges.
1219:                 if !(1.0..79.0).contains(&wx) || !(1.0..79.0).contains(&wz) {
1220:                     continue;
1221:                 }
1222:                 let (cx, cz) = ((wx / 10.0).floor() * 10.0, (wz / 10.0).floor() * 10.0);
1223:                 let grid = generate(cx, cz);
1224:                 let (lx, lz) = (
1225:                     ((wx - cx) / config.voxel_scale) as usize,
1226:                     ((wz - cz) / config.voxel_scale) as usize,
1227:                 );
1228:                 assert!(
1229:                     is_open(&grid, lx.min(grid.width() - 1), lz.min(grid.depth() - 1)),
1230:                     "main corridor blocked at world ({wx:.1}, {wz:.1})"
1231:                 );
1232:                 checked += 1;
1233:             }
1234:         }
1235:         assert!(checked > 5, "spine barely sampled ({checked} points)");
1236:     }

1287:     /// Assemblies voxelize as walled rooms whose planned entrance is open
1288:     /// (with a lintel when the designer's threshold language wants one).
1289:     #[test]
1290:     fn assemblies_have_walls_and_open_entrances() {
1291:         let noise = SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
1292:         let mut config = GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
1293:         config.anomalies.frequency = 0.0;
1294:         let tuning = LevelTuning::default();
1295:         let plans =
1296:             BackroomsLevel::region_plans_for(Position::new(0.0, 0.0), 80.0, 42, &config, &noise);
1297:         let plan = &plans.iter().find(|(k, _)| *k == (0, 0)).unwrap().1;
1298:         assert!(!plan.assemblies.is_empty());
1299: 
1300:         for a in &plan.assemblies {
1301:             let e = &a.entrances[0];
1302:             // The entrance column itself: open (possibly under a lintel).
1303:             let door =
1304:                 BackroomsLevel::plan_column(plan, &noise, 42, &tuning, e.center.x, e.center.z);
1305:             assert!(!door.solid, "assembly {} door is walled shut", a.id);
1306:             // Somewhere along the same front wall, clear of the door span,
1307:             // there must be solid wall. Probe the middle of the wall band
1308:             // (the entrance center sits exactly on the footprint boundary,
1309:             // where containment is ambiguous).
1310:             let b = a.footprint.bounds();
1311:             let band = |c: f32, lo: f32, hi: f32| {
1312:                 if (c - lo).abs() < (c - hi).abs() {
1313:                     lo - PLAN_WALL_T * 0.5
1314:                 } else {
1315:                     hi + PLAN_WALL_T * 0.5
1316:                 }
1317:             };
1318:             let (lo, hi, door_along) = if e.through_x_wall {
1319:                 (b.0, b.2, e.center.x)
1320:             } else {
1321:                 (b.1, b.3, e.center.z)
1322:             };
1323:             let mut solid_found = false;
1324:             let mut along = lo + 0.3;
1325:             while along < hi - 0.2 {
1326:                 if (along - door_along).abs() > e.width * 0.5 + 0.4 {
1327:                     let (wx, wz) = if e.through_x_wall {
1328:                         (along, band(e.center.z, b.1, b.3))
1329:                     } else {
1330:                         (band(e.center.x, b.0, b.2), along)
1331:                     };
1332:                     if BackroomsLevel::plan_column(plan, &noise, 42, &tuning, wx, wz).solid {
1333:                         solid_found = true;
1334:                         break;
1335:                     }
1336:                 }
1337:                 along += 0.2;
1338:             }
1339:             assert!(
1340:                 solid_found,
1341:                 "assembly {} has no solid front wall anywhere",
1342:                 a.id
1343:             );
1344:         }
1345:     }

1347:     /// An abandoned expansion is a dark shell: it keeps its walls but none of
1348:     /// its fixtures are lit.
1349:     #[test]
1350:     fn abandoned_expansions_are_unlit() {
1351:         let noise = SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
1352:         let config = GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
1353:         let tuning = LevelTuning::default();
1354:         let mut found = false;
1355:         for rx in -3i64..3 {
1356:             for rz in -3i64..3 {
1357:                 let plans = BackroomsLevel::region_plans_for(
1358:                     Position::new(rx as f32 * 80.0, rz as f32 * 80.0),
1359:                     1.0,
1360:                     42,
1361:                     &config,
1362:                     &noise,
1363:                 );
1364:                 let plan = &plans[0].1;
1365:                 for a in &plan.assemblies {
1366:                     if !a.corruption.abandoned {
1367:                         continue;
1368:                     }
1369:                     found = true;
1370:                     let (x0, z0, x1, z1) = a.footprint.bounds();
1371:                     // No interior column may carry a lit fixture.
1372:                     let mut probe_z = z0 + 0.6;
1373:                     while probe_z < z1 - 0.4 {
1374:                         let mut probe_x = x0 + 0.6;
1375:                         while probe_x < x1 - 0.4 {
1376:                             // A corridor clipping the footprint may still run
1377:                             // its own lit strip through the shell — that is
1378:                             // canon ("unreachable but still lit"). Only the
1379:                             // room's fixtures must be dark.
1380:                             let in_corridor = plan
1381:                                 .corridors
1382:                                 .iter()
1383:                                 .any(|s| s.distance(probe_x, probe_z) <= s.width * 0.5);
1384:                             if !in_corridor {
1385:                                 let c = BackroomsLevel::plan_column(
1386:                                     plan, &noise, 42, &tuning, probe_x, probe_z,
1387:                                 );
1388:                                 assert!(!c.light, "abandoned assembly {} is lit", a.id);
1389:                             }
1390:                             probe_x += 0.8;
1391:                         }
1392:                         probe_z += 0.8;
1393:                     }
1394:                 }
1395:             }
1396:         }
1397:         assert!(found, "no abandoned expansion within 36 regions");
1398:     }

1400:     /// The baseline is broad regular dropped ceiling, with enough expansive
1401:     /// and vaulted territory to prevent Level 0 from reading as a low maze.
1402:     #[test]
1403:     fn ceilings_are_vast_and_varied() {
1404:         let noise = SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
1405:         let mut counts = [0usize; 4];
1406:         let mut lowest = f32::MAX;
1407:         let mut tallest = 0.0f32;
1408:         for z in (-600..=600).step_by(8) {
1409:             for x in (-600..=600).step_by(8) {
1410:                 let (wx, wz) = (x as f32 + 0.5, z as f32 + 0.5);
1411:                 let band = BackroomsLevel::fabric_ceiling_band(&noise, 42, wx, wz);
1412:                 let ceiling = BackroomsLevel::fabric_ceiling_height(&noise, 42, wx, wz, band);
1413:                 let index = match band {
1414:                     FabricCeilingBand::Compression => 0,
1415:                     FabricCeilingBand::Regular => 1,
1416:                     FabricCeilingBand::Expanse => 2,
1417:                     FabricCeilingBand::Vault => 3,
1418:                 };
1419:                 counts[index] += 1;
1420:                 lowest = lowest.min(ceiling);
1421:                 tallest = tallest.max(ceiling);
1422:             }
1423:         }
1424:         let total = counts.iter().sum::<usize>() as f32;
1425:         let ratio = |index| counts[index] as f32 / total;
1426:         // The labyrinth fabric is the default; open volumes punctuate it.
1427:         assert!(
1428:             (0.60..=0.85).contains(&ratio(1)),
1429:             "ceiling territories: compression {:.1}%, regular {:.1}%, expanse {:.1}%, vault {:.1}%",
1430:             ratio(0) * 100.0,
1431:             ratio(1) * 100.0,
1432:             ratio(2) * 100.0,
1433:             ratio(3) * 100.0
1434:         );
1435:         assert!(
1436:             (0.10..=0.28).contains(&ratio(2)),
1437:             "open expanse territory was {:.1}%",
1438:             ratio(2) * 100.0
1439:         );
1440:         assert!(
1441:             (0.03..=0.15).contains(&ratio(3)),
1442:             "vault territory was {:.1}%",
1443:             ratio(3) * 100.0
1444:         );
1445:         assert!(
1446:             (0.01..=0.10).contains(&ratio(0)),
1447:             "compression territory was {:.1}%",
1448:             ratio(0) * 100.0
1449:         );
1450:         assert!(
1451:             lowest <= 2.8 && tallest >= 4.5,
1452:             "ceiling range was only {lowest:.1}--{tallest:.1} u"
1453:         );
1454:     }

1495:     /// The generation knobs actually steer the output: zeroing pillars and
1496:     /// walls empties the world of solids; cranking them fills it back up.
1497:     #[test]
1498:     fn tuning_knobs_control_density() {
1499:         let noise = SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
1500:         // Aggregate over chunks in different fabric regimes (walled rooms
1501:         // and open expanses) so both knobs have something to steer.
1502:         let count_solids = |tuning: LevelTuning| -> usize {
1503:             let mut n = 0;
1504:             for (ox, oz) in [(10.0, 10.0), (30.0, 10.0), (50.0, 30.0), (10.0, 50.0)] {
1505:                 let grid = BackroomsLevel.generate(
1506:                     Position::new(ox, oz),
1507:                     42,
1508:                     GeneratorConfig::low_spec().with_tuning(tuning),
1509:                     &noise,
1510:                 );
1511:                 for z in 0..grid.depth() {
1512:                     for x in 0..grid.width() {
1513:                         if grid.get(x, 1, z) != VOXEL_AIR {
1514:                             n += 1;
1515:                         }
1516:                     }
1517:                 }
1518:             }
1519:             n
1520:         };
1521: 
1522:         let none = count_solids(LevelTuning {
1523:             pillars: 0.0,
1524:             walls: 0.0,
1525:             ..Default::default()
1526:         });
1527:         let sparse = count_solids(LevelTuning {
1528:             pillars: 0.3,
1529:             walls: 0.3,
1530:             ..Default::default()
1531:         });
1532:         let default = count_solids(LevelTuning::default());
1533:         let dense = count_solids(LevelTuning {
1534:             pillars: 2.0,
1535:             walls: 2.0,
1536:             ..Default::default()
1537:         });
1538: 
1539:         assert_eq!(none, 0, "pillars=0 walls=0 must produce an empty plane");
1540:         assert!(
1541:             sparse < default,
1542:             "sparse ({sparse}) must be < default ({default})"
1543:         );
1544:         assert!(
1545:             default < dense,
1546:             "default ({default}) must be < dense ({dense})"
1547:         );
1548:     }

1550:     /// Every LOD of a chunk must voxelize the same plan: coarse walls stay
1551:     /// within one fine voxel of fine walls (the streaming engine swaps LODs
1552:     /// of a chunk in place, so they must be faithful proxies).
1553:     #[test]
1554:     fn lods_of_the_same_chunk_correspond() {
1555:         let noise = SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
1556:         let fine = BackroomsLevel.generate(
1557:             Position::new(10.0, 10.0),
1558:             42,
1559:             GeneratorConfig::low_spec(),
1560:             &noise,
1561:         );
1562:         let coarse = BackroomsLevel.generate(
1563:             Position::new(10.0, 10.0),
1564:             42,
1565:             GeneratorConfig::low_spec().at_lod(1),
1566:             &noise,
1567:         );
1568:         let solid = |g: &VoxelGrid, x: usize, z: usize| g.get(x, 1, z) == VOXEL_WALL;
1569:         let (mut matches, mut total) = (0usize, 0usize);
1570:         for z in 0..coarse.depth() {
1571:             for x in 0..coarse.width() {
1572:                 if !solid(&coarse, x, z) {
1573:                     continue;
1574:                 }
1575:                 total += 1;
1576:                 let mut near = false;
1577:                 for dz in -1i32..=2 {
1578:                     for dx in -1i32..=2 {
1579:                         let (fx, fz) = (x as i32 * 2 + dx, z as i32 * 2 + dz);
1580:                         if fx >= 0
1581:                             && fz >= 0
1582:                             && (fx as usize) < fine.width()
1583:                             && (fz as usize) < fine.depth()
1584:                             && solid(&fine, fx as usize, fz as usize)
1585:                         {
1586:                             near = true;
1587:                         }
1588:                     }
1589:                 }
1590:                 if near {
1591:                     matches += 1;
1592:                 }
1593:             }
1594:         }
1595:         assert!(total > 0, "coarse chunk has no walls at all");
1596:         assert!(
1597:             matches * 10 >= total * 9,
1598:             "coarse walls stray from fine walls: {matches}/{total}"
1599:         );
1600:     }
````
