````rust
1602:     /// The player spawns *on the main corridor*: open floor along the
1603:     /// centerline, a lit fixture within a light-strip period, and — for the
1604:     /// readable opening sequence — solid edge walls on both sides.
1605:     #[test]
1606:     fn spawn_is_a_readable_walled_corridor() {
1607:         let noise = SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
1608:         let config = GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
1609:         let tuning = LevelTuning::default();
1610:         let sp = crate::use_cases::region_plan::spawn_point(42);
1611: 
1612:         let plans =
1613:             BackroomsLevel::region_plans_for(Position::new(0.0, 0.0), 80.0, 42, &config, &noise);
1614:         let plan = &plans.iter().find(|(k, _)| *k == (0, 0)).unwrap().1;
1615:         let spine = &plan.corridors[0];
1616:         assert!(
1617:             spine.distance(sp.x, sp.z) < 0.3,
1618:             "spawn ({}, {}) is not on the main corridor centerline",
1619:             sp.x,
1620:             sp.z
1621:         );
1622: 
1623:         // The corridor around spawn is open along the centerline, lit, and
1624:         // predominantly walled on both sides. Framed entrances and branch
1625:         // tees may pierce the run, but the edge must *read* as a wall — no
1626:         // dissolution into open fabric inside the readable radius.
1627:         let half = spine.width * 0.5;
1628:         let mut lit = false;
1629:         let mut solid_edges = [0usize; 2];
1630:         const STEPS: usize = 16;
1631:         for step in 0..STEPS {
1632:             let wx = sp.x + step as f32;
1633:             let c = BackroomsLevel::plan_column(plan, &noise, 42, &tuning, wx, sp.z);
1634:             assert!(!c.solid, "main corridor blocked at ({wx}, {})", sp.z);
1635:             lit |= c.light;
1636:             for (i, side) in [-1.0, 1.0f32].iter().enumerate() {
1637:                 let wz = sp.z + side * (half + PLAN_WALL_T * 0.5);
1638:                 if BackroomsLevel::plan_column(plan, &noise, 42, &tuning, wx, wz).solid {
1639:                     solid_edges[i] += 1;
1640:                 }
1641:             }
1642:         }
1643:         assert!(lit, "no lit fixture along the first {STEPS} u of corridor");
1644:         for (i, solid) in solid_edges.iter().enumerate() {
1645:             assert!(
1646:                 solid * 10 >= STEPS * 6,
1647:                 "start corridor side {i} is mostly open ({solid}/{STEPS}): \
1648:                  the opening sequence must read as a walled corridor"
1649:             );
1650:         }
1651:     }
1652: 
1653:     /// The fabric connectivity invariant: every warren cell opens through
1654:     /// its west or its north wall (doorway, dropped wall, or an override by
1655:     /// corridor/assembly/expanse), so the labyrinth is globally connected
1656:     /// by induction — no chunk ever needs to see its neighbors to prove it.
1657:     #[test]
1658:     fn every_fabric_cell_opens_west_or_north() {
1659:         let noise = SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
1660:         let config = GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
1661:         let tuning = LevelTuning::default();
1662:         let mut cells_checked = 0usize;
1663:         for cell_x in -40i64..40 {
1664:             for cell_z in -40i64..40 {
1665:                 let x0 = cell_x as f32 * FABRIC_CELL;
1666:                 let z0 = cell_z as f32 * FABRIC_CELL;
1667:                 let plans = BackroomsLevel::region_plans_for(
1668:                     Position::new(x0, z0),
1669:                     FABRIC_CELL,
1670:                     42,
1671:                     &config,
1672:                     &noise,
1673:                 );
1674:                 let plan_for = |wx: f32, wz: f32| {
1675:                     let key = (region_index(wx), region_index(wz));
1676:                     &plans.iter().find(|(k, _)| *k == key).unwrap().1
1677:                 };
1678:                 // The invariant belongs to *pure* fabric. Cells clipped by a
1679:                 // corridor edge or an assembly take their connectivity from
1680:                 // those systems instead (tested separately), so skip them.
1681:                 let (cx0, cz0) = (x0 - PLAN_WALL_T, z0 - PLAN_WALL_T);
1682:                 let (cx1, cz1) = (x0 + FABRIC_CELL, z0 + FABRIC_CELL);
1683:                 let clipped = plans.iter().any(|(_, p)| {
1684:                     p.corridors.iter().any(|s| {
1685:                         let m = s.width * 0.5 + PLAN_WALL_T + 0.1;
1686:                         [
1687:                             (cx0, cz0),
1688:                             (cx1, cz0),
1689:                             (cx0, cz1),
1690:                             (cx1, cz1),
1691:                             ((cx0 + cx1) * 0.5, (cz0 + cz1) * 0.5),
1692:                         ]
1693:                         .iter()
1694:                         .any(|&(px, pz)| s.distance(px, pz) <= m + FABRIC_CELL)
1695:                     }) || p.assemblies.iter().any(|a| {
1696:                         let b = a.footprint.bounds();
1697:                         cx0 < b.2 + PLAN_WALL_T
1698:                             && b.0 - PLAN_WALL_T < cx1
1699:                             && cz0 < b.3 + PLAN_WALL_T
1700:                             && b.1 - PLAN_WALL_T < cz1
1701:                     }) || p.anomalies.iter().any(|an| {
1702:                         // Anomaly interiors own their connectivity rules
1703:                         // (entrances, skeleton lanes, arch openings) and are
1704:                         // tested by their own family invariants.
1705:                         an.footprint
1706:                             .bounds()
1707:                             .expanded(PLAN_WALL_T + 0.1)
1708:                             .intersects(WorldBounds::new(cx0, cz0, cx1, cz1))
1709:                     })
1710:                 });
1711:                 if clipped {
1712:                     continue;
1713:                 }
1714:                 let mut open = false;
1715:                 let mut probe = |wx: f32, wz: f32| {
1716:                     let c =
1717:                         BackroomsLevel::plan_column(plan_for(wx, wz), &noise, 42, &tuning, wx, wz);
1718:                     if !c.solid {
1719:                         open = true;
1720:                     }
1721:                 };
1722:                 // Sample along the west and north wall bands of the cell.
1723:                 let mut a = PLAN_WALL_T + 0.1;
1724:                 while a < FABRIC_CELL - PLAN_WALL_T {
1725:                     probe(x0 + 0.2, z0 + a);
1726:                     probe(x0 + a, z0 + 0.2);
1727:                     a += 0.2;
1728:                 }
1729:                 assert!(
1730:                     open,
1731:                     "fabric cell ({cell_x},{cell_z}) is sealed on both its \
1732:                      west and north walls"
1733:                 );
1734:                 cells_checked += 1;
1735:             }
1736:         }
1737:         assert!(cells_checked > 1000, "sample too small: {cells_checked}");
1738:     }
1739: 
1740:     /// Red identity is owned by whole rooms: some region must contain a red
1741:     /// room whose fixtures voxelize as red lights, and crimson/peeled wall
1742:     /// voxels may appear only inside a red-room footprint (plus its wall
1743:     /// band) — the approach stain is telegraphy, never leakage into fabric.
1744:     #[test]
1745:     fn red_rooms_are_lit_red_but_never_built_red() {
1746:         use crate::domain::entities::voxel_grid::{VOXEL_RED_LIGHT, VOXEL_RED_WALL};
1747:         let noise = SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
1748:         let config = GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
1749:         let tuning = LevelTuning::default();
1750: 
1751:         let mut red_room_seen = false;
1752:         'search: for rx in -4i64..=4 {
1753:             for rz in -4i64..=4 {
1754:                 let plans = BackroomsLevel::region_plans_for(
1755:                     Position::new(rx as f32 * REGION_SIZE, rz as f32 * REGION_SIZE),
1756:                     1.0,
1757:                     42,
1758:                     &config,
1759:                     &noise,
1760:                 );
1761:                 let plan = &plans.iter().find(|(k, _)| *k == (rx, rz)).unwrap().1;
1762:                 for a in &plan.assemblies {
1763:                     if !a.corruption.red_room {
1764:                         continue;
1765:                     }
1766:                     assert!(!a.corruption.abandoned, "a red room must be occupied");
1767:                     // Its lit fixtures plan red lights.
1768:                     let f = a.fixtures.iter().find(|f| f.lit).expect("lit fixture");
1769:                     let c = BackroomsLevel::plan_column(plan, &noise, 42, &tuning, f.at.x, f.at.z);
1770:                     if c.light {
1771:                         assert!(c.red_light, "red-room fixture plans a warm light");
1772:                         red_room_seen = true;
1773:                         break 'search;
1774:                     }
1775:                 }
1776:             }
1777:         }
1778:         assert!(red_room_seen, "no red room found within 81 regions");
1779: 
1780:         // Red walls stay contained: any crimson voxel must sit inside some
1781:         // red-room footprint (plus wall band), and red lights appear only as
1782:         // ceiling lights.
1783:         for (ox, oz) in [(0.0, 0.0), (30.0, 10.0), (-40.0, 70.0), (150.0, -90.0)] {
1784:             let grid = generate(ox, oz);
1785:             let plans = BackroomsLevel::region_plans_for(
1786:                 Position::new(ox, oz),
1787:                 config.chunk_size,
1788:                 42,
1789:                 &config,
1790:                 &noise,
1791:             );
1792:             let scale = config.voxel_scale;
1793:             for z in 0..grid.depth() {
1794:                 for x in 0..grid.width() {
1795:                     for y in 0..grid.height() {
1796:                         if grid.get(x, y, z) == VOXEL_RED_WALL {
1797:                             panic!(
1798:                                 "VOXEL_RED_WALL should never be voxelized at {wx}, {y}, {wz}",
1799:                                 wx = ox + (x as f32 + 0.5) * scale,
1800:                                 wz = oz + (z as f32 + 0.5) * scale
1801:                             );
1802:                         }
1803:                     }
1804:                     // Red lights sit at ceiling height, never at floor level.
1805:                     assert_ne!(grid.get(x, 1, z), VOXEL_RED_LIGHT);
1806:                 }
1807:             }
1808:         }
1809:     }

1811:     fn find_macro_anomaly(kind: AnomalyKind) -> (GeneratorConfig, AnomalyInstance) {
1812:         let mut config = GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
1813:         config.anomalies.frequency = 4.0;
1814:         config.anomalies.pillar_expanses = (kind == AnomalyKind::PillarExpanse) as u8 as f32;
1815:         config.anomalies.blackouts = (kind == AnomalyKind::BlackoutExpanse) as u8 as f32;
1816:         config.anomalies.pit_lattices = (kind == AnomalyKind::PitLattice) as u8 as f32;
1817:         let noise = SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
1818:         for rz in 3i64..24 {
1819:             for rx in 3i64..24 {
1820:                 let plans = BackroomsLevel::region_plans_for(
1821:                     Position::new(rx as f32 * REGION_SIZE, rz as f32 * REGION_SIZE),
1822:                     1.0,
1823:                     42,
1824:                     &config,
1825:                     &noise,
1826:                 );
1827:                 if let Some(instance) = plans
1828:                     .iter()
1829:                     .flat_map(|(_, p)| &p.anomalies)
1830:                     .find(|a| a.kind == kind)
1831:                 {
1832:                     return (config, instance.clone());
1833:                 }
1834:             }
1835:         }
1836:         panic!("no {kind:?} fixture found");
1837:     }

1839:     #[test]
1840:     fn pillar_epoch_changes_only_committed_wake_and_preserves_bearing_lane() {
1841:         use crate::domain::entities::anomaly::{AnomalyStateStamp, AxisDirection};
1842:         let (mut config, instance) = find_macro_anomaly(AnomalyKind::PillarExpanse);
1843:         config.anomalies.remap_intensity = 4.0;
1844:         let gate = instance.gates[instance.gates.len() / 2];
1845:         let reality = RealitySnapshot::new(vec![AnomalyStateStamp::new(
1846:             instance.id,
1847:             1,
1848:             gate.plane,
1849:             gate.axis,
1850:             AxisDirection::Positive,
1851:             crate::domain::entities::anomaly::RedRoomPhase::Outside,
1852:             0,
1853:             0,
1854:         )]);
1855:         let empty = RealitySnapshot::empty();
1856:         let noise = SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
1857:         let mut changed = 0usize;
1858:         let mut unchanged_forward = 0usize;
1859:         let mut lz = -instance.footprint.half_z + 1.0;
1860:         while lz < instance.footprint.half_z - 1.0 {
1861:             let mut lx = -instance.footprint.half_x + 1.0;
1862:             while lx < instance.footprint.half_x - 1.0 {
1863:                 let p = instance.world_coords(lx, lz);
1864:                 let a = sample_anomaly(&instance, &noise, 42, &config, &empty, p.x, p.z);
1865:                 let b = sample_anomaly(&instance, &noise, 42, &config, &reality, p.x, p.z);
1866:                 let in_wake =
1867:                     reality.stamps()[0].point_is_in_wake(p.x, p.z, config.anomalies.remap_distance);
1868:                 if a.solid != b.solid {
1869:                     assert!(in_wake, "geometry changed ahead of the crossed gate");
1870:                     assert!(lz.abs() > instance.skeleton_half_width);
1871:                     changed += 1;
1872:                 } else if !in_wake {
1873:                     unchanged_forward += 1;
1874:                 }
1875:                 if lz.abs() <= instance.skeleton_half_width {
1876:                     assert!(!a.solid && !b.solid, "bearing lane was blocked");
1877:                 }
1878:                 lx += 0.4;
1879:             }
1880:             lz += 0.4;
1881:         }
1882:         assert!(changed > 0, "pillar epoch produced no changed wake infill");
1883:         assert!(unchanged_forward > 100);
1884:     }

2074:     /// Arch rooms are the stable contrast: pale walls, deep wet carpet, no
2075:     /// gates, and geometry provably identical under any encounter state —
2076:     /// even a fabricated stamp for their own instance id changes nothing.
2077:     #[test]
2078:     fn archway_rooms_are_stable_pale_anchors() {
2079:         use crate::domain::entities::anomaly::{AnomalyStateStamp, Axis2, AxisDirection};
2080:         use crate::domain::entities::voxel_grid::{VOXEL_DEEP_CARPET, VOXEL_PALE_WALL};
2081:         let mut config = GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
2082:         config.anomalies.frequency = 4.0;
2083:         config.anomalies.pillar_expanses = 0.0;
2084:         config.anomalies.blackouts = 0.0;
2085:         config.anomalies.pit_lattices = 0.0;
2086:         let noise = SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
2087:         let mut found = None;
2088:         'search: for rz in 3i64..24 {
2089:             for rx in 3i64..24 {
2090:                 let plans = BackroomsLevel::region_plans_for(
2091:                     Position::new(rx as f32 * REGION_SIZE, rz as f32 * REGION_SIZE),
2092:                     1.0,
2093:                     42,
2094:                     &config,
2095:                     &noise,
2096:                 );
2097:                 if let Some(instance) = plans
2098:                     .iter()
2099:                     .flat_map(|(_, p)| &p.anomalies)
2100:                     .find(|a| a.kind == AnomalyKind::ArchwayRoom)
2101:                 {
2102:                     found = Some(instance.clone());
2103:                     break 'search;
2104:                 }
2105:             }
2106:         }
2107:         let instance = found.expect("no archway fixture found");
2108:         assert!(instance.gates.is_empty(), "arch rooms must carry no gates");
2109:         assert!(instance.arch.is_some());
2110: 
2111:         let forged = RealitySnapshot::new(vec![AnomalyStateStamp::new(
2112:             instance.id,
2113:             7,
2114:             0.0,
2115:             Axis2::X,
2116:             AxisDirection::Positive,
2117:             crate::domain::entities::anomaly::RedRoomPhase::Outside,
2118:             0,
2119:             0,
2120:         )]);
2121:         let empty = RealitySnapshot::empty();
2122:         let mut pale_seen = false;
2123:         let mut carpet_seen = false;
2124:         let mut lz = -instance.footprint.half_z + 0.2;
2125:         while lz < instance.footprint.half_z {
2126:             let mut lx = -instance.footprint.half_x + 0.2;
2127:             while lx < instance.footprint.half_x {
2128:                 let p = instance.world_coords(lx, lz);
2129:                 let a = sample_anomaly(&instance, &noise, 42, &config, &empty, p.x, p.z);
2130:                 let b = sample_anomaly(&instance, &noise, 42, &config, &forged, p.x, p.z);
2131:                 assert_eq!(a, b, "archway geometry moved under a forged epoch");
2132:                 if a.solid && a.wall_material == VOXEL_PALE_WALL {
2133:                     pale_seen = true;
2134:                 }
2135:                 if !a.solid && a.floor_material == VOXEL_DEEP_CARPET {
2136:                     carpet_seen = true;
2137:                 }
2138:                 lx += 0.4;
2139:             }
2140:             lz += 0.4;
2141:         }
2142:         assert!(pale_seen, "no pale arch wall voxelized");
2143:         assert!(carpet_seen, "no deep wet carpet voxelized");
2144:     }

2150:     fn pillar_expanse_is_dry_and_its_bearing_lane_is_lit_in_rhythm() {

2186:     #[test]
2187:     fn blackout_cues_are_glimmers_and_floors_pool_fluid() {

2212:             let mut sx = -instance.footprint.half_x * 0.5;

2227:     #[test]
2228:     fn test_print_ascii_map() {
2229:         let noise = SimpleNoiseProvider::new();
2230:         let tuning = LevelTuning::default();
2231:         let config = GeneratorConfig::low_spec();
2232:         // The whole of region (0,0) at 0.5 u per character.
2233:         let plans =
2234:             BackroomsLevel::region_plans_for(Position::new(0.0, 0.0), 80.0, 42, &config, &noise);
2235:         let plan = &plans.iter().find(|(k, _)| *k == (0, 0)).unwrap().1;
2236:         let mut map = String::new();
2237:         for sz in 0..160 {
2238:             for sx in 0..160 {
2239:                 let wx = sx as f32 * 0.5 + 0.25;
2240:                 let wz = sz as f32 * 0.5 + 0.25;
2241:                 let col = BackroomsLevel::plan_column(plan, &noise, 42, &tuning, wx, wz);
2242:                 if col.solid {
2243:                     map.push('#');
2244:                 } else if col.light {
2245:                     map.push('*');
2246:                 } else if col.lintel_from_units.is_some() {

2249:                     map.push(' ');
````

````rust
189: /// Touch-play session state. On touch devices there is no pointer lock:
190: /// tapping the overlay enters "touch play" directly, the left half of the
191: /// screen is a virtual joystick (drag from touch-down point), and the right
192: /// half is a look surface. On-screen buttons cover flashlight and menu.
193: #[derive(Default)]
194: struct TouchState {
195:     /// True while playing in touch mode.
196:     active: bool,

203: /// Renderer selection: surfaces by default, `?renderer=splat` for the
204: /// instanced face-splat path (default candidate once parity/perf is
205: /// confirmed), `?renderer=raymarch` for the retained SVO debug path,
206: /// `?renderer=cpu` for software fallback.
207: fn create_renderer(canvas: &HtmlCanvasElement, query: &str) -> Result<DriverRenderer, JsValue> {
208:     if query.contains("renderer=cpu") {
209:         return Ok(DriverRenderer::Cpu(CpuCanvasRenderer::new(canvas)?));
210:     }
211:     if query.contains("renderer=raymarch") {
212:         return WebGl2Renderer::new(canvas).map(DriverRenderer::Raymarch);
213:     }
214:     if query.contains("renderer=splat") {
215:         let profile = if query.contains("spec=high") {
216:             SplatProfile::high()
217:         } else {
218:             SplatProfile::low()
219:         };
220:         match SplatRenderer::new(canvas, profile) {
221:             Ok(gpu) => return Ok(DriverRenderer::Splat(gpu)),
222:             Err(err) => {
223:                 web_sys::console::warn_2(
224:                     &JsValue::from_str(
225:                         "splat renderer unavailable, falling back to surface meshes:",
226:                     ),
227:                     &err,
228:                 );
229:             }
230:         }
231:     }
232:     match SurfaceRenderer::new(canvas) {
233:         Ok(gpu) => Ok(DriverRenderer::Surface(gpu)),
234:         Err(err) => {
235:             web_sys::console::warn_2(
236:                 &JsValue::from_str(
237:                     "WebGL2 surface renderer unavailable, falling back to CPU splatting:",
238:                 ),
239:                 &err,
240:             );
241:             Ok(DriverRenderer::Cpu(CpuCanvasRenderer::new(canvas)?))
242:         }
243:     }
244: }

246: pub fn boot() -> Result<(), JsValue> {
247:     let window = web_sys::window().ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("no window"))?;
248:     let document = window
249:         .document()
250:         .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str("no document"))?;
251: 
252:     let canvas: HtmlCanvasElement =
253:         element(&document, "view").or_else(|_| element(&document, "game-canvas"))?;
254:     let overlay: HtmlElement = element(&document, "overlay")?;
255:     let status_msg: HtmlElement = element(&document, "status-msg")?;
256:     let play_msg: HtmlElement = element(&document, "play-msg")?;
257: 
258:     // ?spec=high -> 20u chunks, 5x5 streaming radius, 0.1u voxels.
259:     // Default is the low-spec profile: 10u chunks, 3x3 radius, 0.2u voxels.
260:     // Generation controls: ?seed=… (number or any text) plus the density
261:     // knobs ?pillars= ?walls= ?atria= ?lights= (multipliers, default 1).
262:     let query = window.location().search().unwrap_or_default();
263:     web_sys::console::log_1(&format!("BOOTING ENGINE: query={}", query).into());
264:     // Renderer optimization switchboard (?rt_<name>=0|1); see
265:     // application::render_settings for the catalog of switches.
266:     crate::init_render_toggles(&query);
267:     let gen_params = parse_generation_params(&query, WORLD_SEED);
268:     let high_spec = query.contains("spec=high");
269:     // Spawn on the main corridor of region (0,0), looking east down its
270:     // west leg: the first frame is a lit, walled corridor receding into
271:     // fog — the player knows immediately that this is the Backrooms.
272:     let spawn_at = vackrooms::use_cases::region_plan::spawn_point(gen_params.seed);
273:     let spawn = [spawn_at.x, 1.7, spawn_at.z];
274:     let spawn_yaw = -std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2; // face +X
275:     // ?level=34 boots straight into the grassland (debugging any level in
276:     // any renderer without waiting on a noclip roll).
277:     let initial_level = query
278:         .trim_start_matches('?')
279:         .split('&')
280:         .find_map(|pair| pair.strip_prefix("level="))
281:         .and_then(|v| v.parse::<u32>().ok())
282:         .unwrap_or(0);
283:     let (generator_config, engine_config) = if high_spec {
284:         (
285:             GeneratorConfig::high_spec()
286:                 .with_tuning(gen_params.tuning)
287:                 .with_anomalies(gen_params.anomalies),
288:             EngineConfig {
289:                 chunk_size: 20.0,
290:                 chunk_radius: 2,
291:                 seed: gen_params.seed,
292:                 spawn,
293:                 spawn_yaw,
294:                 // 5x5 footprint: the outer ring (>= 20 units away) stays at
295:                 // the coarse LOD, so high spec pays for ~9 fine chunks, not 25.
296:                 fine_distance: 25.0,
297:                 initial_level,
298:                 ..EngineConfig::default()
299:             },
300:         )
301:     } else {
302:         (
303:             GeneratorConfig::low_spec()
304:                 .with_tuning(gen_params.tuning)
305:                 .with_anomalies(gen_params.anomalies),
306:             EngineConfig {
307:                 seed: gen_params.seed,
308:                 spawn,
309:                 spawn_yaw,
310:                 initial_level,
311:                 ..EngineConfig::default()
312:             },
313:         )
314:     };
315: 
316:     let renderer = Rc::new(RefCell::new(create_renderer(&canvas, &query)?));
317:     if let Ok(hud_renderer) = element::<HtmlElement>(&document, "hud-renderer") {
318:         hud_renderer.set_text_content(Some(renderer.borrow().label()));
319:     }
320:     // Names the section the player is standing in (top-right HUD). The
321:     // locator re-derives the deterministic region plan, cached per region.
322:     let locator = Rc::new(RefCell::new(SectionLocator::new(
323:         gen_params.seed,
324:         generator_config,
325:     )));
326:     // Chunk generation runs on a Web Worker pool so crossing a streaming
327:     // boundary never stalls the frame loop. `?workers=0` forces the old
328:     // synchronous in-thread source (also the fallback if workers fail).
329:     let source: Box<dyn crate::application::ports::ChunkSourcePort> = if query.contains("workers=0")
330:     {
331:         Box::new(LocalChunkSource::with_telemetry(
332:             SimpleNoiseProvider::new(),
333:             gen_params.seed,
334:             generator_config,
335:             &CONSOLE_TELEMETRY,
336:         ))
337:     } else {
338:         match crate::drivers::worker_source::WorkerChunkSource::new(&query, WORLD_SEED) {
339:             Ok(pool) => {
340:                 web_sys::console::log_1(
341:                     &format!("chunk generation: {} worker threads", pool.pool_size()).into(),
342:                 );
343:                 Box::new(pool)
344:             }
345:             Err(err) => {
346:                 web_sys::console::warn_2(
347:                     &JsValue::from_str(
348:                         "worker pool unavailable, falling back to in-thread generation:",
349:                     ),
350:                     &err,
351:                 );
352:                 Box::new(LocalChunkSource::with_telemetry(
353:                     SimpleNoiseProvider::new(),
354:                     gen_params.seed,
355:                     generator_config,
356:                     &CONSOLE_TELEMETRY,
357:                 ))
358:             }
359:         }
360:     };
361:     let engine = Rc::new(RefCell::new(Engine::new(
362:         engine_config,
363:         Box::new(SharedRenderer(renderer.clone())),
364:         source,
365:     )));
366:     let input = Rc::new(RefCell::new(InputCollector::new()));
367:     let touch = Rc::new(RefCell::new(TouchState::default()));
368: 
369:     let is_capture = query.contains("capture=1");
370:     if is_capture {
371:         let mut cam_pos = spawn;
372:         if let Some(pos_idx) = query.find("camera=") {
373:             let s = &query[pos_idx + 7..];
374:             let end = s.find('&').unwrap_or(s.len());
375:             let parts: Vec<&str> = s[..end].split(',').collect();
376:             if parts.len() == 3 {
377:                 if let (Ok(x), Ok(y), Ok(z)) = (
378:                     parts[0].parse::<f32>(),
379:                     parts[1].parse::<f32>(),
380:                     parts[2].parse::<f32>(),
381:                 ) {
382:                     cam_pos = [x, y, z];
383:                 }
384:             }
385:         }
386:         let mut yaw_val = 1.5708f32;
387:         if let Some(yaw_idx) = query.find("yaw=") {
388:             let s = &query[yaw_idx + 4..];
389:             let end = s.find('&').unwrap_or(s.len());
390:             if let Ok(y) = s[..end].parse::<f32>() {
391:                 yaw_val = y;
392:             }
393:         }
394:         let mut pitch_val = -0.05f32;
395:         if let Some(pitch_idx) = query.find("pitch=") {
396:             let s = &query[pitch_idx + 6..];
397:             let end = s.find('&').unwrap_or(s.len());
398:             if let Ok(p) = s[..end].parse::<f32>() {
399:                 pitch_val = p;
400:             }
401:         }
402:         engine
403:             .borrow_mut()
404:             .teleport_player(cam_pos, yaw_val, pitch_val);
405:     }
406: 
407:     if !is_capture {
408:         attach_input_listeners(&document, &canvas, &overlay, &input, &touch)?;
409:         attach_touch_listeners(&document, &canvas, &overlay, &input, &touch)?;
410:     }
411:     run_frame_loop(
412:         window, document, canvas, overlay, status_msg, play_msg, renderer, engine, input, locator,
413:     )
414: }

416: fn element<T: JsCast>(document: &Document, id: &str) -> Result<T, JsValue> {
417:     document
418:         .get_element_by_id(id)
419:         .ok_or_else(|| JsValue::from_str(&format!("missing #{id} element")))?
420:         .dyn_into::<T>()
421:         .map_err(|_| JsValue::from_str(&format!("#{id} has unexpected element type")))
422: }
423: 
424: fn attach_input_listeners(
425:     document: &Document,
426:     canvas: &HtmlCanvasElement,
427:     overlay: &HtmlElement,
428:     input: &Rc<RefCell<InputCollector>>,
429:     touch: &Rc<RefCell<TouchState>>,
430: ) -> Result<(), JsValue> {
431:     // Keyboard: KeyboardEvent.code -> MoveIntent, mapped by the input adapter.
432:     for (event, pressed) in [("keydown", true), ("keyup", false)] {
433:         let input = input.clone();
434:         let closure = Closure::<dyn FnMut(KeyboardEvent)>::new(move |e: KeyboardEvent| {
435:             // F3 toggles the anomaly debug overlay (and never reaches the
436:             // browser's own F3 find shortcut).
437:             if pressed && e.code() == "F3" {
438:                 e.prevent_default();
439:                 if !e.repeat() {
440:                     let on = crate::ANOMALY_DEBUG.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
441:                     crate::ANOMALY_DEBUG.store(!on, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
442:                 }
443:                 return;
444:             }
445:             if !e.repeat() {
446:                 input.borrow_mut().key_event(&e.code(), pressed);
447:             }
448:         });
449:         document.add_event_listener_with_callback(event, closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref())?;
450:         closure.forget();
451:     }
452: 
453:     // Mouse look (deltas are ignored by the adapter unless pointer-locked).
454:     {
455:         let input = input.clone();
456:         let closure = Closure::<dyn FnMut(MouseEvent)>::new(move |e: MouseEvent| {
457:             input
458:                 .borrow_mut()
459:                 .mouse_delta(e.movement_x() as f32, e.movement_y() as f32);
460:         });
461:         document.add_event_listener_with_callback("mousemove", closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref())?;
462:         closure.forget();
463:     }
464: 
465:     // Click-to-play: the overlay requests pointer lock on the render canvas.
466:     {
467:         let canvas = canvas.clone();
468:         let closure = Closure::<dyn FnMut()>::new(move || {
469:             canvas.request_pointer_lock();
470:         });
471:         overlay.add_event_listener_with_callback("click", closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref())?;
472:         closure.forget();
473:     }
474: 
475:     // Pointer-lock state drives both the input adapter and overlay
476:     // visibility — unless a touch session owns them.
477:     {
478:         let input = input.clone();
479:         let touch = touch.clone();
480:         let doc_for_closure = document.clone();
481:         let overlay = overlay.clone();
482:         let closure = Closure::<dyn FnMut()>::new(move || {
483:             if touch.borrow().active {
484:                 return;
485:             }
486:             let locked = doc_for_closure.pointer_lock_element().is_some();
487:             input.borrow_mut().set_locked(locked);
488:             let _ = overlay
489:                 .style()
490:                 .set_property("display", if locked { "none" } else { "flex" });
491:         });
492:         document.add_event_listener_with_callback(
493:             "pointerlockchange",
494:             closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref(),
495:         )?;
496:         closure.forget();
497:     }
498: 
499:     Ok(())
500: }
501: 
502: /// Wires the touch controls: overlay tap-to-play, split-screen virtual
503: /// joystick + look surface on the canvas, and the on-screen flashlight and
504: /// menu buttons (`#btn-flashlight`, `#btn-menu`, inside `#touch-ui`).
505: fn attach_touch_listeners(
506:     document: &Document,
507:     canvas: &HtmlCanvasElement,
508:     overlay: &HtmlElement,
509:     input: &Rc<RefCell<InputCollector>>,
510:     touch: &Rc<RefCell<TouchState>>,
511: ) -> Result<(), JsValue> {
512:     let touch_ui: Option<HtmlElement> = element(document, "touch-ui").ok();
513: 
514:     let set_touch_play = {
515:         let input = input.clone();
516:         let touch = touch.clone();
517:         let overlay = overlay.clone();
518:         let touch_ui = touch_ui.clone();
519:         Rc::new(move |on: bool| {
520:             touch.borrow_mut().active = on;
521:             let mut input = input.borrow_mut();
522:             input.set_locked(on);
523:             if !on {
524:                 input.set_move_axes(0.0, 0.0);
525:             }
526:             let _ = overlay
527:                 .style()
528:                 .set_property("display", if on { "none" } else { "flex" });
529:             if let Some(ui) = &touch_ui {
530:                 let _ = ui
531:                     .style()
532:                     .set_property("display", if on { "flex" } else { "none" });
533:             }
534:         })
535:     };
536: 
537:     // Tap the overlay -> enter touch play (the desktop path uses `click` +
538:     // pointer lock instead). prevent_default suppresses the synthetic click
539:     // that would otherwise also request pointer lock.
540:     {
541:         let enter = set_touch_play.clone();
542:         let closure = Closure::<dyn FnMut(TouchEvent)>::new(move |e: TouchEvent| {
543:             e.prevent_default();
544:             enter(true);
545:         });
546:         overlay.add_event_listener_with_callback("touchend", closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref())?;
547:         closure.forget();
548:     }
549: 
550:     // Canvas touches: left 45% of the screen is the movement joystick,
551:     // the rest is the look surface.
552:     {
553:         let touch = touch.clone();
554:         let closure = Closure::<dyn FnMut(TouchEvent)>::new(move |e: TouchEvent| {
555:             let mut st = touch.borrow_mut();
556:             if !st.active {
557:                 return;
558:             }
559:             e.prevent_default();
560:             let move_split = web_sys::window()
561:                 .and_then(|w| w.inner_width().ok())
562:                 .and_then(|v| v.as_f64())
563:                 .unwrap_or(800.0)
564:                 * 0.45;
565:             let changed = e.changed_touches();
566:             for i in 0..changed.length() {
567:                 let Some(t) = changed.item(i) else { continue };
568:                 let (x, y) = (t.client_x() as f64, t.client_y() as f64);
569:                 if x < move_split && st.move_id.is_none() {
570:                     st.move_id = Some(t.identifier());
571:                     st.move_origin = (x, y);
572:                 } else if st.look_id.is_none() {
573:                     st.look_id = Some(t.identifier());
574:                     st.look_last = (x, y);
575:                 }
576:             }
577:         });
578:         canvas.add_event_listener_with_callback("touchstart", closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref())?;
579:         closure.forget();
580:     }
581: 
582:     {
583:         let input = input.clone();
584:         let touch = touch.clone();
585:         let closure = Closure::<dyn FnMut(TouchEvent)>::new(move |e: TouchEvent| {
586:             let mut st = touch.borrow_mut();
587:             if !st.active {
588:                 return;
589:             }
590:             e.prevent_default();
591:             let changed = e.changed_touches();
592:             for i in 0..changed.length() {
593:                 let Some(t) = changed.item(i) else { continue };
594:                 let (x, y) = (t.client_x() as f64, t.client_y() as f64);
595:                 if st.move_id == Some(t.identifier()) {
596:                     let dx = ((x - st.move_origin.0) / JOYSTICK_RADIUS).clamp(-1.0, 1.0);
597:                     let dy = ((y - st.move_origin.1) / JOYSTICK_RADIUS).clamp(-1.0, 1.0);
598:                     // Screen-space up (negative dy) walks forward.
599:                     input.borrow_mut().set_move_axes(dx as f32, -dy as f32);
600:                 } else if st.look_id == Some(t.identifier()) {
601:                     let (lx, ly) = st.look_last;
602:                     st.look_last = (x, y);
603:                     input.borrow_mut().mouse_delta(
604:                         (x - lx) as f32 * TOUCH_LOOK_SCALE,
605:                         (y - ly) as f32 * TOUCH_LOOK_SCALE,
606:                     );
607:                 }
608:             }
609:         });
610:         canvas.add_event_listener_with_callback("touchmove", closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref())?;
611:         closure.forget();
612:     }
613: 
614:     for event in ["touchend", "touchcancel"] {
615:         let input = input.clone();
616:         let touch = touch.clone();
617:         let closure = Closure::<dyn FnMut(TouchEvent)>::new(move |e: TouchEvent| {
618:             let mut st = touch.borrow_mut();
619:             if !st.active {
620:                 return;
621:             }
622:             e.prevent_default();
623:             let changed = e.changed_touches();
624:             for i in 0..changed.length() {
625:                 let Some(t) = changed.item(i) else { continue };
626:                 if st.move_id == Some(t.identifier()) {
627:                     st.move_id = None;
628:                     input.borrow_mut().set_move_axes(0.0, 0.0);
629:                 } else if st.look_id == Some(t.identifier()) {
630:                     st.look_id = None;
631:                 }
632:             }
633:         });
634:         canvas.add_event_listener_with_callback(event, closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref())?;
635:         closure.forget();
636:     }
637: 
638:     // On-screen buttons (optional elements; the page may omit them).
639:     if let Ok(btn) = element::<HtmlElement>(document, "btn-flare") {
640:         let input = input.clone();
641:         let closure = Closure::<dyn FnMut(web_sys::Event)>::new(move |e: web_sys::Event| {
642:             e.prevent_default();
643:             e.stop_propagation();
644:             input.borrow_mut().queue_flare();
645:         });
646:         btn.add_event_listener_with_callback("touchend", closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref())?;
647:         btn.add_event_listener_with_callback("click", closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref())?;
648:         closure.forget();
649:     }
650:     if let Ok(btn) = element::<HtmlElement>(document, "btn-flashlight") {
651:         let input = input.clone();
652:         let closure = Closure::<dyn FnMut(web_sys::Event)>::new(move |e: web_sys::Event| {
653:             e.prevent_default();
654:             e.stop_propagation();
655:             input.borrow_mut().toggle_flashlight();
656:         });
657:         btn.add_event_listener_with_callback("touchend", closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref())?;
658:         btn.add_event_listener_with_callback("click", closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref())?;
659:         closure.forget();
660:     }
661:     if let Ok(btn) = element::<HtmlElement>(document, "btn-menu") {
662:         let exit = set_touch_play.clone();
663:         let closure = Closure::<dyn FnMut(web_sys::Event)>::new(move |e: web_sys::Event| {
664:             e.prevent_default();
665:             e.stop_propagation();
666:             exit(false);
667:         });
668:         btn.add_event_listener_with_callback("touchend", closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref())?;
669:         btn.add_event_listener_with_callback("click", closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref())?;
670:         closure.forget();
671:     }
672: 
673:     Ok(())
674: }
675: 
676: #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
677: fn run_frame_loop(
678:     window: Window,
679:     _document: Document,
680:     canvas: HtmlCanvasElement,
681:     _overlay: HtmlElement,
682:     status_msg: HtmlElement,
683:     play_msg: HtmlElement,
684:     renderer: Rc<RefCell<DriverRenderer>>,
685:     engine: Rc<RefCell<Engine>>,
686:     input: Rc<RefCell<InputCollector>>,
687:     locator: Rc<RefCell<SectionLocator>>,
688: ) -> Result<(), JsValue> {
689:     let hud_fps: HtmlElement = element(window.document().as_ref().unwrap(), "hud-fps")?;
690:     let hud_chunks: HtmlElement = element(window.document().as_ref().unwrap(), "hud-chunks")?;
691:     let hud_nodes: HtmlElement = element(window.document().as_ref().unwrap(), "hud-nodes")?;
692:     let hud_scale: HtmlElement = element(window.document().as_ref().unwrap(), "hud-scale")?;
693:     let hud_gpu: HtmlElement = element(window.document().as_ref().unwrap(), "hud-gpu")?;
694:     let hud_dist: Option<HtmlElement> =
695:         element(window.document().as_ref().unwrap(), "hud-dist").ok();
696:     let last_dist_text = Rc::new(RefCell::new(String::new()));
697:     // Top-right section readout and the anomaly debug overlay; both are
698:     // optional page elements so older/embedded shells keep working.
699:     let hud_section: Option<HtmlElement> =
700:         element(window.document().as_ref().unwrap(), "hud-section").ok();
701:     let last_section_text = Rc::new(RefCell::new(String::new()));
702:     let debug_overlay: Option<HtmlElement> =
703:         element(window.document().as_ref().unwrap(), "debug-overlay").ok();
704:     let debug_overlay_visible = Rc::new(Cell::new(false));
705: 
706:     let query = window.location().search().unwrap_or_default();
707:     let is_capture = query.contains("capture=1");
708:     // Visual baselines get fifteen settled frames; renderer smoke tests only
709:     // need proof that a loaded scene completed a couple of real draws. The
710:     // shorter path keeps deliberately unoptimized reference renderers usable
711:     // under software WebGL in CI without weakening screenshot baselines.
712:     let capture_settle_frames = if query.contains("smoke=1") { 2 } else { 15 };
713:     let capture_frame_counter = Rc::new(Cell::new(0u32));
714: 
715:     let last_time = Rc::new(Cell::new(0.0f64));
716:     let frame_count = Rc::new(Cell::new(0u32));
717:     let hud_window_start = Rc::new(Cell::new(0.0f64));
718:     let was_ready = Rc::new(Cell::new(false));
719: 
720:     // Standard self-referential rAF closure pattern.
721:     let raf_handle: Rc<RefCell<Option<Closure<dyn FnMut(f64)>>>> = Rc::new(RefCell::new(None));
722:     let raf_handle_clone = raf_handle.clone();
723: 
724:     let loop_window = window.clone();
725:     *raf_handle.borrow_mut() = Some(Closure::new(move |time_ms: f64| {
726:         let dt = if is_capture {
727:             0.0
728:         } else if last_time.get() > 0.0 {
729:             ((time_ms - last_time.get()) / 1000.0) as f32
730:         } else {
731:             1.0 / 60.0
732:         };
733:         last_time.set(time_ms);
734: 
735:         // Adaptive resolution: size the backing store to
736:         // window * governor scale * renderer base factor. A non-zero
737:         // user override (settings menu) replaces the governor scale.
738:         {
739:             let forced =
740:                 f32::from_bits(crate::RENDER_SCALE_BITS.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed));
741:             let governor_scale = if forced > 0.0 {
742:                 forced as f64
743:             } else {
744:                 engine.borrow().stats().resolution_scale as f64
745:             };
746:             let scale = governor_scale * renderer.borrow().resolution_factor();
747:             let mut target_w = (loop_window
748:                 .inner_width()
749:                 .ok()
750:                 .and_then(|v| v.as_f64())
751:                 .unwrap_or(800.0)
752:                 * scale)
753:                 .max(1.0) as u32;
754:             let mut target_h = (loop_window
755:                 .inner_height()
756:                 .ok()
757:                 .and_then(|v| v.as_f64())
758:                 .unwrap_or(600.0)
759:                 * scale)
760:                 .max(1.0) as u32;
761: 
762:             if matches!(*renderer.borrow(), DriverRenderer::Cpu(_)) {
763:                 let max_w = 480.0;
764:                 let max_h = 270.0;
765:                 let cap_scale = (max_w / target_w as f32)
766:                     .min(max_h as f32 / target_h as f32)
767:                     .min(1.0);
768:                 target_w = (target_w as f32 * cap_scale).round() as u32;
769:                 target_h = (target_h as f32 * cap_scale).round() as u32;
770:             }
771: 
772:             if canvas.width() != target_w || canvas.height() != target_h {
773:                 canvas.set_width(target_w);
774:                 canvas.set_height(target_h);
775:                 renderer.borrow_mut().resize(target_w, target_h);
776:             }
777:         }
778: 
779:         let frame_input = input.borrow_mut().take_frame();
780:         engine.borrow_mut().tick(dt, &frame_input);
781: 
782:         // Loading overlay: flip to "click to play" once the spawn chunk is in.
783:         let stats = engine.borrow().stats();
784:         if stats.ready && !was_ready.get() {
785:             was_ready.set(true);
786:             let _ = status_msg.style().set_property("display", "none");
787:             let _ = play_msg.style().set_property("display", "block");
788:         }
789: 
790:         // HUD refresh at a fixed frame cadence.
791:         frame_count.set(frame_count.get() + 1);
792:         if frame_count.get() % HUD_INTERVAL == 0 {
793:             let elapsed = (time_ms - hud_window_start.get()) / 1000.0;
794:             if elapsed > 0.0 {
795:                 let fps = (HUD_INTERVAL as f64 / elapsed).round();
796:                 hud_fps.set_text_content(Some(&fps.to_string()));
797:             }
798:             hud_window_start.set(time_ms);
799:             hud_chunks.set_text_content(Some(&format!(
800:                 "{}/{}",
801:                 stats.fine_chunks, stats.resident_chunks
802:             )));
803:             hud_nodes.set_text_content(Some(&stats.atlas_nodes.to_string()));
804:             hud_scale.set_text_content(Some(&format!("{:.0}%", stats.resolution_scale * 100.0)));
805:             if let Some(hud_dist) = &hud_dist {
806:                 // Restrained rounding, and only touch the DOM on change.
807:                 let text = format!("{:.0} m", stats.distance_m);
808:                 let mut last = last_dist_text.borrow_mut();
809:                 if *last != text {
810:                     hud_dist.set_text_content(Some(&text));
811:                     *last = text;
812:                 }
813:             }
814:             let gpu = renderer.borrow().gpu_frame_ms();
815:             let cpu_telemetry = renderer.borrow().cpu_telemetry_string();
816:             if let Some(text) = cpu_telemetry {
817:                 hud_gpu.set_text_content(Some(&text));
818:             } else {
819:                 hud_gpu.set_text_content(Some(
820:                     &gpu.map(|ms| format!("{ms:.1} ms"))
821:                         .unwrap_or_else(|| "n/a".to_string()),
822:                 ));
823:             }
824: 
825:             // Top-right section readout ("LEVEL 0 · MAIN CORRIDOR · ...").
826:             // The locator caches its region plan, so this is cheap except on
827:             // a region crossing; only touch the DOM when the text changes.
828:             if let Some(hud_section) = &hud_section {
829:                 let (level, pos) = {
830:                     let engine_ref = engine.borrow();
831:                     (engine_ref.level(), engine_ref.player().position)
832:                 };
833:                 let text = locator.borrow_mut().describe(level, pos[0], pos[2]);
834:                 let mut last = last_section_text.borrow_mut();
835:                 if *last != text {
836:                     hud_section.set_text_content(Some(&text));
837:                     *last = text;
838:                 }
839:             }
840: 
841:             // Anomaly debug overlay (F3 or the settings switch).
842:             if let Some(overlay_el) = &debug_overlay {
843:                 let on = crate::ANOMALY_DEBUG.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
844:                 if on {
845:                     overlay_el.set_text_content(Some(&engine.borrow().anomaly_debug_text()));
846:                 }
847:                 if on != debug_overlay_visible.get() {
848:                     debug_overlay_visible.set(on);
849:                     let _ = overlay_el
850:                         .style()
851:                         .set_property("display", if on { "block" } else { "none" });
852:                 }
853:             }
854:         }
855: 
856:         // In capture mode, wait until the camera chunk is loaded, then allow
857:         // the requested number of frames to settle before exposing readiness.
858:         if is_capture {
859:             let engine_ref = engine.borrow();
860:             let pos = engine_ref.player().position;
861:             let cs = engine_ref.chunk_size();
862:             let cam_chunk = crate::application::streaming::chunk_key(
863:                 (pos[0] / cs).floor() * cs,
864:                 (pos[2] / cs).floor() * cs,
865:             );
866:             if frame_count.get() % 30 == 0 {
867:                 web_sys::console::log_1(
868:                     &format!(
869:                         "[DEBUG CAPTURE] player pos: {:?}, cs: {}, cam_chunk: {:?}, resident: {}, ready: {}",
870:                         pos,
871:                         cs,
872:                         cam_chunk,
873:                         engine_ref.is_chunk_resident(cam_chunk),
874:                         engine_ref.stats().ready
875:                     )
876:                     .into(),
877:                 );
878:             }
879:             if engine_ref.is_chunk_resident(cam_chunk) {
880:                 let frames = capture_frame_counter.get();
881:                 if frames < capture_settle_frames {
882:                     capture_frame_counter.set(frames + 1);
883:                 } else {
884:                     if let Some(w) = web_sys::window() {
885:                         let _ = js_sys::Reflect::set(
886:                             &w,
887:                             &JsValue::from_str("__sceneReady"),
888:                             &JsValue::from_bool(true),
889:                         );
890:                     }
891:                 }
892:             }
893:         }
894: 
895:         // Schedule next frame.
896:         if let Some(closure) = raf_handle_clone.borrow().as_ref() {
897:             let _ = loop_window.request_animation_frame(closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref());
898:         }
899:     }));
900: 
901:     if let Some(closure) = raf_handle.borrow().as_ref() {
902:         window.request_animation_frame(closure.as_ref().unchecked_ref())?;
903:     }
904:     // Keep the closure (and everything it captures) alive forever.
905:     std::mem::forget(raf_handle);
906:     Ok(())
907: }
````
